3Jʋab bʋla pɩ kuoro, “A leŋ dɩ La TƖƖNA ŋaa dɩ ŋ laalɩyuoro-la pʋŋa pɛ naansɩɩŋ zɔlɔ, kuoro mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ba kala ŋaa ŋ nɩaa nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wʋdoho deeŋ a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa?”
4Ama kuoro sɩ bʋl wɩɩ-la nɛ chɩna a kɩɩ wɩɩ-la Jʋab sɩ bʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jʋab sii a gɔllɛ Iziral tinteeŋ kala aŋ mɩɩra kɔ Jerusalɛm.
5Ʋ kɔ a dagɛ laalɩyuoro-la kala niiŋ a pɩ Devit. Iziral tinteeŋ kala lɛ, laalɩyuoroo fa ŋaa bʋɩba bʋɩ nɛ arɩ bʋɩ zɔlɔ, Juda ma nɩaa ŋaa bʋɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii. 6Ama Jʋab fa bɩ Levi doho arɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa laalɩyuoro dɩɩsa pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ fa bɩ kuoro nii-la sɛyɛ. 7Wɩɩ-la kuoro sɩ bʋla ma fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ dɔgɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
8Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩa, “Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ bal nɛ. Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, joŋo chɛmɛ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ cheerii-la mɩ-na ŋ tɩntɩnna lɛ. Nɩyaarɩ wɩɩ nɛ mɩ ŋaa.”
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Gad sɩ ŋaa Devit sɩɩ-naara, 10“Mʋ a bʋla pɩ Devit, ‘Wɩɩ-la mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩaa batori nɛ mɩ joŋo bibil ŋ sɩpaaŋ. Lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩ jaŋ cho dɩ mɩ joŋo ŋaa ŋ lɛ.’ ”
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Gad mʋ Devit teeŋ a bʋl, “Wɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ daga nɛ ŋ-la, lɩɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ: 12Ŋŋ chɛ dɩ losuŋ jʋʋ ŋ tinteeŋ jɩsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kiriŋ baarɛ chɛnsɩŋ batori nɛ koo ŋŋ chɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA leŋ dɩ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ kʋ kpʋ ŋ tinteeŋ nɩaa tapʋlaa batori nɛ, ka dɩ ʋ tɩndaara chei Iziral tinteeŋ? Bɩɩnɛ a joŋ ba tʋɔŋ kʋ-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ, dɩ mɩ mʋ bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ tɩmmɛ.”
13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Gad, “Mɩ tʋɔŋ chaasa chei nɛ. Leŋ dɩ mɩ jʋʋ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋʋ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ woruŋ, ama sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la jʋʋ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ.”
14Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA joŋ nyanyal bɔŋŋɔɔ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, nɩaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii sʋʋ.
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara dɩ ʋ mʋ chei Jerusalɛm. Ama ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ chei leriŋ, La TƖƖNA tʋɔŋ chei, ʋ bʋla pɩ ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ kpʋ nɩalɩŋ, “Ʋ maga nɛ, lemba magɛ ŋɩɩ.” Bʋa-la lɛ dɩ La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la fa hɛ Jebus tɩɩna kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Araʋna taha lɛ.
16Devit beŋ a na La TƖƖNA tɩndaara dɩ ʋ chɩŋ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ pɛgɛ a kori tokobiiŋ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ chei Jerusalɛm. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ sɩ laalɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛnnɩŋ tuu tele chu.
17Devit bʋla pɩ Wɩa, “Mɩ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ-la a chei wɩaa. Mɩ nɛ leŋe ba dɩɩsɛ laalɩyuoro-la. Nɩaa deemba nagɛ piesee nɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ ba ŋaa? Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, mɩɩra dɔgɩsɛ mɩ dɩ mɩ dɩa nɩaa nɛ, aŋ leŋ nɩaa deemba.” 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la hɛ Gad dɩ ʋ mʋ bʋla pɩ Devit arɩ ʋ sii mʋ Araʋna, Jebus tɩɩna-la taha a saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ pɩ La TƖƖNA nɩmɛ. 19Devit to La TƖƖNA niiŋ a mʋ, arɩ Gad sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. 20Araʋna arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ banɛsɛ faa ŋmoo mɛmpɛ nɛ taha-la lɛ aŋ na Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la, ʋ hambolibiisi-la sii fá mʋ faa. 21Araʋna sɩ na kuoro Devit dɩ ʋʋ kɔ, ʋ lɩɩ taha-la lɛ a mʋ chemu, a tuu kpirimi kuoro Devit sɩpaaŋ a kɛŋ ʋ sɩaa chu tinteeŋ.
22Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Yallɛ ŋ taha-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ saa koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, dɩ nyanyal-bɔŋ-la sɩ jʋʋ nɩalɩŋ ba sʋsʋʋ dɛrɛ. Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ʋ yallɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ.” 23Araʋna bʋla pɩ Devit, “Kuoro, mɩ nɩhɩaŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ taha-la a ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ. Na nɛ-ferisiŋ, ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Na mɛmpɛ ma ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, na mɩɩ-ŋmoori daasɩŋ ŋ jaŋ wuo kaa hɛ nyiniŋ. Kɩaa deemba kala nɛ mɩ-na Araʋna joŋo pɩ ŋ-na kuoro.”
24Kuoro Devit ma bɩra bʋl, “Aɩ, mɩ cho dɩ mɩ timiŋ ʋ yalɩŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala kpʋ a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩ mɩ bɩ chɩmɩŋ ŋmobo kʋ-la lɛ.” 25Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɔɔ taha-la arɩ nɛ-ferisi-la a tiŋ sɛlɩmɛ moribibiiŋ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ. 26Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit saa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nɩmɛ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a sʋl kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ nii-magɛ dɔŋɔ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. La TƖƖNA laa ʋ sʋla, a leŋ nyiniŋ lɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ a kʋ tuu dii Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ. 27Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl wɩaa pɩ ʋ tɩndaarʋ-la. Ʋ joŋ ʋ tokobiiŋ hɛ ʋ pɛɛŋ lɛ aŋ leŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. 28Devit sɩ na dɩ La TƖƖNA laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ Araʋna Jebus tɩɩna-la taha lɛ, ʋ bɩra kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɩmɛ. 29Bʋa-la lɛ La TƖƖNA lɛbɩ-la Mosis fa sɩ ŋaa, arɩ koru-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ fa hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a fa hɛ Gibioŋ dundolo-la nyuŋ, lee-la ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. 30Ama Devit fa bɩ wuo mʋ koru-la sɩ hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ a pɩɛsa na wɩaa Wɩa teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ faa fá La TƖƖNA tɩndaarʋ-la sɩ kori tokobii-la nɛ.

english_text:
1David said, “The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.”
David Prepares To Build the Temple
2David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple. 3He got a large supply of iron to make into nails and hinges for the doors, and he provided so much bronze that it could not be weighed. 4He also brought an endless supply of cedar logs from the cities of Sidon and Tyre.
5He said, “The temple for the Lord must be great, so that everyone in the world will know about it. But since my son Solomon is young and has no experience, I will make sure that everything is ready for the temple to be built.”
That's why David did all these things before he died.
David Instructs Solomon To Build the Temple
6David sent for his son Solomon and told him to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel. 7 He said:
My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped. 8But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple. 9But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful. 10Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
11Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him. 12May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law. 13 If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
14I have all the supplies you'll need to build the temple: You have more than 3,000 tons of gold and over 34,000 tons of silver. There's also plenty of wood, stone, and more bronze and iron than I could weigh. Ask for anything else you need. 15I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with 16gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
17David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon. 18David said:
The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people. 19Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_text:
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Daha nɛ maga dɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ hɛ.”
Ba kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit leŋ ba yɩrɛ nʋhʋɔra-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ a hɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ lɩɩsɛ nɩaa ba tʋɔŋ dɩ ba yɛrɛ tabɩaa dɩ ba nagɛ tiebiee dɩ ba kaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ. 3Ʋ chɛ hɔɔŋ yʋgɛ dɩ ba kaa ŋaa hɛŋŋɛɛ a kaa kpaasɛ borusuŋ hɛ boi-baala-la arɩ ba wenjeba. Ʋ fa chɛ kɔlɩɩŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo magɩsɛ. 4Devit fa chɛ kuolu daasɩŋ ma yʋgɛ nɛ ba sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ a bil. Sɩdɔŋ nɩaa arɩ Taaya nɩaa nɛ fa kɛŋ daasɩ-la kʋ pʋ.
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ ha ŋaa hambie nɛ ʋ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ, ama La TƖƖNA dɩa-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ saa maga dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ nɛ a zɔŋ woruŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala jɩŋ ʋ zɔmʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ chɛ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa saa dɩa-la a bil.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ chɛ kɩalɩŋ yʋgɛ woruŋ a bil aŋ-na sʋʋ.
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit yɩrɛ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ a bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ saa dɩa pɩ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa. 7Devit bɩra bʋla pɩ Solomoŋ, “Mɩ nanʋala, mɩ fa kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛ mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa nɩmɛ. 8Ama ŋ-la nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ: ‘Ŋ kpʋ nɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ, a yuo laalɩŋ ma woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ŋ dee bɩ jaŋ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ nɩmɛ. 9Ama ŋ jaŋ lʋl hambolibie dɩ ʋ dii kuoruŋ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fɩɛlɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa kala lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ jaŋ ŋaa Solomoŋ (yɩrɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ fɩɛlɩŋ), bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ kuoruŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɔŋ sɔm arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ. 10Ʋ nɛ jaŋ saa dɩa dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ nanʋala, dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma. Ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.’
11Mɩ nanʋala, La TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ saa ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 12A leŋ dɩ ŋ TƖƖNA Wɩa pɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ-jegilee dɩ ŋ nɛ kʋ dii kuoruŋ, dɩ ŋ wuo to ʋ wombiiŋ a beŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa. 13Dɩ ŋ nɛ fɩɛlɛ ŋ sɩaa a to ʋ niiriŋ arɩ ʋ wombie-la ʋ sɩ to Mosis lɛ a dagɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, wɩaa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ. Nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ.
14Mɩ na hɛɛŋ nɛ a chɛ kɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ jaŋ kaa saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ a bil. Mɩ chɛ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kiloba bʋɩ zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa, hɔpʋla ma yuŋuŋ ŋaa bʋɩ bʋɩba bʋɩ batori arɩ bʋɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ, kɔlɩɩŋ arɩ hɔɔŋ ma fa yʋga kɩɩ magɩsɩŋ nɛ, a pɛ daasɩŋ arɩ tabɩaa lɛ. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ŋ ha chɛ dɔnsʋŋ pɛ nɛ. 15Ŋ kɛŋ tɩntɩnnaa ma yʋgɛ nɛ: Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yɛrɛ tabɩaa, dɩɩ-saaraa, kapɩntaba, a pɛ gɔgɔɔ yʋgɛ ma sɩ jɩŋ 16sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ arɩ hɔɔŋ kaa tɩmɩŋ. Lɛɛlɛ suomi tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, La TƖƖNA jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.”
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kala dɩ ba pɛ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ lɛ. 18Ʋ bʋla pɩba, “Ma TƖƖNA Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, ʋ pɩma wiese nɛ ma sɛmɛ kala. Ʋ joŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ tɩɩ tintee-la a hɛ mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, tintee-la lɛɛlɛ ŋaa La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ nɩaa kʋa nɛ. 19Má saa to ma TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma wɩɩwɩɩ-kala. Má suomi La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ saanɩŋ, dɩ ma wuo joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA tɩntɩŋŋaa kaa kʋ jʋʋ bil ʋ dɩa-la tʋɔŋ ba sɩ jaŋ dɩdɛnnʋ.”

english_text:
David Assigns the Levites Their Duties
1 David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel. 2Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites. 3He then counted the Levite men who were at least 30 years old, and the total was 38,000. 4He said, “Twenty-four thousand of the Levites will be in charge of the temple, 6,000 will be temple officials and judges, 54,000 will be guards at the temple, and 4,000 will praise the Lord by playing the musical instruments I have given them.”
6David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
7Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei. 8Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel. 9They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran. 10-11Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
12Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. 13 Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name. 14-15Moses, the man of God, was the father of Gershom and Eliezer, and their descendants were considered Levites. 16Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel. 17Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children. 18The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith. 19Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam. 20Kohath's youngest son, Uzziel, was the father of Micah and Isshiah.
21Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. 22Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons. 23Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
24These were the clans and families of the tribe of Levi. Those who were 20 years and older were assigned to work at the Lord's temple.
25David said:
The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever. 26 And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place. 27From now on, all Levites at least 20 years old 28 will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure. 29They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
30Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him. 31They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done. 32They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_text:
Levi doho nɩaa
1Devit sɩ faasa kʋ hɩɛsɛ, ʋ leŋ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ dii kuoruŋ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. 2Ʋ yɩrɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaaraa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ, a pɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ. 3Ʋ dɩɩsɛ Levi doho nɩaa baal na-kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba kala ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ chori. 4Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “Nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ, nɩaa bʋɩ mara arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ maga dɩ ba bibeŋ La TƖƖNA dɩa-la tɩntɩŋŋaa, ka dɩ nɩaa bʋɩ balɩdʋ ma ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ sarɩya diiree. 5Nɩaa bʋɩ banɛsɛ ma jaŋ pʋpɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi baalaa, dɩ nɩaa bʋɩ banɛsɛ ma du kʋduulo-la mɩ sɩ chɛ bil dɩ ba kaa dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit kɛŋ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ kpaa leree batori ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa nyusuŋ: Gɛsɔŋ, Kohaf arɩ Mɛrarɩ.
Gɛsɔŋ doho nɩaa
7Gɛsɔŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ: Ladaŋ arɩ Sɩmɛɩ. 8Ladaŋ ma fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Jɛhɩɛl, Zɛtam arɩ Jowɛl. 9Sɩmɛɩ ma fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Sɛlɔmɔf, Hazɩɛl arɩ Haraŋ. Ba nɛ fa ŋaa Ladaŋ doho nɩaa nɩhɩasɩŋ. 10Sɩmɛɩ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ: Jahaf, Ziza, Jeyus arɩ Bɛrɩa. 11Jahaf nɛ fa ŋaa ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Ziza ma nɛ faa tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ, a pɛ Jeyus arɩ Bɛrɩa lɛ. Jeyus arɩ Bɛrɩa hambolibiisiŋ fa bɩ lʋla yʋgɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba dɩɩsɛ ba kala ba ŋaa dɩɩ-bala nɩaa nɛ. Ba joŋ tɩntɩŋ-bala pɩba.
Kohaf doho nɩaa
12Kohaf ma hambolibiisiŋ fa ŋaa banɛsɛ nɛ: Amɩram, Ɩzɩha, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl. 13Amɩram ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Arɔŋ arɩ Mosis. Ba fa lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ arɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa nɛ a jomba hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu dɩ ba bibeŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ, a kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩpɩ La TƖƖNA aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ wuu. 14Ba fa dɩɩsɛ Wɩa tɩntɩnna Mosis hambolibiisiŋ a pɛ Levi doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ. 15Mosis hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Gesom arɩ Elieza. 16Gesom bii-hɩaŋ nɛ fa Sʋbɛɛl. 17Elieza fa kɛŋ hambolibii-bala nɛ baa yɩrɛ Rehabia, ama Rehabia-na fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ woruŋ. 18Hambolibii-hɩaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa Sɛlɔmɩf. 19Hɛbʋrɔŋ ma hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Jɛrɩa ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, Amarɩa ʋ bii-lɩa, Jahazɩɛl ʋ bii-tori arɩ Jekamɩam ʋ bii-nɛsɛ. 20Ʋzɩɛl hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mɩka ʋ bii-hɩaŋ arɩ Ɩsɩa ʋ bii-lɩa.
Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa
21Mɛrarɩ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Mali arɩ Musi. Mali hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Elieza arɩ Kɩs. 22Elieza ka sʋʋ dɩ ʋ bɩ hambolibie kɛnɛ, toloo dʋndʋŋa nɛ ʋ lʋl. Tolie-la jaa ba nyɩŋ-bie Kɩs hambolibiisiŋ nɛ. 23Musi hambolibiisiŋ ŋaa batori nɛ: Mali, Ɛda arɩ Jɛrɩmɔf. 24Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩ dɩɩsɛba a ŋmʋnsɛ ba yɩraa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ba pɩba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ ba tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. 25Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋl, “La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa pɩ ʋ nɩaa wiese nɛ, ʋ tɩtɩa jaŋ hɛ Jerusalɛm lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. 26Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Levi doho nɩaa bɩra bɩ jaŋ chʋchʋŋ Wɩa lɛbɩ-la, koo kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa.” 27Devit sɩ to harɩŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ daga arɩ ba dɩɩsɛ Levi tɩɩna na-kala sɩ yi jɩsɩŋ mara koo a kɩɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ. 28Levi doho nɩaa tɩntɩmɩŋ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa lɛ a tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba beŋ Wɩa dɩa-la kaalɩsɩŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ dɩɩsɩŋ, aŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa ma sɩ disiniŋ kɛŋ. 29Ba nɛ jaŋ bibeŋ boroboro-la sɩ yie daŋ teebʋl nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ munuŋ, boroboro pɛrɛ pɛrɛ biisiŋ sɩ bɩ sɩbʋrʋŋ kɛnɛ, boroboro wasɩŋ arɩ ba sɩ kɛŋ nʋʋŋ a buu munuŋ arɩ kɩaa magɩsɩŋ. 30Tapʋlɩɩ kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, ba nɛ maga dɩ ba lɔllɛ La TƖƖNA a dɛnnʋ. 31Bʋa na-kala dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa kaa mʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ arɩ chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele arɩ gbielee dɔnsʋŋ, Levi doho nɩaa maga dɩ ba yi magɩna nɛ a hɛ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩŋ. 32Ŋɩɩ nɛ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ pɛ ba naambiiriŋ lɛ, Arɔŋ doho nɩaa lɛ a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala sɩ maga dɩ ba tɩŋ lɛbɩ-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ maga dɩ ba ŋɩŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ ma tʋɔŋ.

english_text:
David Assigns the Priests Their Duties
1Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. 2 But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
3David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
4Eleazar's descendants were divided into 16 groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders. 5However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
6As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
7-18Each group of priests went by the name of its family leader, and they were assigned their duties in the following order: Jehoiarib, Jedaiah, Harim, Seorim, Malchijah, Mijamin, Hakkoz, Abijah, Jeshua, Shecaniah, Eliashib, Jakim, Huppah, Jeshebeab, Bilgah, Immer, Hezir, Happizzez, Pethahiah, Jehezkel, Jachin, Gamul, Delaiah, Maaziah. 19These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron.
The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
20Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi:
Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
21Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
22Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
23Hebron had four sons, in the following order: Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
24Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
25Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
26Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.
27Jaaziah had three sons: Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri. 28-29Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel. 30Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth.
These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans. 31Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_text:
Ba kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kpaa bugoo
1Ba fa kɛŋ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa kpaa bugoo nɛ. Arɔŋ fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ banɛsɛ nɛ: Nadab, Abihu, Elieza arɩ Ɩtama. 2Ama Nadab arɩ Abihu nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ sʋʋ ba nyɩmma lɛ, ba fa bɩ bii lʋla. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit kɛŋ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa kaa hɛ bugoo dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Elieza doho nʋʋ arɩ Ahɩmɛlɛk sɩ ŋaa Ɩtama doho nʋʋ nɛ pɛ Devit lɛ. 4Ba fa kɛŋ Elieza doho nɩaa kpaa bugoo fii arɩ balɩdʋ nɛ, aŋ kɛŋ Ɩtama doho nɩaa ma kpaa bugoo chori, bɛɛ wɩaa, Elieza doho nɩaa baalaa sɩ ŋaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ nɛ fa yʋga. 5A tɩŋ Elieza arɩ Ɩtama doho nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ fa sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ Wɩa wɩaa sɩpaalaaraa, ba yie tɔnsɔ nɛ a kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaaba.
6Ba yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, Nɛtanɛl nanʋala Sɛmaaya sɩ ŋaa Levi doho nʋʋ nɛ yie ŋmʋnsɛ dɩa kʋhɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ bugu-la yɩrɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie ŋaa pɛ-naaraa nɛ: Kuoro Devit arɩ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, a pɛ Zadɔk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛ arɩ Abɩata nanʋala Ahɩmɛlɛk arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ. 7Ba sɩ tɔnsɛ bumbuŋ, Jehoyarib nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ, ba bɩra tɔnsɛ lɩa a lɩɩsɛ Jedaaya, 8Harɩm ŋaa tori, Siorim ŋaa nɛsɛ, 9Malɩkɩja ŋaa nɔŋ, Mɩjamɩŋ ŋaa dʋ, 10Hakɔs ŋaa pɛɩ, Abija ŋaa chori, 11Jesua ŋaa nibi, Sɛkanɩa ŋaa fii, 12Ɛlɩasɩb ŋaa fii arɩ kʋbala, Jakɩm ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa, 13Hupa ŋaa fii arɩ batori, Jɛsɛbɩab ŋaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ, 14Bɩlɩga ŋaa fii arɩ banɔŋ, Ɩma ŋaa fii arɩ balɩdʋ, 15Hɛzɩ ŋaa fii arɩ balɩpɛ, Hapɩzɛs ŋaa fii arɩ chori, 16Pɛtahɩa ŋaa fii arɩ nibi, Jɛhɛzɩkɛl ŋaa mara, 17Jakɩŋ ŋaa mara arɩ kʋbala, Gamʋl ŋaa mara arɩ balɩa, 18Delaaya ŋaa mara arɩ batori, Maazɩa ma ŋaa mara arɩ banɛsɛ.
19Ba fa dagɛ baalaa deemba ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo kʋŋkala ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ, arɩ La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ dagɛ ba naabalɩma Arɔŋ ŋɩɩ.
Levi doho nɩaa nɩkaanaa
20Levi doho nɩaa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Jedeya, ʋ ŋaa Amɩram arɩ Sʋbaɩl doho nʋʋ nɛ.
21Ɩsɩa, ʋ ma ŋaa Rehabia doho nʋʋ nɛ, 22Jahaf, ʋ ma ŋaa Ɩza arɩ Sɛlɔmɔf doho nʋʋ nɛ, 23Jɛrɩa, Amarɩa, Jahazɩɛl arɩ Jɛkamɩam. Ba ŋaa Hɛbʋrɔŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ, a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ a kaa tuu kʋbie. 24Mɩka nanʋala nɛ Samɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa Ʋzɩɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ.
25Mɩka naambie Ɩsɩa nanʋala Zɛkarɩya, ʋ ŋaa Ʋzɩɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ. 26Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa nɛ: Mali, Musi arɩ Jaazɩa. 27Jaazɩa hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Beno, Soham, Zaku, arɩ Ibiri. 28-29Mali hambolibiisiŋ nɛ Elieza arɩ Kɩs. Elieza bɩ hambolibie lʋla, ama Kɩs-na lʋl hambolibie nɛ baa yɩrɛ Jɛramɛɛl. 30Musi ma kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ batori nɛ: Mali, Ɛda arɩ Jɛrɩmɔf. Levi doho nɩaa nɛ ba kala. 31Dɩa na-kala kʋhɩaŋ arɩ ʋ ŋaana yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaa, a nagɛ ba naambiiriŋ Arɔŋ doho Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Kuoro Devit, Zadɔk, Ahɩmɛlɛk arɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ nɛ fa yie chɩŋ a ŋaa pɛ-naara.

english_text:
David Assigns the Temple Musicians Their Duties
1David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
2Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
3Jeduthun's six sons, Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, were under the direction of their father and played harps and sang praises to the Lord.
4Heman had 14 sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth. 5Heman was one of the king's prophets, and God honored Heman by giving him 14 sons and 3 daughters. 6His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple.
Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
7There were 288 of these men, and all of them were skilled musicians. 8David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
9-31The musicians were divided into 24 groups of twelve, and each group went by the name of their family leader. They were assigned their duties in the following order: Joseph, Gedaliah, Zaccur, Zeri, Nethaniah, Bukkiah, Asarelah, Jeshaiah, Mattaniah, Shimei, Uzziel, Hashabiah, Shebuel, Mattithiah, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Joshbekashah, Hanani, Mallothi, Eliathah, Hothir, Giddalti, Mahazioth, and Romamtiezer.
translation_text:
Yɩɩlɩ yɩɩraa
1Devit arɩ Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa lɩɩsɛ Asaf, Hemaŋ arɩ Jedutuŋ doho nɩaa nɛ dɩ ba nɛ kɛŋ nɩaa yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa dɩa lɛ ka ba dɛnnɛ hɩhɛ. Ba nɛ jaŋ dagɛ dɩ ba du chenniŋ, kɔnɛba a chɩgɩsɛ buguloo aa dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa nɛ ŋ-la: 2Asaf hambolibiisi-la banɛsɛ, Zaku, Josɛf, Nɛtanɩa arɩ Asarɛla. Ba nyɩmma Asaf nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaara. Dɩ kuoro nɛ sɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa, ʋ nɛ yie dɛnnɛ hɩhɛ.
3Jedutuŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Gedalia, Zeri, Jesaaya, Sɩmɛɩ, Hasabɩa arɩ Matɩtɩa. Ba nyɩmma nɛ fa ŋaa ba ma sɩpaalaara, a dagɛ ba du chenniŋ a yɩɩ yɩɩlaa dɩdɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA aŋ pɛ lʋlɔllʋ.
4Hemaŋ hambolibiisiŋ nɛ: Bukia, Matanɩa, Ʋzɩɛl, Sɛbaɩl, Jɛrɩmɔf, Hananaaya, Hanani, Ɛlɩata, Gidaliti, Romamiti-Ɛza, Josibekasa, Maloti, Hoti arɩ Mahazɩɔf. Ba ŋaa fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ. 5Hemaŋ nɛ fa ŋaa kuoro sɩɩ-naara. Wɩa pʋ hambolibiisiŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ, toloo ma batori arɩ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ a leŋ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.
6Hambolibiisi-la nyɩmmaba nɛ fa ŋaa ba sɩpaalaaraa, a yie leŋ ba chɩgɩsɛ buguloo, a du chenniŋ arɩ kɔnɛba dɩ ba nɩɩ chɛ ba dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ lɛ. Asaf, Jedutuŋ arɩ Hemaŋ yie ŋaa wɩɩ-la kala kuoro sɩ daga nɛ. 7Baala-la kala fa ŋaa zɔɔ-balɩa mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ chori nɛ. Ba fa dagɛ ba kala ba jɩŋ yɩɩlaa wɩaa nɛ woruŋ. 8Ka dɩ ba-na kɛŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa kpaaba, ba kala yie tɔnsɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋ ŋaa bii-bie koo nɩhɩaŋ, wʋjɩnnʋ koo gʋŋgʋnnʋ.
9Ba sɩ bugumo tɔnsɛ Asaf doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Josɛf arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ, ba ŋaa fii arɩ balɩa nɛ. Ba tɔnsɛ lɩa a lɩɩsɛ Gedalia arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 10Tori nɛ ŋaa Zaku arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 11Nɛsɛ nɛ ŋaa Ɩzɩrɩ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 12Nɔŋ nɛ ŋaa Nɛtanɩa arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 13Dʋ nɛ ŋaa Bukia arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 14Pɛɩ nɛ ŋaa Jesarela arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 15Chori nɛ ŋaa Jesaaya arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 16Nibi nɛ ŋaa Matanɩa arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 17Fiimiŋ nɛ ŋaa Sɩmɛɩ arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 18Fii arɩ kʋbala nɛ ŋaa Azarɛl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 19Fii arɩ balɩamɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Hasabɩa arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 20Fii arɩ batorumuŋ nɛ ŋaa Sʋbɛɛl arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 21Fii arɩ banɛsɩmɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Matɩtɩa arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 22Fii arɩ banɔmʋŋ nɛ ŋaa Jɛrɩmɔf arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 23Fii arɩ balɩdʋmʋŋ nɛ ŋaa Hananaaya arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 24Fii arɩ balɩpɛmɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Josibekasa arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 25Fii arɩ chorimuŋ nɛ ŋaa Hanani arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa, 26fii arɩ nibimiŋ nɛ ŋaa Maloti arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 27Mara nɛ ŋaa Ɛlɩata arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 28Mara arɩ kʋbala nɛ ŋaa Hotii arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 29Mara arɩ balɩa nɛ ŋaa Gidaliti arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 30Mara arɩ batori nɛ ŋaa Mahazɩɔf arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa. 31Mara arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ ŋaa Romamiti-Ɛza arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ, ba ma fii arɩ balɩa.

english_text:
The Temple Guards Are Assigned Their Duties
1The temple guards were also divided into groups according to clans.
Meshelemiah son of Kore was from the Korah clan and was a descendant of Asaph. 2He had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Zechariah, Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel, 3Elam, Jehohanan, and Eliehoenai.
4-5 Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
6-7Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan. 8There were 62 descendants of Obed-Edom who were strong enough to be guards at the temple.
9Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
10-11Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
12The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites. 13Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
14Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate. 15Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms. 16Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road.
The guards were assigned the following work schedule: 17Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms, 18four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
19These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari.
Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
20The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
21Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan. 22Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
23Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
24Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury. 25The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.
26Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders. 27And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple. 28Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah.
Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
29Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
30Hashabiah from the Hebron clan and 1,700 of his skilled relatives were the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the Israelite territories west of the Jordan River.
31-32Jerijah was the leader of the Hebron clan. David assigned him and 2,700 of his relatives, who were all respected family leaders, to be the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. David found out about these men during the fortieth year of his rule, when he had a list made of all the families in the Hebron clan. They were from the town of Jazer in the territory of Gilead.
translation_text:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ boi-baalaa
1Ba fa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaa kpaa bugoo nɛ, nyɩŋ-nɩa nyɩŋ-nɩa. Kore nyɩŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ, ʋ nanʋala Mɛsɛlɛmɩa sɩ ŋaa Asaf doho nʋʋ nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ. 2Mɛsɛlɛmɩa fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩpɛ nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ a kaa tuu kʋbie: Zɛkarɩya, Jɛdayɛl, Zɛbadɩa, Jatɩnɩɛl, 3Ɛlam, Jehohanaŋ arɩ Ɛlɩɛhɔnaɩ.
4Wɩa fa pɛ Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm lɛ ʋ kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ chori nɛ, ba nɛ ŋ-la a chɩŋ kʋhɩaŋ a kaa tuu kʋbie: Sɛmaaya, Jehozabad, Jʋa, Saka, Nɛtanɛl, 5Amɩɛl, Ɩsaka arɩ Pɛʋlɛtaɩ. 6-7Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm bii-hɩaŋ Sɛmaaya fa kɛŋ hambolibiisiŋ balɩdʋ nɛ: Ofini, Rɛfɛɛl, Ɔbɛd, Ɛlɩzabad, Ɛlɩhu arɩ Sɛmaaya. Ba kala fa ŋaa nɩduoru nɛ. 8Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm doho nɩaa mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩa kala nɛ fa ŋaa nɩduoru sɩ jaŋ wuo pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.
9Mɛsɛlɛmɩa doho nɩaa fii arɩ chori ma nɛ ba lɩɩsɛ sɩ jaŋ wuo tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la woruŋ.
10Mɛrarɩ tɩŋŋaa Hosa nanʋala nɛ: Sɩmɩrɩ. (Ʋ fa dee ʋ bii-hɩaŋ, ka ʋ nyɩmma joŋ hɩasɩŋ pʋ.) 11Ʋ hambolibiisiŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ Hɩlɩkaaya, Tabalɩa arɩ Zɛkarɩya. Hosa hambolibiisiŋ arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ kala fa ŋaa fii arɩ batori nɛ.
12Ba fa kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boi-baalaa kaa kpaa bugoo nɛ, dɩa dɩa, a pɩba tɩntɩŋŋaa Wɩa dɩa lɛ, arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 13Dɩa na-kala nɩaa, dɩ ba yʋga koo ba muuro, ba yie tɔnsɛ nɛ a na boi-baal-la ba sɩ jaŋ pɔ.
14Ba sɩ tɔnsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ wɩaa, ʋ tel Sɛlɛmaaya nyuŋ nɛ. Ba bɩra tɔnsɛ ʋ nanʋala Zɛkarɩya nyuŋ, nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ nɩaa chagɩlɩŋ woruŋ, a lɩɩsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ a pɩ ʋ ma. 15Ba bɩra tɔnsɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ ma wɩaa, ʋ tel Ɔbɛd-Ɛdɔm nyuŋ. Ba sɩ tɔnsɛ Wɩa dɩa chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa ma wɩaa, ʋ tel ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nyuŋ. 16Supim arɩ Hosa ma nɛ ba tɔnsɔ lɩɩsɛ, a leŋ ba bibeŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ boi-baalɩŋ arɩ Salɛkɛf boi-baalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nyuŋ dɩɩrɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɔ leree fa tɩma aŋ ka pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ nɛ. 17Tapʋlɩɩ kala Levi doho nɩaa balɩdʋ nɛ yie hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, banɛsɛ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ, banɛsɛ ma hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ dɩɩrɩŋ, ka balɩa ma hɛ ba chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩa-la leriŋ. 18Nɩaa banɛsɛ nɛ yie chɩŋ kaala-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, ka nɩaa balɩa ma hɛ kaala-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ.
19Kora arɩ Mɛrarɩ doho nɩaa bugo-la fa sɩɩ pɔ boi-baala-la nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩnnaa dɔnsʋŋ
20Ba doho nɩaa Levi doho nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ nɛ faa beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dʋa arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
21Ladaŋ fa ŋaa Gɛsɔŋ nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ, ʋ nanʋala nɛ Jɛhɩɛlɩ. Ladaŋ doho nɩaa fa yʋga nɛ a ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 22Jɛhɩɛlɩ hambolibiisiŋ Zetam arɩ Jowɛl nɛ faa beŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ dʋa.
23Ba fa pɩ Amɩram, Ɩza, Hɛbʋrɔŋ arɩ Ʋzɩɛl doho nɩaa ma tɩntɩŋŋaa dɔnsʋŋ nɛ.
24Sʋbaɩl fa ŋaa Mosis nanʋala Gesom doho nʋʋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩaŋ-la sɩɩ beŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dʋa. 25Gesom naambie Elieza doho nɩaa nɛ ŋ-la: Rehabia, Jesaaya, Joram, Zikiri arɩ Sɛlɔmɩf.
26Sɛlɔmɩf arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ faa beŋ kɩalɩŋ kuoro Devit dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ sɩ kaa kʋ ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩ Wɩa. 27Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ba sɩ yuo laa laalɩŋ lɛ, ba joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-balɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. 28Sɛlɔmɩf arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ nɛ faa beŋ kʋŋ na-kala ba sɩ joŋo hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ, a pɛ chɔgɩta kɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Samʋɛl, arɩ Kɩs nanʋala kuoro Sɔɔl, Nɛɛ nanʋala Abɩna arɩ Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab fa sɩ kaa kɔ.
29Ɩzɩha doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Kenania arɩ ʋ hambolibiisiŋ nɩɩ tɩŋ ba tenniŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ba nɛ fa ŋmʋnsɛ ba wɩaa bibil aŋ pɛ didii Iziral tɩŋŋaa sarɩya.
30Hɛbʋrɔŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Hasabɩa arɩ ʋ naambiiriŋ bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ sɩ jɩŋ wɩaa woruŋ nɛ faa beŋ La TƖƖNA arɩ kuoro tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa, Iziral tinteye-la sɩ cholo hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. 31Jɛrɩa nɛ fa ŋaa Hɛbʋrɔŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara. Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ, ʋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa lɛ, ba beŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ doho nɩaa wɩaa ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil tʋɔŋ a na dɩ ba nɩduoruŋ dɔnsʋŋ hɛ Jaza sɩ hɛ Gɩlɩad tinteeŋ lɛ. 32Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit lɩɩsɛ dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ bʋɩ balɩa arɩ zɔɔ-balɩpɛ sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ Jɛrɩa naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ a leŋ ba bibeŋ Wɩa arɩ kuoro tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa, Iziral tinteye-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ: Rubiŋ, Gad arɩ Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ tinteyee nɛ ŋɩɩ.

Laalɩyuoroo bugoo
1Chɛnɛ na-kala Iziral tɩŋŋaa baalaa bʋɩ mara arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ yie tɩŋ ba laalɩyuoroo tɩntɩŋŋaa. Nɩaa deemba fa ŋaa dɩa dɩa kʋhɩasɩŋ, laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ kuoro tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoro-la ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo nɛ. Ba sɩpaalaaraa nɛ ŋ-la chɛnɛ na-kala:
2Chɛŋ-bumbuŋ nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Zabɩdɩɛl nanʋala Jasɔbɩam, 3ʋ ŋaa Pɛrɛs doho nʋʋ nɛ.
4Chɛŋ-lɩa sɩpaalaara nɛ Dodai, ʋ ŋaa Aho tɩɩna nɛ. Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋaa Mɩkɩlɔf.
5Chɛŋ-tori sɩpaalaara nɛ Bɛnaaya, ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara Jehoyada nanʋala nɛ. 6Bɛnaaya deeŋ nɛ fa ŋaa laalɩyuori babiibala-la mara arɩ fii sɩpaalaara. Ʋ nanʋala Amizabad ma fa ŋaa laalɩyuori-hɩaŋ nɛ.
7Chɛŋ-nɛsɛ sɩpaalaara nɛ Jʋab naambie Asahɛl. Ʋ nanʋala Zɛbadɩa nɛ laa ʋ nyuŋ. 8Chɛŋ-nɔŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Ɩzɩra tɩŋŋaa Samɩhʋf. 9Chɛŋ-dʋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Tɛkʋa tɩŋŋaa Ɩkɛs nanʋala Ɩra. 10Chɛŋ-pɛɩ sɩpaalaara nɛ Hɛlɛs a lɩɩ Pɛlɔŋ sɩ hɛ Efirem tinteeŋ lɛ. 11Chɛŋ-chori sɩpaalaara nɛ Sɩbɛkaɩ a lɩɩ Husa, ʋ fa ŋaa Zɛra nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ. 12Chɛŋ-nibi sɩpaalaara nɛ Abieza a lɩɩ Anatɔf sɩ hɛ Bɛnjamɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ. 13Chɛŋ-fii sɩpaalaara nɛ Maharaɩ a lɩɩ Netofa, ʋ fa ŋaa Zɛra nyɩŋ-nʋʋ nɛ. 14Chɛŋ-fii arɩ kʋbala sɩpaalaara nɛ Bɛnaaya, a lɩɩ Pɩratɔŋ sɩ hɛ Efirem tinteeŋ lɛ. 15Chɛŋ-fii arɩ balɩa sɩpaalaara nɛ Hɛlɩdaɩ a lɩɩ Netofa, ʋ ŋaa Ofiniel doho nʋʋ nɛ.
Doho doho sɩpaalaaraa
16Iziral tɩŋŋaa doho doho sɩpaalaaraa nɛ ŋ-la: Rubiŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Zikiri nanʋala Elieza. Simioŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Maaka nanʋala Sɛfatɩa. 17Levi doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Kɛmʋɛl nanʋala Hasabɩa, Arɔŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Zadɔk. 18Juda doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Devit naambie Elihu, Ɩsaka doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Maakɩl nanʋala Omiri. 19Zebuluŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Obadaaya nanʋala Ɩsɩmaaya. Nafɩtalɩ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Azɩrɩɛl nanʋala Jɛrɩmɔf. 20Efirem doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Azazɩa nanʋala Hosia. Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Pedaaya nanʋala Jowɛl. 21Manasɛ doho nɩaa kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ-la sɩ hɛ Jɔdaŋ fuo-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ sɩpaalaara nɛ Zɛkarɩya nanʋala Ido. Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Abɩna nanʋala Jaasɩɛl. 22Daŋ doho nɩaa sɩpaalaara nɛ Jeroham nanʋala Azarɛl. Iziral doho doho sɩpaalaaraa nɛ ŋɩɩ.
23Devit fa sɩɩ dɩɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ʋ fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ jɩsɩŋ mara yie dɩɩsa pɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pʋŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ. 24Zeruya nanʋala Jʋab sɩ suomi a dɩdɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ bɩ dɛrɛ ka Wɩa na baanɩŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyuŋ aa dɔgɩsɛba, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ dɩɩsɩŋ. A tɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba fa bɩ nɩalɩŋ niiŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ kuoro Devit wʋŋaalaa tenniŋ tʋɔŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ kuoro dʋa
25Adɩɛl nanʋala Azɩmavɛf nɛ faa beŋ kuoro chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ.
Uzia nanʋala Jonataŋ ma nɛ faa beŋ kuoro chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ hɛ tabalaa, tabiisiŋ arɩ dɩɩ-duduosi-la lɛ.
26Kelub nanʋala Ɛzɩrɩ nɛ faa beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ kuoro bagɩsɩŋ lɛ. 27Sɩmɛɩ sɩ lɩɩ Rama nɛ faa beŋ girep tɩɩsɩŋ bagɩsɩŋ, ka Zabidi sɩ lɩɩ Sɩfam ma nɛ bibeŋ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ biliŋ wɩaa.
28Baal-Hanaŋ sɩ lɩɩ Gɛda nɛ faa beŋ olif tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ diibina tɩɩsɩŋ a chɩŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ. Jʋas ma nɛ faa beŋ olif nʋʋŋ. 29Sɩtɩraɩ sɩ lɩɩ Sarɔŋ nɛ faa beŋ nɛsɩ-la sɩ hɛ Sarɔŋ lɛ. Atalɩa nanʋala Safat ma nɛ faa beŋ nɛsɩ-la sɩ hɛ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ. 30Obil, sɩ ŋaa Ɩsɩmɛl doho nʋʋ nɛ faa beŋ ba bʋntaŋŋaba. Jɛdɩya sɩ lɩɩ Mɛrɔnɔf nɛ faa beŋ kakusuŋ.
31Jazɩs, sɩ ŋaa Hagɩ tɩɩna nɛ faa beŋ ba piesee arɩ bʋʋnaa. Nɩaa deemba kala fa ŋaa kuoro Devit tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ ʋ dʋa nɛ.
32Devit nyɩŋ-bie Jonataŋ fa ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛ nɩaa. Ʋ fa jɩŋ teniŋ nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ dɩ Hakɩmɔnɩ nanʋala Jɛhɩɛl nɛ faa dagɛ kuoro Devit hambolibiisiŋ.
33Ahitofɛl nɛ fa ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋl wɩaa chɩchagɩlɛ kuoro. Husai sɩ ŋaa Akɩ tɩɩna fa ŋaa kuoro Devit nandɔŋɔ nɛ. 34Bɛnaaya nanʋala Jehoyada nɛ fa laa Ahitofɛl nyuŋ, harɩŋ Abɩata ma bɩra laa ʋ nyuŋ. Jʋab nɛ fa ŋaa kuoro laalɩyuoroo nɩhɩaŋ.

english_text:
David Gives Solomon the Plans for the Temple
1David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
2 After everyone was there, David stood up and said:
Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple, 3but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
4The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings. 5The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel. 6The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. 7If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
8My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
9Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever. 10The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
11After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place. 12He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
13David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship. 14He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects, 15including the lampstands and lamps, 16the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver, 17the meat forks, the bowls and cups, 18the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
19David then said to Solomon:
The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built. 20But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him. 21The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_text:
Ŋɩɩ Devit sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la
1Kuoro Devit yɩrɛ Iziral tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ kala dɩ ba kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ Jerusalɛm lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa doho doho-la sɩpaalaaraa, kuoro laalɩyuoro-la ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ beŋ kuoro arɩ ʋ biiriŋ pʋsʋŋ arɩ ba kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ, kuoro dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, nɩbalaa arɩ laalɩyuori-babiibalaa kʋ hilimi Jerusalɛm lɛ.
2Kuoro Devit sii chɩŋ a bʋl, “Mɩ naambiiri, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔŋ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa nɛ a hɛ La TƖƖNA Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la, ʋ naasɩŋ dɩ-daŋɩŋ. Mɩ chɛ kɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ jaŋ kaa saa dɩa-la nɛ. 3Ama Wɩa bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ saa dɩa-la dɩ ba dɩdɛnnʋ nɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ sɩ mɩ ŋaa laalɩyuoru nɛ a kpʋ nɩaa yʋgɛ.
4La TƖƖNA, Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa fa lɩɩsɛ Juda doho nɛ dɩ ba ŋaa sɩpaalaaraa. Juda ma lɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nyɩmma dɩa nɩaa, mɩ nyɩmma biiriŋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ mɩ nyuŋ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro, aŋ hɛ niiŋ arɩ mɩ dɩ mɩ doho nɩaa nɛ jaŋ didii kuoruŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. 5La TƖƖNA pɩmɛ hambolibiisiŋ yʋgɛ nɛ, ama ba tʋɔŋ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ dɩ ʋ dii ʋ-na La Tɩɩna nɩaa, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoruŋ. 6La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩmɛ, ‘Ŋ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ jaŋ saa mɩ dɩa arɩ mɩ kaalɩsɩŋ a pɩmɛ. Mɩ lɩɩsʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ ŋaa mɩ nanʋala, ka dɩ mɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nyɩmma. 7Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu dɩ ʋ nɛ haa to mɩ niiŋ wɩaa arɩ mɩ wombiee.’
8Mɩ naambiiriŋ, La TƖƖNA Wɩa arɩ ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ hilime sɩpaaŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma hɛ niiŋ arɩ ma jaŋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ to wɩalɩŋ kala La TƖƖNA Wɩa sɩ dagɛla, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ma dɩ ma doho nɩaa tɩɩ tintee-zɔmʋŋ deeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu.”
9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ ma, “Mɩ bii, to ŋ nyɩmma Wɩa a tɩma pʋ arɩ ŋ tʋɔŋ arɩ ŋ wɩɩwɩɩ kala. La TƖƖNA jɩŋ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa arɩ la wʋchɛɛlɛɛ kala nɛ. Dɩ ŋ nɛ chɛʋ, ŋ jaŋ naʋ, ama dɩ ŋ nɛ vɩaʋ, ʋ ma jaŋ vɩaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. 10Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ jɩŋ arɩ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ ŋ saa ʋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la.”
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit joŋ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la, ʋ teniŋ a pɩ Solomoŋ, ʋ chʋgʋsʋŋ dɩɩsɩŋ arɩ dɩɩsɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ sɩ jaŋ hɛ Wɩa dɩa-la lɛ, a pɛ dɩa-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, lee-la ba sɩ pɩɩsɛ disiniŋ tɩta. 12Ʋ bɩra joŋ teniŋ sɩɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kaalɩsɩŋ arɩ dɩɩsɩ-la sɩ gollu, a pɛ dɩɩsɩ-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ Wɩa dɩa dʋa arɩ chɔgɩta kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pɩ La TƖƖNA a bil, a pɩ Solomoŋ. 13Devit bɩra dagʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩaa kpaa bugoo dɩ ba tɩtɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ, aŋ pɛ bibeŋ Wɩa dɩa-la tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa. 14Ʋ bɩra dagɛ Solomoŋ hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa Wɩa dɩa tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa: 15Chaanaa arɩ chaaŋ daasɩŋ, 16hɔpʋla teebʋlba, arɩ sɛlɩmɛ teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ boroboro-la ba sɩ joŋo pɩ Wɩa a daŋ. 17Sɛlɩmɛ-la ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa lɛsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kerikee ba kaa lɩlɩɩsɛ nammɩa, kʋmɩsɩrɩ-gbansɩŋ arɩ tagɩsɩŋ. Hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa pɩrataba. 18Ʋ bɩra dagɛ Solomoŋ sɛlɩmɛ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa koru-la lɛ ba sɩɩ nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ arɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa ŋaa janɩŋ toruko a pɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a jɛrɛ tɔ La TƖƖNA niiriŋ daga-la nyuŋ.
19Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bɩra bʋl, “La TƖƖNA dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ ba saa ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ mɩ ŋmʋnsa bil.”
20Devit bʋla pɩ ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ, “Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-doluŋ a tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnɩŋ koo dɩ ŋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa mɩ sɩ tɩmaa pa jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ vɩaŋ ta, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ tɩŋ ʋ dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ. 21Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa arɩ Levi doho nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kpaa bugoo kala a kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tɩntɩŋŋaa. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-doho kala ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ ŋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ arɩ ba sɩpaalaaraa kala ma kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ dɩ ba to ŋ niiŋ.”

english_text:
Gifts for Building the Temple
1 David told the crowd:
God chose my son Solomon to build the temple, but Solomon is young and has no experience. This is not just any building—this is the temple for the Lord God! 2That's why I have done my best to get everything Solomon will need to build it—gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, onyx, turquoise, colored gems, all kinds of precious stones, and marble.
3Besides doing all that, I have promised to give part of my own gold and silver as a way of showing my love for God's temple. 4More than 100 tons of my finest gold and almost 240 tons of my silver will be used to decorate its walls 5and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
6After David finished speaking, the family leaders, the tribal leaders, the army commanders, and the government officials voluntarily gave gifts 7for the temple. These gifts included more than 170 tons of gold, over 340 tons of silver, 620 tons of bronze, and more than 3,400 tons of iron. 8Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
9David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated.
David Praises the Lord
10Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord:
I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped. 11 Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world, 12and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous. 13We thank you, our God, and praise you.
14But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours. 15We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
16Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us. 17But we are happy, because everyone has voluntarily given you these things. You know what is in everyone's heart, and you are pleased when people are honest. 18Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you. 19And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
20David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king.
Solomon Is Crowned King
21The next day, the Israelites slaughtered 1,000 bulls, 1,000 rams, and 1,000 lambs, and they offered them as sacrifices to please the Lord, along with offerings of wine. 22The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar.
That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
23 So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him. 24Every official and every soldier, as well as all of David's other sons, were loyal to him. 25The Lord made Solomon a great king, and the whole nation was amazed at how famous he was. In fact, no other king of Israel was as great as Solomon.
David Dies
26David the son of Jesse was king of Israel 27 for 40 years. He ruled from Hebron for 7 years and from Jerusalem for 33 years. 28David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.
29Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad. 30They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.
translation_text:
Chɔgɩta kɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩ kaa kɔ dɩ ba kaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ kuoro Devit bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime, “Mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ʋ saa ʋ dɩa-la, ama ʋ ha ŋaa hambie nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ woruŋ. Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la yʋga nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩa-la tuo nuhuobiiŋ dɩa, ama La TƖƖNA Wɩa dɩa nɛ. 2Mɩ hɛ doluŋ a chɛ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ jaŋ kaa saa mɩ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la a bil nɛ: Sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, daa-doloo, tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ ɔnɩs, tabɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ takʋa arɩ tabɩɩ-tʋl dosunuŋ kala. Ba kala yʋga nɛ woruŋ, 3a lɩɩsɛ kɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ chɛ bil a ta. Mɩ ha bɩra joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a pɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩaa. 4Mɩ joŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ kɩɩ kilo bʋɩ zɔlɔ nɛ arɩ hɔpʋla ma yuŋuŋ sɩ kɩɩ kilo bʋɩ zɔɔ-balɩa dɩ ba kaa kpɩɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jebiee, 5a pɛ sɛlɩmɛ arɩ hɔpʋla kɩalɩŋ kala gɔgɔɔ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ. Lɛɛlɛ, kʋbɛɛ ma nɛ cho dɩ ʋ suri ʋ tʋɔŋ a joŋ kɩaa ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩ La TƖƖNA dɩ ba kaa saa ʋ dɩa-la?”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyɩŋ-nɩaa sɩpaalaaraa, ba doho doho tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ, laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ kuoro dʋa joŋ kɩaa pa ba tɩtɩa chonuŋ lɛ. 7Kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo pa dɩ ba kaa saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nɛ, sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ, hɔpʋla ma yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ mara arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ, kɔlɩɩŋ ma yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ balɩa, hɔɔŋ ma yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ zɔɔ-batori arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa, 8nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa joŋo hɛ Jɛhɩɛl sɩ ŋaa Gɛsɔŋ doho nʋʋ nɛsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ba kaa saa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la. 9Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ joŋ kɩaa pa arɩ tʋɔ-bala, ba tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ nɛ a tɩŋ kɩaa magɛ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ kaa kʋ pɩ La TƖƖNA, kuoro Devit ma tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ woruŋ.
Devit dɛnnɛ Wɩa
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit chɩŋ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩpaaŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA a bʋl,
“Mɩɩ dɛnnɩŋ La TƖƖNA, la naabalɩma Jekɔb Wɩa,
a leŋ dɩ ŋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
11La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala, a kɛŋ doluŋ,
arɩ tʋla arɩ yɩrɩŋ. Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ,
La TƖƖNA, ŋ nɛ kuoro.
Ŋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala.
12Ŋ nɛ yie pɩ nɩaa dʋa, ŋ yie leŋ nɩaa kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ.
Ŋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ kʋŋkala,
ŋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nɩa ŋaa nɩbal a kɛŋ doluŋ.
13Lɛɛlɛ, la Wɩa, laa lɔllʋŋ a dɩdɛnnɛ ŋ yɩrɩ zɔmʋŋ.
14Ama mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa nɛ kʋbɛɛba a magɛ dɩ la kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ ŋaa chɔgɩta pɩŋ la tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ. Ŋ nɛ tɩɩ kʋŋkala, kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ pɩla, ba nɛ la bɩra joŋo pɩŋ ŋɩɩ. 15La ŋaa nʋhʋɔra nɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, arɩ la naabalɩmaba fa sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔra ŋɩɩ. La jaŋ lɛl dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a nagɛ daaliimiŋ sɩ yie lɛl ŋɩɩ. 16La TƖƖNA Wɩa, la kɛŋ dʋa deeŋ kala kɔ dɩ la saa ŋ dɩɩ-balɩŋ nɛ a zil ŋ yɩrɩ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ama kɩalɩŋ kala lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, ŋ nɛ tɩɩ ba kala. 17Mɩ Wɩa, mɩ jɩma ŋ yie magɩsɛ nʋʋkala tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nyuŋ nɛ. Tʋɔpʋla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ mɩ kaa joŋ kɩaa deemba kala pɩŋ. Ŋ nɩaa ma kala sɩ hilimi daha tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩ kɛŋ kɩaa kʋ pɩŋ. 18La TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa la naabalɩma Abɩraham, Aɩzɩk, arɩ Jekɔb ba Wɩa, leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩaa kɛŋ tʋɔŋ deeŋ doho, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. 19Leŋ dɩ mɩ nanʋala Solomoŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ to wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ daga aŋ pɛ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ chɛ bil a saa ŋ dɩa-la.”
20Ŋɩɩ nɛ Devit bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hilime, “Má dɛnnɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.” Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kala dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA, ba naabalɩmaba Wɩa, aŋ tuu kpirimi a zil La TƖƖNA arɩ kuoro Devit.
Ba sɛɩ Solomoŋ kuoruŋ
21Taŋ sɩ pʋla, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kpʋ nɛ-belliŋ bʋɩ, pie-belliŋ bʋɩ arɩ pie-bel-pɔrɔɔ ma bʋɩ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a pɩ La TƖƖNA, a pɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ lɛ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ yʋga dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dii. 22Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ chaasa tɔrɛ nɛ ba dii kɩaa aŋ nyʋa kʋnyʋalaa La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ. Ba bɩra wasa lɩɩsɛ Solomoŋ, Devit nanʋala lɩa ʋ ŋaa kuoro a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, aŋ lɩɩsɛ Zadɔk ma a joŋ nʋʋŋ tɩsʋ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara. 23Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ laa ʋ nyɩmma Devit nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ a hɔŋ La TƖƖNA kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ, wɩɩkala vɛŋ woruŋ pʋ, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala tuto ʋ niiŋ. 24Tɩntɩnnɩ-hɩasɩŋ arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩŋ, a pɛ Devit hambolibiisiŋ kala lɛ fa sɛyɛ nɛ arɩ ba jaŋ to kuoro Solomoŋ.
25Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA leŋ Solomoŋ ŋaa nɩbal, Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala zizilu. Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoru kala fa tuo a magɛ Solomoŋ.
Devit sʋba
26Jesi nanʋala Devit nɛ fa ŋaa Iziral tinteeŋ kala kuoro. 27Ʋ fa beŋ Iziral tinteeŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa nɛ. Ʋ hɔŋ Hɛbʋrɔŋ lɛ a bemba jɩsɩŋ balɩpɛ nɛ, Jerusalɛm ma lɛ ʋ bemba jɩsɩŋ mara arɩ fii arɩ batori. 28Ʋ fa nɩɩ sɩma nɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, a hɩɛsɛ woruŋ aŋ-na sʋʋ, ka ʋ nanʋala Solomoŋ laa ʋ nyuŋ a dii kuoruŋ. Devit fa kɛŋ kɩaa nɛ woruŋ, nɩaa ma zizilu.
29Wɩalɩŋ kala Devit sɩ dii kuoruŋ a ŋaa, ba kala nɛ ba ŋmʋnsa hɛ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla Netaŋ, Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Samʋɛl arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ-naara Gad tenniŋ tʋɔŋ a bil. 30Ba ŋmʋnsɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ beŋ ʋ nɩaa, ŋɩɩ ʋ kuoruŋ fa sɩ dolie arɩ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa ʋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala lɛ arɩ kuorusu-la dɔnsʋŋ tinteeŋ sɩ golliba.

english_text:
The Lord Makes Solomon Wise
(1 Kings 3.1-15)
1King Solomon, the son of David, was now in complete control of his kingdom, because the Lord God had blessed him and made him a powerful king.
2-5 At that time, the sacred tent that Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the desert was still kept at Gibeon, and in front of the tent was the bronze altar that Bezalel had made.
One day, Solomon told the people of Israel, the army commanders, the officials, and the family leaders, to go with him to the place of worship at Gibeon, even though his father King David had already moved the sacred chest from Kiriath-Jearim to the tent that he had set up for it in Jerusalem. Solomon and the others went to Gibeon to worship the Lord, 6and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord.
7God appeared to Solomon that night in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
8Solomon answered:
Lord God, you were always loyal to my father David, and now you have made me king of Israel. 9 I am supposed to rule these people, but there are as many of them as there are specks of dust on the ground. So keep the promise you made to my father 10and make me wise. Give me the knowledge I'll need to be the king of this great nation of yours.
11God replied:
Solomon, you could have asked me to make you rich or famous or to let you live a long time. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom and knowledge to rule my people. 12So I will make you wise and intelligent. But I will also make you richer and more famous than any king before or after you.
13Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel.
Solomon's Wealth
(1 Kings 10.26-29)
14 Solomon had a force of 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.
15While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.
16-17 Solomon's merchants bought his horses and chariots in the regions of Musri and Kue. They paid 600 pieces of silver for a chariot and 150 pieces of silver for a horse. They also sold horses and chariots to the Hittite and Syrian kings.
translation_text:
Solomoŋ sʋl Wɩa aa chɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ
1Devit nanʋala Solomoŋ fa leŋe ʋ kuoruŋ chɩŋ nɛ woruŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ TƖƖNA Wɩa fa chɩŋ ʋ harɩŋ nɛ, a leŋ ʋ chaasa ŋaa nɩbal.
2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ yɩrɛ Iziral nɩaa kala hilimi: Laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo bʋɩba arɩ laalɩyuori-hɩasɩ-la sɩɩ beŋ laalɩyuoroo zɔlɔba, ba sarɩya diiree arɩ ba sɩpaalaara-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ, a pɛ ba dɩa dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ lɛ. 3Ʋ bʋla pɩba dɩ ba to ʋ harɩŋ dɩ ba mʋ dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa Gibioŋ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa lɛbɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ yie mʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna Mosis nɛ fa ŋaaʋ bʋa la lɛ ba fa sɩ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ. 4Dɩ Devit fa joŋ Wɩa niiriŋ daga-la lɩɩ Kɩrɩaf Jɩarɩm lɛ a kaa mʋ bil ʋ dɩ-biliŋ lɛbɩ-la ʋ fa sɩ hɛ pʋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 5Ama kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la Uri nanʋala Bɛzalɛl fa sɩ ŋaa hɛ Gibioŋ lɛ nɛ a chɩŋ La TƖƖNA dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩpaaŋ. Bɛzalɛl fa ŋaa Huu nihiŋ nɛ. Gibioŋ lɛ nɛ Solomoŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ chʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA. 6Lɛbɩ-la lɛ La Tɩɩna sɩ yie kɔ Iziral teeŋ lɛ nɛ, Solomoŋ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ bʋɩ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɔlɩɩŋ koru-la nyuŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ.
7Tɩtaŋ-la nɛ Wɩa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a bʋla pʋ, “Sʋl kʋŋ na-kala ŋ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ.”
8Solomoŋ bʋl, “Ŋ chaasa dii zile kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ mɩ nyɩmma Devit lɛ aŋ leŋ mɩ ma dii kuoruŋ ʋ nyuŋ lɛ. 9Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa, leŋ dɩ nii-la ŋ sɩ hɛ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɛnɛ chɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ leŋe mɩ dii kuoruŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ beŋ nɩ-daŋ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ. 10Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, pɩmɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ a leŋ dɩ mɩ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa dɩ mɩ wuo beŋ nɩaa deemba. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, ɛɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a beŋ ŋ nɩ-daŋ deeŋ?”
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ sɩ folo chɩchɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ mɩɩ-duduoŋ koo dʋa nɛ pɩɛsa chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ, a bɩra bɩ sʋla chɩchɛ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ma nɛ sʋʋ, aŋ sʋla chɩchɛ wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa a kaa beŋ mɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ leŋe ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro, 12mɩ jaŋ pɩŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ a leŋ dɩ ŋ jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ. Mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ kɩaa, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa ziziliŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ dii kuoruŋ kʋŋkala bɩŋ maga, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ to ŋ harɩŋ a dii kuoruŋ kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ magɩŋ.”
13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ lɩɩ Gibioŋ lɛ dundolo-la nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, lɛbɩ-la lɛ La TƖƖNA sɩ yie kɔ Iziral tɩŋŋaa teeŋ, a mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm a bibeŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa.
14Solomoŋ fa chɛ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba bʋɩ arɩ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ nɛ, janɩŋ ma bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩa, ʋ joŋ dɔnsʋŋ bil tasɩ-la lɛ ʋ sɩɩ bil ʋ laalɩŋ janɩŋ torukoba, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ ʋ teeŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ. 15Bʋa-la lɛ Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ, hɔpʋla arɩ sɛlɩmɛ fa pʋrɩga nɛ woruŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ a nagɛ tabɩaa, kuolu daasɩŋ ma pʋrɩgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ tutogusuŋ sɩ hɛ Juda tinteeŋ dundollu-la sɩ hɛ peelee bʋbʋɔŋ nyuŋ. 16Solomoŋ fa yie leŋ ʋ bayalaa mʋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ arɩ Kuwe tinteeŋ nɛ a yɔɔ ʋ janɩŋ. 17Ba yie yɔɔ laalɩŋ jaaba toruko Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ warɩpʋla zɔɔ-balɩdʋ nɛ, a yɔɔ jaaba ma warɩpʋla zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii. Ba ma yie mɩɩra kaa kʋ yalla pɩpɩ Hiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Siiria tɩŋŋaa kuoroo.

english_text:
Solomon Asks Hiram To Help Build the Temple
(1 Kings 5.1-12)
1Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself. 2He assigned 70,000 men to carry building supplies and 80,000 to cut stone from the hills. And he chose 3,600 men to supervise these workers.
3Solomon sent the following message to King Hiram of Tyre:
Years ago, when my father David was building his palace, you supplied him with cedar logs. Now will you send me supplies? 4I am building a temple where the Lord my God will be worshiped. Sweet-smelling incense will be burned there, and sacred bread will be offered to him. Worshipers will offer sacrifices to the Lord every morning and evening, every Sabbath, and on the first day of each month, as well as during all our religious festivals. These things will be done for all time, just as the Lord has commanded.
5This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods. 6 No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.
7Send me a worker who can not only carve, but who can work with gold, silver, bronze, and iron, as well as make brightly colored cloth. The person you send will work here in Judah and Jerusalem with the skilled workers that my father has already hired.
8I know that you have workers who are experts at cutting lumber in Lebanon. So would you please send me some cedar, pine, and juniper logs? My workers will be there to help them, 9because I'll need a lot of lumber to build such a large and glorious temple. 10I will pay your woodcutters 2,000 tons of wheat, the same amount of barley, 400,000 liters of wine, and that same amount of olive oil.
11Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon:
I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king. 12Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.
13I am sending Huram Abi to you. He is wise and very skillful. 14His mother was from the Israelite tribe of Dan, and his father was from Tyre. Not only is Huram an expert at working with gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, and wood, but he can also make colored cloth and fine linen. And he can carve anything if you give him a pattern to follow. He can help your workers and those hired by your father King David.
15Go ahead and send the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine you promised to pay my workers. 16I will tell them to start cutting down trees in Lebanon. They will cut as many as you need, then tie them together into rafts, and float them down along the coast to Joppa. Your workers can take them to Jerusalem from there.
Solomon's Work Force
17Solomon counted all the foreigners who were living in Israel, just as his father David had done when he was king, and the total was 153,600. 18He assigned 70,000 of them to carry building supplies and 80,000 of them to cut stone from the hills. He chose 3,600 others to supervise the workers and to make sure the work was completed.
translation_text:
Solomoŋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ dɩ ʋ saa dɩa-la lɛ ba sɩ jaŋ chʋchʋɔlɛ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kuoru dɩa. 2Ʋ ŋaa baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii chʋŋ dɩɩsɩ-la kɩaa kʋkɔ, baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ ma yɩyɛrɛ tabɩaa dundolluŋ nyuŋ, ka baalaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ ma bibeŋ tɩntɩnna-la.
3Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ pɩ Taaya kuoro Hiram a bʋl,
“Pɩmɛ kuolu daasɩŋ arɩ ŋ fa sɩ pɩ mɩ nyɩmma Devit ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ ʋ saa ʋ kuoru dɩa. 4Lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ chɛ mɩ saa dɩa nɛ dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛ Mɩ TƖƖNA Wɩa nɩmɛ, a nyɩgɛ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ, a joŋ ʋ boroboro-la ba sɩ yie joŋo pɩ Wɩa a bibil nɩmɛ, a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ-kala chʋchʋɔŋ arɩ dɩdaanɩŋ, arɩ chɛ-wiesii-la chɛɛŋ, chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbielee arɩ La TƖƖNA Wɩa gbiele-la dɔnsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA sɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
5Mɩɩ chɛ mɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ dɩ ʋ chaasa yʋgɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa la Wɩa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ vene kala. 6Ama kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo saa dɩa a pɩ Wɩa, ʋ paala yʋga kɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kala nɛ. Mɩ nɛ saa kʋbɛɛ dɩ mɩ saa dɩa a pʋ? Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa nɛ dɩ mɩ saa lee dɩ ba nyɩgɛ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa a pʋpʋ nɩmɛ.
7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, chɛ nʋʋ sɩ ŋaa gɔgɔ a jɩŋ kɩaa deemba kaa tɩmɩŋ: sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ, ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ, ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine, a jɩŋ kɩaa higiŋ ma, dɩ ʋ kʋ pɛ gɔgɩa-la mɩ nyɩmma Devit sɩ chɛ pɩmɛ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Juda arɩ Jerusalɛm lɛ.
8Mɩ jɩma ŋ nɩaa jɩŋ daasɩŋ keriŋ nɛ woruŋ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa pɩmɛ kuolu daasɩŋ, bʋtʋma arɩ tɩa-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ jʋnɩpa doloo. Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa kʋ pɛ dɩ ba 9keri daasɩ-la yʋgɛ woruŋ pɩmɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-ballɩŋ dɩ ʋ yʋgɛ nɛ a chaasa zɔŋ woruŋ. 10Mɩ jaŋ tiŋ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ keri daasɩ-la mɛmpɛ bɔtɔ bʋɩ balɩa, mɩaa bɔtɔba bʋɩ balɩa, girep nɛnɛɛ sɩnɩŋ galamba bʋɩ mara arɩ balɩa, a pɛ olif nʋʋŋ ma galamba bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ arɩ fii lɛ.” 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ Taaya kuoro Hiram ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ Solomoŋ a bʋl,
“A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ cho ʋ nɩaa wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ leŋ ŋ ŋaa ba kuoro.”
12Ʋ bɩra bʋl:
“Má dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ. Ʋ joŋ hambolibie sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ a pɩ Devit dɩ ʋ nɛ saa dɩa a pɩ La TƖƖNA arɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kuoru dɩa.
13Mɩ leŋe Huram-Abi nɛ kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ, ʋ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. 14Ʋ naaŋ ŋaa Daŋ doho nʋʋ nɛ, ka ʋ nyɩmma lɩɩ Taaya. Huram-Abi jɩŋ sɛlɩmɛ, hɔpʋla, kɔlɩɩŋ, hɔɔŋ, tabɩaa, daasɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-vachalɩŋ, gɛrɩpɛ-diibelimbine, gɛrɩpɛ-fɩaŋ arɩ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ chaasa jɩŋ kɩaa higiŋ nɛ woruŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo higiŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ dagʋ. Ʋ jaŋ pɛ ŋ tɩntɩnnaa lɛ arɩ mɩ nɩhɩaŋ Devit, ŋ nyɩmma gɔgɔɔ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ.
15Lɛɛlɛ leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɛmpɛ-la, mɩa-la, olif nʋʋŋ arɩ girep nɛnɛɛ sɩŋ-la ŋ sɩ sɩ ŋ jaŋ pɩla kaa kɔ. 16Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba keri dolo-la ŋ sɩɩ chɛ Lɛbanɔŋ lɛ a vɔɔ paa hɛ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɛ a duoro kaa kɔ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jopa a pɩŋ, dɩ ŋ paa mʋ Jerusalɛm.”
17Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩwogusu-la kala sɩ hɛ Iziral tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba kala ŋaa nɩaa bʋɩ zɔlɔ arɩ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ. Ʋ nyɩmma Devit fa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ʋ harɩŋ lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ. 18Ʋ leŋ nɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ batori arɩ fii chʋŋ dɩa-la kɩaa kʋkɔ, ka baalaa bʋɩ mahɩŋ banɛsɛ ma yɩyɛrɛ tabɩaa dundolluŋ nyuŋ, ka baalaa bʋɩ batori arɩ zɔɔ-balɩdʋ ma bibeŋ tɩntɩnna-la.

english_text:
The Temple Is Built
(1 Kings 6.1-38)
1-2 Solomon's workers began building the temple in Jerusalem on the second day of the second month, four years after Solomon had become king of Israel. It was built on Mount Moriah where the Lord had appeared to David at the threshing place that had belonged to Araunah from Jebus.
3The inside of the temple was 27 meters long and 9 meters wide, according to the older standards. 4Across the front of the temple was a porch 9 meters wide and 9 meters high. The inside walls of the porch were covered with pure gold.
5Solomon had the inside walls of the temple's main room paneled first with pine and then with a layer of gold, and he had them decorated with carvings of palm trees and designs that looked like chains. 6He used precious stones to decorate the temple, and he used gold imported from Parvaim 7to decorate the ceiling beams, the doors, the door frames, and the walls. Solomon also told the workers to carve designs of winged creatures into the walls.
8 The most holy place was nine meters square, and its walls were covered with over 20 tons of fine gold. 9Five hundred and seventy grams of gold was used to cover the heads of the nails. The walls of the small storage rooms were also covered with gold.
10 Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made to put in the most holy place, and he covered them with gold. 11-13Each creature had two wings and was four and a half meters from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing. Solomon set them next to each other in the most holy place, facing the doorway. Their wings were spread out and reached all the way across the nine-meter room.
14 A curtain was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with designs of winged creatures.
The Two Columns
(1 Kings 7.15-22)
15Two columns were made for the entrance to the temple. Each one was 16 meters tall and had a cap on top that was over 2 meters high. 16The top of each column was decorated with designs that looked like chains and with 100 carvings of pomegranates. 17Solomon had one of the columns placed on the south side of the temple's entrance; it was called Jachin. The other one was placed on the north side of the entrance; it was called Boaz.
translation_text:
Solomoŋ suomi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la saanɩŋ
1Ŋɩɩ nɛ Solomoŋ suomo sɩsaa La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la Jerusalɛm lɛ Moria peel-la nyuŋ. Lee-la nɛ La TƖƖNA fa kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kʋ dagɛ Solomoŋ nyɩmma Devit. Jebus tɩŋŋaa Araʋna taha nɛ fa ŋɩɩ. Devit nɛ fa chɛ lee-la bil. 2Solomoŋ sɩ dii kuoruŋ ʋ jɩ-nɛsɛ lɛ, chɛŋ-lɩa tapʋl lɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ ʋ suomi Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la saanɩŋ. 3Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ saa tʋɔŋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mara arɩ fii nɛ. Ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii. 4Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la zawʋra ŋ sɩ jaŋ jʋʋ aŋ-na jʋʋ dɩa-la tɩtɩa tʋɔŋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ, ʋ dɩ dɩa-la jalɩŋ kala magɛ dɔŋɔ, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ mahɩŋ balɩa arɩ fii arɩ banɛsɛ.
Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ taarɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. 5Ʋ joŋ bʋtʋma daasɩŋ nɛ a kɩɛla tɔ Wɩa dɩa-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ jeeŋ kala a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taarɛ, aŋ higi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ abɛ tɩɩsɩŋ arɩ chɔrʋmɔɔ a hɛ ba lɛ. 6Ʋ kɛŋ tabɩɩ-tʋlaa nɛ a kpɩɛrɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la. Sɛlɩmɛ-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, ʋ fa kaa lɩɩ Paavem tinteeŋ nɛ. 7Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ taara tɔ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la nyuŋ doloo, boro daasɩŋ, jeyee, arɩ ʋ borusuŋ kala, aŋ saa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ jebiee lɛ.
8Ʋ saa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ, ʋ duomuŋ magɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jalɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii. Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ yuŋuŋ sɩ ŋaa kilo bʋɩ balɩa nɛ a taara tɔ ʋ tʋɔŋ kala. 9Ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ ŋaa hɛŋŋɛɛ yuŋuŋ fa ka mʋa ka dɩ ʋ yi kilo bala. Dɩɩsɩ-la ma sɩ hɛ nyuŋ, ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ nɛ a taarɛ ba kala.
10Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ hɔɔŋ libi kɩaa balɩa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ lɛ. 11Kɩalɩŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ banɛsɛ kala duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii nɛ. Bumbuŋ kʋa kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jeeŋ lɛ. Kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ma duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ cheŋ dɔŋ-la. 12Lɩamɩŋ tɩɩna ma kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la jeeŋ lɛ, ka kɩŋkɛŋɛ dɔŋɔ ma duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ a mʋ tɩgɛ bumbuŋ kʋ-la kɩŋkɛŋɛ lɛ. 13Ba kɩŋkɛsɩ-la kala duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ nibi nɛ. Ba chɩŋ ba naasɩŋ lɛ nɛ a chaasɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la dɩ-balɩŋ.
14Ʋ kɛŋ gɛrɩpɛ fʋfʋlʋŋ nɛ a ŋaa patɩɩsaŋ, a kɛŋ ŋmɛŋ-diibelimbine arɩ ŋmɛŋ-vachalɩŋ arɩ ŋmɛŋ-fɩaŋ a sʋa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ a hɛ.
15Kuoro leŋe ba saa kɩaa balɩa nɛ a nagɛ jebiee dɩ ʋ joŋo pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Ba kala balɩa leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. Ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nyunchuuluŋ a sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ. Ba kʋŋkala leŋiŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ leŋ ba ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ʋ joŋo daŋ jebie-la nyuŋ, aŋ libi kɩaa sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ zɔlɔ a hɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la lɛ. 17Ʋ joŋ kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la a pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la boiŋ niiŋ. Dɔŋɔ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, dɔŋɔ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Kʋ-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ ʋ hɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ Jakɩŋ, a hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa kʋa ma yɩrɩŋ Bʋas.

english_text:
The Furnishings for the Temple
(1 Kings 7.23-51)
1 Solomon had a bronze altar made that was nine meters square and four and a half meters high. 2He also gave orders to make a large metal bowl called the Sea. It was 4.5 meters across, just over two meters deep, and 13.5 meters around. 3Its outer edge was decorated with two rows of carvings of bulls, ten bulls to about every 45 centimeters, all made from the same piece of metal as the bowl. 4The bowl itself sat on top of twelve bronze bulls, with three bulls facing outward in each of four directions. 5The sides of the bowl were 75 millimeters thick, and its rim was in the shape of a cup that curved outward like flower petals. The bowl held about 60,000 liters.
6 He also made ten small bowls and put five on each side of the large bowl. The small bowls were used to wash the animals that were burned on the altar as sacrifices, and the priests used the water in the large bowl to wash their hands.
7 Ten gold lampstands were also made according to the plans. Solomon placed these lampstands inside the temple, five on each side of the main room. 8 He also made ten tables and placed them in the main room, five on each side. And he made 100 small gold sprinkling bowls.
9Solomon gave orders to build two courtyards: a smaller one that only priests could use and a larger one. The doors to these courtyards were covered with bronze. 10The large bowl called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the temple.
11Huram made shovels, sprinkling bowls, and pans for hot ashes. Here is a list of the other furnishings he made for God's temple: 12two columns, two bowl-shaped caps for the tops of these columns, two chain designs on the caps, 13400 pomegranates in two rows for the chain designs, 14the stands and the small bowls, 15the large bowl and the twelve bulls that held it up, 16pans for hot ashes, as well as shovels and meat forks.
Huram made all these things out of polished bronze 17by pouring melted bronze into the clay molds he had set up near the Jordan River, between Succoth and Zeredah.
18There were so many bronze furnishings that no one ever knew how much bronze it took to make them.
19Solomon also gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar, the tables that held the sacred loaves of bread, 20the lampstands and the lamps that burned in front of the most holy place, 21flower designs, lamps and tongs, 22lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, ladles, fire pans, and the doors to the most holy place and the main room of the temple.
translation_text:
Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ kpɩɛraa
1Kuoro Solomoŋ leŋe ba kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, ʋ duomuŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ʋ jalɩŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii, ka ʋ leŋiŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. 2Huram kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a libi taasɩ-gbaŋ-balɩŋ ʋ ŋaa gulogulo. Ʋ jalɩŋ ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋnɔŋ a chɩŋ niiŋ dɔŋɔ a mʋmʋ dɔŋɔ, ʋ luŋuŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ bʋlɩa arɩ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ. Ʋ gulluŋ ma ŋaa naakieliŋ fii arɩ banɔŋ. 3Gbaŋa-la niipiniŋ lɛ, ʋ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a ŋaa kɩaa sɩ nagɛ nɛ-belliŋ naaderee balɩa a golli. Naakieliŋ kpaa magɛ dɔŋɔ na-kala pɛgɛ, nɛ-belliŋ fii nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ.
4Taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la sagɛ nɛ-belliŋ fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ nɛ. Nɛ-belli-la batori sɩaa chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɛ, batori ma sɩaa chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, batori ma chaasɛ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ, ka batori ma chaasɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ. Gbaŋa-la sagɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ ka ba kala bʋbʋɔŋ chaasɛ dɔŋɔ. 5Taasɩ-gbaŋa-la barɩmɩŋ ŋaa vama nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ niipiniŋ nagɛ nyʋnyʋala niipiniŋ, a nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa. Ʋ tʋɔŋ lɩɩŋ ŋaa galamba bʋɩ fii arɩ balɩpɛ arɩ zɔɔ-banɔŋ nɛ.
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa taasɩ-gbaŋ-biisiŋ fii dɩ ba kaa sʋsɔŋ nɩsaa, a joŋ banɔŋ bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, aŋ joŋ banɔŋ ma bil wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. Ba tʋɔŋ nɛ ba chɩchɛsɛ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa. Ama taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la tʋɔŋ nɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa jaŋ sʋsɔŋ ba tɩtɩa.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋaa chaaŋ daaŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ dagʋ, kɩaa fii a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa. 8Ʋ ŋaa teebʋlba ma fii nɛ a joŋo bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la tʋɔŋ. Banɔŋ chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa, banɔŋ ma chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ. Ʋ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa kʋmɩsɩrɩ-gbansɩŋ ma zɔlɔ. 9Ʋ saa kaalɩ-bie a pɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, aŋ saa kaalɩ-balɩŋ ma a ŋaa ba borusuŋ, a kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ taara tɔ. 10Ʋ joŋ taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la a bil Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ arɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ pɛgɛ gʋnʋŋ lɛ nɛ.
11Huram bɩra ŋaa puposuŋ, safʋlba arɩ kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Huram tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩa-la kala kuoro Solomoŋ sɩ sɩ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lɛ a dɛrɛ. Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: 12Jebie-la balɩa, kɩalɩŋ balɩa ʋ sɩ libe ba nagɛ gbaŋa a sagɛ jebie-la balɩa nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa ba nagɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ ba kaa kpɩɛrɛ gbansɩ-la sɩ sagɛ jebie-la nyuŋ, 13kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ kampoi nɛnɛɛ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ libi tʋŋ-bʋlɩa (a kɛmba kɩɛlɛ naadere-la balɩa, a kpɩɛrɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ nagɛ gbaŋa a sagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ jebie-la nyuŋ), 14taasɩ-gbansɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ba sɩɩ chɩŋ, 15taasɩ-gbaŋ-bal-la arɩ nɛ-belli-la fii arɩ balɩa nyuŋ ʋ sɩ saga, 16puposuŋ, safʋlba, lɛsɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ kerikee ba kaa lɩɩsɛ nammɩa, arɩ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ. La TƖƖNA dɩɩ-bal-la kɩalɩŋ kala Huram-Abi sɩ ŋaa pɩ kuoro Solomoŋ, kɔlɩɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa. 17Kuoro leŋe ba chɔ kɔlɩɩŋ nɛ a bɩsa hɛ chʋrʋŋ ba sɩ kaa mɛ kɩaa lɛ a ŋaa kɩalɩŋ Sʋkɔf arɩ Zarɛtaŋ pɛgɛ, Jɔdaŋ tintee-taala-la lɛ. 18Kɩaa deemba kala Solomoŋ sɩ leŋe ba ŋaa fa yʋga nɛ, nʋʋkala bɩ wuo jɩŋ kɔlɩɩŋ yuŋuŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ ba kaa ŋaaba. 19Solomoŋ bɩra leŋ ba kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la kɩaa deemba: Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ, teebʋlba-la nyuŋ ba sɩ yie joŋ boroboro daŋ La TƖƖNA sɩpaaŋ, 20chaaŋ daasɩŋ arɩ ba chaanaa, dɩ ba hɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a didii arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ. 21Kpɩɛra-la ba sɩ ŋaa ba nagɛ tɩɩfɩɩlaa, chaanaa arɩ chɛŋŋɛɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kaa ŋaaba. 22Kɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma nɛ, kɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa kikeri chaaŋ ŋmɛnɩŋ, kʋmɩsɩrɩ gbansɩŋ, gbansɩŋ, kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ hɛnsɩŋ arɩ nyiniŋ hɛntɛrɛɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kaa ŋaaba, a pɛ Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la borusuŋ lɛ. Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ borusuŋ arɩ Wɩa dɩa-la dɩɩ-balɩŋ borusuŋ, sɛlɩmɛ sɩ chaasa zɔŋ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ba kala.

english_text:
1 After the Lord's temple was finished, Solomon put in its storage rooms everything that his father David had dedicated to the Lord, including the gold and silver, and the objects used in worship.
Solomon Brings the Sacred Chest to the Temple
(1 Kings 8.1-13)
2-3 The sacred chest had been kept on Mount Zion, also known as the city of David. But Solomon decided to have the chest moved to the temple while everyone was in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Shelters during the seventh month.
Solomon called together all the important leaders of Israel. 4-5Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple. 6Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.
7The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures, 8whose wings covered both the chest and the poles used for carrying it. 9The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.
