12Did any of you measure
the ocean by yourself
or stretch out the sky
with your own hands?
Did you put the soil
of the earth in a bucket
or weigh the hills and mountains
on balance scales?
13 Has anyone told the Lord
what he must do
or given him advice?
14Did the Lord ask anyone
to teach him wisdom
and justice?
Who gave him knowledge
and understanding?
15 To the Lord, all nations
are merely a drop in a bucket
or dust on balance scales;
all of the islands
are but a handful of sand.
16The cattle on the mountains
of Lebanon
would not be enough to offer
as a sacrifice to God,
and the trees would not
be enough for the fire.
17God thinks of the nations
as far less than nothing.
18 Who compares with God?
Is anything like him?
19Is an idol at all like God?
It is made of bronze
with a thin layer of gold,
and decorated with silver.
20 Or special wood may be chosen
because it doesn't rot—
then skilled hands
take care to make an idol
that won't fall on its face.
God Rules the Whole Earth
21Don't you know?
Haven't you heard?
Hasn't it been clear
since the time of creation?
22God is the one who rules
the whole earth,
and we that live here
are merely insects.
He spread out the heavens
like a curtain or an open tent.
23God brings down rulers
and turns them into nothing.
24They are like flowers
freshly sprung up
and starting to grow.
But when God blows on them,
they wilt and are carried off
like straw in a storm.
25The holy God asks,
“Who compares with me?
Is anyone my equal?”
26 Look at the evening sky!
Who created the stars?
Who gave them each a name?
Who leads them like an army?
The Lord is so powerful
that none of the stars
are ever missing.
The Lord Gives Strength
27You people of Israel say,
“God pays no attention to us!
He doesn't care if we
are treated unjustly.”
But how can you say that?
28Don't you know?
Haven't you heard?
The Lord is the eternal God,
Creator of the earth.
He never gets weary or tired;
his wisdom cannot be measured.
29The Lord gives strength
to those who are weary.
30Even young people get tired,
then stumble and fall.
31But those who trust the Lord
will find new strength.
They will be strong like eagles
soaring upward on wings;
they will walk and run
without getting tired.
translation_text:
Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ
1La Wɩa sɩ, “Nyagɛ mɩ nɩaa bɔyɛ woruŋ
dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.”
2Má fɩɛla bʋl wɩaa pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ ba tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala,
arɩ hɛɛ-la ba fa sɩɩ na dɛrɛ nɛ.
La TƖƖNA leŋe ba tiŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ kala nɛ,
ʋ dɔgɩsɛba naansɩɩŋ bʋlɩa nɛ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa.
3Nʋʋ nɛ heelee bʋl,
“Má wasɛ wombiiŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ a bil La TƖƖNA lɛ,
má pori wombii-la dɩ ʋ tʋʋlɛ woruŋ a pɩ la Wɩa.
4Má dɩŋ fuonaa na-kala.
Má keri peelee arɩ dundolluŋ a kaa jɛrɛ dɩ ba magɛ dɔŋɔ. Má tɔ buotuonuŋ dɩ ba kala magɛ dɔŋɔ.
Lere-la sɩ ŋaa nyʋra-nyʋra,
má leŋ ba kala magɛ dɔŋɔ.
5Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛ ʋ tʋla
dɩ nuhuobiinee kala naʋ.
La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ bʋla.”
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ bʋla,
“Ŋmoo niiŋ.”
Mɩ pɩɛsɛ, “Mɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋbɛɛ lɛ?
Nuhuobiinee kala nagɛ yaŋ nɛ,
ba tʋla ma kala nagɛ ya-fɩɩlaa nɛ
ba bɩ dieni.
7Yaŋ yie hɩl nɛ, ba fɩɩlaa ma yuori,
bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA nɛ yie leŋ peliŋ lu hɛ ba lɛ.
Nuhuobiine sɛnɛ nagɛ yaŋ nɛ.
8Yaŋ yie hɩl nɛ, ba fɩɩlaa ma yuori,
ama Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”
9Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ,
má kɔ Jerusalɛm,
má jɩl peeliŋ sɩ leŋie nyuŋ
a heele bʋl wɩalɩŋ.
Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá,
má bʋla pɩ Juda tasɩŋ nɩaa:
“Ma Wɩa hɛ daha.”
10La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ nɩɩ kɔ arɩ ʋ doluŋ,
dɩ ʋ beŋ ʋ nɩaa.
Ʋ pɛ kori ʋ time kaa kɔ nɛ:
Nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa ta.
Ʋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ laa ta nɩɩ kɔ.
11Ʋ jaŋ beŋ ʋ nɩaa nyuŋ
arɩ pie-daara sɩɩ beŋ ʋ piesee nyuŋ ŋɩɩ.
Ʋ jaŋ paa ʋ pie-biisiŋ a nɔgɛ
aŋ fɩɛla dɩdaa pie-naamba-la sɩ kɛŋ biiriŋ.
12Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha wuo joŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ kala hɛ ʋ nachala lɛ a magɩsɛ,
koo a kɛŋ ʋ nɩsɩŋ a magɩsɛ wɩa-nyuŋ duomuŋ?
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha wuo joŋ tinteeŋ hagɩla kala hɛ sime lɛ a magɩsɛ,
koo a joŋ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ kala
a hɛ sanɩa lɛ a magɩsɛ?
13Kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ La TƖƖNA tʋɔbɩɩnaa
koo a bʋl wɩaa a chagɩlʋ?
14Kʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA ha pɩɛsɛ
dɩ ʋ dagʋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa?
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ha dagʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ
koo wɩaa bʋɔsʋŋ jɩmɩŋ.
15La TƖƖNA teeŋ, tinteyee kala nagɛ lɩɩ-suosoo sɩ hɛ bogiti lɛ nɛ
koo a nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ sɩ hɛ sanɩa lɛ.
Tinteye-la kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu yuŋuŋ
nagɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ nɛ ʋ teeŋ.
16Lɛbanɔŋ tinteeŋ daasɩŋ kala bɩ yʋga magɛ
dɩ ba kaa hɛ nyiniŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ koruŋ nyuŋ.
Ʋ pʋsʋŋ ma bɩ yʋga magɛ dɩ ba kaa kpʋ a ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ.
17La TƖƖNA teeŋ, tinteyee kala bɩ kɩa ŋaa.
Ʋ jomba ba ŋaa kʋpɛɩba nɛ,
ba bɩ kɩa ŋaa.
18Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ Wɩa magɩsɛ?
Ŋ jaŋ wuo dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ nagaa?
19La TƖƖNA bɩ tɔmʋŋ libiree sɩ yie libi naga,
kʋ-la ba sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ taara tɔ
aŋ kɛŋ hɔpʋla libi chɔrʋmɔɔ hɛ.
20Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa summu a bɩ sɛlɩmɛ lɛ wuo yi,
ʋ yie chɛ daa-la sɩ bɩ pʋa nɛ,
a chɛ saarɩ-gɔgɔ ʋ saa tɔmʋŋ ʋ joŋo bil
kʋa nyuŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.
21Ma bɩ jɩŋ?
Ma bɩ nɩaa?
Dɩ-suomuŋ kala ba bɩ bʋla pɩmaa?
Ma bɩ ŋɩɩ dʋnɩa sɩ suomo jɩŋ?
22La TƖƖNA hɔŋ ʋ kuoru kpasa nyuŋ nɛ a bibeŋ tinteeŋ.
Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala nagɛ nyaŋgɩrɩgɛba nɛ ʋ teeŋ.
Ʋ kɛŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a jɛrɛ nɛ ʋ nagɛ patɩɩsaŋ,
koo ʋ kaa jɛrɛ ʋ nagɛ palɩŋ.
23Ʋ kɛŋ sɩpaalaaraa muuri nɛ
a leŋ kuoru-duoruŋ yuŋuŋ tuu tinteeŋ.
24Ba nagɛ kɩaa sɩ bumo nyʋ nɛ,
ba naapoloo ha bɩ tinteeŋ jʋa woruŋ,
ʋ leŋ peliŋ du hɛ ba lɛ ba sʋʋ,
pel-vinvilimiŋ paaba viiri a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.
25Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ,
“Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛmmɛ magɩsɛ?
Koo kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɛmɛ?”
26Má beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ a na,
kʋbɛɛ nɛ ŋaa kɩaa deemba sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ?
Ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa chɛnwʋlaa kʋbala kʋbala
a yɩyɩrɛ ba yɩraa kʋŋ kʋŋ.
Ʋ doluŋ sɩ yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ tɩɩ
ba hɛ nɩmɛ,
ba kʋbala ma bɩ lɛlɛ.
27Iziral tɩmma, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma gʋrɩmɛ wɩaa
a bʋl,
“La TƖƖNA bɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa la lɛ jɩŋ.
Wɩa sɩpaa tuo hɛɛ-la la sɩɩ na lɛ.”
28Ma bɩ jɩŋ?
Ma bɩ nɩaa?
La TƖƖNA nɛ Wɩa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ.
Ʋ nɛ ŋaa dʋnɩa kala.
Ʋ bɩ lɔl,
nʋʋkala ma bɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa wuo jɩŋ.
29Ʋ yie pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɛsɩmɛ doluŋ nɛ,
a leŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ pʋgʋma doluŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ.
30Nɩwaa-falaa yie lɔl nɛ a kala bɛsɩmɛ,
bapʋɔsaa gɛrɛ titel,
31ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La TƖƖNA lɛ,
jaŋ wasa kɛŋ doluŋ.
Ba jaŋ nagɛ kachuuŋ sɩɩ fil.
Ba jaŋ fá aŋ bɩ jaŋ lɔl,
a vɛŋ woruŋ aŋ bɩ jaŋ yiegi.

english_text:
The Lord Controls Human Events
1Be silent and listen,
every island in the sea.
Have courage and come near,
every one of you nations.
Let's settle this matter!
2Who appointed this ruler
from the east?
Who puts nations and kings
in his power?
His sword and his arrows
turn them to dust
blown by the wind.
3He goes after them so quickly
that his feet
barely touch the ground—
he doesn't even get hurt.
4Who makes these things happen?
Who controls human events?
I do! I am the Lord.
I was there at the beginning;
I will be there at the end.
5Islands and foreign nations
saw what I did and trembled
as they came near.
What Can Idols Do?
6Worshipers of idols
comfort each other,
saying, “Don't worry!”
7Woodcarvers, goldsmiths,
and other workers
encourage one another and say,
“We've done a great job!”
Then they nail the idol down,
so it won't fall over.
The Lord's Chosen Servant
8 Israel, you are my servant.
I chose you, the family
of my friend Abraham.
9From far across the earth
I brought you here and said,
“You are my chosen servant.
I haven't forgotten you.”
10Don't be afraid. I am with you.
Don't tremble with fear.
I am your God.
I will make you strong,
as I protect you with my arm
and give you victories.
11Everyone who hates you
will be terribly disgraced;
those who attack
will vanish into thin air.
12You will look around
for those brutal enemies,
but you won't find them—
they will be gone.
13I am the Lord your God.
I am holding your hand,
so don't be afraid.
I am here to help you.
14People of Israel, don't worry,
though others may say,
“Israel is only a worm!”
I am the holy God of Israel,
who saves and protects you.
15I will let you be like a log
covered with sharp spikes.
You will grind and crush
every mountain and hill
until they turn to dust.
16A strong wind will scatter them
in all directions.
Then you will celebrate
and praise me, your Lord,
the holy God of Israel.
The Lord Helps the Poor
17When the poor and needy
are dying of thirst
and cannot find water,
I, the Lord God of Israel,
will come to their rescue.
I won't forget them.
18I will make rivers flow
on mountain peaks.
I will send streams
to fill the valleys.
Dry and barren land
will flow with springs
and become a lake.
19I will fill the desert
with all kinds of trees—
cedars, acacias, and myrtles;
olive and cypress trees;
fir trees and pines.
20Everyone will see this
and know that I,
the holy Lord God of Israel,
created it all.
Idols Are Useless
21I am the Lord,
the King of Israel!
Come argue your case with me.
Present your evidence.
22Come near me, you idols.
Tell us about the past,
and we will think about it.
Tell us about the future,
so we will know
what is going to happen.
23Prove that you are gods
by making your predictions
come true.
Do something good or evil,
so we can be amazed
and terrified.
24You idols are nothing,
and you are powerless.
To worship you
would be disgusting.
25I, the Lord, appointed a ruler
in the north;
now he comes from the east
to honor my name.
He tramples kings like mud,
as potters trample clay.
26Did any of you idols predict
what would happen?
Did any of you get it right?
None of you told about this
or even spoke a word.
27I was the first to tell
the people of Jerusalem,
“Look, it's happening!”
I was the one who announced
this good news to Zion.
28None of these idols
are able to give advice
or answer questions.
29They are nothing,
and they can do nothing—
they are merely
a passing breeze.
translation_text:
Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ
1Wɩa sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ, má kɛŋ goŋ aŋ jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.
Tinteyee nɩaa, má wasa chɛ doluŋ.
Má kʋ lɩɩ bʋl ma wɩɩŋ.
Má leŋ la cheŋ dɔŋɔ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ.
2Kʋbɛɛ nɛ lɩɩsɛ kuoru-la sɩ hɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ
a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ a yuo didii tinteyee arɩ ba kuoroo ŋɩɩ?
Ʋ tokobiiŋ yie leŋ ba bɩrɩmɛ kʋŋkɔlʋŋ,
ka ʋ toŋ ma ŋmooba pɩsɛ a nagɛ peliŋ sɩ paa mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.
3Ʋ yie kire to ba harɩŋ nɛ parɩ parɩ,
a yuo diiba, ka kʋŋ ma bɩ ʋ kɩɩsa.
4Kʋbɛɛ nɛ leŋe wɩaa deemba kala ŋaa?
Dɩ-suomuŋ kala, kʋbɛɛ nɩɩ beŋ nuhuobiinee doho wʋkɛnɛɛ nyuŋ?
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ-suomuŋ kala,
mɩ saa jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ.”
5Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ na wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa nɛ, fawʋllʋŋ kɛmba,
dʋnɩa nɩaa kala chichel.
Ba kala sii hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɔ.
6Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba nyagɛ dɔŋɔ ba bɔyɛ a bʋl,
“Má nyɩrɛ bɔyɛ.”
7Nɩɩ-la sɩ jɩŋ daasɩŋ kaa saa kɩaa
nyagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ a ŋaa kɩaa bɔyɛ.
Nɩɩ-la ma sɩ yie libi tɔŋŋɔɔ
nyagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ yie paa
mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ bɔyɛ.
Ba yie bʋl, “Ba mɛrɛ woruŋ nɛ.”
Ʋ yie kpaasɛ tɔŋ-la bil nɛ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ tel.
8Ama ma-na Iziral tɩŋŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa,
ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ, mɩ nandɔŋɔ Abɩraham doho nɩaa.
9Mɩ kɛmma lɩɩ dʋnɩa loŋgoruŋ dɩ-bolii nɛ a bʋla pɩma,
“Ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.”
Mɩ nɛ lɩɩsɛma, mɩ bɩ ma vɩa ta.
10Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ.
Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ vʋgʋmɛ, mɩ nɛ ma Wɩa.
Mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a pɩma doluŋ,
mɩ jaŋ pɔma a laama ta.
11Nɩalɩŋ sɩ chaasa na baanɩŋ ma nyuŋ,
hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba.
Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ yuoma
jaŋ nagɛ kʋpɛɩba a sʋʋ.
12Ma jaŋ beŋ a chɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ ka.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yuoma jaŋ nagɛ kʋpɛɩba,
13bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa.
Mɩ kɛŋ ma nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl,
“Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.”
14La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa
a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ,
“Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma muuro nɛ
a bɩ doluŋ ma kɛnɛ,
ama má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá,
mɩ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.
15Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma nagɛ kʋ-la ba sɩ kaa ŋmoo kɩaa,
ʋ nyɩlaa ŋaa kʋfalɩa a yʋgɛ a kɛŋ niiŋ.
Ma jaŋ yɛrɛ peelee arɩ dundolluŋ
a nɔmba dɩ ba pugisi a nagɛ mɩɩ-jɔrʋŋ.
16Ma jaŋ ŋmooba villi,
dɩ pel-duoŋ paaba viiri.
Ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ mɩ-na
ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa
sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ
a chʋɔlɛmɛ.
17Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ kɛŋ summoo arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ba tɩtɩa lɛ wuo pɛ nɛ
ba chɩchɛ lɩɩŋ aŋ bɩ na,
ba yikorusuŋ hɩl.
Ama mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta.
18Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ dundol-hɩlaa nyuŋ,
aŋ ŋaa dɩ lɩɩ-bul sɩaa
pɩpɛllɛ fuonaasɩŋ lɛ.
Tintee-hɩlɩŋ jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ
fuonuŋ lee,
dɩ lɩɩ-bul sɩaa bubul tinteeŋ ma
sɩ hɩla lɛ.
19Mɩ jaŋ chɔnsɛ tɩɩsɩŋ deemba tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ:
Kuolo, sɔjaamɩŋ, chɛɛŋ arɩ olif tɩa.
Mɩ jaŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ tɩɩsɩŋ deemba ma nyʋ ʋ lɛ:
Bʋtʋnsʋŋ, chɛrɩsɩŋ arɩ kanchalaa.
20Nɩaa jaŋ na a jɩŋ arɩ mɩ-na
ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa
sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.”
21Ma Tɩɩna sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro bɩra sɩ,
“Má kʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ,
wɩɩ-la ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma kaa lɛrɛ.
22Má kɛŋ ma tɔŋŋɔɔ kɔ dɩ ba bʋl
wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩla.
Má leŋ dɩ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa bal a pɩla,
dɩ la jɩmba aŋ dagɛla ba bʋbʋɔŋ.
23Ma dagɛla wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa
dɩ la jɩŋ arɩ ma sɛnɛ ŋaa vesi nɛ.
Má ŋaa wʋzɔŋ koo wʋbɔŋ
a leŋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnla
dɩ la chɩl.
24Ama ma bɩ kɩa kala ŋaa,
ma wʋŋaalaa ma bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ toma ŋaa disiŋ tɩmma nɛ.
25Nʋʋ sɩ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ a kɛŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ tɩtɩŋ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa a kʋ yuoma.
Ʋ yie nʋɔsɛ kuoroo a bil tinteeŋ nɛ
a nagɛ ba sɩ nʋɔsɛ tɩɛrɩŋ
koo a nagɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ
sɩ yie nʋɔsɛ chʋrʋŋ ŋɩɩ.
26Ma tɔmɔ-la kʋbɛɛ nɛ fa wuo bʋl arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa,
dɩ la jɩŋ a bʋl,
‘Ʋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ?’ Ma kʋŋkala bɩ wɩɩ bʋla.
Nʋʋ bɩ wɩɩ nɩa ma teeŋ.
27Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa, ‘Ma nɩaa ka kɔ nɛ.’
Mɩ-na nɛ bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa.
28Mɩ sɩ beŋ tɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ,
mɩ bɩ ba kʋŋkala na sɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa a chagɩlɛba,
koo a dagɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ pɩɛsɛba bʋbʋɔŋ.
29Ba kala ŋaa wʋnyɩɛra nɛ.
Ba wɩaa bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ.
Ba tɔmɔ-la nagɛ peliŋ nɛ.”

english_text:
The Lord's Servant
1 Here is my servant!
I have made him strong.
He is my chosen one;
I am pleased with him.
I have given him my Spirit,
and he will bring justice
to the nations.
2He won't shout or yell
or call out in the streets.
3He won't break off a bent reed
or put out a dying flame,
but he will make sure
that justice is done.
4He won't quit or give up
until he brings justice
everywhere on earth,
and people in foreign nations
long for his teaching.
5 I am the Lord God.
I created the heavens
like an open tent above.
I made the earth and everything
that grows on it.
I am the source of life
for all who live on this earth,
so listen to what I say.
6 I chose you to bring justice,
and I am here at your side.
I selected you and sent you
to bring light
and my promise of hope
to the nations.
7You will give sight
to the blind;
you will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons.
8My name is the Lord!
I won't let idols or humans
share my glory and praise.
9Everything has happened
just as I said it would;
now I will announce
what will happen next.
Sing Praises to the Lord
10Tell the whole world to sing
a new song to the Lord!
Tell those who sail the ocean
and those who live far away
to join in the praise.
11Tell the tribes of the desert
and everyone in the mountains
to celebrate and sing.
12Let them announce
his praises everywhere.
13The Lord is marching out
like an angry soldier,
shouting with all his might
while attacking his enemies.
The Lord Will Help His People
14For a long time, I, the Lord,
have held my temper;
now I will cry out and groan
like a woman giving birth.
15I will destroy the mountains
and what grows on them;
I will dry up rivers and ponds.
16I will lead the blind on roads
they have never known;
I will guide them on paths
they have never traveled.
Their road is dark and rough,
but I will give light
to keep them from stumbling.
This is my solemn promise.
17Everyone who worships idols
as though they were gods
will be terribly ashamed.
God's People Won't Obey
18You people are deaf and blind,
but the Lord commands you
to listen and to see.
19No one is as blind or deaf
as his messenger,
his chosen servant,
20who sees and hears so much,
but pays no attention.
21The Lord always does right,
and so he wanted his Law
to be greatly praised.
22But his people were trapped
and imprisoned in holes
with no one to rescue them.
All they owned had been taken,
and no one was willing
to give it back.
23Why won't his people
ever learn to listen?
24Israel sinned and refused
to obey the Lord
or follow his instructions.
So the Lord let us be robbed
of everything we owned.
25He was furious with us
and punished our nation
with the fires of war.
Still we paid no attention.
We didn't even care
when we were surrounded
and scorched by flames.
translation_text:
La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna
1La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ nɛ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ.
Ʋ nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ.
Mɩ joŋ mɩ Dɩma a hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ,
dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ tinteyee kala lɛ.
2Ʋ bɩ jaŋ ŋɩŋaa goŋ koo aa ŋmoo niiŋ,
koo a chɩŋ wombiee lɛ aa kpɩa wɩaa.
3Fuolo-ŋmʋl sɩ gʋɔra ma ʋ bɩ jaŋ kaa boro ta.
Ʋ bɩ chaaŋ-la ma sɩ gʋala jaŋ dɩsɛ.
Ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ.
4Ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɔlɔ koo dɩ ʋ nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ,
see dɩ ʋ leŋe wʋtɩtɩɩ chɩŋ tinteeŋ lɛ kpaŋkpaŋ.
Ʋ wʋdagaa lɛ nɛ tinteye-la kala lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa jaŋ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ.”
5La TƖƖNA Wɩa nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ a leŋ ʋ jɛrɛ tɔ leriŋ,
ʋ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ lɛ.
Ʋ nɛ pɩ nuhuobiine mɩɩsɩŋ.
6Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ yɩrɩŋ
arɩ tʋɔpʋla.
Mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ
aŋ beŋ ŋ nyuŋ woruŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nii
mɩ dɩ mɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ,
aŋ ŋaa pʋlʋŋ a pɩ
tinteyee dɔnsʋŋ ma.
7Ŋ jaŋ suri nyʋlɩmaa sɩaa,
a lɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ
birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a ta.
8Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma TƖƖNA,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tʋla a pɩ kʋŋ dɔŋ kala,
koo a joŋ mɩ dɛnnɛ a pɩ tɔŋŋɔɔ.
9Má bee na, wʋbɩnaa-na ŋaa bal nɛ,
wʋfalaa nɛ mɩ bʋlaa pɩma ŋ-la,
wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa maachie.”
La TƖƖNA dɛnnɩŋ yɩɩlaa
10Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ,
má yɩɩ yɩɩl-falɩŋ a dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.
Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ duori lɩɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ,
arɩ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa, má dɛnnʋ.
11Má leŋ dɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ arɩ tasɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nɩaa dɛnnɛ La TƖƖNA.
Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kɛda lɛ, má jʋjʋɔsɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ hɔŋ taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɛla lɛ,
má sii jɩl peelee nyuŋ a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.
12Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu lɛ,
má bɛsɛ La TƖƖNA tʋla lɛ, a dɛnnʋ.
13La TƖƖNA jaŋ kɔ a nagɛ bayuori duoŋ,
a nagɛ laalɩyuori babii-balɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ yuo laalɩŋ.
Ʋ jaŋ kpɩa laalɩyuori-goŋ
aŋ yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ.
14Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ tɔrɛ mɩ niiŋ a dieni nɛ.
Mɩ fa kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa nɛ a ŋaa fʋlʋlʋ,
ama lɛɛlɛ bʋa-la yie nɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa.
Mɩɩ ŋmoo niiŋ a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ nɛ.
15Mɩ jaŋ chei peelee arɩ dundolluŋ,
a leŋ dɩ ba yaŋ
arɩ tɩɩsɩŋ kala hɩl.
Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ fuonuŋ leree kala bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ,
aŋ ŋaa dɩ pɩlaa lɩɩŋ ma hʋ.
16Mɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyʋlɩma sɩpaaŋ,
a kɛmba vɛŋ wombii-la ba ha sɩ bɩ vɛnɛ aŋ ka lɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ pɔba a leŋ dɩ birimiŋ bɩrɩmɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ ba sɩpaaŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lere-la kala sɩ ŋaa nyʋra nyʋra ŋaa mʋla mʋla.
Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩba nɛ ŋɩɩ:
Mɩ bɩ jaŋ vɩaba ta.
17Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa kala a daŋ vesiŋ lɛ,
a bʋl ‘Ma nɛ la wɩa,’
ba wɩaa jaŋ mʋ harɩŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.”
Iziral tɩŋŋaa nyʋlɩma nɛ aŋ taŋ ma
18La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Iziral tɩmma, ma taŋa nɛ a pɛ nyʋlɩmɛ ma,
ama má jegile nɩɩ aŋ suri ma sɩaa.
19Kʋbɛɛ nɛ nyʋlɩma a nagɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna,
koo a taŋ a nagɛ nɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa a tɩmʋ?
20Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa, ma na wɩaa a yʋgɛ nɛ, aŋ vɩa dɩ ma chɩna gbɛrɛ wɩalɩŋ,
ma dɩgɩlaa suro nɛ, ka ma bɩ wɩɩkala ka nɩɩ.”
21Ʋ ŋaa La TƖƖNA tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩɩ nɛ,
ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla-la wɩaa
a leŋ ʋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ bile
dɩ la tuto kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ tʋla.
22Ama ʋ nɩaa ŋaa nɩa ba sɩ yuo dii
a kɛsɛ hɛ buotuonuŋ lɛ nɛ
ba faa a nagɛ nɩaa ba kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa
ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laaba ta.
Ba kɛmba mʋmʋ nɛ
ka nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ bʋl,
“Má kɛmba mɩɩra kɔ.”
23Ma kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ jegili wɩɩŋ deeŋ
koo a jaŋ fɩɛlɛ ʋ sɩaa a jegile nɩɩ,
a chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ?
24Kʋbɛɛ nɛ leŋe ba yuo dii
Iziral tɩŋŋaa a paa ba kɩaa ŋɩɩ?
La TƖƖNA nɛ, Nɩɩ-la harɩŋ la sɩ lɩa a ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ.
Ba vɩa dɩ ba to ʋ wombiiŋ nɛ,
a bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛba sɛyɛ.
25Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ na baanɩŋ woruŋ
ba nyuŋ, laalɩŋ jʋʋba.
Ʋ baaŋ-la nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ
a joŋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala dii,
ka ba ha bɩ wɩɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ.
Nyiŋ-la diiba ŋɩɩ ma nɛ,
ka ba ha vɩa dɩ ba joŋ wɩɩ-la
a hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Has Rescued His People
1Descendants of Jacob,
I, the Lord, created you
and formed your nation.
Israel, don't be afraid.
I have rescued you.
I have called you by name;
now you belong to me.
2When you cross deep rivers,
I will be with you,
and you won't drown.
When you walk through fire,
you won't be burned
or scorched by the flames.
3I am the Lord, your God,
the Holy One of Israel,
the God who saves you.
I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia,
and the region of Seba
in exchange for you.
4To me, you are very dear,
and I love you.
That's why I gave up nations
and people to rescue you.
5Don't be afraid! I am with you.
From both east and west
I will bring you together.
6I will say to the north
and to the south,
“Free my sons and daughters!
Let them return
from distant lands.
7They are my people—
I created each of them
to bring honor to me.”
The Lord Alone Is God
The Lord said:
8Bring my people together.
They have eyes and ears,
but they can't see or hear.
9Tell everyone of every nation
to gather around.
None of them can honestly say,
“We told you so!”
If someone heard them say this,
then tell us about it now.
10My people, you are my witnesses
and my chosen servant.
I want you to know me,
to trust me, and understand
that I alone am God.
I have always been God;
there can be no others.
11I alone am the Lord;
only I can rescue you.
12I promised to save you,
and I kept my promise.
You are my witnesses
that no other god did this.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
13I am God now and forever.
No one can snatch you from me
or stand in my way.
The Lord Will Prepare the Way
14I, the Lord, will rescue you!
I am Israel's holy God,
and this is my promise:
For your sake, I will send
an army against Babylon
to drag its people away,
crying as they go.
15I am the Lord, your holy God,
Israel's Creator and King.
16I am the one who cut a path
through the mighty ocean.
17I sent an army to chase you
with chariots and horses;
now they lie dead,
unable to move.
They are like an oil lamp
with the flame snuffed out.
Forget the Past
The Lord said:
18Forget what happened long ago!
Don't think about the past.
19I am creating something new.
There it is! Do you see it?
I have put roads in deserts,
streams in thirsty lands.
20Every wild animal honors me,
even jackals and owls.
I provide water in deserts—
streams in thirsty lands
for my chosen people.
21I made them my own nation,
so they would praise me.
22I, the Lord, said to Israel:
You have become weary of me,
but not from worshiping me.
23You have not honored me
by sacrificing sheep
or other animals.
And I have not burdened you
with demands for sacrifices
or sweet-smelling incense.
24You have not brought
delicious spices for me
or given me the best part
of your sacrificed animals.
Instead, you burden me down
with your terrible sins.
25But I wipe away your sins
because of who I am.
And so, I will forget
the wrongs you have done.
26Meet me in court!
State your case and prove
that you are right.
27Your earliest ancestor
and all your leaders
rebelled against me.
28That's why I don't allow
your priests to serve me;
I let Israel be destroyed
and your people disgraced.
translation_text:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa Laataara
1Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la.
“Mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma,
má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá,
mɩ nɛ laama ta, mɩ jɩmma nɛ a yɩrɛma,
ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.
2Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ ma,
mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ,
lɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛllɛ paama.
Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ ma,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ nyɩgɛma,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo diima.
3Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, ma Laataara,
ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kus arɩ Sɛba, time laama ta.
4A tɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa nɩfɩɛma mɩ teeŋ wɩaa,
mɩ choma a zizilma,
mɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩaa lenni ma mɩɩsɩŋ.
5Má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ kɛsɛ ma biiriŋ a lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ
a kɛmma lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ.
6Mɩ jaŋ bʋla pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nadiiŋ nɩaa: ‘Má jomba tɩa,’
a bʋla pɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa nɩaa: ‘Má sɩ́ ba lɛrɛ bil.’
Má jomba ta dɩ ba lɩɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala a kɔ.
7Ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nɛ,
mɩ nɛ ŋaaba, mɩ nɛ mɛba
dɩ ba dagɛ mɩ tʋla.”
8Laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ sɩaa aŋ bɩ na sɩpaaŋ a kɛmba kʋ lɩɩ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ dɩgɩlaa aŋ bɩ nɩɩ.
9Má leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kala kʋ hilimi.
Ba tʋɔŋ kʋbɛɛ nɛ fa wuo heele bʋl faafaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa,
arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ a pɩla?
Leŋ dɩ ba kɛŋ kʋ-la sɩ ŋaa magɩlɩŋ kʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ dagɛ arɩ ba bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ,
dɩ la nɩkaanaa ma nɩɩ a bʋl tɛŋɛ nɛ.
10La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa
arɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa,
dɩ ma wuo jɩmmɛ a laamɛ dii woruŋ arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa.
A lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ, wɩa dɔŋ kala tuo.
Kʋŋ ma dɔŋ saa bɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dɩ mɩ dee.
11Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ma TƖƖNA,
laataarʋ kala tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
12Mɩ nɛ fa bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩma,
aŋ laama ta, vene kala dee.
Ma pɛ na nɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ Wɩa.
13Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a chɩŋ dɩ-suomuŋ kala mɩ nɛ Wɩa.
Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo fori mɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
Dɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ, kʋbɛɛ nɛ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ wɩɩ-la bɩrɩmɛ?”
Wɩa nisusu-fanɩŋ arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ
14Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara
Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ laalɩyuoroo mʋ Babɩlɔŋ
a chei taŋ-la kala.
Ba babiibal goŋ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ yele.
15Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, ma Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ma
Iziral tɩŋŋaa, mɩ nɛ ma kuoro.”
16Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
ʋ nɛ bil wombiiŋ mʋga tʋɔŋ,
ʋ nɛ leŋe wɛnɩŋ pɩŋ lɩɩ-balɩŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ.
17Ʋ nɛ leŋe laalɩyuoroo arɩ ba janɩŋ torukoba
arɩ ja-jɩllaa kala tel
a bɩra bɩ wuo sii.
Ba nyɩɩga nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ fuuni chaanɩŋ dɩsɛ.
18Ʋ sɩ, “Má yʋ faafaa wɩaa,
má bɩra sɩ́ ba kaa tɩtɩŋ.
19Má bee na, lɛɛlɛ mɩɩ ŋaa wʋfalɩɩ nɛ,
ʋ suomo nɛ, ma bɩ wɩɩ-la ka naa?
Mɩɩ bil wombiiŋ nɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ,
a leŋ fuonuŋ ma pɩpɩŋ nɩmɛ.
20Baga kɩaa jaŋ zilmi,
jolluŋ arɩ hajaaŋkuŋkumba jaŋ zilmi,
bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ lɩɩŋ hɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ
dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ,
dɩ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa ba ŋaa mɩ nɩaa nyʋa.
21Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa a pɩ mɩ tɩtɩa
dɩ ba dɩdɛnnɛmɛ.
22Ama Iziral tɩmma, ma ha bɩ mɩ dɛnnɛ
a magɛ dɩ ma lɔl mɩ wɩaa, Jekɔb doho nɩaa.
23Ma bɩ piesee kaa kʋ ŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩmɛ.
Ma bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a zilmi.
Mɩ bɩ ma fʋga dɩ ma kɛŋ mɩaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɔ,
koo a walɩmɛ ma a tɩŋ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma wɩaa.
24Ma bɩ kʋsʋɔrʋsʋŋ kaa kʋ pɩmɛ
koo ma bɩ leŋe mɩ vɔgɛ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa nʋʋra lɛ.
Ama ma joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a nyagɛmɛ,
a leŋ mɩ lɔl ma wʋcheelee lɛ.
25Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, mɩ nɛ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma.
Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ mɩ tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ.
Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liisi ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
26Má liisi wɩalɩŋ sɩ bala,
dɩ la kala jʋʋ ba tʋɔŋ
a na wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ ma bʋl ma bɩ wɩɩkala cheye.
27Ma bumbuŋ naabalɩma ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ,
ma sɩpaalaaraa ma lɩɩ mɩ harɩŋ.
28Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ dɩa nɩhɩasɩŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ chei Iziral kala
aŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa tʋʋsɛ ʋ joŋŋoo.”

english_text:
The Lord's Promise to Israel
1People of Israel,
I have chosen you
as my servant.
2I am your Creator.
You were in my care
even before you were born.
Israel, don't be terrified!
You are my chosen servant,
my very favorite.
3I will bless the thirsty land
by sending streams of water;
I will bless your descendants
by giving them my Spirit.
4They will spring up like grass
or like willow trees
near flowing streams.
5They will worship me
and become my people.
They will write my name
on the back of their hands.
6 I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the first and the last,
the one and only God.
Israel, I have rescued you!
I am your King.
7Can anyone compare with me?
If so, let them speak up
and tell me now.
Let them say what has happened
since I made my nation
long ago,
and let them tell
what is going to happen.
8Don't tremble with fear!
Didn't I tell you long ago?
Didn't you hear me?
I alone am God—
no one else is a mighty rock.
Idols Can't Do a Thing
The Lord said:
9Those people who make idols
are nothing themselves,
and the idols they treasure
are just as worthless.
Worshipers of idols are blind,
stupid, and foolish.
10Why make an idol or an image
that can't do a thing?
11Everyone who makes idols
and all who worship them
are mere humans,
who will end up
sadly disappointed.
Let them face me in court
and be terrified.
Idols and Firewood
12A metalworker shapes an idol
by using a hammer
and heat from the fire.
In his powerful hand
he holds a hammer,
as he pounds the metal
into the proper shape.
But he gets hungry and thirsty
and loses his strength.
13Some woodcarver measures
a piece of wood,
then draws an outline.
The idol is carefully carved
with each detail exact.
At last it looks like a person
and is placed in a temple.
14Either cedar, cypress, oak,
or any tree from the forest
may be chosen.
Or even a pine tree planted
by the woodcarver
and watered by the rain.
15 Some of the wood is used
to make a fire for heating
or for cooking.
One piece is made into an idol,
then the woodcarver bows down
and worships it.
16He enjoys the warm fire
and the meat that was roasted
over the burning coals.
17Afterwards, he bows down
to worship the wooden idol.
“Protect me!” he says.
“You are my god.”
18Those who worship idols are stupid and blind! 19They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
20How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods?
The Lord Won't Forget His People
21People of Israel,
you are my servant,
so remember all of this.
Israel, I created you,
and you are my servant.
I won't forget you.
22Turn back to me!
I have rescued you
and swept away your sins
as though they were clouds.
Sing Praises to the Lord
23Tell the heavens and the earth
to start singing!
Tell the mountains
and every tree in the forest
to join in the song!
The Lord has rescued his people;
now they will worship him.
The Lord Created Everything
24Israel, I am your Lord,
the source of your life,
and I have rescued you.
I created everything
from the sky above
to the earth below.
25 I make liars of false prophets
and fools of fortunetellers.
I take human wisdom
and turn it into nonsense.
26I will make the message
of my prophets come true.
They are saying, “Jerusalem
will be filled with people,
and the Lord will rebuild
the towns of Judah.”
27I am the one who commands
the sea and its streams
to run dry.
28 I am also the one who says,
“Cyrus will lead my people
and obey my orders.
Jerusalem and the temple
will be rebuilt.”
translation_text:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ La TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ
1La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩmma, má jegile nɩɩ,
Jekɔb doho nɩaa, ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ.
2Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaama
a pɛ ma lɛ
a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlma,
wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
Mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa,
má sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá,
ma nɛ mɩ lɩɩsɛ.
3Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ vɔgɛ lɩɩŋ,
dɩ fuonuŋ pɩŋ nɩmɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ Dɩma a hɛ ma biiriŋ lɛ
aŋ pɛ ma doho nɩaa lɛ.
4Ba jaŋ tɔsɛ a nagɛ ya-fɩɛlɩŋ
koo a nagɛ sagɩrɩgalɩaba sɩ chɩŋ fuoŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ niiŋ.
5Dɔŋɔ jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA nɛ tɩɩmɛ.’
Nʋʋ dɔŋ ma jaŋ bʋl,
‘Mɩ ŋaa Jekɔb nʋʋ nɛ.’
Nʋʋ dɔŋ ma jaŋ ŋmʋnsa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ,
‘Mɩ ŋaa La TƖƖNA nʋʋ nɛ,’
a yɩyɩrɛ ʋ tɩtɩa Iziral tɩɩna.”
6La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna
sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa kuoro arɩ ba Laataara sɩ,
“Mɩ nɛ dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ dɩ-dɛrɩŋ,
Wɩa dɔŋ kala tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
7Nʋʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a magɛ mɩɩ?
Leŋ dɩ tɩɩna kʋ lɩɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa
a chɩŋ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ ŋaa nuhuobiinee a kaa kʋ yi jɩnɩŋ,
arɩ wɩalɩŋ ha sɩ jaŋ ŋaa.
8Má sɩ́ chel, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.
Mɩ bɩ bʋla pɩma faafaa kala wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa?
Ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naaraa. Wɩa dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a pɛ mɩ lɛɛ?
Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.”
9Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ,
tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ ŋaa ba sɩɩfɩaŋ kɩaa bɩ bʋbʋa kala kɛnɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kpaarɛ tɔmɔ-la ma ŋaa nyʋlɩma nɛ,
a ŋaa nɩyaara. Hɩɩsɩŋ jaŋ diiba.
10Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ nɩa jaŋ mɛ tɔmʋŋ
aŋ jɩŋ dɩ tɔŋ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala?
11Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ kpaarɛba jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a mɛ tɔmɔ-la
ŋaa nuhuobiinee nɛ
a bɩ dol kala kɛnɛ.
Leŋ dɩ ba kala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ba sɩ kɛnɛ.
Fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛmba dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diiba.
12Libire yie joŋ hɔɔŋ hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ nɛ,
ʋ fɩɛsɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛ a joŋ hama
a ŋmoo ŋɩɩ ʋ mʋ bɩrɩmɛ tɔmʋŋ.
Ʋ nɩsɩŋ doluŋ nɛ ʋ yie kaa libu.
Dɩ ʋ nɩɩ libu, ʋ yie lɔl nɛ,
losuŋ arɩ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ ma yie kɛnʋ nɛ.
13Kapɩnta ma yie kɛŋ kʋŋ nɛ a magɩsɛ daaŋ
a kɛŋ ʋ tɩntɩnnɩ kɩaa kere lɩɩsɛ,
a kɛŋ wogu a lɔsɔ lɩɩsɛ
ʋ zɔŋ a nagɛ nuhuobiine,
ʋ joŋo bil ʋ dɩa lɛ.
14Ʋ yie keri kuolo
koo kanchalɩŋ koo piine dɔŋɔ nɛ duuŋ lɛ,
koo ʋ yie chɔnsɛ bʋtʋma nɛ duonuŋ nɩɩ hɛ ʋ waa.
15Nuhuobiine kɛŋ daasɩ-la hɛ nyiniŋ wiwieni nɛ
aŋ pɛ kaa ŋaa kʋdiilee,
aŋ ha sii kaa ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ ma a kpʋkpaarɛ.
16Daasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ nɛ ʋ yie kaa hɛ nyiniŋ a ŋaa kʋdiilee
koo a wasɛ nammɩa,
a dii kɩaa deemba a vɔgɛ.
Ʋ yie wieni nyiŋ-la
aŋ bʋl, “Mɩ yaraa lɩma nɛ, nyiniŋ zɔmɔ.”
17Daasɩ-la kʋkaanaa, ʋ yie kaa ŋaa tɔmʋŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ.
Ʋ yie kpaarʋ aŋ bʋl,
“Ŋ nɛ mɩ wɩa, laamɛ ta.”
18Ba ŋaa nɩyaaraa nɛ, ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ
ba sɩaa tɔ nɛ, ba bɩ na.
Ba ŋaa tʋɔ-togi tɩmma nɛ,
ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ka nɩɩ.
19Nɩalɩŋ kʋŋ bɩ jaŋ hɔŋ a bɩɩnɛ a bʋl,
“Daasɩ-la dɔnsʋŋ nɛ mɩ kaa hɛ nyiniŋ
a ŋaa kʋdiilee didii
a kaa wasɛ nammɩa chɩchaŋ.
Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ daa-la kʋkaanaa
a ŋaa tɔmʋŋ a kpʋkpaarɛ?”
20Ɛɛ nɛ nɩa yaara magɛ, a sii joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa hɛ
kʋŋ sɩ jaŋ wuo dii a bɩrɩmɛ tʋɔrʋŋ lɛ?
Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo to ŋ-la a laa ʋ tɩtɩa ta.
Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩma pɩ ba tɩtɩa
arɩ kʋ-la ba sɩ koro bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ.
21“Iziral tɩmma, ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa,
má jɩŋ arɩ ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nɛ.
Mɩ nɛ ŋaama, ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ yʋ ma wɩaa.
22Mɩ dʋɔrɛ ma wʋcheelee kala ta nɛ a nagɛ duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanɩŋ sɩ sie,
a lɩɩsɛ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ma kala ta arɩ nyalɩŋ sɩ huoso.
Má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ,
mɩ laama ta nɛ.”
23Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ bʋbʋɔŋ kɩaa,
ma yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
peelee arɩ tɩa na-kala sɩ hɛ duuŋ lɛ má faasa yɩɩ yɩɩlaa,
bɛɛ wɩaa La TƖƖNA dagɛ ʋ doluŋ nɛ
a laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa a ta.
Nɩaa jaŋ hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ
24Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA, ma Laataara,
Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaama sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA,
mɩ nɛ ŋaa kʋŋkala.
Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.
25Mɩ nɛ pɔ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa a bʋl arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa
arɩ vʋgʋraa wʋmagɩlaa sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩba kʋ ŋaa.
Mɩ nɛ leŋe wʋjɩnnaa wʋjɩmɩŋ kala ŋaa pɛɩ.
26Mɩ nɛ leŋe wɩalɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnna
arɩ mɩ tɩndaaraa sɩ bʋla kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba.
Mɩ bʋla arɩ nɩaa jaŋ bɩra hɔŋ Jerusalɛm lɛ,
ka ba wasa saa Juda tasɩ-la ma sɩ pɩŋ jikpeeŋ.
27Dɩ mɩ nɛ kpɩa fuonuŋ arɩ mʋgʋ-balaa lɛ,
ba kala jaŋ hʋ.
28Mɩ nɛ bʋla pɩ Siirus, ‘Ŋ nɛ jaŋ beŋ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ,’
a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ.
Ŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba wasa saa Jerusalɛm
arɩ mɩ-na Wɩa dɩɩ-bal-la.”

english_text:
Cyrus Obeys the Lord's Commands
1The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one:
I have taken hold
of your right hand
to help you capture nations
and remove kings from power.
City gates will open for you;
not one will stay closed.
2As I lead you,
I will level mountains
and break the iron bars
on bronze gates of cities.
3I will give you treasures
hidden in dark
and secret places.
Then you will know that I,
the Lord God of Israel,
have called you by name.
4Cyrus, you don't even know me!
But I have called you by name
and highly honored you
because of Israel,
my chosen servant.
5Only I am the Lord!
There are no other gods.
I have made you strong,
though you don't know me.
6Now everyone from east to west
will learn that I am the Lord.
No other gods are real.
7I create light and darkness,
happiness and sorrow.
I, the Lord, do all this.
8Tell the heavens
to send down justice
like showers of rain.
Prepare the earth
for my saving power
to sprout and produce justice
that I, the Lord, create.
The Lord's Mighty Power
The Lord said:
9 Israel, you have no right
to argue with your Creator.
You are merely a clay pot
shaped by a potter.
The clay doesn't ask,
“Why did you make me this way?
Where are the handles?”
10Children don't have the right
to demand of their parents,
“What have you done
to make us what we are?”
11I am the Lord, the Creator,
the holy God of Israel.
Do you dare question me
about my own nation
or about what I have done?
12I created the world
and covered it with people;
I stretched out the sky
and filled it with stars.
13I have done the right thing
by placing Cyrus in power,
and I will make the roads easy
for him to follow.
I am the Lord All-Powerful!
Cyrus will rebuild my city
and set my people free
without being paid a thing.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Alone Can Save
14My people, I, the Lord, promise
that the riches of Egypt
and the treasures of Ethiopia
will belong to you.
You will force into slavery
those tall people of Seba.
They will bow down and say,
“The only true God is with you;
there are no other gods.”
15People of Israel,
your God is a mystery,
though he alone can save.
16Anyone who makes idols
will be confused
and terribly disgraced.
17But Israel, I, the Lord,
will always keep you safe
and free from shame.
Everyone Is Invited
18The Lord alone is God!
He created the heavens
and made a world
where people can live,
instead of creating
an empty desert.
The Lord alone is God;
there are no others.
19The Lord did not speak
in a dark secret place
or command Jacob's descendants
to search for him in vain.
The Lord speaks the truth,
and this is what he says
20to every survivor
from every nation:
“Gather around me!
Learn how senseless it is
to worship wooden idols
or pray to helpless gods.
21“Why don't you get together
and meet me in court?
Didn't I tell you long ago
what would happen?
I am the only God!
There are no others.
I bring about justice,
and have the power to save.
22“I invite the whole world
to turn to me and be saved.
I alone am God!
No others are real.
23 I have made a solemn promise,
one that won't be broken:
Everyone will bow down
and worship me.
24They will admit that I alone
can bring about justice.
Everyone who is angry with me
will be terribly ashamed
and will turn to me.
25I, the Lord, will give
victory and great honor
to the people of Israel.”
translation_text:
1Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Siirus,
nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ lɩɩsa a pʋ doluŋ
dɩ ʋ yuo dii tinteyee
aŋ dʋɔrɛ kuoroo ba doluŋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ jaŋ suri tabalaa boi-baalaa pʋ,
boi-baala-la bɩ jaŋ tɔ.
2Mɩ jaŋ laa ŋ sɩpaaŋ
a jɛrɛ peelee,
aŋ ŋmoo boiŋ-baala-la kala ba sɩ kɛŋ kɔlɩɩŋ ŋaa lo,
aŋ bori ba hɔ-daa-dolo-la.
3Mɩ jaŋ joŋ dʋa-la kala sɩ faa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a pɩŋ.
Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA,
Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ jɩmɩŋ, a yɩrɩŋ.
4Siirus, arɩ ŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ ma kala,
ama a tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩnnaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa
sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa wɩaa,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ lɩɩsɩŋ a pɩŋ yuŋuŋ ŋɩɩ.
5Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ dɔŋ tuo.
Mɩ nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.
Arɩ ŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ jɩŋ ma kala,
mɩ ha jaŋ pɩŋ doluŋ.
6A chɩŋ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ a kaa mʋ
wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ,
nʋʋkala jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA.
Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
7Mɩ nɛ ŋaa birimiŋ arɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ.
Mɩ nɛ leŋe nɩaa dʋdʋa, mɩ nɛ leŋe wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ ma jʋjʋʋba.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.
8Wɩa-nyuŋ, suri a leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla kʋ tuu su tinteeŋ, a nagɛ duonuŋ,
dɩ laatanɩŋ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala.
9Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ ŋɩŋaara yuyuo yuosuŋ.
Ŋ ŋaa chʋrʋŋ nɛ.
Chʋrʋŋ jaŋ wuo pɩɛsɛ pupo-mɛɛrɛ arɩ,
bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ ʋ kɛnʋ ŋɩŋaa?
Ŋ nɩsɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩŋ
arɩ ŋ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛɛ?
10Wɩaa jaŋ jʋʋ nɩɩ-la sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ nyɩmma koo ʋ naaŋ,
‘Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ŋ lʋlmɛ mɩ nagɛ ŋ-la?’ ”
11Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, a ŋaaba sɩ,
“Má kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ma pɩɛsɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa,
koo a pɩɛsɛmɛ mɩ biiriŋ wɩaa,
koo a dagɛmɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ tɩŋ mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa?
12Mɩ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ
arɩ nuhuobiine kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ.
Mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ,
a ŋaa wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ chɛnɛ arɩ chɛnwʋlaa kala a leŋ ba chɩŋ lere-la ba sɩ chɩna.
13Mɩ-na Wɩa sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ lɩɩsɛ Siirus a pʋ doluŋ, dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ wombiee kala tʋʋlɛ.
Ʋ nɛ jaŋ paa mɩ taŋ Jerusalɛm a wasa saa,
aŋ laa mɩ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ
a kaa mʋ tintee-wogusuŋ a ta.
Nʋʋkala dee bɩ ʋ joŋo dɩ ʋ ŋaa wɩaa deemba ka dɩ ʋ timu koo a siilu.
La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna nɛ bʋla.”
14Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la:
“Ijipiti tɩŋŋaa arɩ Kus tɩŋŋaa bayal kɩaa jaŋ ŋaa ma kɩaa.
Sɛba tɩŋŋaa bawayiile-la kala jaŋ ŋaa ma yosi.
Ma jaŋ hɛba chɔrʋmɔɔ,
dɩ baa to ma harɩŋ.
Ba jaŋ kpirimi ma sɩpaaŋ a suri ba niiŋ bʋl,
‘Wɩa sɩ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ nɛ
sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa, kʋŋ dɔŋ tuo.’ ”
15Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ ŋaa ba Laataara,
kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa nɛ.
16Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ mɛ tɔŋŋɔɔ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
Ba jaŋ hɩɩsɛba hɛ dɔŋɔ.
17Ama La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta,
a laa ba ta a kaa mʋ wuu.
Ba bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ,
a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diiba.
18La TƖƖNA nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ.
Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa.
Ʋ bɩ ba ŋaa dɩ ba pɩŋ hoi,
ʋ ŋaa nuhuobiinee arɩ kɩaa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ.
Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA,
kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo.
19Mɩ bɩ wɩaa lʋara bʋl
koo a ŋaa wɩaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.
Mɩ bɩra bɩ bʋla pɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa
dɩ ba nɛ tomi ŋɩɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ.
Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA, mɩ yie bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ,
a dagɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga.
20Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ fá a kagɛ ma tinteyee lɛ,
má hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɔ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ a ŋaa tɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ bɩ ba wuo laa ta a kpʋkpaarɛba a tuto vesiŋ,
ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ.
21Má kɔ sarɩya dɩ-diiliŋ a bʋl wɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ.
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bʋla faafaa kala arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ ŋaa?
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA dee?
Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
Mɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a laa nɩaa tɩta.
Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a pɛ mɩ lɛ.
22Má mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ dɩ mɩ laama ta,
ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ,
bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa, Wɩa dɔŋ bɩra tuo.
23Mɩ tɛŋɛ kala nɛ mɩ kaa hɛ niiŋ deeŋ,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ ta.
Nʋʋkala jaŋ kpirimi mɩ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlɛmɛ.
24Ba jaŋ bʋl, ‘La TƖƖNA dʋndʋŋa teeŋ nɛ la jaŋ wuo
kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla arɩ doluŋ.’
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ na baanɩŋ ʋ nyuŋ
jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ.”
25La TƖƖNA jaŋ leŋ dɩ Jekɔb doho nɩaa kala
ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma dɩ ba yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.

english_text:
Babylonia's Gods Are Helpless
The Lord said:
1The gods Bel and Nebo
are down on their knees,
as wooden images of them
are carried away
on weary animals.
2They are down on their knees
to rescue the heavy load,
but the images are still taken
to a foreign country.
3You survivors in Israel,
listen to me, the Lord.
Since the day you were born,
I have carried you along.
4I will still be the same
when you are old and gray,
and I will take care of you.
I created you. I will carry you
and always keep you safe.
5Can anyone compare with me?
Is anyone my equal?
6Some people hire a goldsmith
and give silver and gold
to be formed into an idol
for them to worship.
7They carry the idol
on their shoulders,
then put it on a stand,
but it cannot move.
They call out to the idol
when they are in trouble,
but it doesn't answer,
and it cannot help.
8Now keep this in mind,
you sinful people.
And don't ever forget it.
The Lord Alone Is God
9I alone am God!
There are no other gods;
no one is like me.
Think about what happened
many years ago.
10From the very beginning,
I told what would happen
long before it took place.
I kept my word 11and brought
someone from a distant land
to do what I wanted.
He attacked from the east,
like a hawk swooping down.
Now I will keep my promise
and do what I planned.
12You people are stubborn
and far from being safe,
so listen to me.
13I will soon come to save you.
I am not far away
and will waste no time;
I take pride in Israel
and will save Jerusalem.
translation_text:
Babɩlɔŋ vesiŋ
1Babɩlɔŋ vesi-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ
Bɛɛl arɩ Nɛbɔ wɩaa dɛrɛ nɛ,
ba faa kpaarɛba nɛ,
ama lɛɛlɛ ba nɛ ba paa hɛ pʋsʋŋ toruko lɛ ŋɩɩ.
Ba mɩɩra ŋaa chʋga nɛ a pɩ pʋsʋ-la,
ba chʋŋ a bɛsɩmɛ.
2Tɔmɔ-la arɩ pʋsʋ-la sɩ chʋmba kala tuu kpirimi nɛ,
ba bɩ ba tɩtɩa wuo laa ta,
ba kɛsɛ ba kala mʋ yo-baga nɛ.
3La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Má nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka Jekɔb doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ,
má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.
Mɩ beŋ ma nyuŋ nɛ a lɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ lʋlma.
4Dɩ ma nɛ paala hɩɛsɛ dɩ ma nyusuŋ pʋllɛ ma,
mɩ-na nɛ ma Wɩa, mɩ ha jaŋ beŋ ma nyuŋ woruŋ.
Mɩ nɛ ŋaama, a kɛmma vɩvɛŋ,
mɩ jaŋ beŋ ma nyuŋ woruŋ a laama ta.
5Kʋbɛɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo kaa magɩsɛmɛ?
Mɩ dɩ kʋbɛɛ nɛ magɛ dɔŋɔ?
6Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yie chaarɛ sɛlɩmɛ ba lʋagaba lɛ,
a joŋ hɔpʋla a magɩsɛ sanɩa lɛ,
a joŋo pɩ libire ʋ libi vene pɩba,
ka ba timu aŋ kpʋkpaarɛ.
7Ba yie joŋo baasɛ,
a kaa mʋ bil ʋ chɩŋ,
ʋ bɩ wuo vɛŋ.
Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bunso pʋ ma, ʋ yie chɩŋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ wuo laa bʋl.
Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ ma,
ʋ bɩŋ wuo laata.
8Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ mɩ niiŋ sɛyɛ,
má liisi wɩɩŋ deeŋ a joŋo hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ, a sɩ́ yʋ.
9Má liliisi wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa faafaa kala,
a jɩŋ arɩ mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa,
Wɩa dɔŋ tuo a nagɛmɛ.
10Dɩ-suomuŋ kala nɛ mɩ dagɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ kʋ ŋaa maachie.
Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ jaŋ chɩŋ,
mɩ jaŋ ŋaaʋ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ birigi.
11Mɩ jaŋ yɩrɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ dɩ-bolii a kɔ.
Ʋ jaŋ kʋ tuu a nagɛ kɩla,
a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ sɩ mɩ jaŋ ŋaa.
Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩɩna, mɩ jaŋ ŋaaba.
12Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ,
ma tʋɔ-dol tɩmma-la,
ma nɩalɩŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla pɛgɛ sɩ bolie.
13Mɩ kɛŋ mɩ tʋɔpʋla kʋ kpagɛma nɛ.
Ʋ bɩra bɩ dɩ-bolii hɛ,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni aŋ laa nɩaa ta.
Mɩ jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta,
a leŋ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kɛŋ yuŋuŋ.”

english_text:
Babylon Will Fall
The Lord said:
1 City of Babylon,
You are delicate
and untouched,
but that will change.
Surrender your royal power
and sit in the dirt.
2Start grinding grain!
Take off your veil.
Strip off your fancy clothes
and wade across rivers.
3You will suffer the shame
of going naked,
because I will take revenge,
and no one can escape.
4I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the holy God of Israel.
I am their Savior.
5Babylon, be silent!
Sit in the dark.
No longer will nations
accept you as their queen.
6I was angry with my people.
So I let you take their land
and bring disgrace on them.
You showed them no mercy,
but were especially cruel
to those who were old.
7You thought that you
would be queen forever.
You didn't care what you did;
it never entered your mind
that you might get caught.
8 You think that you alone
are all-powerful,
that you won't be a widow
or lose your children.
All you care about is pleasure,
but listen to what I say.
9Your magic powers and charms
will suddenly fail,
then you will be a widow
and lose your children.
10You hid behind evil
like a shield and said,
“No one can see me!”
You were fooled by your wisdom
and your knowledge;
you felt sure that you alone
were in full control.
11But without warning,
disaster will strike—
and your magic charms
won't help at all.
12Keep using your magic powers
and your charms
as you have always done.
Maybe—just maybe—
you will frighten somebody!
13You have worn yourself out,
asking for advice
from those who study the stars
and tell the future
month after month.
Go ask them how to be saved
from what will happen.
14People who trust the stars
are as helpless as straw
in a flaming fire.
No one can even keep warm,
sitting by a fire
that feeds only on straw.
15These are the fortunetellers
you have done business with
all of your life.
But they don't know
where they are going,
and they can't save you.
translation_text:
Babɩlɔŋ jaŋ tel
1La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Babɩlɔŋ,
ŋ fa nagɛ haala sɩ bɩ baal jɩŋ nɛ,
sii ŋ kuoru kpasa-la nyuŋ,
a tuu hɔŋ tinteeŋ.
Ŋ fa ŋaa taŋ nʋʋkala ha sɩ bɩ yuo dii aŋ ka nɛ.
Ama lɛɛlɛ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɛnɩŋ pɩɛnɛ.
2Má paa nɔnnʋŋ a nɔŋ munuŋ,
aŋ kɛŋ ma nyu-kpal duduosu-la puri ma nyusuŋ lɛ.
Má kɛŋ ma gondomba kuro ta ba jɩl,
aŋ kɛŋ naabirimee chol fuonu-la.
3Ma jaŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-biree a dii hɩɩsɩŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ baanɩŋ fɩɩsɛ ma lɛ.
Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ ma kʋbala ma ta.”
4La Laataara yɩrɩŋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna,
ʋ nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ.
5La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Babɩlɔŋ,
“Hɔŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a tɔrɛ ŋ niiŋ.
Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ yɩrɩŋ tinteyee kuoro.
6Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ mɩ nɩaa nyuŋ
a joŋ wɩaa ŋaa ba lɛ arɩ mɩ dee bɩra bɩ ba tɩɩ.
Mɩ sɩ jomba a hɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ,
ŋ bɩ ba nenige fá.
Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ paala hɩɛsɛ,
ŋ dɔgɩsɛba nɛ woruŋ.
7Ŋ fa bɩɩna arɩ ŋ jaŋ ŋaa kuoru deeŋ deeŋ nɛ,
aŋ vɩa dɩ ŋ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ chɔgɩsɛ
a na ŋɩɩ ba dɩ-dɛrɩŋ sɩ jaŋ nagɛ.
8Jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ,
ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ cho sɩma,
ŋ fa bɩɩna ŋ hɔŋ woruŋ nɛ,
wɩɩkala bɩ jaŋ walɩmɩŋ.
Ŋ fa bʋla arɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ,
kʋŋ dɔŋ tuo a magɩŋ.
Ŋ bɩɩna ŋ bɩ jaŋ kɔ
dɩ ŋ nagɛ yo-haal
koo dɩ ŋ biiriŋ kʋŋ tuo
dɩ ŋ na hɛɛŋ.
9Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ guu
ŋaa ŋ lɛ tapʋl bala.
Ŋ biiriŋ jaŋ lɛl, ka dɩ ŋ pɛ nagɛ yo-haal ma,
arɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ jɩma arɩ ŋ chichiribiŋ ma kala.
10Ŋ joŋ ŋ yɩɛlaa hɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ nɛ aŋ bʋl,
‘Nʋʋkala bɩ mɩɩ na.’
Ŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ ŋ kʋjɩma leŋe ŋ yeŋŋi nɛ.
Ŋ sɩ ŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ.
Kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo a magɩŋ.
11Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ jaŋ jʋʋŋ,
ŋ chichiribii-la bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɩŋ ba lɛ.
Wʋlɩmɩŋ jaŋ jʋʋŋ,
ka ŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo time laa ŋ tɩtɩa.
Wɩɩ ŋ ha sɩ bɩ bɩɩna aŋ ka
jaŋ guu jʋʋŋ a cheyiŋ.
12Ha fɩɛsɛ sɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa ŋ chichiribi wɩaa,
a kɛŋ daalusuŋ nyɩsa kɩkɛsɛ nɩaa
arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩɩ ŋaa
ŋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ.
Kapo ba jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ
a fugusi nʋʋ dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛnʋ.
13Wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ bʋla chagɩlɩŋ mɩɩra cheyiŋ nɛ.
Leŋ dɩ ŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie beŋ chɛnwʋlaa a dɩdagɛ wɩaa kʋ lɩɩ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie bʋl wɩalɩŋ maachie sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a pɩpɩŋ chɛnɛ na-kala,
leŋ dɩ ba laaŋ ta wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaaŋ lɛ yei.
14Nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ pɩpɩŋ nagɛ ya-yʋalaa nɛ,
nyiniŋ jaŋ diiba.
Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo laa ba tɩtɩa ta nyiŋ-la lɛ.
Nʋʋ paala bɩ nyiŋ-la wuo kpagɛ ma a saa wiwieni.
15Nɩalɩŋ harɩŋ ŋ sɩ to
ŋ hambiiriŋ kala lɛ ba dɩdagɩŋ,
wɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa pɩŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Ba kala jaŋ fá aŋ vɩaŋ ta.
Ba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo laaŋ ta.”

english_text:
The Lord Corrects His People
1People of Israel,
you come from Jacob's family
and the tribe of Judah.
You claim to worship me,
the Lord God of Israel,
but you are lying.
2You call Jerusalem your home
and say you depend on me,
the Lord All-Powerful,
the God of Israel.
3Long ago I announced
what was going to be,
then without warning,
I made it happen.
4I knew you were stubborn
and hardheaded.
5And I told you these things,
so that when they happened
you would not say,
“The idols we worship did this.”
6You heard what I said,
and you have seen it happen.
Now admit it's true!
I will show you secrets
you have never known.
7Today I am doing something new,
something you cannot say
you have heard before.
8You have never been willing
to listen to what I say;
from the moment of your birth,
I knew you would rebel.
The Lord Warns Israel
9I, the Lord, am true to myself;
I will be praised for not punishing
and destroying you.
10I tested you in hard times
just as silver is refined
in a heated furnace.
11I did this because of who I am.
I refuse to be dishonored
or share my praise
with any other god.
12 Israel, my chosen people,
listen to me.
I alone am the Lord,
the first and the last.
13With my own hand
I created the earth
and stretched out the sky.
They obey my every command.
The Lord Speaks to the Nations
14Gather around me, all of you!
Listen to what I say.
Did any of your idols
predict this would happen?
Did they say that my friend
would do what I want done
to Babylonia?
15I was the one who chose him.
I have brought him this far,
and he will be successful.
16Come closer and listen!
I have never kept secret
the things I have said,
and I was here
before time began.
It Is Best To Obey the Lord
By the power of his Spirit
the Lord God has sent me
17with this message:
People of Israel,
I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
For your own good,
I teach you, and I lead you
along the right path.
18How I wish that you
had obeyed my commands!
Your success and good fortune
would then have overflowed
like a flooding river.
19Your nation would be blessed
with more people
than there are grains of sand
along the seashore.
And I would never have let
your country be destroyed.
20 Now leave Babylon!
Celebrate as you go.
Be happy and shout
for everyone to hear,
“The Lord has rescued
his servant Israel!
21He led us through the desert
and made water flow from a rock
to satisfy our thirst.
22 But the Lord has promised
that none who are evil
will live in peace.”
translation_text:
Iziral nyu-duo tɩmma-la
1Ma Iziral tɩmma-la sɩ ŋaa Juda doho nɩaa,
má jegile nɩɩ:
Ma nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ maa chʋɔlɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa nɛ,
ama ma bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ arɩ tʋɔpʋla kɛnɛ.
2Ma sɩ ma ŋaa tabal-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɩaa nɛ,
ma yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa lɛ,
ʋ nɛ La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.
3La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa,
“Faafaa kala mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ
sɩ jaŋ ŋaa nɛ, a leŋ ma jɩmba.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ leŋ wɩalɩŋ guu ŋaa
a bal.
4Mɩ jɩma ma nyuŋ dolie nɛ woruŋ
a nagɛ hɔɔŋ.
5Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ, faafaa kala mɩ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa pɩma,
ka ba-na kʋ ŋaa.
Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ma sɩ́ wuo na wɛnɩŋ
a bʋl arɩ ma tɔmɔ-la ma sɩ kɛŋ daaŋ arɩ hɔɔŋ a ŋaa nɛ
leŋe wɩalɩŋ ŋaa.
6Ma nɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala nɛ, a naba ma dɩ ba ŋaa.
Lɛɛlɛ ma bɩ jaŋ sɛɩ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛɛ?
A chɩŋ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ,
mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋfalaa ma sɩ bɩ jɩŋ a pɩma.
7Lɛɛlɛ nɛ mɩ leŋ wɩalɩŋ ŋɩŋaa, faafaa dee
ma ha bɩ ba nɩa aŋ ka.
Ma bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl:
‘La laa sɩpaaŋ jɩmba nɛ.’
8Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ nɩa, ma bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ma jɩŋ.
Faafaa kala ma dɩgɩlaa yuŋŋie nɛ.
Ma ŋaa nɩaa
sɩ bɩ dagɩŋ ka nɩɩ nɛ
a lɩɩ ma hambiiriŋ kala lɛ.
9Ama a tɩŋ mɩ yɩrɩŋ wɩaa, mɩ bɩ leŋe mɩ baanɩŋ sii ma nyuŋ,
mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa dɛnnɛmɛ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa,
a bɩ ma kala chei ta.
10Mɩ joŋ hɛɛŋ sɩ nagɛ nyiniŋ nɛ a hɛ ma lɛ a magɩsɛ ma,
arɩ ba sɩ joŋ hɔpʋla a chɔ dɩ ba lɩɩsɛ hɔɔ-bɩnɩŋ ŋɩɩ.
11Mɩ tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ mɩ tɩma ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ.
Mɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa sɩɩŋ jʋʋmɛ,
mɩ bɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ tʋla pɩ kʋŋ dɔŋ kala.
La TƖƖNA laa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta
12Má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ Iziral tɩmma,
ma Jekɔb doho nɩaa, ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ lɩɩsa.
Mɩ-na nɛ Wɩa.
Mɩ nɛ dɩ-suomuŋ arɩ dɩ-dɛrɩŋ.
13Mɩ nɛ ŋaa tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ.
Dɩ mɩ nɛ bʋl wɩɩ tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ lɛ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ sɛnɛ yie chɩŋ.
14Má kala kʋ hilimi, a jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.
Ma tɔmɔ-la kʋbɛɛ nɛ wuo bʋla pɩma
arɩ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ nɛ dɩ ʋ yuo Babɩlɔŋ,
a joŋ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho a ŋaa ʋ lɛ?
15Mɩ-na nɛ yɩrʋ.
Mɩ jaŋ kɛnʋ lɩɩ dɩ ʋ yuo dii.
16Má kʋ kpagɛmɛ a nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ:
Faafaa kala mɩ bɩ lʋara bʋl wɩaa, mɩ heele nɛ.
Bʋa-la ma lɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa, mɩ fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ.”
Lɛɛlɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ joŋ ʋ Dɩma hɛ mɩ-na Azaaya lɛ nɛ,
aŋ tɩmmɛ.
17Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la,
ma Laataara Iziral Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ:
“Mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa,
mɩ nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ pɩma
arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ maga dɩ ma ŋɩŋaa wɩaa.
18Dɩ ma nɛ fa jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ dagɛma, a kɛmba tɩŋ,
wɩaa fa jaŋ vɛŋ woruŋ pɩma a nagɛ fuoŋ sɩ suo a pɩpɛllɛ.
19Ma doho nɩaa fa jaŋ yʋgɛ a nagɛ hagɩlɩ-biee nʋʋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo dɩɩsɛ.
Ba yɩrɩŋ fa bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ lɛlɛ mɩ teeŋ.
20Má lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ,
má fá kagɛ Babɩlɔŋ tɩŋŋaa lɛ.
Má heele bʋl arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ:
‘La TƖƖNA laa ʋ nɩaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ.’ ”
Má leŋ dɩ dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɩɩ.
21Lɩɩ-nyʋasʋŋ fa bɩ ba kpʋa, ʋ sɩ kɛmba a vɩvɛŋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.
Ʋ fa leŋe lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ lɩɩ bʋŋ lɛ nɛ,
ʋ fa leŋe bʋŋ yɛrɛ nɛ lɩɩŋ gbu lɩɩ,
ba nyʋa.
22La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ jaŋ na wiese mʋapɩlɩɩ ma.”

english_text:
The Work of the Lord's Servant
1 Everyone, listen,
even you foreign nations
across the sea.
The Lord chose me
and gave me a name
before I was born.
2 He made my words pierce
like a sharp sword
or a pointed arrow;
he kept me safely hidden
in the palm of his hand.
3The Lord said to me,
“Israel, you are my servant;
and because of you
I will be highly honored.”
4I said to myself,
“I'm completely worn out;
my time has been wasted.
But I did it for the Lord God,
and he will reward me.”
5Even before I was born,
the Lord God chose me
to serve him and to lead back
the people of Israel.
So the Lord has honored me
and made me strong.
6 Now the Lord says to me,
“It isn't enough for you
to be merely my servant.
You must do more than lead back
survivors from the tribes
of Israel.
I have placed you here as a light
for other nations;
you must take my saving power
to everyone on earth.”
The Lord Will Rescue His People
7Israel, I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
You are slaves of rulers
and of a nation
who despises you.
Now this is what I promise:
Kings and rulers will honor you
by kneeling at your feet.
You can trust me! I am your Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and you are my chosen ones.
The Lord Will Lead His People Home
8 This is what the Lord says:
I will answer your prayers
because I have set a time
when I will help
by coming to save you.
I have chosen you
to take my promise of hope
to other nations.
You will rebuild the country
from its ruins,
then people will come
and settle there.
9You will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons
to see the light of day.
On their way home,
they will find plenty to eat,
even on barren hills.
10 They won't go hungry
or get thirsty;
they won't be bothered
by the scorching sun
or hot desert winds.
I will be merciful
while leading them along
to streams of water.
11I will level the mountains
and make roads.
12Then my people will return
from distant lands
in the north and the west
and from the city of Syene.
The Lord's Mercy
13Tell the heavens and the earth
to celebrate and sing;
command every mountain
to join in the song.
The Lord's people have suffered,
but he has shown mercy
and given them comfort.
14The people of Zion said,
“The Lord has turned away
and forgotten us.”
15The Lord answered,
“Could a mother forget a child
who nurses at her breast?
Could she fail to love an infant
who came from her own body?
Even if a mother could forget,
I will never forget you.
16A picture of your city
is drawn on my hand.
You are always in my thoughts!
17“Your city will be built faster
than it was destroyed—
those who attacked it
will retreat and leave.
18Look around! You will see
your people coming home.
As surely as I live,
I, the Lord, promise
that your city with its people
will be as lovely as a bride
wearing her jewelry.”
Jerusalem's Bright Future
19Jerusalem is now in ruins!
Nothing is left of the city.
But it will be rebuilt
and soon overcrowded;
its cruel enemies
will be gone far away.
20Jerusalem is a woman
whose children were born
while she was in deep sorrow
over the loss of her husband.
Now those children
will come and seek room
in the crowded city,
21and Jerusalem will ask,
“Am I really their mother?
How could I have given birth
when I was still mourning
in a foreign land?
Who raised these children?
Where have they come from?”
22 The Lord God says:
“I will soon give a signal
for the nations
to return your sons
and your daughters
to the arms of Jerusalem.
23The kings and queens
of those nations
where they were raised
will come and bow down.
They will take care of you
just like a slave
taking care of a child.
Then you will know
that I am the Lord.
You won't be disappointed
if you trust me.”
The Lord Is on Our Side
24Is it possible to rescue victims
from someone strong
and cruel?
25But the Lord has promised
to fight on our side
and to rescue our children
from those strong
and violent enemies.
26He will make those cruel people
dine on their own flesh
and get drunk from drinking
their own blood.
Then everyone will know
that the Lord is our Savior;
the powerful God of Israel
has rescued his people.
translation_text:
La TƖƖNA tɩntɩnna
1Má jegili mɩ teeŋ tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu.
Tinteye-la sɩ hɛ dɩ-bolii nɩaa, ma ma nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.
Ka dɩ ba-na lʋlmɛ, La TƖƖNA yɩrɛmɛ nɛ.
Mɩ lʋlʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ.
2Ʋ leŋe mɩ niiŋ wɩaa kɛŋ niiŋ a nagɛ tokobiiŋ nɛ.
Ʋ kɛmmɛ faa ʋ vaaluŋ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ.
Ʋ chɛsɛmɛ nɛ a nagɛ ba sɩ chɛsɛ to-hɛmɩŋ
a joŋo hɛ ʋ to-huoŋ lɛ.
3Ʋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Iziral tɩŋŋaa ma nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa,
ma lɛ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ to a zilmi.”
4Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, “Mɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa bɩ nyʋʋrɩɩ kala kɛnɛ,
mɩ lɔlɔ tɩta pɛɩ nɛ.
Ama, mɩ joŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ,
mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ Wɩa jaŋ timmi.”
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA bʋl arɩ ka ba na lʋlmɛ, ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ,
mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ,
dɩ mɩ kɛŋ Jekɔb mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ,
dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ kɔ ʋ leriŋ.
La TƖƖNA zilmi nɛ,
mɩ Wɩa nɛ mɩ doluŋ.
6La TƖƖNA bɩra sɩ,
“Ŋ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnʋ,
a kɛŋ Iziral doho doho-la dʋndʋŋ
mɩɩra kɔ mɩ teeŋ
Jekɔb doho nɩkaana-la sɩ bɩ sʋba,
ama mɩ ha jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma pʋlʋmʋŋ,
dɩ mɩ laatanɩŋ wuo yi dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala.”
7Iziral tɩŋŋaa, Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ,
a ŋaa ba laataara
bʋla pɩ nɩɩ-la Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩ bɩ ʋ wʋŋaalaa cho a bɛrɛ,
a ŋaa kuoroo tɩntɩnnʋ:
“Kuoroo jaŋ naŋ a sii chɩŋ,
dɩ kuori-biiriŋ ma naŋ a tuu kpirimi.
Wɩaa deemba kala jaŋ ŋaa,
bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA Iziral tɩŋŋaa Wɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ
sɩ lɩɩsɛ mɩ tɩntɩnna, kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.”
8La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa,
“Dɩ bʋa-la sɩ maga dɩ mɩ laa nɩaa ta nɛ yie,
mɩ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ pɔŋ woruŋ, a leŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa nii sɩ hɛ mɩ dɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ.
Ba jaŋ wasa saa ba jikpeeni-la kala a hɔŋ nɩmɛ.
9Ŋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ
arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ a ta dɩ ba na pʋlʋmʋŋ.
Ba jaŋ na kʋdiilee
lee-la kʋŋkala sɩ paala tuo.
10Losuŋ koo lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛmba.
Wɩɩpɔsʋŋ arɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɩmɩŋ ma bɩ jaŋ lɩma kɛmba,
bɛɛ wɩaa nɩɩ-la sɩɩ fá ba nenige jaŋ laa ba sɩpaaŋ
a kɛmba mʋ lɩɩ-bulo leriŋ.
11Mɩ jaŋ yɛrɛ peelee a bil wombiee
a bil womporuŋ dɩ mɩ nɩaa vɛŋ.
12Mɩ nɩaa jaŋ lɩɩ dɩ-boloo a kɔ.
Dɔnsʋŋ jaŋ lɩɩ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ nagʋa dɩɩrɩŋ,
dɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ wɩɩjʋʋlʋŋ dɩɩrɩŋ,
ka dɔnsʋŋ ma lɩɩ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Asɩwaŋ.”
13Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kɩaa,
má ŋaa goŋ a jʋjʋɔsɛ,
peelee ma má yɩyɩɩ yɩɩlaa,
bɛɛ wɩaa, La TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ ʋ nɩaa bɔyɛ,
aŋ fá ʋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ nisusuŋ.
14Ama Jerusalɛm nɩaa sɩ,
“La TƖƖNA vɩala ta nɛ, ʋ yʋ la wɩaa nɛ.”
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ La TƖƖNA pɩɛsɛba,
“Bie sɩɩ wasɛ yɩlɩŋ, ʋ naaŋ jaŋ wuo yʋ ʋ wɩaa
a bɩ ʋ nisusuŋ ka fá?
Dɩ ʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ ma,
mɩ-na bɩ jaŋ yʋ ma wɩaa.
16Jerusalɛm tɩmma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo yʋ ma wɩaa.
Mɩ tuuri ma yɩraa hɛ mɩ nachala lɛ nɛ,
ma wɩaa hɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ.
17Ŋ hambolibiisiŋ sɩ jaŋ paa ŋ jikpeeniŋ a wasa saa ka kɔ nɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yigiŋ lo jaŋ lɩɩ aŋ leŋiŋ.
18Beŋ leriŋ kala na, ŋ nɩaa ka kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ.
Mɩ nɛ Wɩa sɩ weye,
ŋ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ ŋ nɩaa nyuŋ
arɩ ba sɩ yie kpɩɛrɛ ha-falɩŋ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ŋɩɩ.
19Ŋ tinteeŋ fa wuolo nɛ a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ,
ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa kʋbie ŋ teeŋ a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ kɔ dɩ ba hɔŋ nɩmɛ wɩaa.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ yigiŋ lo jaŋ leŋiŋ aŋ mʋ dɩ-bolii.
20Ba sɩ cheyiŋ aŋ kɛnɩŋ mʋ tintee-wogo
ŋ lʋl biiri-la,
chɛɛ dɔŋ ba jaŋ bʋla pɩŋ
arɩ tintee-la muuro nɛ,
baa chɛ leriŋ nɛ dɩ ba pɛ a wuo hɔŋ.
21Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ pɩɛsɛ ŋ tɩtɩa:
‘kʋbɛɛ nɛ lʋl biiriŋ deemba a pɩmɛ?
Mɩ nɩaa kala fa sʋba nɛ
aŋ ka mɩ hɔŋ a bɩra bɩ bii wuo lʋl.
Mɩ fa bɩ bii kala kɛnɛ aŋ hɛ yoŋ-baga lɛ.
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ dɩɛsɛ nɩaa deemba?
Mɩ dʋndʋŋa nɛ fa ka,
nɩɩ nɛ nɩaa deemba saa lɩɩ?’ ”
22Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ jaŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa duosoo
dɩ ba kɛŋ ŋ biiriŋ mɩɩra kʋ pɩŋ.
Ba jaŋ paa ŋ hambolibiisiŋ a nɔgɛ,
aŋ chaalɛ ŋ toloo a kaa kʋ pɩŋ.
23Kuoroo jaŋ ŋaa nyɩmmaba ŋ teeŋ,
dɩ kuori-haalaa ma nagɛ ŋ naamba a bibeniŋ.
Ba jaŋ kpirimi ŋ sɩpaaŋ a ziliŋ.
Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋ Tɩɩna.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ bɩ jaŋ dii hɩɩsɩŋ.”
24Ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ laalɩyuoro sɩ yuo laa, a laa ʋ teeŋ?
Koo ŋ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ nɩtɛrɛ yomo laa ʋ teeŋ?
25Ama La TƖƖNA sɩ,
“Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ paala bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ laalɩyuori-wajɩa yomo laa,
koo a laa kɩalɩŋ nɩtɛrɛ sɩ yuo laa,
mɩ-na jaŋ wuo ŋaa ŋɩɩ.
Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ yuo nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuoŋ, a laa ŋ biiriŋ ta.
26Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋ dʋndɔmɔ-la sɩɩ walɩmɩŋ gʋra kpʋ dɔŋɔ,
ba jaŋ fo ba tɩtɩa chalɩŋ.
Dɩ ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋaa,
nuhuobiinee kala jaŋ jɩŋ
arɩ mɩ nɛ ma Tɩɩna doluŋ kala Tɩɩna,
ma Iziral tɩŋŋaa Laataara.”

english_text:
The Lord's Power To Punish
1 The Lord says, “Children,
I didn't divorce your mother
or sell you to pay debts;
I divorced her and sold you
because of your sins.
2I came and called out,
but you didn't answer.
Have I lost my power
to rescue and save?
At my command oceans and rivers
turn into deserts;
fish rot and stink
for lack of water.
3I make the sky turn dark
like the sackcloth
you wear at funerals.”
God's Servant Must Suffer
4The Lord God gives me
the right words
to encourage the weary.
Each morning he awakens me
eager to learn his teaching;
5he made me willing to listen
and not rebel or run away.
6 I let them beat my back
and pull out my beard.
I didn't turn aside
when they insulted me
and spit in my face.
7But the Lord God keeps me
from being disgraced.
So I refuse to give up,
because I know
God will never let me down.
8 My protector is nearby;
no one can stand here
to accuse me of wrong.
9The Lord God will help me
and prove I am innocent.
My accusers will wear out
like moth-eaten clothes.
10None of you respect the Lord
or obey his servant.
You walk in the dark
instead of the light;
you don't trust the name
of the Lord your God.
11Go ahead and walk in the light
of the fires you have set.
But with his own hand,
the Lord will punish you
and make you suffer.
translation_text:
Iziral wʋbɔmʋŋ arɩ tɩntɩnnʋ-la sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa niiŋ
1Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA sɩ pɩɛsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa nɛ ŋ-la:
“Teŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ ma naaŋ,
aŋ kiru ta hɛ nɩɩ nɛ?
Koo kʋbɛɛ chɩŋ nɛ mɩ dii
a joŋu yalla tiŋ?
Ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ma nagɛ nʋʋ ba sɩ yalla.
Ma wʋcheelee nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kirima ta.
2Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɔ dɩ mɩ laama ta, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kʋŋ tuo?
Mɩ sɩ yɩra, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma kʋŋkala bɩ sɛyɛ?
Ma bɩɩna mɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ mɩ laama ta nɛ koo?
Ma bɩɩna mɩ ŋaa nɩpʋgʋ nɛ a bɩ ma wuo laa ta koo?
Dɩ mɩ nɛ kpɩa mʋga koo fuonuŋ lɛ,
ba kala yie hʋ nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ,
chenfile-la sɩ hɛ ba lɛ
kala sʋʋ lɩɩnyʋasʋŋ.
3Mɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ wɩa-nyuŋ biri
a nagɛ tʋɔ-chei gɛrɩŋ ba sɩ yie laalɛ a yiyel yoho.”
4La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ joŋ nɩaa dagɩŋ doluŋ pɩmɛ nɛ,
dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩaa a leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ nandaasɩŋ sɩ yʋɔra nyuŋ nyaasɛ.
Chʋchʋa na-kala,
ʋ yie chɩsɛmɛ nɛ
a leŋ mɩ cho dɩ mɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ
ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ dagɛmɛ.
5La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ dagɛmɛ wɩalɩŋ mɩ nɩa nɛ, mɩ bɩ ba vɩa,
mɩ bɩ ʋ harɩŋ ma mɩɩra.
6Mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa nɩalɩŋ
sɩ ŋmoo mɩ nɛ,
aŋ fʋʋla yagɛ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ sieri mɩ lɛ
a kɛŋ mɩ tɔŋ-pʋnaa lɩlɛrɛ
aŋ pɛ tʋ nantʋɔrʋŋ hɩhɛ mɩ sɩaa lɛ
mɩ bɩ mɩ sɩaa kaa faaba.
7A tɩŋ La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa,
mɩ joŋ sɩaa chaasɛba nɛ,
mɩ jɩma, hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ diimi.
8Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ bɩ wɩɩ cheye kpagɛmɛ nɛ.
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo bʋl mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ?
Nɩɩ-la sɩ bene dɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ,
ʋ chaasa kʋ lɩɩ chɩŋ mɩ sɩpaaŋ
a dagɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ cheye.
9La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ tɩtɩa nɛ chɩŋ mɩ harɩŋ.
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ chei wɩɩ nɛ?
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ bʋl mɩ teeŋ jaŋ kɔsɛ
a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ tiiŋ sɩ die.
10Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ zil La TƖƖNA,
a sɛɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ tɩntɩnna sɩ bʋla,
dɩ ma nɩɩ vɛŋ birimiŋ lim tʋɔŋ
a bɩ nyiniŋ kɛnɛ ma,
má laa La TƖƖNA dii,
a bibeŋ ma Wɩa lɛ.
11Ama, ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ lɔgɛ wɩaa a wuwurisi ma dɔnsʋŋ,
wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ gʋra jomma dii.
La TƖƖNA tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa ma lɛ.
Ma jaŋ faasa na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.

english_text:
The Lord Will Bring Comfort
1 If you want to do right
and obey the Lord,
follow Abraham's example.
He was the rock from which
you were chipped.
2God chose Abraham and Sarah
to be your ancestors.
The Lord blessed Abraham,
and from that one man
came many descendants.
3Though Zion is in ruins,
the Lord will bring comfort,
and the city will be as lovely
as the garden of Eden
that he provided.
Then Zion will celebrate;
it will be thankful
and sing joyful songs.
The Lord's Victory Will Last
4The Lord says:
You are my people and nation!
So pay attention to me.
My teaching will cause justice
to shine like a light
for every nation.
5Those who live across the sea
are eagerly waiting
for me to rescue them.
I am strong and ready;
soon I will come to save
and to rule all nations.
6Look closely at the sky!
Stare at the earth.
The sky will vanish like smoke;
the earth will wear out
like clothes.
Everyone on this earth
will die like flies.
But my victory will last;
my saving power never ends.
7If you want to do right
and obey my teaching
with all your heart,
then pay close attention.
Don't be discouraged
when others insult you
and say hurtful things.
8They will be eaten away
like a moth-eaten coat.
But my victory will last;
my saving power
will never end.
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
9Wake up! Do something, Lord.
Be strong and ready.
Wake up! Do what you did
for our people long ago.
Didn't you chop up
Rahab the monster?
10Didn't you dry up the deep sea
and make a road for your people
to follow safely across?
11Now those you have rescued
will return to Jerusalem,
singing on their way.
They will be crowned
with great happiness,
never again to be burdened
with sadness and sorrow.
The Lord Gives Hope
12I am the Lord, the one
who encourages you.
Why are you afraid
of mere humans?
They dry up and die like grass.
13I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
But you have forgotten me,
your Lord and Creator.
All day long you were afraid
of those who were angry
and hoped to oppress you.
Where are they now?
14Everyone crying out in pain
will be quickly set free;
they will be rescued
from the power of death
and never go hungry.
15I will help them
because I am your God,
the Lord All-Powerful,
who makes the ocean roar.
16I have told you what to say,
and I will keep you safe
in the palm of my hand.
I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
Now I say, “Jerusalem,
your people are mine.”
A Warning to Jerusalem
17 Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up!
You've drunk too much
from the cup filled
with the Lord's anger.
You have swallowed every drop,
and you can't walk straight.
18Not one of your many children
is there to guide you
or to offer a helping hand.
19You have been destroyed
by war and by famine;
I cannot comfort you.
20The Lord your God is angry,
and on every street corner
your children lie helpless,
like deer trapped in nets.
21You are in trouble and drunk,
but not from wine.
So pay close attention
22to the Lord your God,
who defends you and says,
“I have taken from your hands
the cup filled with my anger
that made you drunk.
You will never be forced
to drink it again.
23Instead I will give it
to your brutal enemies,
who treated you like dirt
and walked all over you.”
translation_text:
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Zaayɔŋ nyuŋ jaŋ na laatanɩŋ a kaa mʋ wuu
1La Tɩɩna sɩ, “Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ chɛ tʋɔpʋla,
arɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ ma TƖƖNA, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.
Má beŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaama sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ a nagɛ bʋŋ.
2Má liisi ma naabalɩma Abɩraham
arɩ Sara wɩaa, ma ŋaa ba doho nɩaa nɛ.
Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ yɩrɛ Abɩraham,
ʋ fa bɩ bii kala kɛnɛ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ, a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ biiriŋ,
ʋ doho nɩaa yʋgɛ woruŋ.
3Mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA jaŋ nyagɛ Zaayɔŋ nɩaa bɔyɛ
a fá Jerusalɛm nɩaa nisusuŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ʋ jikpeeni-la lɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ kala mɩɩra nagɛ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA ŋmaŋkaa-la fa sɩ hɛ Ɛdɩŋ lɛ.
Ʋ tintee-hɩlɩɩ-la jaŋ nagɛ mɩ ŋmaŋkaaŋ.
Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ba yɩɩ yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛmɛ.
4Mɩ nɩaa, mɩ tinteeŋ nɩaa, má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ woruŋ.
Mɩ jaŋ dagɛ mɩ wombiiŋ a pɩ tinteyee nɩaa.
Mɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ jaŋ ŋaa ba pʋlʋmʋŋ.
5Mɩ tʋɔpʋl wɩaa kʋ kpagɛma lɩma nɛ.
Bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ laama ta kpaga nɛ.
Mɩ doluŋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ tinteyee nɩaa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ.
Tinteye-la lɩɩŋ sɩ gollo chu nɩaa joŋ ba yɩɛlaa hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ,
a gbɩgbɛrɛmɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ laaba ta.
6Má wʋla beŋ wɩa-nyuŋ na,
aŋ beŋ tinteeŋ ma na.
Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ nyɩɩgɛ
a nagɛ nyʋɔsʋŋ sɩ lɛlɛ.
Tinteeŋ ma sɩma kala jaŋ lɩɩ
a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ sɩ lɩa.
Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ jaŋ sʋʋ
a nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ.
Ama mɩ ha jaŋ laa mɩ nɩaa tɩta a kaa mʋ wuu.
Mɩ tʋɔpʋla ma bɩ jaŋ dɛrɛ.
7Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a joŋ
mɩ wombii-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ,
má jegile nɩɩ mɩ teeŋ.
Dɩ nɩaa nɛ ŋaa wɩaa a jʋjʋʋ ma lɛ koo a tʋtʋʋsɛma,
má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma.
8Ba kala jaŋ kɔsɛ
a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ tiiŋ sɩ die.
Nanchʋɔlaa jaŋ dii ba kala
a nagɛ ba sɩ dii pie-pʋnaa.
Ama mɩ tʋɔpʋla
arɩ mɩ nɩaa laatanɩŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”
9La TƖƖNA, sii a pɛ la lɛ arɩ ŋ doluŋ a laala ta.
Sii ŋaa ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa
ŋ fa sɩ ŋaa pɩ la bumbuŋ nɩaa.
Ŋ dee fa bɩ mʋga tʋɔŋ peribanyeŋŋu
ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Rahab kaa keri muno muno ŋɩɩ?
10Ŋ dee fa bɩ ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ hʋ,
aŋ ka ŋ bil wɛnɩŋ ʋ dɩ-luŋuŋ,
nɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa ta to chol?
11Nɩalɩŋ La TƖƖNA sɩ laa ta jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ ʋ teeŋ.
Ba jaŋ yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kʋ jʋʋ Jerusalɛm.
Ba jaŋ nɩɩ sɩma a kaa mʋ wuu.
Tʋɔtɔrʋŋ jaŋ faasa yʋgɛ ba teeŋ,
dɩ hɛɛŋ arɩ tʋɔ-cheeŋ fa lɛl.
12La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ-na nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ nyagɛ ma bɔyɛ.
Ka ma mɩɩra fɩfá nuhuobiine sɩɩ sʋʋ a nagɛ yaŋ
a bɩ dɩ-pɛsɩɩ kala kɛnɛ.
13Ma yʋ mɩ-na ma TƖƖNA sɩ ŋaa ma wɩaa nɛ
Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala.
Aŋ ka fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma tapʋlɩɩ kala
a tɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma wɩaa.
Kʋbɛɛ ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛma?
Nɩɩ nɛ ba hɛ lɛɛlɛ?
14Fawʋlʋba-la kala ba sɩ kaa tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni ka mɩ laaba ta.
Ba bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ.
Losuŋ ma bɩ jaŋ kpʋba,
15bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɛ ma TƖƖNA Wɩa,
mɩ nɛ yie ŋaa mʋgʋ-balɩŋ lɩɩŋ huhuuri.
Mɩ yɩrɩŋ nɛ ma TƖƖNA doluŋ kala Tɩɩna.
16Mɩ nɛ joŋ mɩ wɩaa hɛ ma niiriŋ lɛ,
a kɛŋ mɩ nɩsɩŋ a chu tɔma.
Mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala,
aŋ bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa,
‘Má nɛ mɩ nɩaa.’ ”
La TƖƖNA Baanɩŋ
17Jerusalɛm nɩaa,
má sii chɩŋ,
ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ
La TƖƖNA nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
Ʋ na baanɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛma kɩŋkɛŋ nɛ,
ma kala vɔgɛ a gɩgɛrɛ.
18Ma hambolibiisiŋ kala tʋɔŋ,
nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ laa ma sɩpaaŋ.
Nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ dɩɛsa tʋɔŋ,
nʋʋ tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ.
19Wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ deemba balɩa sɩ jʋʋma,
nʋʋ hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ jaŋ nyagɛ ma bɔyɛɛ?
Laalɩŋ sɩ jʋa, ma taŋ tel a pɩŋ jikpeeŋ, losuŋ ma jʋʋ,
nʋʋ hɛ nɩmɛ a nyagɛ ma bɔyɛɛ?
20La TƖƖNA Wɩa chaasa na baanɩŋ nɛ ma nyuŋ.
Ma biiriŋ yiege nɛ a pɩŋ wombiiŋ niiŋ loŋgoru kala lɛ,
a nagɛ bɛrɛ sɩ kɛŋ bagɩla.
21Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma Jerusalɛm nɩaa,
hɛɛ-la sɩ leŋe ma nagɛ nɩaa sɩ bugo, má nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ.
22Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ,
ma Wɩa sɩ chɩŋ ma harɩŋ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ kɛŋ hɛɛ-la mɩ fa sɩ na baanɩŋ a joŋo hɛ ma lɛ
a leŋ ma gɩgɛrɛ a dʋɔrɛ ma lɛ nɛ.
Ma bɩra bɩ jaŋ naʋ.
23Mɩ jaŋ mɩɩra joŋ hɛɛ-la a hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dɔgɩsɛ ma lɛ,
nɩalɩŋ sɩ yie leŋ ma tuu pɩŋ tinteeŋ
ba nʋɔsɛma bɩbal
a nagɛ ma ŋaa hagɩla nɛ,
a nagɛ wombiiŋ ba sɩɩ vɛŋ ʋ lɛ.”

english_text:
Jerusalem Can Celebrate
1 Jerusalem, wake up!
Stand up and be strong.
Holy city of Zion,
dress in your best clothes.
Those foreigners who ruined
your sacred city
won't bother you again.
2Zion, rise from the dirt!
Free yourself from the rope
around your neck.
Suffering Will End
3The Lord says:
My people, you were sold,
but not for money;
now you will be set free,
but not for a payment.
4Long ago you went to Egypt
where you lived
as foreigners.
Then Assyria was cruel to you,
5 and now another nation
has taken you prisoner
for no reason at all.
Your leaders groan with pain,
and day after day
my own name is cursed.
6My people, you will learn
who I am and who is speaking
because I am here.
A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
7 What a beautiful sight!
On the mountains a messenger
announces to Jerusalem,
“Good news! You're saved.
There will be peace.
Your God is now King.”
8Everyone on guard duty,
sing and celebrate!
Look! You can see the Lord
returning to Zion.
9Jerusalem, rise from the ruins!
Join in the singing.
The Lord has given comfort
to his people;
he comes to your rescue.
10The Lord has shown all nations
his mighty strength;
now everyone will see
the saving power of our God.
A Command To Leave Babylon
11 Leave the city of Babylon!
Don't touch anything filthy.
Wash yourselves. Be ready
to carry back everything sacred
that belongs to the Lord.
12You won't need to run.
No one is chasing you.
The Lord God of Israel
will lead and protect you
from enemy attacks.
The Suffering Servant
13The Lord says:
My servant will succeed!
He will be given great praise
and the highest honors.
14Many were horrified
at what happened to him.
But everyone who saw him
was even more horrified
because he suffered until
he no longer looked human.
15 My servant will make
nations worthy to worship me;
kings will be silent
as they bow in wonder.
They will see and think about
things they have never seen
or thought about before.
translation_text:
1Jerusalɛm nɩaa, má sii, má sii chɩŋ,
a kɛŋ doluŋ.
Zaayɔŋ taŋ-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɩaa,
má paa ma gɛrɩ-zɔŋŋɔɔ laalɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kʋ jʋʋ ma taŋ-la.
2Má pɩɩsɛ ma disiniŋ ta,
aŋ hɔŋ ma kuoru kpasa nyuŋ.
Ma Jerusalɛm nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yuo kɛsɛ,
má lɩɩsɛ chɔrʋmɔ-la sɩ hɛ ma baŋŋaa lɛ.
3La TƖƖNA bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa,
“Bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kɛmma mʋ yoŋ-baga,
ba bɩ moribii kala time
aŋ kɛmma mʋ.
Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma bɩ jaŋ tiŋ moribii kala
ka dɩ ba jomma ta.”
4Wɩɩ-la La TƖƖNA Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la:
“Faafaa-la mɩ nɩaa sie nɛ a mʋ hɔŋ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra.
Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ nɛ, Asiiria tɩŋŋaa ma bɩra fʋga kɛsɛba mʋ a dɔgɩsɛ.”
5La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Bɛɛ kʋŋ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ daha lɛɛlɛ?
Ba kɛsɛ mɩ nɩaa mʋ yoŋ-baga nɛ pɛɩ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemba sisieri mɩ lɛ
aŋ chichei mɩ yɩrɩŋ bʋa na-kala.
6Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋa kʋbala jaŋ yi dɩ mɩ nɩaa jɩŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ Wɩa,
mɩ nɛ fa bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩba.”
7Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ chɩŋ peeliŋ nyuŋ
a bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ba yuo dii ba dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ,
a bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa dɩ Wɩa laaba ta nɛ,
dɩ ba jaŋ na fɩɛlɩŋ,
a bʋla pɩ Jerusalɛm nɩaa,
“Ma Wɩa nɛ kuoro.”
8Nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɔ Jerusalɛm kala
ka ŋaa goŋ nɛ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ.
Dɩ La TƖƖNA nɛ mɩɩra kɔ Zaayɔŋ,
ba jaŋ naʋ arɩ ba sɩɩŋ.
9Má gbaara yɩɩ yɩɩlaa arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ ka
Jerusalɛm jikpeeŋ lɛ.
La TƖƖNA jaŋ laa Jerusalɛm nɩaa ta,
aŋ nyagɛ ba nɩaa bɔyɛ.
10La TƖƖNA jaŋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ
dɩ tinteyee kala na.
Dʋnɩa sɛmɛ na-kala nɩaa jaŋ na ŋɩɩ,
la Wɩa sɩ laa ʋ nɩaa ta.
11Má lɩɩ Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, má lɩɩ nɩmɛ!
Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ chʋŋ Wɩa dɩa kɩaa.
Má sɩ́ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ disiniŋ digu.
Má sɩ́ disiniŋ ŋaa hɛ ma tɩtɩa lɛ aŋ lɩɩ.
12Má sɩ́ pese lɩɩ,
nʋʋ dee bɩ ma ka kiri.
La TƖƖNA jaŋ hɛ ma sɩpaaŋ,
Iziral Wɩa jaŋ hɛ ma harɩŋ a pɔma.
13La TƖƖNA sɩ, “Mɩ tɩntɩnna jaŋ dii nyuŋ ʋ wɩaa kala lɛ.
Ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ sii kɩŋkɛŋ, dɩ nɩaa zizilu woruŋ.
14Nɩaa yʋga a naʋ ba yaraa vɛŋ.
Ʋ nagɩŋ kala bɩrɩmɛ arɩ nuhuobiiŋ dee.
15Ʋ wɩaa jaŋ teeli tinteyee kala,
kuoroo niiriŋ jaŋ maa
dɩ ba chɛ wɩɩ ka dɩ ba bʋl a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa.
Wɩalɩŋ ba ha sɩ bɩ na a bɩ nɩa ma,
ba jaŋ naba a jɩŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ.”

english_text:
What God's Servant Did for Us
1 Has anyone believed us
or seen the mighty power
of the Lord in action?
2Like a young plant or a root
that sprouts in dry ground,
the servant grew up
obeying the Lord.
He wasn't some handsome king.
Nothing about the way he looked
made him attractive to us.
3He was hated and rejected;
his life was filled with sorrow
and terrible suffering.
No one wanted to look at him.
We despised him and said,
“He is a nobody!”
4He suffered and endured
great pain for us,
but we thought his suffering
was punishment from God.
5 He was wounded and crushed
because of our sins;
by taking our punishment,
he made us completely well.
6 All of us were like sheep
that had wandered off.
We had each gone our own way,
but the Lord gave him
the punishment we deserved.
7 He was painfully abused,
but he did not complain.
He was silent like a lamb
being led to the butcher,
as quiet as a sheep
having its wool cut off.
8He was condemned to death
without a fair trial.
Who could have imagined
what would happen to him?
His life was taken away
because of the sinful things
my people had done.
9 He wasn't dishonest or violent,
but he was buried in a tomb
among cruel, rich people.
10The Lord decided his servant
would suffer as a sacrifice
to take away the sin
and guilt of others.
Now the servant will live
to see his own descendants.
He did everything
the Lord had planned.
11By suffering, the servant
will learn the true meaning
of obeying the Lord.
Although he is innocent,
he will take the punishment
for the sins of others,
so that many of them
will no longer be guilty.
12 The Lord will reward him
with honor and power
for sacrificing his life.
Others thought he was a sinner,
but he suffered for our sins
and asked God to forgive us.
translation_text:
1Kʋbɛɛ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a laa wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla a dii?
Kʋbɛɛ nɛ La TƖƖNA kɛŋ ʋ doluŋ dagɛ?
2La TƖƖNA sɩɩŋ lɛ nɛ ka ʋ tɩntɩnna wʋwaa,
a nagɛ jɩnjaaŋ-bʋgʋŋ sɩ tɔsɔ lɩlɩɩ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.
Ʋ bɩ tʋla kɛnɛ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋ bɩbagɩsʋ a kɔ ʋ teeŋ,
kʋŋkala tuo ʋ lɛ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ la chou.
3Nuhuobiinee vɩaʋ nɛ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba sɩɩŋ bɩ ʋ suo.
Ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-cheeŋ nɛ
a mal hɛɛŋ.
Nɩaa paala bɩ cho dɩ ba naʋ.
Ba bɩ ʋ bene dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋŋkala, la lɩɩsɛ la jɩa ta ʋ lɛ.
4Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ nɛ laa la nyanyalaa
arɩ hɛɛ-la kala la sɩ na a chʋŋ.
Ka la ha bɩɩnɛ arɩ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na,
Wɩa nɛ dɔgɩsʋ.
5Ba pɩrʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ.
Wʋbɔmɔ-la la sɩ ŋaa wɩaa nɛ ba tɩma vɩɩrʋ.
Hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na nɛ leŋe la kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa.
Ba sɩ pɩrʋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ dɩ la nɛ wɩɩla ma, la yie duori.
6La kala nagɛ piesee sɩ yeŋŋe nɛ,
la kʋŋkala joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wombiiŋ.
Hɛɛ-la la kala fa sɩ jaŋ na a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa,
La TƖƖNA mɩɩra joŋo daŋ ʋ lɛ nɛ.
7Ba fa dɔgɩsʋ nɛ, ʋ na hɛɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ,
ama ʋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ suro.
Ba fa kɛnʋ a nagɛ pie-bie nɛ
a kaa mʋ dɩ ba kpʋ
koo a nagɛ piese ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛ ʋ pʋna,
ka ʋ tɔrɛ ʋ niiŋ, ʋ bɩ ʋ niiŋ suro.
