14I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children. 15So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much? 16You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you. 17Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you? 18I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
19Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
20I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob. 21I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl na wɩaa arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ
1Ʋ maga mɩ sɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ sɩ bɩ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ ma, ama mɩ ha jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe mɩ na a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ. 2Mɩ jɩŋ baal kʋbala fa sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii. Ʋ jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ nɛ ŋ-la Wɩa sɩ guu joŋu kaa jɩl ʋ jaŋ dɩ-bolii-la, a dagʋ wɩaa yʋgɛ, aŋ mɩɩra kɛnʋ kaa kʋ tuu ta. Dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ dɩma nɛ koo ʋ yaraa kala nɛ, mɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Wɩa nɛ jɩma. 3Mɩ jɩma arɩ baala deeŋ Wɩa guu joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ. Dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ dɩma nɛ koo ʋ yaraa kala nɛ, mɩ bɩ jɩŋ. Wɩa nɛ jɩma. 4Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ nɩa, nuhuobiinee paala bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋlba. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba bʋlba ma. 5Mɩ jaŋ bigisi baala deeŋ lɛ, mɩ-na bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ wuo bigisi. Ama dɩ mɩ nɩɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa ma lɛ, mɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ daga arɩ mɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ lɛ. 6Dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ ma, mɩ bɩ jaŋ bʋl nɩyaarɛ wɩaa. Mɩ jaŋ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩba. Ama mɩ bɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a bɩɩnɛ arɩ mɩ kɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ maga nɛ, a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ na mɩ teeŋ, koo a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa dɩ mɩɩ bʋl lɛ. 7Wʋkpuŋkperisi-la kala Wɩa sɩ joŋo dagɛmɛ fa jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ mɩ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ. Ama dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ, Wɩa joŋ hɛɛ kʋbala hɛ mɩ lɛ. Ʋ wʋwɩɩ a nagɛ sɔɔŋ sɩ tɔmɛ. Hɛɛ-la naga ʋ to Sɩtaanɩ lɛ nɛ a kʋ walɩmɛmɛ dɩ mɩ sɩ́ wuo na wombiiŋ a bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ. 8Mɩ yaraa sɩɩ wɩɩ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sʋl Wɩa naansɩɩŋ butori dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ mɩ yaraa fɩɛlɛ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bʋla pɩmɛ, “Mɩ zile yʋga kɩŋkɛŋ ŋ teeŋ, dɩ ŋ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ doluŋ yie faasa tɩŋ ŋ lɛ.” Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ wɩaa, dɩ Kirisito dol-la wuo hɛ mɩ lɛ a tɩtɩŋ. 10Ŋɩɩ wɩaa a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, dɩ ba nɩɩ tʋʋsɛmɛ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ na hɛɛŋ, dɩ ba nɛ to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ, koo dɩ wɩaa nɛ jʋʋmɛ ma, mɩ tʋɔŋ ha yie tɔrɛ nɛ. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ, Wɩa yie pɩmɛ ʋ doluŋ nɛ.
Kɔrɩntɩ nɩaa wɩaa wɩɩ Pɔɔl
11Mɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ mɩ ŋaa nɩyaarɩ nɛ. Ma nɛ saa yigimi hɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ. Ma nɛ fa maga dɩ ma bɩbɛsɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ama nanzɔɔba-la sɩ joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba nɛ kɩɩ nʋʋkala, ba bɩ mɩ kpɩa. 12Mɩ nyalɩma nɛ woruŋ a wuo tɩŋ ma teeŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa, wʋmagɩlaa arɩ wʋkpuŋkperisi-la arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ daga arɩ mɩ sɛnɛ ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ. 13Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋaa ma lɛ, ba tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-kala lɛ. Wɩɩ-la dʋndʋŋa mɩ sɩ bɩ ŋaa ma lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ bɩ ma walɩma dɩ ma pɩmɛ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ saa sʋlma dɩ ma joŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ chɛmɛ.
14Tori nɛ ŋ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kʋ nama, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ walɩmɛma dɩ ma pɩmɛ kʋŋkala. Mɩ bɩ ma kʋŋkala ka chɛ. Ma tɩtɩa nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa hambiisiŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo chɛ kɩaa bil ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba lɛ. Ama hambiisiŋ nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba nɛ maga dɩ ba chɛ kɩaa a bil ba biiriŋ lɛ. 15A tɩŋ ma wɩaa mɩ paala faasa cho nɛ dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ arɩ mɩ doluŋ a tɩma pɩma. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ choma kɩŋkɛŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma ma chomi nɛ. 16Ʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ mɩ bɩ ma walɩma dɩ ma pɩmɛ kʋŋkala, ama ma dɔnsʋŋ bʋla arɩ mɩ nyɩsa laa ma kɩaa nɛ. 17Nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ tɩma ba kɔ ma teeŋ, ma bɩɩna mɩ tɩmba dɩ ba kʋ nyɩsa laa ma kɩaa nɛɛ? 18Mɩ nɛ tɩŋ Taatɩs arɩ la naambie dɔŋɔ ba kɔ ma teeŋ. Taatɩs sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋ nyɩsa laa ma kʋŋ nɛɛ? Wɩɩkala la sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, mɩ dɩ Taatɩs ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. La kala ka to wɛŋ-bala nɛ.
19Wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩɩ bʋl, ma jaŋ bɩɩnɛ arɩ laa bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ la laa la tɩtɩa ma teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ dee. La hɛ Kirisito lɛ nɛ aa bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, laa ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala dɩ la wuo pɛ ma lɛ nɛ dɩ ma waa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. 20Fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ mɩ sɩ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ. Ŋ bɩ pɔ mɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ma bɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ cho naga, ma ma jaŋ na dɩ mɩ ma bɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho naga. Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ nama dɩ maa yuo yuosuŋ, a kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, a nɩna baanɩŋ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ pʋpɔrɛ, a chichei dɔŋɔba yɩrɩŋ, a gɩgaa dɔŋɔ harɩŋ, a kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ, a bɩ nii-bala kɛnɛ. 21Mɩ bɔyɛ ka joŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩra kɔ ma teeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ kɛmmɛ ma wɩaa, dɩ mɩ yel a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Nɩaa yʋga a hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, a ŋaa disiniŋ, a ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a gɔllɔ chɛ nɩaa haalaa, aŋ bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba lɛ.

english_text:
Final Warnings and Greetings
1 I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.” 2During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning. 3This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful! 4Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
5Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed. 6I hope you will discover we have not failed. 7We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
8All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it. 9Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better. 10I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
11Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other.
Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you. 12Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
13I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will bless you and be kind to you! May God bless you with his love, and may the Holy Spirit join all your hearts together.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl bɩra chagɩlɛ Kɔrɩntɩ nɩaa aŋ chʋɔlɛba
1Naansɩɩŋ butori nɛ ŋ-la mɩ sɩɩ kɔ ma teeŋ dɩ mɩ nama. Wɩa teniŋ sɩ, “Nɩaa balɩa koo nɩaa batori nɛ jaŋ pɛ na wɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ na chɩŋ.” 2Mɩ sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ lɩamɩŋ lɛ, mɩ kpʋrɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala dɩgɩlaa nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ama mɩ bɩra kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ arɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ torimuŋ lɛ, mɩ bɩ jaŋ taba. 3Maa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ Kirisito hɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl wɩaa. Kirisito bɩ puwuol ŋaa, ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ ma lɛ, a wuoma ma wɩɩkala lɛ. 4Ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ a nagɛ arɩ ʋ fa bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ama Wɩa doluŋ lɛ ʋ sie nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La hɛ Kirisito lɛ nɛ a bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ la tɩtɩa lɛ. Kirisito sɩ weye ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa doluŋ lɛ a tɩma pɩma.
5Má beŋ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a pɛ mɩmagɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa, a na dɩ ma chɩŋ ma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii naaŋ lɛ nɛ koo ma bɩ chɩna. Ma bɩ jɩŋ arɩ Yesu Kirisito hɛ ma lɛ nɛɛ? Dɩ ma nɛ bɩ jɩŋ dɩ ʋ hɛ ma lɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ma tele nɛ ŋɩɩ. 6Mɩ laa dii arɩ ma jaŋ na dɩ la-na bɩ tele. 7La sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma dɩ ma sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei. Ʋ bɩ naga laa chɛ dɩ la dagɛ arɩ la-na ŋaa woruŋ nɛ, ama laa chɛ dɩ ma wuo ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombiiŋ nɛ, dɩ ma nɛ paala bɩɩnɛ la-na tele ma, 8bɛɛ wɩaa la bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la harɩŋ. Ama la chɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la lɛ nɛ. 9Dɩ la nɛ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma, la yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ a tɩŋ dol-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ wɩaa. Wɩɩ-la la sɩ sʋl Wɩa chɩchɛ nɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ ma laa Kirisito wɩaa dii wasa dol. 10Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩpɩma. Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ dagɛ dol-la La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ ma teeŋ. Ʋ joŋ dol-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kaa pɛ ma lɛ nɛ dɩ ma wasa dol. Ʋ bɩ sɩ dɩ mɩ kaa cheima.
11Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ teniŋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Maa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ. Má jegile nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma, má kɛŋ nii-bala a ŋaa sɩma. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩ cho nɩaa jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ a leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. 12Má kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala a guori dɔŋɔ a chʋchʋɔlɛ dɔŋɔ. 13Wɩa nɩaa kala ka chʋɔlɛma.
14Laa sʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma jʋʋ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ, dɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa ma choma, ka dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa kʋbala. Amɩɩ.

english_text:
1-2From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me.
I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work.
To the churches in Galatia:
3I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! 4Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world. 5God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen.
The Only True Message
6I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message, 7when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ. 8I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven. 9I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
10I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ.
How Paul Became an Apostle
11My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach. 12It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
13 You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it. 14 I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us. 15 But even before I was born, God had chosen me by his gift of undeserved grace and had decided 16to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone. 17I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
18 Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for 15 days. 19The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother. 20And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
21Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia. 22But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person. 23They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy. 24And because of me, they praised God.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl sɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Galiisia tinteeŋ lɛ. Yesu Kirisito arɩ ʋ Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ a tɩmmɛ, nuhuobiinee dee bɩ mɩ lɩɩsa. 2Mɩ dɩ la naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ daha nɩɩ chʋɔlɛma.
3La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. 4Yesu Kirisito joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pa nɛ ba kpʋʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛla wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ lɛɛlɛ. Ʋ to la Nyɩmma Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla. 5Wɩa yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.
Wɩa wombii dɔŋ bɩra tuo
6Ʋ kperimi nɛ ma sɩ bɩ diene aŋ vɩa nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrɛma Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, aŋ bɩra tuto wombii-wogo. 7Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, Wɩa wombii dɔŋ kala bɩra tuo a pɛ kʋ-la la sɩ dagɛma lɛ. Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa yʋga a hɛ nɩmɛ aa walɩmɛma a chɩchɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la kaa bɩrɩmɛ. 8Ama dɩ la-na, koo dɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ nɛ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ bʋl wʋwogusi, a kɛŋ Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma kaa bɩrɩmɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna a kaa mʋ wuu. 9La laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ, aŋ bɩra bʋbʋl ʋ tɩtɩa lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bʋl wombii-wogo wɩaa pɩma, a lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ tɩɩna a kaa mʋ wuu.
10Ma bɩɩna arɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ nɩaa teeŋ nɛɛ? Wɩa teeŋ nɛ mɩ chɩchɛ mɩ laa yɩrɩŋ. Ma bɩɩna mɩɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa nɛ zizilmii? Dɩ mɩ nɛ faa chɛ dɩ nɩaa zizilmi, mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ.
Pɔɔl daga ŋɩɩ Yesu Kirisito sɩ yɩrʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ
11Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má leŋ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩma: Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma bɩ nuhuobiine teeŋ lɩa. 12Nuhuobiinee dee bɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, nuhuobiinee dee bɩ mɩ daga. Ama Yesu Kirisito nɛ joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛmɛ. 13Ma nɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ fa sɩ naga bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩɩ to Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ nɛ. Ma nɩɩ ŋɩɩ mɩ fa sɩ to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ. Mɩ ŋaa mɩ kukeri kala nɛ dɩ mɩ chei ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. 14La Juu tɩŋŋaa Wɩɩ-chʋɔlʋŋ wombiiŋ lɛ, mɩ nɛ fa jɩŋ wɩaa kɩɩ mɩ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa jesiŋ kala. Mɩ fa joŋ mɩ nyuŋ kala a hɛ la naabarɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ. 15Ama ka dɩ ba-na lʋlmɛ, Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ tɩma pʋ. Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ mɩ lɛ. 16Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ dagɛmɛ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito, dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ bɩ nʋʋkala teeŋ mʋa dɩ ʋ dagɛmɛ. 17Mɩ bɩ Jerusalɛm ma mʋa dɩ mɩ na nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔba mɩ lɛ. Ama mɩ guu mʋ tintee-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Arebia nɛ, a lɩɩ nɩmɛ a mɩɩra mʋ tabal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Damasɩkʋs.
18Jɩsɩŋ batori harɩŋ nɛ, mɩ mʋ Jerusalɛm dɩ mɩ na Pɩɩta, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Kɩɩfas. Mɩ sɩ mʋ nɩmɛ, mɩ hɔŋ ʋ teeŋ tapʋlaa fii arɩ banɔŋ nɛ. 19Mɩ sɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ, mɩ bɩ Yesu nanzɔɔ kala na see Jeems, La Tɩɩna Yesu ŋaana. 20Wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsaa pɩma, Wɩa jɩma ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Mɩ bɩ nyɩɛ. 21Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ sii Jerusalɛm lɛ, a mʋ Siiria arɩ Siliisia tinteeŋ. 22Bʋa deeŋ kala lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, ba fa ha bɩ mɩ jɩŋ. 23Ba ta nɩɩ nɩaa sɩɩ bʋl mɩ wɩaa nɛ, “Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ to naasɩŋ a dʋdɔgɩsɛla nɛ lɛɛlɛ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ chei.” 24Ba dɛnnɛ Wɩa woruŋ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.

english_text:
1 Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus. 2But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
3Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised. 4We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves. 5But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
6 Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message. 7They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews. 8God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
9James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews. 10They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do.
Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
11When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong. 12He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles. 13He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled. 14But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said:
Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
15We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles. 16 But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
17When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't! 18But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first. 19It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God.
I have been nailed to the cross with Christ. 20I have died, but Christ lives in me. And I now live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me. 21I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_text:
Yesu nanzɔɔba-la sɛɩ Pɔɔl sɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa teeŋ
1Jɩsɩŋ fii arɩ banɛsɛ sɩ kiele, mɩ dɩ Banabas bɩra mɩɩra mʋ Jerusalɛm. Mɩ pɛ kɛŋ Taatɩs to la harɩŋ mʋ nɛ. 2Mɩ sɩ mʋ lee-la, Wɩa nɛ dagɛmɛ mɩ mʋ. La sɩ mʋa, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii kʋhɩasɩŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ hilime. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩba wɩalɩŋ mɩ fa sɩ bʋla pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa a tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ. Mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩba dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ fa sɩ tɩma aŋ haa tɩŋ sɩ́ pɛɩ ŋaa. 3Taatɩs sɩɩ to mɩ harɩŋ fa ŋaa Giriik tɩɩna nɛ, ama ba bɩ ʋ fʋga dɩ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ. 4Arɩ ŋɩɩ kala, nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ fa bʋla arɩ Taatɩs maga ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ nɛ. Nɩaa deemba fa fugo arɩ ba ma laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ a ŋaa la naambiiriŋ. Ba fa kʋ guoli la tʋɔŋ dɩ ba na arɩ laa to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la nɛ koo la bɩbaa to. La sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ba faa chɛ dɩ ba na ŋɩɩ la sɩ lɩɩsɛ la tɩtɩa Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ. Ba fa cho dɩ la to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la nɛ a ŋaa yosi ʋ lɛ. 5Ama la bɩ sɛyɛ pɩba mʋapɩlɩɩ ma, dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ daga sɩ́ lɛl ma teeŋ. 6Mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩhɩasɩŋ Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ bɩ wɩɩ bʋla dɩ mɩ dagɛ a pɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ mɩ sɩ jɩma. Ama nɩaa deemba dɩchɩnɩŋ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa mɩ teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ nuhuobiine yaraa lɛ nɩɩ beŋ. 7Nɩhɩasɩŋ deemba na arɩ Wɩa lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa nɛ, ka dɩ Pɩɩta ma bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa. 8Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛ Pɩɩta a pʋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ yɩrɛmɛ ma dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. 9Jeems arɩ Pɩɩta arɩ Jɔɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɩhɩasɩ-la na arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-fɩɛmɩŋ deeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ba kɛŋ mɩ dɩ Banabas hɛ ba tʋɔŋ, la kala kɛŋ nii-bala. Ba bʋla arɩ la dɩ Banabas jaŋ mʋ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa teeŋ, ka ba ma bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la Juu tɩŋŋaa teeŋ. 10Wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩla dʋndʋŋa nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ summo-la sɩ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ wɩaa yʋ. Wɩɩ-la mɩ ma fa sɩ paala cho dɩ mɩ ŋaa nɛ ŋɩɩ.
Pɔɔl bʋl Pɩɩta teeŋ
11Ama bʋa kʋbala Pɩɩta sii kɔ Antɩɔk. Ʋ sɩ kɔ, mɩ chaasa bʋl ʋ teeŋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ cheye nɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ cheye nɛ ŋ-la: 12Ʋ sɩ hɛ Antɩɔk lɛ, Jeems tɩŋ nɩaa ba ma kɔ Antɩɔk. Ba sɩ kɔ, ba na arɩ Pɩɩta arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, dɩ ba kala nɛ pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a didii kɩaa. Pɩɩta sɩ na nɩalɩŋ Jeems sɩ tɩma, ʋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa lɛ, ʋ dɩ ba bɩra bɩ kɩaa ka dii. Pɩɩta faa fá nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɩ ʋ maga dɩ ba keri nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa aŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii penee nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 13Ŋɩɩ nɛ Juu tɩmma-la kʋkaana-la ma paala to ba fawʋllʋ wɩaa, arɩ Pɩɩta sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Banabas ma paala to ba fawʋllʋ wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ. 14Mɩ sɩ na arɩ ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ daga ka to, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋla pɩ Pɩɩta ba kala sɩpaaŋ, “Ŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna nɛ, aŋ ka ŋ wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ Juu tɩɩna ŋaa. Ɛɛ nɛ saa ŋ jaŋ wuo ŋaa a fʋgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ ba tuto Juu tɩŋŋaa naabarɩŋ?”
Wɩa laa diiniŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa teeŋ
15Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ba sɩ lʋlla, la ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la, la bɩ baa ŋaa. 16La jɩma arɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto, ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii, ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna Wɩa teeŋ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii, dɩ Wɩa leŋ dɩ la ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma ʋ teeŋ, a tɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ laa Kirisito dii. Dɩ nʋʋ nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, ʋ ŋɩɩ bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa teeŋ. 17La sɩɩ chɛ dɩ la to Kirisito lɛ dɩ Wɩa leŋ dɩ la ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma, la na arɩ la nagɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaara nɛ. Ma saa bɩɩna arɩ Kirisito nɛ leŋe la ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ? Aɩ, ʋ dee!
18Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto, dɩ mɩ nɛ vɩaba ta aŋ bɩra suomo tutoba, ʋ ŋɩɩ daga arɩ mɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ ŋaarʋ nɛ. 19Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ la tuto, ba tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe mɩ sʋʋ. Ama ʋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ sʋʋ Mosis wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ. 20Mɩ dɩ Kirisito kala nɛ ba kpaasa mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ. Mɩɩsɩ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩ teeŋ lɩa, ʋ lɩɩ Kirisito teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ sɩ laa Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii nɛ tɩɩ mɩ wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Wɩa Bie Yesu nɛ chomi, a joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ mɩ wɩaa. 21Mɩ bɩ lahɔrɩmɔ-la Wɩa sɩ kɛnɛ la teeŋ vɩa. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ, sʋʋ-la Kirisito sɩ sʋba ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.

english_text:
Faith Is the Only Way
1You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you? 2I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him? 3How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you? 4Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing? 5God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
6 The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith. 7 And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham. 8 Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him. 9This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
10 Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.” 11 No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
12 The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands. 13 But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse. 14And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit.
The Law and the Promise
15My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement. 16That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ. 17 What I am saying is that the Law cannot change or cancel God's promise made 430 years before the Law was given. 18 If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
19What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people. 20There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him.
Slaves and Children
21Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law. 22But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
23The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith. 24In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God. 25But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
26All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus. 27And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes. 28Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman. 29 So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_text:
Wɩa laa diiniŋ koo wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile
1Ma-na Galiisia nɩyaara! Kʋbɛɛ nɛ bugumima? La sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, mɩ dagɛma woruŋ ŋɩɩ Yesu sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ma jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ. 2Má leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma wɩɩŋ deeŋ: Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ dii zile ma lɛ, ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ, koo a tɩŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a laaba dii nɛ tɩɩ? 3Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma yaarɛ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋ-la? Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma suomi a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ Kirisito lɛ. Ma saa chɛ dɩ ma na ʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛɛ? 4Hɛɛ-la kɩŋkɛŋ ma sɩ na ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ ma teeŋ koo? Aɩ, mɩ bɩɩna ʋ bɩ pɛɩ wuo ŋaa. 5Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la a dii zile ma lɛ, aŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ ma teeŋ. Ma bɩɩna ma sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile nɛ tɩɩ ʋ wuo ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ, koo ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a laaba dii nɛ tɩɩ?
6Má liisi Abɩraham wɩaa. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ, “Ʋ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa leŋ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋla tɩɩna ʋ teeŋ.” 7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ma jɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋaa Abɩraham biiriŋ nɛ. 8Wɩɩŋ deeŋ hɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ faafaa kala nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba nɛ laa Wɩa dii, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla. Faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa bʋl wʋzɔmʋŋ deeŋ a pɩ Abɩraham, “Ŋ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ to a pɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala lɛ.” 9Abɩraham nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ a laa dii. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa pɛ ʋ lɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma kala sɩ laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii, Wɩa pɛ ba ma lɛ nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ pɛ Abɩraham lɛ ŋɩɩ.
10Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ka to, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. 11Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa chaasa dagɛ arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil bɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla, “Tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii.” 12Yarɩda dee ba kaa tuto wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto. Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba sɩ, “Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ to wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ.” 13Ama Wɩa sɩ ŋmɩɛsa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil aŋ bɩ ba wuo tuto, Kirisito lɩɩsɛla wɩaa deemba lɛ nɛ. Ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ a tɩŋ la wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Nɩɩ-la kala ba sɩ kpaasa mɛrɛ daaŋ nyuŋ, Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ.” 14Kirisito ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ ba wuo to ʋ lɛ a na pɛnɛ-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba. Dɩ la nɛ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la ʋ sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, la jaŋ wuo laa.
Mosis nii-la bɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Abɩraham wuo chei
15Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wʋmagɩsɩɩ nɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ magɩsɛ. Dɩ nɩaa balɩa nɛ vʋʋra dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ a ŋmɩɛsa pɩ dɔŋɔ, nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo chei wɩɩ-la koo a ŋaa wɩɩ pɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ vʋʋra bil lɛ. 16Wɩa ma hɛ niiŋ nɛ a pɩ Abɩraham arɩ ʋ doho nʋʋ. Ʋ bɩ ʋ doho nɩaa kala daga. Nɩbala nɛ ʋ dagɛ. Nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ daga nɛ ŋaa Kirisito. 17Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa sɩ hɛ nii-la a pɩ Abɩraham, ʋ ŋaa jɩsɩŋ zɔɔ-banɛsɛ arɩ mara arɩ fii nɛ, aŋ ka Mosis-na bil wɩalɩŋ dɩ nɩaa tuto. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa Mosis sɩ bil wɩalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo chei nii-la Wɩa sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ. 18Kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Abɩraham, ʋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ lɩa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile lɛ, ʋ naga arɩ Wɩa bɩ ʋ niiŋ hɛ pɩ Abɩraham. Ama Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pɩ Abɩraham nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ kʋ-la pʋ.
19Ŋɩɩ-na saa wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ bɛɛ? Mosis sɩ bil wɩalɩŋ dɩ nɩaa tuto pɛ dagɛ ŋɩɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ sɩ naga nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ hɛ nɩmɛ ŋɩɩ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Abɩraham doho nɩɩ-la sɩ kɔ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa sɩ ʋ jaŋ to a pɛ nɩaa lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile, Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ kaa kʋ tuu pʋ. Mosis nɛ saa ŋaa Wɩa arɩ nɩaa sɩpaa-tooro ŋɩɩ. 20Nɩaa balɩa nɛ yie ŋɩŋaa wɩɩ a kɛŋ sɩpaa-tooro. Ama Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala nɛ.
Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Mosis bil nii-la pɩla
21Wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, ba saa kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ Abɩraham chei nɛɛ? Aɩ, dɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile nɛ faa pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ fa maga dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ toba kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla nɛ. 22Ama Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa kala ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yosi nɛ. Wɩa bʋl ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo joŋ kʋ-la wɩaa ʋ fa sɩ bʋla a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ, a tɩŋ ba sɩ laa Wɩa dii.
23Ka dɩ bʋa-la-na yi dɩ la wuo laa Yesu Kirisito dii, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nyagɛla bil nɛ ka Yesu-na kɔ. 24Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ faa pɔla, a kʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Kirisito sɩ kɔ, dɩ la wuo laaʋ dii a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 25Lɛɛlɛ Kirisito sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile bɩra dee bɩ laa pɔ. 26A tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito dii nɛ tɩɩ ma kala ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ ŋɩɩ. 27Ma nɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ fo Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ, ma kala nagɛ Kirisito nɛ. 28Lɛɛlɛ, la bɩra bɩ nɩaa kaa pʋpɔrɛ. Dɩ ŋ ŋaa Juu tɩɩna koo dɩ ŋ bɩ ŋaa, dɩ ŋ ŋaa yoŋ koo dɩ ŋ tɩɩ ŋ tɩtɩa, dɩ ŋ ŋaa haal koo baal, ma kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Kirisito Yesu teeŋ. 29Dɩ ma dɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, ŋɩɩ-na ma ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛ. Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la a pɩ Abɩraham, ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩ ma ma.

english_text:
1Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs. 2This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set. 3This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
4But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law, 5 so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children. 6 Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father. 7You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised.
Paul's Concern for the Galatians
8Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real. 9But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers? 10You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years. 11I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
12My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me 13when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick. 14My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself. 15Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me. 16Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
17Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention. 18It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you. 19My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you. 20I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.
Hagar and Sarah
21Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says? 22 In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free. 23The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
24All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave. 25Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
26 But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave. 27 The Scriptures say about her,
“You have never had children,
but now you can be glad.
You have never given birth,
but now you can shout.
Once you had no children,
but now you will have
more children than a woman
who has been married
for a long time.”
28My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was. 29 But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today. 30 The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.” 31My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_text:
1Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl nɛ ŋ-la: Dɩ bie nɛ muuro aŋ dii ʋ nyɩmma dʋa, ba yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa bile lɛ arɩ ʋ ŋaa yoŋ nɛ, ka ʋ nɛ paala tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ma. 2Nɩaa nɛ yie bibenu a dɩdagʋ wɩaa deeŋ deeŋ, ʋ kʋ waa a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ nyɩmma sɩ daga. 3Ŋɩɩ nɛ la ma fa nagɛ. La fa sɩ bɩ Yesu laa dii, dʋnɩa wʋkɛnɛɛ harɩŋ nɛ la fa tuto. 4Ama bʋa-la tɩtɩa sɩ yie, Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ bie nɛ. Haal nɛ lʋlʋ. Ʋ ma faa to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la nɛ, 5dɩ ʋ wuo laa nɩalɩŋ fa sɩɩ to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la a ta, dɩ ba dɩ la kala wuo ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ. 6A tɩŋ la sɩ ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ Bie Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ la lɛ. Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie ŋaa la kɛŋ Wɩa kaa yɩrɛ “La Nyɩmma.” 7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ma kʋŋkala bɩra bɩ yoŋ ŋaa. Ma ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Ma saa sɩ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma dii ʋ dʋa.
Pɔɔl sɩ chɩl Galiisia nɩaa wɩaa ŋɩɩ
8Faafaa-la, ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ma faa to vʋɩyaa nɛ a ŋaa ba yosi. 9Ama lɛɛlɛ ma sɩ jɩŋ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, koo mɩ jaŋ bʋl Wɩa sɩ jɩmma ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma cho dɩ ma mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ a mʋ tuto dʋnɩa wʋkɛnɛɛ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ dɩ ba laama ta? Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ma saa cho dɩ ma bɩra tutoba a bɩrɩmɛ ba yosuŋ? 10Ma yie gbigbieli tapʋlaa gbiele, chɛnsɩŋ gbiele, kɩaa duunuŋ arɩ kɩaa ŋaanɩŋ bʋa lɛ gbiele arɩ jɩsɩŋ gbiele. 11Ma leŋe fawʋllʋŋ kɛmmɛ nɛ arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ tɩma ma teeŋ ŋaa pɛɩ nɛ.
12Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma, má nagɛmɛ. Mɩ sɩ nagɛma ŋɩɩ, má ma nagɛmɛ. Ma bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa cheimi. 13Ma jɩma, bumbuŋ-la mɩ sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la pɩpɩma, mɩ faa wɩɩlɛ nɛ. 14Mɩ fa sɩɩ wɩɩlʋ ŋɩɩ walɩmɛ ma nɛ, ama ma bɩ mɩ kaa gbesi koo a vɩamɛ ta. Ma kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ a nagɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaarʋ nɛ. Ma kɛmmɛ woruŋ nɛ a nagɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ. 15Ma sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ woruŋ. Nɩɩ nɛ ma tʋɔtɔrʋ-la mʋ? Mɩ tɩtɩa jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ fa wuolo, ma fa jaŋ paala wuo chaarɛ ma sɩaa ma a pɩmɛ. 16Mɩ lɛɛlɛ ŋaa ma dʋndɔŋ nɛ, a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ-la pɩmaa? 17Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ dagɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la fogo dɩdagɛ arɩ ba tʋɔŋ wɩɩ ma lɛ nɛ woruŋ, ama ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa bɩ zɔŋ. Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala nɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ mɩ dɩ ma pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ wɩɩ ba lɛ. 18Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ la tʋɔŋ nɩɩ wɩɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ ma teeŋ koo lee na-kala, ama ʋ maga dɩ ba ŋaa tʋɔ-wɩɩ-zɔmɔ nɛ. 19Mɩ bii chooloo, ma wɩaa ka wɩɩmɛ nɛ woruŋ, a nagɛ haala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ lʋl ʋ luoruŋ wʋwɩɩ ŋɩɩ. Ma wɩaa jaŋ wɩwɩɩmɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, see dɩ ma bɩrɩma a nagɛ Kirisito sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. 20Mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ lɛɛlɛ, a wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl nʋʋkala teeŋ. Ma wɩaa walɩmɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ.
Pɔɔl bʋl Haga arɩ Saara wɩaa
21Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɩ ma haa to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile, má leŋ dɩ mɩ pɩɛsɛma na, ma bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ? 22Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋla arɩ Abɩraham fa lʋl hambolibiisiŋ balɩa nɛ, dɔŋɔ ŋaa ʋ haala tɩtɩa bie, ka dɔŋɔ ma fa ŋaa ʋ haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo bii. 23Abɩraham haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo a lʋl bile, nuhuobiine wombiiŋ lɛ nɛ ba to a lʋlʋ. Ama Bile Abɩraham haala tɩtɩa sɩ lʋla, Wɩa nɛ hɛ niiŋ ba lʋlʋ. 24Ba kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ kaa magɩsɛ arɩ haalaa deemba balɩa ŋaa niiriŋ balɩa nɛ Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ. Haga nɛ chɩŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ peel-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sɩnaɩ nyuŋ, ʋ biiriŋ ŋaa yosi nɛ. 25Haga nɛ chɩŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ Sɩnaɩ peel-la nyuŋ, a hɛ Arebia tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ bɩra chɩŋ jɩnɩŋ tabal-la ba sɩ kaa yɩrɛ Jerusalɛm nyuŋ, ʋ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ kala ŋaa yosi nɛ. 26Ama Jerusalɛm dɔŋɔ nɛ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ a tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la naaŋ. 27Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba sɩ,
“Hapɩrɩŋ, jʋjʋɔsɛ.
Ŋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ bɩ bii lʋla.
Faasa ŋaa goŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ,
ŋ-na nɩɩ-la ha sɩ bɩ halʋllɩ luoruŋ wɩɩ na
bɛɛ wɩaa ha-vɩa taalɩŋ jaŋ lʋl biiriŋ yʋgɛ
a kɩɩ haal-la sɩ kɛŋ bala.”
28Mɩ naambiiriŋ, Wɩa fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ ba lʋl Aɩzɩk ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa hɛ niiŋ la ma ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ. 29Abɩraham biiri-la balɩa tʋɔŋ, kʋ-la ba sɩ to nuhuobiine wombiiŋ a lʋl dɔgɩsɛ bile ba sɩ lʋla Wɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba dʋdɔgɩsɛ la ma lɛɛlɛ. 30Bɛɛ nɛ ba bʋl Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ? Ba sɩ, “Kiri yoŋ-la arɩ ʋ bie ta, bɛɛ wɩaa haal-la sɩ ŋaa yomo bie bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ haal-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa bie lɛ dɩ ba dii ba nyɩmma dʋa.” 31Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, la bɩ hayoŋ-la biiriŋ ŋaa. La ŋaa haal-la sɩ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa biiriŋ nɛ.

english_text:
Christ Gives Freedom
1Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
2I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised. 3If you do, you must obey the whole Law. 4And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace. 5But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ. 6If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
7You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth. 8And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you. 9 A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough, 10but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
11My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised. 12I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
13My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love. 14 All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself. 15But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves.
God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
16If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires. 17 The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should. 18But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
19People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds. 20They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are 21envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
22God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful, 23gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways. 24And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires. 25God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit. 26But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_text:
Kirisito laala ta nɛ dɩ la tɩɩ la tɩtɩa
1Kirisito laala ta nɛ dɩ la tɩɩ la tɩtɩa. Má saa chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a pɔ dɩ nʋʋkala bɩra sɩ́ ma kaa ŋaa yosi. 2Má jegile nɩɩ, mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Dɩ ma nɛ leŋe dɩ ba keri ma penee a nagɛ Juu tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ sɩ dagɛ ŋɩɩ, wɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ ŋaa pɩma ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ. 3Mɩ jaŋ bɩra bʋl, dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ sɛyɛ dɩ ba keri ʋ peniŋ, ʋ maga dɩ tɩɩna tuto wɩalɩŋ kala Mosis fa sɩ bile nɛ. 4Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ bile aa walɩmɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, ma keri ma tɩtɩa ta nɛ Kirisito teeŋ. La Tɩɩna Yesu zile-la nɛ ma vɩa ŋɩɩ. 5Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, la-na laa dii a kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ la jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 6Dɩ la dɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, dɩ la keri la penee koo dɩ la bɩ kere, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ la laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a cho dɔŋɔ. 7Ma faa ŋaa woruŋ nɛ. Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa nyɩsɛma dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la to? 8Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛma, ʋ dee bɩ ma nyɩsa dɩ ma leŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la tonuŋ. 9Sɩ-bʋrʋŋ mʋapɩlɩɩ nɛ ba yie joŋo hɛ boroboro munuŋ sɩ yʋga lɛ, aŋ ka ʋ kala sii pʋɔrɛ. 10La dɩ ma kala sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ Kirisito teeŋ, mɩ ha laa dii arɩ ma bɩ jaŋ to wombii-tanɩɩ. Mɩ saa laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ walɩmɛma. 11Mɩ naambiiriŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ haa bʋl arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma keri ma penee nɛ, aŋ ka dɩ Wɩa-na laama ta, bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ba ha to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛmɛ? Dɩ mɩ nɛ fa sɩ dɩ nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ keri ʋ peniŋ, ŋɩɩ-na mɩ fa bɩ jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Yesu sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ wɩaa. 12Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ walɩmɛma, mɩ fa jaŋ cho dɩ ba lɩɩ ma tʋɔŋ a mʋ feri ba tɩtɩa.
13Ka ma-na mɩ naambiiriŋ, Wɩa yɩrɛma nɛ dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa. Ma saa sɩ tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ joŋ a to ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Ama má cho dɔŋɔ a tɩma pɩpa dɔŋɔ. 14Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto, ba tʋɔŋ wʋnyuŋ nɛ ŋ-la: “Cho ŋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna arɩ ŋ sɩ cho ŋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ.” 15Ama dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nɛ nagɛ baga kɩaa dɩ ma gʋra kɛŋ dɔŋɔ didii, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee ma jaŋ kpʋ dɔŋɔ dɛrɛ.
Má to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ
16Ama wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Má to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ aŋ vɩa ma tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa, 17bɛɛ wɩaa la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la wʋŋaalaa bɩ dɔŋɔɔ to. La tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa arɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la saa ŋaa dʋndɔmɔ nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩɩ-la la sɩɩ chɛ la ŋaa, la bɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa. 18Ama dɩ ma nɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ lɛ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma lɛ. 19La tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa bɩ wʋfaalɩa ŋaa. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ toba, ʋ yie ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, a ŋɩŋaa disiniŋ, a ŋɩŋaa hɩɩsɩ wɩaa, 20aa kpaarɛ vʋɩyaa, a ŋɩŋaa hɩl wɩaa, a bɛrɛ nɩaa, a hɩhɛ yuosuŋ, a kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ, a kɛŋ baanɩŋ, a chɩl ʋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ pʋpɔrɛ, a lɩlɩɩ dɔŋɔ harɩŋ, 21a kɛŋ tʋɔbɔmʋŋ, a nyʋa sɩnɩŋ a bubugi. Dɩ ba nɛ kʋ hilimi na-kala, ba nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bugi a ŋɩŋaa wʋtɔɔnʋŋ. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ. Mɩ saa bɩraa kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa nɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. 22Ama dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ hɛ nʋʋ lɛ, ʋ yie ŋaa ʋ cho nɩaa nɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, a fɩɛla hɔŋ sɔm, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a kɛŋ zile, a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, 23a kɛŋ sɩɩ-fɩɛlaa, a jɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kɛnɩŋ woruŋ. Wʋzɔŋ kala bɩra tuo a lɩɩ wɩaa deemba harɩŋ. 24Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ba kpʋ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa ta nɛ. Ba bɩra bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ hɩɛnʋ arɩ ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ ka to. 25Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ la tuto ʋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ. 26Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la cho dɩ la bibigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ, a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la ŋaa dɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa baanɩŋ sisii, a sɩ́ yarɩ-bieriŋ kɛŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ.

english_text:
Help Each Other
1My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself. 2You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
3If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong. 4Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others. 5We each must carry our own load.
6Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
7You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant. 8If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life. 9Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up. 10We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord.
Final Warnings
11You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
12Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ. 13They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised. 14But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
15It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
16If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
17 On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
18My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_text:
Má ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a pɩ nʋʋkala
1Mɩ naambiiri, dɩ ma dɔŋɔ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ma nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ, má dagʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to a lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔmʋŋ lɛ. Má chagɩlʋ, a sɩ́ ʋ lɛ kpɩa. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ, dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛ ma ma, dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. 2Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩ, má pɛ ʋ lɛ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, maa to Kirisito niiŋ nɛ. 3Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ ŋaa nʋʋ nɛ, aŋ bɩ nʋʋ ŋaa, ʋʋ nyɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. 4Nʋʋkala maga ʋ beŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋŋaalaa lɛ a na dɩ ba tʋʋla nɛ koo ba bɩ tʋʋla. Dɩ ba nɛ tʋʋla, ʋ jaŋ wuo bigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ wʋŋaalɩa-la wɩaa, aŋ sɩ́ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa magɩsɛ ʋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa, 5bɛɛ wɩaa nʋʋkala maga dɩ ʋ chʋŋ ʋ tɩtɩa chʋga nɛ.
6Nɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ dagɛ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ kʋŋkala, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ ŋaa pɩ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ dagʋ nɛ.
7Má sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa nyɩsʋ. Nʋʋkala bɩ Wɩa wuo mɔŋ. Kʋ-la ŋ sɩ duo, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ŋ jaŋ kʋŋ. 8Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ to ʋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ, ʋ wʋŋaalɩa-la lɛ nɛ Wɩa jaŋ to a dɔgɩsʋ. Ama dɩ nʋʋ nɛ to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la niiŋ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a timu. 9Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la lɔl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a lɔl aŋ nyalɩmɛ, dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, Wɩa jaŋ tinla. 10Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ wuolo, la ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nʋʋkala lɛ, a wasa nyaŋ la dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii a ŋaa kʋbala.
Chagɩlɩŋ arɩ Chʋɔlaa
11Ma na mɩ ŋmʋnsʋŋ sɩ barɩma ŋɩɩ. Mɩ tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ mɩ kaa ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma. 12Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba dagɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ baa to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombiiŋ, ba nɩɩ fʋgɛma dɩ ma keri ma penee. Ba laa dii arɩ Kirisito sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ba wɩaa nɛ. Ama ba bɩ chɛ dɩ nɩaa to ŋɩɩ lɛ a dɔgɩsɛba. 13Nɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ keri ba penee, ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile ka to. Baa chɛ dɩ ma keri ma penee dɩ ba wuo bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ma maa to Juu tɩŋŋaa wombii-la nɛ.
14Ama mɩ-na, mɩ jaŋ bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ-la nyuŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa. A tɩŋ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, dʋnɩa wɩaa nagɛ wʋsʋʋnɩ nɛ mɩ teeŋ, mɩ ma nagɛ nɩsʋʋ dʋnɩa wɩaa teeŋ. 15Ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ la keri la penee koo dɩ la bɩ kere. Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩ nɛ, dɩ la bɩrɩmɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩɩ-la.
16Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ to wɩɩŋ deeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ fá ba nenige a leŋ dɩ ba hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, ba dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala. Ba nɛ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa tɩtɩa Wɩa teeŋ. 17A lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ, nʋʋkala bɩra sɩ́ mɩ walɩmʋ. Fʋfʋʋnʋ-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ mɩ yaraa lɛ, ba nɩɩ dagʋ arɩ mɩ ŋaa Yesu nʋʋ nɛ.
18Mɩ naambiiri, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Amɩɩ.

english_text:
1 From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus.
To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
2I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
3Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven! 4Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people. 5God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children. 6God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
7-8 Christ sacrificed his life's blood to set us free, which means our sins are now forgiven. Christ did this because of God's gift of undeserved grace to us. God has great wisdom and understanding, 9and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways. 10Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
11God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us. 12He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him. 13Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God. 14The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised.
Paul's Prayer
15I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people. 16So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers. 17I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God. 18My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
19I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used 20 when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven. 21There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well. 22 God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything. 23The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Ɛfɛsɩs lɛ a laa Yesu Kirisito dii arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa Kirisito Yesu nanzɔɔ.
2La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ.
Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito lɛ a pɛ la lɛ
3Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnɛ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma. La dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ tɩɩ ʋ pɛ la lɛ a joŋ wʋzɔŋ na-kala sɩ lɩɩ ʋ teeŋ a pɩla. 4Ka dɩ ʋ-na suomo ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛla, dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, a sɩ́ cheeri kala kɛŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. A tɩŋ Wɩa sɩ chola wɩaa, 5ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ bɩɩna bil nɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a leŋ dɩ la ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ. Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 6Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la wuo dɛnnʋ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ fá la nenige. Ʋ Bii-choolii-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩla lɛ nɛ ʋ to a pɛ la lɛ. 7La sɩ mɛrɛ Kirisito lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ la wɩaa a tiŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ, dɩ Wɩa joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla. Wɩa zile yʋga nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ la teeŋ, 8ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla. Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ, a jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa lɛ nɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩla. 9Ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ leŋ la jɩŋ ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩ faa, wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ to Kirisito lɛ a ŋaa pɩla. 10Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ kʋŋkala kʋ hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ kala, dɩ Kirisito ŋaa ba kala Tɩɩna.
11Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ arɩ ʋ chɛnɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ yie ŋaa wɩɩkala. Ʋ to Kirisito lɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛla a leŋ la ŋaa ʋ nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ bɩɩna bil faafaa kala. 12Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ joŋ la yɩɛlaa hɛ Kirisito lɛ, dɩ la wuo leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ. 13Ma ma kʋ ŋaa Kirisito nɩaa nɛ bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba, Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ laa nɩaa tɩta. Ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, Wɩa joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ a magɩlɛma, kʋ-la ʋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii. 14Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ʋ sɩ joŋo hɛ la lɛ nɛ sɛnɛ daga arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, maachie la jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ, aŋ laa ʋ nɩaa ta. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ.
Pɔɔl chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a pɩ Ɛfɛsɩs nɩaa
15Mɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa dii arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho Wɩa nɩaa ma nɛ. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ, dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa na-kala, mɩ yie lʋlɔllʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. Mɩ yie liisi ma wɩaa nɛ a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma. 17Mɩ yie sʋl Wɩa, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma, Nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, dɩ ʋ pɩma wʋjɩmɩŋ, a bɩra kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa ma kaa dagɛma ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ dɩ ma wuo jɩmʋ. 18Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛma dɩ ma wuo jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ wuo suri ma tʋɔŋ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ kʋ-la ma sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ nagɩsɩŋ, a bɩra jɩŋ kɩalɩŋ ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ jaŋ dii zɔmʋŋ. 19Mɩ bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ wuo leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ dol-bal-la sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii teeŋ. Ʋ yie to ʋ dol-bal-la lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. 20Dol-la tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ kaa chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ a leŋ ʋ hɔŋ ʋ nadiiŋ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ. 21Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ nʋʋ na-kala sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ arɩ dʋnɩa-la sɩ jaŋ bɩra kɔ lɛ. 22Wɩa joŋ kʋŋkala doluŋ a hɛ Kirisito nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a bɩra leŋ ʋ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa kala kʋhɩaŋ ma. 23Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ ŋaa Yesu yaraa. Nɩalɩŋ nɛ leŋe Kirisito ŋaa nɩ-piliŋ, ʋ ma leŋ kʋŋkala ŋaa kʋpiliŋ wɩɩkala lɛ.

english_text:
From Death to Life
1 In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God. 2You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God. 3Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
4-5But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you. 6God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven. 7God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done. 8You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own. 9It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about. 10God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are.
United by Christ
11Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised. 12At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God, 13and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
14Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body 15 to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace. 16 On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body. 17 Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God. 18And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
19You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God. 20You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone. 21Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord. 22And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_text:
Wɩa to Kirisito lɛ a leŋ la kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ
1Ma fa naga arɩ ma sʋba nɛ a tɩŋ ma wʋcheelee arɩ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. 2Ma faa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a ŋɩŋaa dʋnɩa deeŋ tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa, a tuto Sɩtaanɩ. Sɩtaanɩ nɛ ŋaa jɩŋ-bɔŋŋɔɔ kala kuoro, ʋ nɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to. 3La ma kala fa nagɛ ba nɛ a tuto la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɔrʋnʋŋ, a bɩbɩɩnɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. La fa sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa deemba, Wɩa fa na baanɩŋ nɛ la nyuŋ, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ na baanɩŋ nɩalɩŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. 4Ama Wɩa chola nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, a faasa fɩfá la nenige, 5a leŋ la dɩ Kirisito kala kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa leŋe la sʋʋ nɛ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ laama ta. 6La dɩ Kirisito Yesu sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, Wɩa chɩsɛla sʋʋ-la lɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa sɩ ŋaa la sʋʋ lɛ nɛ, arɩ ʋ sɩ chɩsɛ Kirisito sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, a leŋ la dɩ Kirisito Yesu kala hɔŋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ Wɩa jaŋ lɛ. 7Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo dagɛla ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige a kaa mʋ maachie kala. Ʋ to Kirisito lɛ a dagɛ ʋ zile sɩ yʋga ŋɩɩ la lɛ. 8Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laama ta, a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii. Ʋ bɩ naga ma tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa laama ta, ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ pɩma chɔgɩta nɛ. 9Ʋ bɩ naga ma tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laama ta. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nʋʋkala bɩ maga dɩ ʋ bibigisi ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ. 10Wɩa nɛ ŋaala. Ʋ ŋaala dɩ la dɩ Kirisito Yesu ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba bil la lɛ faa faa kala nɛ dɩ la ŋɩŋaaba.
Nuhuobiinee kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Kirisito teeŋ
11Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Juu tɩmma-la fa sɩ keri ba penee kɛŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ma penee keri yɩyɩrɛ peŋ-puru tɩmma nɛ. Ama nuhuobiine nɛ keri ba penee. 12Ma bɩra sɩ́ yʋ arɩ bʋa kʋbala lɛ ma fa bɩ Kirisito jɩŋ. Ma dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa bɩ wɩɩ pɛ, ma fa nagɛ nʋhʋɔra nɛ. Wɩa fa sɩ bil nii-la ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ nɩaa lɛ, ma-na fa bɩ ba lɛ pɛ. Ma fa bɩ kʋŋkala ka yɩɛlɛ, ma fa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ nɛ a bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ. 13Ma dɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ fa bolie nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ ma wɩaa nɛ, a kɛŋ ma dɩ Wɩa kʋ kpagɛ dɔŋɔ. 14Kirisito tɩtɩa nɛ leŋe la sɩŋ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba kʋ ŋaa kʋbala. Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ giri dʋndɔnnɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ la pɛgɛ ta. 15Ʋ sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala to ʋ lɛ nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ nɩfalɩa a sɩŋ. 16Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe ba dʋndɔnnʋ-la dɛrɛ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe ba kala balɩa to ʋ lɛ nɛ a ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ kɛŋ ba dɩ Wɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ba sɩŋ. 17Kirisito nɛ kɔ a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ kɛŋ fɩɛlɩŋ kʋkɔ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ arɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ fa sɩ bolie, arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩ kpagɛ Wɩa kala. 18Kirisito lɛ nɛ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa arɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa kala to a kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la, a jaŋ wuo mʋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa teeŋ.
19Ma saa bɩra bɩ nʋhʋɔraa ŋaa, ma bɩ jʋjʋʋlʋ ma ŋaa. Ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a ŋaa Wɩa dɩa nɩaa. 20Ma nagɛ tie-biee Wɩa sɩ kaa sɩsaa ʋ dɩa nɛ. Wɩa nanzɔɔba arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ ŋaa dɩa-la gentine. Kirisito Yesu tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa tie-bii-duo-la ba sɩ kaa bil dɩa-la gentine. 21Ʋ nɛ chagɛ dɩa-la kala bil ʋ kʋ ŋaa Wɩa dɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩa-la. 22Ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ma dɩ Wɩa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kala nɛ ʋ kaa saa Wɩa dɩa deeŋ, ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ jʋjʋʋ.

english_text:
Paul's Mission to the Gentiles
1Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles. 2You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you. 3In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways. 4 As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ. 5No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets. 6And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
7God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news. 8I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured. 9 God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind. 10Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
11God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done. 12Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith. 13This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you.
Christ's Love for Us
14I kneel in prayer to the Father. 15All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him. 16God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers 17and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love. 18 I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep. 19I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
20-21I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa
1Ba kɛŋ mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ Kirisito Yesu wɩaa nɛ. Mɩ bɩra hɛ sarɩka lɛ a tɩŋ ma ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa wɩaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ mɩ yie sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩma. 2Mɩ jɩma arɩ ma ma nɩɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛmɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ ma teeŋ nɛ. 3Teŋ-la mɩ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma mɩ bʋl wɩaa mʋa, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa a kaa dagɛmɛ nɛ. 4Dɩ ma nɛ karɩmɛ teŋ-la, ma jaŋ na ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ leŋe mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa a tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ. 5Wɩa fa bɩ leŋe nʋʋkala jɩŋ wɩaa deemba, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ to ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋ wɩalɩŋ dagɛ ʋ nanzɔɔba-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla arɩ ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa. 6Wɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa to Kirisito Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ nɛ a leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa ma kɛŋ toruŋ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa lɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ba kala pɛ Kirisito yaraa lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Ba ma jaŋ pɛ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito Yesu lɛ a bʋl dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla.
7Wɩa leŋe mɩ ŋaa ʋ tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ dii zile mɩ lɛ a joŋ ʋ doluŋ pɩmɛ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ. 8Wɩa nɩaa kala tʋɔŋ, mɩ nɛ ŋaa ba kʋbie, aŋ ka ʋ lɩɩsɛmɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ba jɩŋ Kirisito dʋa-la sɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩ kɛnɛ wɩaa, 9a bɩra leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ to a ŋaa ʋ wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ faa. Wɩa nɛ Nɩɩ-la sɩ ta kʋŋkala, ʋ fa joŋ wɩalɩŋ faa faafaa kala nɛ. 10Wɩa ka chɛ dɩ ʋ to nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lɛ, a leŋ Wɩa bii-zɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ Wɩa bii-bɔŋŋɔɔ kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ ŋɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ. 11Wɩa fa bɩɩnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ faafaa kala nɛ a lɛɛlɛ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a leŋ wɩalɩŋ sɛnɛ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ. 12La sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, la bɩ jaŋ fɩfá fawʋllʋŋ. La jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a mʋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ. 13Mɩ saa sʋlma dɩ má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tʋɔŋ chei a tɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa. Mɩ sɩɩ na hɛɛ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma laa yɩrɩŋ.
Pɔɔl bɩra sʋl Wɩa a pɩ Ɛfɛsɩs nɩaa
14Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩɩnɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa pɩla, mɩ yie tuu kpirimi la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ. 15Ʋ nɛ hɛ doho kala yɩrɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ. 16Ʋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ kɩŋkɛŋ ŋɩɩ, mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ pɩma doluŋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ. 17Mɩ bɩra sʋlʋ dɩ ma wuo laa Kirisito wɩaa dii woruŋ, dɩ ʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ a cho nɩaa. 18Mɩ bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma doluŋ, dɩ ma dɩ ʋ nɩaa kala wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Kirisito sɩ faasa choma kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ. 19Ama nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo jɩŋ Kirisito chono-la sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ wuo jɩŋ. Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma nagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga.
20Ʋ dol-la ʋ sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ la lɛ, mɩɩ sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ dol-la faasa tɩtɩŋ la tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩaa yʋga kɩɩ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ sʋlʋ chɩchɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala la sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ. 21Má leŋ dɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi to Kirisito Yesu lɛ, a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ a lɩɩ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_text:
Unity with Christ
1As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own. 2 Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other. 3Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace. 4All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people. 5We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism. 6There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
7Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us. 8 As the Scriptures say,
“When he went up
to the highest place,
he led away many prisoners
and gave gifts to people.”
9When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth. 10This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
11Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers, 12so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong. 13This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
14We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place. 15Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head 16 of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love.
The Old Life and the New Life
17As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people. 18Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right, 19and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
20-21But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him. 22 You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits. 23Let the Spirit change your way of thinking 24 and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy.
Rules for the New Life
25 We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth. 26 Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry 27and don't give the devil a chance.
28If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
29Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
30Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
31Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude. 32 Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_text:
La ŋaa kʋbala nɛ Kirisito teeŋ
1Ba kɛŋ mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa nɛ. Ma nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra, mɩɩ sʋlma dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa joŋ wombiiŋ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ŋɩɩ. 2Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa tuu tinteeŋ, a pɛ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, a kɛŋ kenyiri, a joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ cho dɔŋɔ wɩaa. 3Má hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɛŋ nii-maga-la Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ pɩma. Má kɛŋ dɔŋɔ woruŋ a fɩɛla hɔŋ sɔm. 4La kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ, ma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛla ŋɩɩ, la kala ka yɩɛlɛ wʋbala nɛ. 5La kala Tɩɩna ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii ma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩ-bala nɛ la kala fo. 6Wɩɩ-bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, a ŋaa la kala Nyɩmma. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kʋŋkala. Ʋ kɛŋ la kʋŋkala tɩtɩŋ nɛ, a hɛ la kala tʋɔŋ lɛ. 7Kirisito joŋ kɩaa dii zile la kʋŋkala lɛ nɛ a magɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ. 8Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ a bʋl,
“Ʋ sɩɩ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ,
ʋ pɛ kɛsɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii nɛ, aŋ joŋ kɩaa dii zile nɩaa lɛ.”
9Dɩ ba nɛ sɩ ʋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu tinteeŋ. 10Nɩɩ-la tɩtɩa sɩ kʋ tuu tinteeŋ, ʋ nɛ bɩra jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ ŋɩɩ a kieli lere-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, dɩ ʋ wuo hɛ lee-kala. 11Kirisito lɩɩsɛ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ba ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔba, dɔnsʋŋ ma ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, a leŋ dɔnsʋŋ ma gɔllɔ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa a pɩpɩ nɩaa, dɔnsʋŋ ma bibeŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii, ka dɔnsʋŋ ma dɩdagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ-na Yesu wɩaa dii. 12Ʋ pɩla doluŋ deeŋ dɩ Wɩa nɩaa wuo kaa tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa, a wuo pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lɛ dɩ ba waa wɩalɩŋ lɛ. 13Ʋ pɛ la lɛ ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ la kala sɩ jaŋ wuo kʋ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii lɛ, a wuo kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa Bie sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ, a kʋ ŋaa nɩduoru Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, a wuo kʋ nagɛ Kirisito sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ wɩɩkala lɛ. 14Ŋɩɩ-na la bɩra bɩ jaŋ ŋaa hambiisi Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, dɩ wʋwogusu-la nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩɩ dagʋ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ kɛnla begili. La bɩ jaŋ to nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa, a kɛŋ badɛrɩŋ nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩaa, dɩ ba joŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii ta. 15Ama ʋ maga dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ a bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ bʋa na-kala. Dɩ la nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ a kʋ nagɛ Kirisito sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nagɛ nuhuobiine nandaasɩŋ nɛ. Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ba nyuŋ. 16Ʋ sɩ ŋaa la kala nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, dɩ nandaasɩ-la kala nɛ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa woruŋ, yara-la jaŋ waa a tɩŋ ba sɩ cho dɔŋɔ.
Mɩɩ-falɩɩ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ
17La Tɩɩna yɩrɩŋ lɛ mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wɩɩ nɛ pɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩɩ bɩɩnʋ ŋaa wʋpɛɩba nɛ. 18Birimiŋ tɔ ba wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ. Ba bɩ jaŋ wuo na mɩɩsɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩɩkala jɩŋ, ba dɩgɩlaa ma bɩ wɩaa ka nɩɩ. 19Ba joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ chɔmɔ nyʋa nɛ, aŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ, a hɩhɩɛnɛ dɩ ba gɔllɔɔ ŋaa disiŋ-na kala, a bɩ chɛ ba leŋ. 20Ama wɩaa deemba dee ma gʋnnɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ. 21Ma nɩɩ Yesu wɩaa nɛ, ba dagɛma wʋtɩtɩɩ-la kala sɩ mʋ tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ. 22Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má joŋ ma bumbuŋ mɛlɛ-la ta. Mɛlɛ-la fa nyɩsɛma nɛ a cheima. 23Má leŋ dɩ Wɩa kɛŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala bɩrɩmɛ dɩ ba ŋaa kʋfalɩa. 24Má leŋ dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ falɩa-la nagɛ gɛrɩŋ ma sɩ laala. Wɩa ŋaama dɩ ma nagʋ nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ.
25Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má bɩra sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩnyɩa. Má leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ a pɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, bɛɛ wɩaa la kala nagɛ nandaasɩŋ nɛ a kʋ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋaa kʋbala. 26Dɩ ma nɛ na baanɩŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma baaŋ-la leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Má sɩ́ baanɩŋ na ŋɩɩ dɩ wɩa tuu jʋʋ. 27Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Sɩtaanɩ na wombiiŋ a nyɩsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. 28Nɩɩ-la kala fa sɩɩ gaa, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ leŋ gaarɩŋ, aŋ kɛŋ ʋ nɩsaa faasa tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ a wuo na kʋ-la kala ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ tɩtɩa lɛ, aŋ wuo pɛ summoo ma lɛ. 29Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala lɩɩ ma niiŋ lɛ. Má bʋl wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩɩ jʋʋ nɩaa dɩgɩlaa bʋa-la lɛ sɩ maga, a leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ bʋl pɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jegili ba lɛ. 30Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tʋɔŋ chei. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa joŋo hɛ ma lɛ, ʋ ŋaa magɩlɩŋ ma lɛ a dagɛ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ laama ta tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ́ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. 31Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ jʋʋ ma lɛ, má sɩ́ joŋo hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ. Má sɩ́ tɛrʋ, má sɩ́ baanɩŋ na. Má sɩ́ goŋ ŋaa nɩaa nyuŋ. Má sɩ́ nɩaa yɩrɩŋ chichei. Má sɩ́ nʋʋkala bɛrʋ. 32Ama má kɛŋ zile dɔŋɔ lɛ, a fɩfá dɔŋɔ nenige. Má joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ to Kirisito lɛ a joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala chɛma ŋɩɩ.

english_text:
1Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children. 2 Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
3You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy. 4Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are. 5Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God.
Living as People of Light
6Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things. 7So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
8You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light 9and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful, 10as you try to please the Lord. 11Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are. 12It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark. 13But the light will show what these things are really like. 14Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say,
“Wake up from your sleep
and rise from death.
Then Christ will shine on you.”
15Act like people with good sense and not like fools. 16 These are evil times, so make every minute count. 17Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do. 18Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life. 19 When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart. 20Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything.
Wives and Husbands
21Honor Christ and put others first. 22 A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord. 23A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body. 24Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
25 A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it. 26He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water. 27Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
28In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself. 29None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church, 30because we are each part of his body. 31 As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.” 32This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church. 33So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_text:
Má hɛ Kirisito pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ
1Ma ŋaa Wɩa bii-chooloo nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má chichesi Wɩa wʋŋaalaa. 2Má cho dɔŋɔ arɩ Kirisito sɩ chola ŋɩɩ a sʋʋ la wɩaa. Ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa nɛ, ba kpʋʋ arɩ ba sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a nyɩga pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ sʋɔra sɩŋ.
3Ma sɩ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ, a bɩra lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa disiŋ kala lɛ, a sɩ́ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ kɛŋ. 4Má sɩ́ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ wʋtɔɔnʋŋ ma bʋbʋl. Má sɩ́ sɩsɩɩ-tɔɔnʋŋ ma sɩɩ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba. Ama ʋ maga dɩ ma lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ. 5Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ woruŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ koo nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa disiniŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ [tʋɔ-luŋuŋ nagɛ vʋɩ-kpaarɩŋ nɛ], nɩaa deemba kʋŋkala bɩ jaŋ dii kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ, ʋ-na Wɩa arɩ Kirisito kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. 6Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala kɛŋ wʋnyɩɛrɩŋ a nyɩsɛma. Wɩaa deemba nɛ leŋe Wɩa baanɩŋ sisii nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ ka to nyuŋ. 7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa nɩdosunuŋ deemba lɛ. 8Bʋa kʋbala lɛ ma ma fa hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama La Tɩɩna Yesu leŋe ma lɛɛlɛ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ. 9Pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ nɩaa ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, tʋɔpʋl wɩaa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩba. 10Ʋ maga dɩ ma gʋnnɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ. 11Má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ wɩalɩŋ nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ. Má joŋ ba bʋbʋɔŋ ta, a leŋ dɩ nɩaa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa bɩ zɔŋ. 12Ʋ paala kɛŋ hɩɩsɩŋ nɛ dɩ la bʋl wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lʋaraa ŋaa. 13Kʋŋ na-kala lɛ nɛ dɩ pʋlʋmʋŋ chaana hɛ, ba yie na kʋ-la nagɩsɩŋ kala nɛ. 14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl, “Ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩŋ doŋ a nagɛ ma sʋba, má sii doŋ lɛ. Kirisito jaŋ chaana hɛ ma lɛ.”
15Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ ma wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Má sɩ́ nɩyaaraa nagʋ. Má ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. 16Tapʋlaa deemba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ pʋrɩga nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ma nɛ na wombiiŋ, má ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ aa bʋl wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. 17Má sɩ́ nɩyaara ŋaa, má hɛ doluŋ a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa tʋɔŋ a ŋɩŋaaba. 18Má sɩ́ sɩnɩŋ nyʋa bubugi, dɩ ma nɛ nyʋa sɩnɩŋ bubugi, ŋɩɩ jaŋ cheima. Ama má leŋ dɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ a tɩtɩŋ. 19Dɩ ma nɛ kʋ hilimi a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩpɩ dɔŋɔ, má yɩyɩɩ Wɩa yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛ Wɩa, a yɩɩ yɩɩla-la dɔnsʋŋ ma sɩɩ dagɛ Kirisito wɩaa. Má yɩɩ Wɩa yɩɩlaa a dɩdɛnnɛ La Tɩɩna Kirisito arɩ ma tʋɔŋ kala. 20Bʋa na-kala lɛ arɩ wɩɩ-na kala lɛ, má lɔllɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito yɩrɩŋ lɛ.
