Haalaa arɩ ba balaba mɛlɛ sɩ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ
21La sɩɩ zil La Tɩɩna Kirisito ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ la tuto dɔŋɔba niiŋ wɩaa nɛ. 22Haalaa, má tuto ma balaba niiŋ arɩ ma sɩɩ to Kirisito ŋɩɩ, 23bɛɛ wɩaa baalaa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ ba haalaa nyuŋ arɩ Kirisito sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ŋɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi nyuŋ. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɛ ŋaa ʋ yaraa, ka ʋ ŋaa ba Laataara. 24Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi sɩɩ to Kirisito niiŋ wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ haalaa ma maga dɩ ba tuto ba balaba niiŋ wɩaa. 25Baalaa, má cho ma haalaa, arɩ Kirisito sɩ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋɩɩ, ʋ sʋʋ ba wɩaa, 26a pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta, a fo ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ma ta arɩ lɩɩŋ, a tɩŋ Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa wɩaa. 27Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi, dɩ ba wuo zɔŋ kɩŋkɛŋ, a sɩ́ disiŋ koo wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋ kala sɩ́ ba lɛ lagɩsʋ, a sɩ́ nyɔɔ kala kɛŋ. 28Yesu sɩ cho nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ maga dɩ baalaa cho ba haalaa, arɩ ba sɩ cho ba tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ. Baal-la kala sɩ cho ʋ haala, ʋ cho ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. 29Nʋʋkala bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa bɛrɛ, ama ʋ cho ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ a bibeŋ ʋ tɩtɩa nyuŋ woruŋ, arɩ Kirisito sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. 30Kirisito yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa la ŋaa ʋ nandaasɩŋ nɛ a mɛrɛ ʋ yaraa lɛ. 31Ba ŋmʋnsɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a bʋl, “Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ baala yie leŋ ʋ nyɩmma arɩ ʋ naaŋ, ka ʋ dɩ ʋ haala mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a kɛŋ chal-bala.” 32Wʋkpuŋkpere deeŋ ŋaa wʋbal nɛ a faa. Mɩ saa jɩma arɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ mʋʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi lɛ nɛ. 33Ʋ saa nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ ma ma lɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ nʋʋkala cho ʋ haala arɩ ʋ sɩ cho ʋ tɩtɩa ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ haala ma zil ʋ bala.

english_text:
Children and Parents
1 Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says, 2 “Obey your father and your mother, 3and you will have a long and happy life.”
4 Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord.
Slaves and Masters
5 Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ. 6Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do. 7Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people. 8You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
9 Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites.
The Fight against Evil
10Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong. 11 Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks. 12We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world. 13So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
14 Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor. 15 Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet. 16Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one. 17 Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
18Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people. 19Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news. 20I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should.
Final Greetings
21-22 I want you to know how I am getting along and what I am doing. This is why I am sending Tychicus to you. He is a dear friend, as well as a faithful servant of the Lord. He will tell you how I am doing, and he will cheer you up.
23I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower! 24May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl bʋl hambiisiŋ arɩ ba nyɩmmaba arɩ ba naamba wɩaa
1Hambiisiŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma tuto ma nyɩmmaba arɩ ma naamba niiŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ. 2Má zizil ma nyɩmmaba arɩ ma naamba arɩ ba sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagɛ nɩaa dɩ ba tuto tʋɔŋ, wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ kɛŋ time. 3Dɩ ma nɩɩ zil ma naamba arɩ ma nyɩmmaba, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma na dɩ-zɔmʋŋ, a kɛŋ mɩɩ-duduoŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. 4Ma nyɩmmaba, má sɩ́ ma biiriŋ walɩmʋ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba baanɩŋ sisii ma nyuŋ. Má bemba a dagɛba woruŋ Yesu Kirisito wombiiŋ lɛ.
Pɔɔl bʋl yosuŋ arɩ ba tɩŋŋaa wɩaa
5Ma yosuŋ, má tuto nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩɩma niiŋ. Má zizilba a fɩfába. Má kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tutoba arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ to Kirisito. 6Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma tɩŋŋaa bemma aŋ ka ma-na tɩtɩŋ woruŋ, a sɩ́ chɛ dɩ ma tɩŋ dɩ ba bɛsɛ ma lɛ. Ama má tɩŋ arɩ ma tɩmaa pɩ Kirisito nɛ a kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala, a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho. 7Má kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ tɩtɩŋ ma tɩntɩŋŋaa, a nagɛ ma tɩma pɩpɩ Kirisito nɛ, nuhuobiine dee ma tɩmaa pa. 8Ma jɩŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ zɔŋ, La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ joŋ kʋzɔŋ a timu, dɩ tɩɩna ŋaa yomo koo ʋ tɩɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ. 9Ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ kɛŋ yosuŋ, má kɛmba woruŋ, má sɩ́ ba walɩmʋ. Ma jɩŋ arɩ ma kala tɩɩna ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ. La kala ŋaa kʋbala nɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ bɩ la kaa pɔrɛ.
Kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩla dɩ la kaa yuo Sɩtaanɩ
10Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋl, ʋ wʋkaanɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má leŋ dɩ La Tɩɩna dol-bal-la hɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ woruŋ. 11Má paa ma bayuori kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma laalɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo pɔ dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo kɛŋ ʋ badɛ wɩaa nyɩsɛma. 12Ama la bɩ naga nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ yuo nuhuobiinee. Laa yuo Sɩtaanɩ arɩ ʋ harɩ-tooroo nɛ, arɩ kʋŋkala sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ teeŋ. Dʋnɩa deeŋ arɩ dol-bɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ, ba nɛ laa yuo. 13Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má laalɛ laalɩyuori kɩaa Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩma, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba ŋaa ma lɛ, dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ chɩna gbɛrɛ. 14Má chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ, má leŋ dɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩa nagɛ ma laalɩyuori damɛrɛ a vɔɔ ma tɩŋa lɛ, a leŋ dɩ tʋɔpʋla nagɛ ma hɔɔŋ-bɔɩ-tɔɔrɩ-gɛrɩŋ a tɔ ma harɩŋ arɩ ma sɩpaaŋ kala, 15a leŋ dɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ dɩ ma bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩɩ pɩ fɩɛlɩŋ nagɛ ma laalɩyuori nɛntɛŋŋɛɛ ma hɛ. 16Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma Wɩa laa diiniŋ dol a nagɛ hɔɔ-la laalɩyuoroo sɩ kaa kɛrɛ ba bɔyɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo kɛrɛ laa ma dʋndɔmɔ hɛŋŋɛɛ kala sɩɩ chol nyiŋgeliŋ dɩ ba dɩsɛ. 17Wɩa sɩ laama ta ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ hɔɔŋ nyuŋ-chu-gbaŋkogo nɛ ma joŋo chu, aŋ joŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tokobiiŋ a kori. Tokobii-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa. 18Má chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala lɛ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, a sʋsʋlʋ wɩɩ-wɩɩkala lɛ. Ma sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, má pɔ woruŋ a sɩ́ doŋ dɩɛgʋ, aŋ pɛsɛ, a chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa ma. 19Má sʋl Wɩa pɩ mɩ ma dɩ mɩ nɛ suri mɩ niiŋ dɩ Wɩa dagɛmɛ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bʋl, a sɩ́ nʋʋkala fá, aŋ bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la fa sɩ faa a pɩ nɩaa. 20Mɩ sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la aa pɩ nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ. Má sʋl Wɩa pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl Wɩa wɩaa arɩ nyuduoŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ.
Wʋkaanɩŋ
21Takɩkas sɩ ŋaa la naambii-choolii a bɩra ŋaa La Tɩɩna Yesu tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ kɔ ma teeŋ a bʋl mɩ wɩaa pɩma, dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ hɔnʋŋ sɩ naga arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ. 22Wɩɩ-la wɩaa mɩ sɩɩ tɩmʋ nɛ ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la hɔnʋŋ sɩ naga, dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ.
23La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito jaŋ leŋ dɩ la naambiiri-la kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a cho dɔŋɔ. 24Nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, Wɩa jaŋ fá nɩaa deemba kala nenige.

english_text:
1 From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.
To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
2I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
3Every time I think of you, I thank my God. 4And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy. 5This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it. 6God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
7You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail. 8God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
9I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand 10how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day, 11Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God.
What Life Means to Paul
12My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news. 13 The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ. 14Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
15Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help. 16They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him. 17But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail. 18But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad.
I will keep on being glad, 19because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe. 20I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
21If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more. 22I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful. 23It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better. 24-25But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith. 26Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
27Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
28Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen, 29and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him. 30 You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ Timoti sɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnaa nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ Fɩlɩpa lɛ a laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii.
La ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi nɩhɩasɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛ nɩhɩasɩ-la lɛ nɛ. 2La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.
Pɔɔl chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩ Fɩlɩpa nɩaa
3-4Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ mɩ nɛ liisi ma wɩaa, mɩ yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma nɛ. Mɩ yie lɔllʋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, 5bɛɛ wɩaa ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. Ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ a lɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a kaa kɔ jɩnɩŋ. 6Mɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔmɔ-la ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma tɩma mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ. 7Mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Ʋ ŋaa wombii nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma kala pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ la tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ. Ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ bumbuŋ-la mɩ fa sɩɩ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa, arɩ lɛɛlɛ ma kala ba sɩ kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ la kala dii dansɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la lɛ arɩ ba ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, a leŋ nɩaa laa dii a chɩŋ ba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ. 8Mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ woruŋ. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa mɩ pɛ-naara wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Mɩ choma nɛ woruŋ arɩ Kirisito Yesu sɩ choma ŋɩɩ. 9Mɩɩ sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ, dɩ chono-la wasa yʋgɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, a bɩraa sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma wʋjɩmɩŋ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa bʋbʋɔŋ. 10Wʋjɩmɩɩ-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma lɩɩsɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ a ŋɩŋaa. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa disiniŋ lɛ, a sɩ́ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei a mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ. 11Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a wasa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa dɩ nɩaa na a dɛnnɛ Wɩa dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.
Pɔɔl sɩ dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa bil a mʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa
12Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa mɩ lɛ leŋe Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩɩ bʋl wasa mʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ. 13Laalɩyuoro-la kala sɩɩ pɔ kuoru dɩa arɩ nʋʋkala jɩma arɩ Kirisito wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa tɔ dɩa. 14Mɩ sɩ hɛ dɩa-la lɛ pɛ la naambiiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ nɛ ba wasa chɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ, a kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋbʋl Wɩa wɩaa, a bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá.
15Mɩ jɩma arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ arɩ hadɔrʋŋ nɛ aa bʋl Kirisito wɩaa. Ama dɔnsʋŋ ma kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a bʋbʋl Kirisito wɩaa. 16Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ a bʋbʋl Kirisito wɩaa chomi nɛ. Ba jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. 17Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wɩaa arɩ yarɩ-bieriŋ ka to ba tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ, ba bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. Mɩ sɩ hɛ bɩnɩŋ dɩa lɛ ŋ-la, baa chɛ dɩ wɩaa wasa jʋʋmɛ nɛ. 18Ama mɩ-na teeŋ ʋ bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ. Dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ koo dɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ ba kaa bʋl, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ba sɩɩ bʋl Kirisito wɩaa.
Mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ a kaa mʋmʋ, 19bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma arɩ ma chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩmɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa a tɩŋ ma Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Yesu Kirisito Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ lɛ, mɩ jɩma ba jaŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ ta. 20Wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ kɩŋkɛŋ arɩ wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩɩ a mʋ tɩgɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ tɩŋ lɛ dɩ hɩɩsɩŋ diimi, ama a suomi jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋ, bʋa na-kala lɛ, mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a bʋl Wɩa wɩaa. Dɩ sʋʋŋ nɛ koo waaŋ nɛ, mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Kirisito tɩntɩmɩɩ-la, dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ. 21Mɩ-na teeŋ, dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ, ʋ lɩɩ Kirisito teeŋ nɛ, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ma, mɩ jaŋ na nyʋʋrʋŋ ʋ teeŋ. 22Dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, mɩ jaŋ faasa tɩŋ, dɩ nɩ-daŋ nɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa. Dɩ mɩ nɛ bɩra sʋba ma, mɩ jaŋ na nyʋʋrʋŋ. Mɩ bɩ jɩŋ ba kʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ. 23Mɩ hɛ wɩaa deemba balɩa pɛgɛ nɛ. Mɩ fa cho nɛ woruŋ dɩ mɩ lɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ a mʋ Kirisito teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ kpɩa mɩ sɩ jaŋ hɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. 24Ama ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ a pɩma dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. 25Mɩ laa wɩɩŋ deeŋ dii nɛ arɩ mɩ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, a wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma waa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ ba lɛ. 26Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ mɩ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ, ma tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ Yesu Kirisito lɛ a tɩŋ mɩ wɩaa.
27Wɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ, má leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa tuto Kirisito wʋzɔmɔ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ mɩ nɛ hɛ ma teeŋ koo dɩ mɩ tuo, mɩ jaŋ wuo nɩɩ arɩ ma faasa chɩŋ nɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ a kɛŋ nii-bala, a leŋ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa ŋaa kʋbala, a faasa hɛ doluŋ a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. 28Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a mʋ tɩgɛ ma dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Ma kɛŋ nyuduoŋ bʋa na-kala ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ba chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ba jaŋ lɛl, ama Wɩa jaŋ laa ma-na ta. 29Ma-na, Wɩa nɛ pɩma wombiiŋ dɩ ma laa Kirisito wɩaa dii aŋ pɛ na hɛɛŋ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa. 30Lɛɛlɛ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ dɩ la yuo laal-la, laal-la ma fa sɩ na dɩ mɩɩ yuo, a bɩra nɩɩ dɩ mɩ haa yuo.

english_text:
True Humility
1Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others. 2Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person. 3Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves. 4Care about them as much as you care about yourselves 5and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
6Christ was truly God.
But he did not try to remain
equal with God.
7Instead he gave up everything
and became a slave,
when he became
like one of us.
8Christ was humble.
He obeyed God and even died
on a cross.
9Then God gave Christ
the highest place
and honored his name
above all others.
10 So at the name of Jesus
everyone will bow down,
those in heaven, on earth,
and under the earth.
11And to the glory
of God the Father
everyone will openly agree,
“Jesus Christ is Lord!”
Lights in the World
12My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved. 13God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
14Do everything without grumbling or arguing. 15 Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world, 16as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
17Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you. 18In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me.
Timothy and Epaphroditus
19I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you. 20I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does. 21The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus. 22But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news. 23I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me. 24And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
25I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me, 26but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick. 27In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
28Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer. 29Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve. 30He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_text:
Kirisito sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri, Wɩa joŋ yɩrɩ-balɩŋ pʋ
1Ma sɩɩ to Kirisito, ŋɩɩ leŋe ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ, ʋ chonuŋ leŋe ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma leŋ ma ŋaa kʋbala, a kɛŋ zile dɔŋɔ lɛ a fɩfá dɔŋɔba nenige. 2Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kɛŋ tʋɔ-bala, a wasa cho dɔŋɔ, a kɛŋ nii-bala, ŋɩɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ. 3Wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, má sɩ́ ma dʋndʋŋa wɩaa chɩl, a sɩ́ ma tɩtɩa lɛ ma bibigisu. Ama má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ, a sɩ́ beŋ arɩ ma kɩɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa. 4Dɩ ma kʋŋ nɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩ, ʋ sɩ́ ŋaa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ wasɛ ʋ dʋndʋŋ. Ama ʋ ŋaa chɩchɛ dɩ ʋ wasɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ma. 5Ma mɛlɛ maga dɩ ʋ nagɛ Yesu Kirisito mɛlɛ nɛ.
6Ʋ fa kɛŋ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ nɛ,
ama ʋ fa bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa joŋo arɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa magɛ dɔŋɔ nɛ.
7Ama ʋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ,
ʋ joŋ ʋ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ bil nɛ, aŋ nagɛ tɩntɩnnʋ.
Ba lʋlʋ ʋ nagɛ nuhuobiiŋ. Nɩaa naʋ arɩ ʋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ.
8Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ,
a to Wɩa niiŋ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋba.
Ba paala kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ ʋ sʋʋ.
9A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa Wɩa chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ nɛ a kɛnʋ kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ,
a pʋ yɩrɩ-la sɩ yʋga kɩɩ yɩrɩ na-kala.
10Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ,
ba kala jaŋ tuu kpirimi ʋ sɩpaaŋ a chʋɔlʋ.
11Nʋʋkala jaŋ suri ʋ niiŋ a bʋl arɩ Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ʋ Tɩɩna,
dɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ.
Má chaanɛ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa dʋnɩa lɛ
12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii-chooloo, má tuto mɩ niiŋ arɩ ma fa sɩɩ to ŋɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ mɩ fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ. Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ kala ma ha to mɩ niiŋ. Wɩa laama ta nɛ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa má fáʋ, aŋ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri a tɩtɩŋ, a na kʋ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. 13Má ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa, Wɩa hɛ ma teeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ a kɛmma tɩtɩŋ, dɩ ma cho dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ.
14Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa wɩɩkala, má sɩ́ kaalɛrɛ koo a gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa. 15Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ. Ma jaŋ ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ a hɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa arɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ma chaanɛ nɩaa deemba tʋɔŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ chaanɛ ŋɩɩ wɩa-nyuŋ. 16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ ma tuto Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɩ mɩɩsɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ wuo bigisi mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ tɩma, tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ. Ŋ-la nɛ jaŋ dagɛ arɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩ tɩma bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa. 17Ama dɩ ba paala kpʋmɛ dɩ mɩ chalɩŋ jaasɛ a nagɛ kʋnyʋalaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Wɩa dii a ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ dɩ mɩ dɩ ma kala jʋjʋɔsɛ. 18Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má ma leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɩ la kala jʋjʋɔsɛ.
Pɔɔl bʋl Timoti arɩ Epafurodaatus wɩaa
19Mɩɩ yɩɛlɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu doluŋ lɛ mɩ jaŋ tɩŋ Timoti dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ lɛɛlɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ aŋ mɩɩra kʋ bʋl ma wɩaa pɩmɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ jaŋ tɔrɛ. 20Ʋ dʋndʋŋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ chɩl ma wɩaa arɩ mɩ ma sɩ chɩl ma wɩaa ŋɩɩ. 21Nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ chɩl ba tɩtɩa wɩaa nɛ, ba bɩ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa chɩla. 22Ma ma tɩtɩa jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Timoti sɩ naga nɛ. Ʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a nagɛ bie sɩ yie pɛ ʋ nyɩmma lɛ ba tɩtɩŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ. 23Dɩ mɩ nɛ kʋ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ wɩaa sɩɩ vɛŋ, mɩ jaŋ tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ. 24Mɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ leŋ dɩ mɩ tɩtɩa kɔ ma teeŋ, ʋ bɩ dieni.
25Mɩ bee na arɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ tɩŋ la naambie Epafurodaatus dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋaa mɩ laalɩyuori dɔŋ ma. Ʋ ŋaa ma tɩndaarʋ nɛ, ma tɩmʋ ʋ kʋ pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. 26Ʋ faa bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ dɩ ʋ kʋ nama, ama ʋ tʋɔŋ cheye a tɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa arɩ ʋ bɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɛnɛ. 27Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ wɩɩla nɛ, a fa ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba, ama Wɩa fá ʋ nenige a leŋ ʋ duori. Dɩ Epafurodaatus nɛ fa sʋba, mɩ tʋɔŋ fa jaŋ faasa chei. Ama Wɩa fá mɩ nenige a bɩ leŋe ʋ sʋʋ. 28Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ sɩɩŋ faasa fɩɛsɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ʋ kɔ ma teeŋ, dɩ ma naʋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ bɩra tɔrɛ, dɩ mɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa pɩŋ dɩbala. 29Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ, má laaʋ woruŋ arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ. Má zizil nɩdosunuŋ deemba. 30A mʋ tɩgɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa wɩaa, ʋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ bil nɛ, ʋ fa ka mʋa dɩ ʋ sʋba. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma tɩtɩa faa chɛ dɩ ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ aŋ bɩ wuo pɛ.

english_text:
Being Acceptable to God
1Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
2Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you. 3But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done, 4although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else. 5 I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses. 6 And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
7But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless. 8Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ 9and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ. 10All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did, 11so that somehow I also may be raised to life.
Running toward the Goal
12I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize. 13My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead. 14I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done. 15All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you. 16But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
17 My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you. 18I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again 19that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
20But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ 21 has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_text:
Pɔɔl bɩ ʋ nyuŋ joŋo hɛ nuhuobiinee yaaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ
1Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la wʋkaanɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ mɩ bʋla pɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Má jʋjʋɔsɛ La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩma nɛ, aŋ bɩra chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl ʋ tɩtɩa ŋ-la. Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ mɩ lɔlɔ arɩ wɩɩ-la bʋlʋŋ. Wɩalɩŋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala jʋʋ.
2Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ vasɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ pɛsɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma keri ma penee. 3La nɛ paala chaasa ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ sɛnɛ keri ba penee, bɛɛ wɩaa la-na to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ niiŋ lɛ nɛ aa chʋɔlɛ Wɩa. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, laa jʋɔsɛ Kirisito Yesu teeŋ nɛ. La-na bɩ la yɩɛlaa joŋo hɛ yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ. 4Mɩ-na nɛ paala magɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa hɛ yaraa wʋŋaalaa lɛ. Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ bɩɩna arɩ ʋ kɛŋ wombiiŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ yɩɛlaa a hɛ yaraa wɩaa lɛ, mɩ-na jaŋ paala wuo bʋl arɩ mɩ kɛŋ wombiiŋ kɩɩ tɩɩna nɛ. 5Ba sɩ lʋlmɛ, tapʋl-chorimuŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ba keri mɩ peniŋ. Mɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩɩna tɩtɩɩ nɛ, a lɩɩ Bɛnjamɩŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Mɩ naaŋ arɩ mɩ nyɩmma ŋaa Hiburu tɩmma nɛ. Dɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩma wombii-la nɛ maa to, mɩ ŋaa Farisii tɩɩna nɛ. 6Mɩ faa to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la nɛ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, a to naasɩŋ dʋdɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Dɩ nuhuobiine nɛ fa jaŋ wuo kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla a tɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ to Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombii-la, mɩ jaŋ bʋl arɩ mɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ, mɩ bɩ wɩɩ ŋaa chei. 7Mɩ fa bɩɩna wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ ŋaa jaŋ kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ pɩmɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito wɩaa mɩ na arɩ ba ŋaa wʋpɛɩba nɛ. 8Mɩ sɩ kʋ jɩŋ mɩ Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito, mɩ na arɩ mɩ tele nɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ. Mɩ chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ nɛ kɛŋ nyʋʋrʋŋ a kɩɩ wɩaa deemba kala mɩ fa sɩɩ to. A tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa mɩ joŋ wɩɩkala yuo ta nɛ. Mɩ na arɩ ba kala nagɛ nɩsʋrʋŋ nɛ. Mɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ mɩ wuo na nyʋʋrʋŋ nɛ Kirisito teeŋ, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ ʋ tʋɔpʋla-la, 9dɩ mɩ dɩ Kirisito kala ŋaa kʋbala. Tʋɔpʋla-la mɩ sɩ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ mɩ tɩtɩa lɛ lɩa, ʋ saa bɩra bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa naabalɩmaba wombiiŋ ma lɛ lɩa. Ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ teeŋ. Tʋɔpʋla deeŋ-na lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, ʋ joŋu pɩ nʋʋkala sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii nɛ. 10Wɩɩ-la kala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ mɩ jɩŋ Yesu Kirisito, a wuo jɩŋ dol-la sɩ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ, a wuo na hɛɛ-la doho ʋ sɩ na, a sʋʋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ sʋba. 11Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ mɩ jaŋ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa arɩ mɩ jaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.
Ʋ maga dɩ la joŋ la nyuŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ la sɩpaaŋ
12Wɩaa deemba mɩ sɩ bʋla, mɩ ha bɩ ba na dɛrɛ, mɩ ha bɩ nɩpʋla ma ŋaa. Mɩ haa loo nɛ dɩ mɩ na kʋ-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ na Yesu teeŋ. Yesu Kirisito paala laa sɩpaaŋ yuo diimi nɛ a tɩɩmɛ. 13Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ bɩɩna mɩ ha paala bɩ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ loo chɩchɛ na, ama mɩ joŋ mɩ nyuŋ kala hɛ wʋbala lɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩ yʋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ harɩŋ nɛ, aŋ hɛ mɩ doluŋ kala a chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ na wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ mɩ sɩpaaŋ. 14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ joŋ mɩ sɩaa chaasɛ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a yige mʋmʋ dɩ mɩ na kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a yɩrɛmɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩmɛ ʋ jaŋ lɛ. 15Ʋ maga dɩ la nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ waa Kirisito wɩaa lɛ bɩbɩɩnɛ wɩaa deemba nɛ. Dɩ ma dɔnsʋŋ nɩɩ bɩɩnɛ wɩɩ dɔŋ ma, Wɩa jaŋ kɛŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pʋlla pɩma. 16Wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ la ŋaa nɛ ŋ-la: Má leŋ dɩ la mʋ sɩpaaŋ a tuto wɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa la fa sɩɩ to a kʋ yi lɛɛlɛ.
17Mɩ naambiiriŋ, má kala chichesi mɩ wʋŋaalaa. Má tuto nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ la sɩ dagɛma naabʋɔsʋŋ. 18Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩaa pɩma a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ lɛ, aŋ ka lɛɛlɛ-na sɩlɩɩrɩŋ paala yuyuori mɩ sɩaa lɛ nɛ ka mɩɩ bʋl. Nɩaa yʋga, ba wʋŋaalaa dagɛ arɩ ba dɩ Kirisito ŋaa dʋndɔmɔ nɛ. Ba teeŋ Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ ŋaa wʋpɛɩ nɛ. 19Ba dɩdɛrɩŋ, ba jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ. Ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ nɛ baa to. Ba sɩɩŋ yie fɩɛsɛ hɩɩsɩ wɩaa lɛ nɛ. Ba yie bɩbɩɩnɛ dʋnɩa kɩaa dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ. 20Ama la-na ŋaa Wɩa-jaŋ nɩaa nɛ. La hɔnɔ gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kɔ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa la Laataara. 21Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ dol-la ʋ sɩ kaa bibeŋ kʋŋkala a kaa bɩrɩmɛ la yaraa deemba sɩ jaŋ pʋa, dɩ ba nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa yara-la sɩ bɩ pʋa.

english_text:
1Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy.
Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
2Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other. 3And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
4Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad. 5Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here. 6Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God. 7Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
8Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise. 9You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you.
Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
10The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it. 11I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have. 12I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little. 13Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
14It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time. 15 My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return. 16 Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once. 17I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
18 I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God. 19I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus! 20May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen.
Final Greetings
21Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus.
The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
22All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
23I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_text:
Pɔɔl chagɩlɛ Fɩlɩpa nɩaa
1Mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩ choma nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ yie bɩbɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ. Ma nɛ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ, mɩ kɛmma ŋmuŋmoo bɔyɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, má chɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ.
2La dɩhaalaa Yuodia arɩ Sɩntɩkɩ, mɩɩ sʋlma jaaŋ jaaŋ dɩ ma sɩŋ a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa. 3Ŋ-na mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ, mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ pɛ haalaa deemba lɛ nɛ dɩ ba sɩŋ. Ba dɩ Kɩlɛmɛnt nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ la bʋl Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa, a saa pɛ mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ dɔnsʋ-la kala lɛ. Ba kala yɩraa nɛ hɛ mɩɩsɩŋ teŋ-la lɛ.
4Má jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ bʋa na-kala. Mɩ jaŋ bɩra bʋla pɩma dɩ ma jʋjʋɔsɛ. 5Má leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ nʋʋkala teeŋ. Má ŋɩŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la lɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ kpaga nɛ. 6Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ kʋŋkala wɩaa wʋwalɩmɛma, ama dɩ ma nɩɩ chɛ kʋŋkala, má sʋl Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ kʋ-la lɛ. Má lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ aa bil ʋ sɩpaaŋ. 7Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaa ŋ-la, Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ʋ fɩɛl-la sɩ kɩɩ nuhuobiine jɩmɩŋ. Fɩɛl-la jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ arɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala pɩŋ dɩ-bala, Yesu Kirisito doluŋ lɛ.
8Mɩ naambiiriŋ, wɩɩ-la dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Má ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba, wɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to wombiiŋ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, wɩalɩŋ sɩ daga arɩ ma cho nɩaa, wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ nɩaa sɩpaaŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa bɩbɛsɛ ma lɛ. Má joŋ ma nyuŋ hɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ. 9Wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩma, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩ dagɛma, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ nɩa dɩ mɩɩ bʋl, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ gʋnna mɩ teeŋ, arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ na mɩɩ ŋaa, má kɛmba tɩntɩŋ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ hɛ ma teeŋ.
Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Fɩlɩpa nɩaa arɩ ba sɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ ŋɩɩ
10Mɩɩ jʋɔsɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ Wɩa teeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa lɛɛlɛ ma daga arɩ ma faa bɩɩnɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Faafaa-la kala ma faa bɩɩnɛ mɩ wɩaa nɛ. Ama wombiiŋ nɛ ma bɩ na dɩ ma wuo dagɛ chono-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a pɩmɛ. 11Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩ chɛ kʋŋ ka nɛ tɩɩ mɩɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ mala nɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋ koo dɩ mɩ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ, mɩ tʋɔŋ yie tɔrɔ nɛ. 12Mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ yie nagɛ nɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ kʋŋ kɛnɛ, a bɩra jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ. Mɩ gʋnnɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ nɛ bʋa na-kala koo lee-na kala lɛ, dɩ mɩ vɔgɔ koo dɩ losuŋ kɛmmɛ, dɩ mɩ kɛŋ kɩaa yʋgɛ koo dɩ mɩ nɛ kɛŋ mʋa, mɩ sɩpaa tuo. 13Mɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ mɩ tɩtɩa woruŋ wɩɩkala lɛ, a tɩŋ dol-la Kirisito sɩ pɩmɛ wɩaa.
14Ama ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ ma sɩ pɛ mɩ lɛ bʋa-la lɛ wɩaa sɩ jʋʋmɛ. 15Ma Fɩlɩpa nɩaa, ma tɩtɩa jɩma woruŋ arɩ mɩ sɩ lɩɩ Masidoonia lɛ, bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ suomo bʋbʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ma teeŋ, ma pɛ mɩ lɛ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi, ba kʋŋkala bɩ mɩ lɛ pɛ, see ma dʋndʋŋa nɛ pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ moribiee. 16Mɩ fa sɩ hɛ Tɛsalonaaka tinteeŋ lɛ, ma pɛ mɩ lɛ yʋgɛ nɛ. 17Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ mɩ yie chɩchɛ dɩ mɩ laa kɩaa nɛ ma teeŋ, ama mɩ cho dɩ mɩ na arɩ ma time wasa yʋgɛ nɛ Wɩa teeŋ. 18Ma sɩ tɩŋ Epafurodaatus ʋ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kʋ pɩmɛ, lɛɛlɛ mɩ kɛŋ kʋŋkala mɩ sɩɩ chɛ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ paala yʋgɛ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ, ba nagɛ kɩaa ba sɩ yie kpʋ pɩ Wɩa, ʋ laaba, ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ nɛ. 19Wɩa-la mɩ sɩ tɩmaa pa kɛŋ kʋŋkala nɛ, ʋ jaŋ to Yesu Kirisito lɛ a pɩma kʋŋkala ma sɩɩ chɛ a yʋgɛ. 20La Nyɩmma Wɩa yɩrɩŋ jaŋ yɩrɛ bʋa na-kala lɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.
Chʋɔlaa
21Mɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to Yesu Kirisito. La naambiiri-la kala ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ mɩ teeŋ, ba maa chʋɔlɛma. 22Wɩa nɩaa kala sɩ hɛ daha ka chʋɔlɛma, a wasa nyaŋ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ kuori-bal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Siiza dɩa lɛ.
23La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_text:
1From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
2To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ.
I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
A Prayer of Thanks
3Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. 4We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people, 5because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
6The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness 7 from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you. 8He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you.
The Person and Work of Christ
9We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives. 10Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better. 11His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
12I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light. 13God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son, 14 who forgives our sins and sets us free.
15 Christ is exactly like God,
who cannot be seen.
He is the first-born Son,
superior to all creation.
16Everything was created by him,
everything in heaven
and on earth,
everything seen and unseen,
including all forces
and powers,
and all rulers
and authorities.
All things were created
by God's Son,
and everything was made
for him.
17God's Son was before all else,
and by him everything
is held together.
18 He is the head of his body,
which is the church.
He is the very beginning,
the first to be raised
from death,
so that he would be
above all others.
19God himself was pleased
to live fully in his Son.
20 And God was pleased
for him to make peace
by sacrificing his blood
on the cross,
so that all beings in heaven
and on earth
would be brought back to God.
21You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things. 22But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent. 23But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message.
Paul's Service to the Church
24I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church. 25God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you. 26For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people. 27God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
28We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature. 29This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔ arɩ Timoti, la naambie, laa chʋɔlɛ ma Koloosi nɩaa.
2Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ ma-na Wɩa nɩaa sɩ ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩba Kirisito teeŋ. La Nyɩmma Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ a leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.
Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa Koloosi nɩaa wɩaa
3Bʋa na-kala dɩ la nɛ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa aa pɩma, la yie lɔllʋ, ʋ-na, La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito Nyɩmma, 4bɛɛ wɩaa la nɩa arɩ ma sɛɩ Kirisito Yesu niiŋ nɛ, a cho Wɩa nɩaa ma kala. 5Ma ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ pɩna gbɛrɛma nɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. Ma nɩɩ wɩɩŋ deeŋ bʋa-la ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. 6Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ leree yʋgɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Nɩaa yʋga a laaba dii, ba pʋŋ lere-la arɩ ba sɩ pʋŋ ŋɩɩ ma lɛ. Ba pʋŋ ŋɩɩ ma lɛ a suomi bʋa-la lɛ ma sɩ jegile nɩɩ wʋzɔmɔ-la a sɛnɛ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ ma lɛ ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ. 7Ma gʋnnɛ wɩaa deemba Ɛpafɩras teeŋ nɛ, la nɩ-choolii-la sɩ ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋɔ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa Kirisito tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ la nyuŋ. 8Ʋ nɛ bʋla pɩla arɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ.
9A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, a lɩɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la la sɩ nɩɩ ma wɩaa, la chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma nɛ a bɩ leŋ. Laa sʋl Wɩa aa pɩma dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma sɛnɛ jɩŋ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa, a kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ dɩgɩlɩŋ jegilee Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ pɩma. 10Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma wʋŋaalaa kala chɩŋ Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ, dɩ ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ a leŋ dɩ ma tɩŋ tɩntɩŋ-zɔŋŋɔɔ, tɩntɩŋ-dosunuŋ kala lɛ, dɩ ʋ kɛŋ doho, dɩ ma kʋ jɩŋ Wɩa woruŋ a waa pɛ. 11Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ʋ dol-bal-la, dɩ ma wuo kɛŋ pɩɩna arɩ kenyiri, a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ 12a lɔllɛ Wɩa arɩ ʋ sɩ leŋe ma ma maachie jaŋ wuo pɛ dii kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. 13Ʋ laala Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ, a kɛnla kaa mʋ hɛ ʋ bii-chooluŋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. 14Ʋ nɛ Wɩa joŋo tiŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ, a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla.
Kirisito kɛŋ doluŋ wɩɩkala lɛ
15Kirisito nɛ nagɛ Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala kala, Wɩa-la la sɩ bɩ na. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa bii-bumbuŋ a kɩɩ kʋŋkala ʋ sɩ ŋaa. 16Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa to a ŋaa kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ, kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ na arɩ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na kala, a pɛ kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ. Ʋ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a ŋaa kɩaa kala, ba ŋaa ʋ kɩaa. 17Ʋ nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, ka kʋŋkala-na hɛ nɩmɛ. Ʋ nɩɩ beŋ kɩaa kala ba chɩŋ ba dɩchɩnaa. 18Ʋ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ nɛ suomo bil Wɩa nɩaa gentine, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ ŋaa bumbuŋ Nɩɩ-la sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ sʋba lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ kʋŋkala lɛ. 19Wɩa cho dɩ Yesu nagɛ ʋ-na Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala nɛ. 20Ʋ lɛ nɛ Wɩa to ʋ dɩ kʋŋkala sɩŋ, kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ tinteeŋ lɛ kala. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ, ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ, ʋ ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe Wɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ dɔŋɔ nyuŋ.
21Ma dɩ Wɩa sɩaa fa bɩ dɔŋɔ ka na, a tɩŋ ma wʋbɔmɔ-la ŋaanɩŋ arɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩŋ lɔrʋnʋ-la wɩaa. 22Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa ŋaa ma dɩ ʋ sɩŋ nɛ a tɩŋ Kirisito sʋʋŋ wɩaa, dɩ ʋ kɛmma kaa kɔ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ arɩ tʋɔpʋla, dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ a sɩ́ wʋcheeli ma kɛŋ. 23Kirisito jaŋ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ pɩma, dɩ ma nɛ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, aa yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ. Ma nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba ba sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩaa dʋnɩa lee-kala nɛ. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl ma kʋ ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa dɔŋɔ aa bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba.
Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ tɩma pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi
24Lɛɛlɛ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na a pɩma lɛ. Hɛɛ-la mɩ sɩ na ma wɩaa nɛ leŋe Kirisito sɩ na hɛɛ-la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii aa hilimi dɛrɛ. Nɩalɩŋ nɛ ŋaa ʋ yaraa. 25Mɩ kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛmɛ dɩ mɩ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ, dɩ mɩ bʋl Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa kala a pɩma. 26Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa fa fáa nɛ. Wɩa joŋo faa la naabalɩmaba nɛ faafaa kala a kʋ yi bʋa deeŋ lɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa joŋo dagɛ ʋ nɩaa nɛ. 27Ba nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsɛ dɩ ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ ŋɩɩ kɩŋkɛŋ, ka ʋ fa joŋo faa. Lɛɛlɛ ʋ dagɛ ba sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa. Wɩalɩŋ nɛ daga arɩ Kirisito hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má yɩyɩɛlɛ dɩ ma kpaa ʋ yɩrɩ-bal-la nɛ. 28Ʋ wɩaa nɛ la bʋla pɩpɩ nɩaa. Laa kpʋrɩsɛ nʋʋkala dɩgɩlaa, aa dagɛ nʋʋ na-kala arɩ wʋjɩmɩɩ-na kala, dɩ la wuo ŋaa ba waa dɛrɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ. 29Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ faasa hɛ mɩ doluŋ kala nɛ a tɩtɩŋ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ dol-bal-la pɩmɛ dɩ mɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_text:
1I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me. 2I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery, 3but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him. 4I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk. 5Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong.
Christ Brings Real Life
6You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him. 7Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
8Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
9God lives fully in Christ. 10And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority. 11Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body. 12 And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death. 13 You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
14 God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross. 15There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
16 Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival. 17These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
18Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires. 19 They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God.
Christ Brings New Life
20You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as, 21“Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”? 22After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up? 23Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_text:
1Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ mɩ sɩ hɛ doluŋ a faasa tɩma pɩma a pɛ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Laadisiya lɛ, arɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ dɔnsʋŋ kala ha sɩ bɩ mɩ na. 2Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a kɛŋ nii-bala a cho dɔŋɔ, a wuo jɩŋ wɩaa sɩaa woruŋ a mʋ dɛrɛ, a jɩŋ wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo faa bʋbʋɔŋ, wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Kirisito. 3Ʋ dʋndʋŋa lɛ nɛ Wɩa joŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ arɩ jɩma kala faa.
4Mɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ pɩpɩma dɩ nʋʋkala sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛma arɩ nii-sɩma. 5Mɩ tuo ma teeŋ, ama mɩɩ bɩɩnɛ ma wɩaa nɛ, a nagɛ mɩ hɛ ma teeŋ. Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ ma sɩ laa Yesu dii a fɩɛlɛ ma yaraa a chɩŋ kpaŋ kpaŋ.
Mɩɩ-zɔŋ-la la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ
6Ma sɩ sɛyɛ arɩ Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ma Tɩɩna, má leŋ dɩ wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa lɛ, dɩ ʋ nagɛ ma dɩ ʋ ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. 7Má leŋ dɩ ma naapoloo sʋʋsa jʋʋ-ʋ woruŋ, dɩ ma wuo gʋnnɛ ʋ wɩaa a waa ba lɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, arɩ ba sɩ dagɛ ma ŋɩɩ. Má faasa lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa woruŋ.
8Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nyɩsa kɛsɛma dɩ ma tou. Baa dagɛma nuhuobiine wʋjɩmɩŋ nɛ, aa nyɩsɛma arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Ba to nuhuobiinee naabalɩma wɛnɩŋ nɛ a dagɛ dɩ-suomuŋ wɩaa dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to. Wɩaa deemba bɩ Kirisito teeŋ lɩa. 9Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ kala hɛ Yesu nuhuobiiŋ yara-la lɛ nɛ. 10Ma dɩ ʋ sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ma wɩɩkala chese nɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ. 11Ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa kʋbala ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga arɩ ʋ keri ma penee nɛ, ʋ bɩ naga nuhuobiinee nɛ kere. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe ma wuo joŋ ma faafaa wʋbɔmɔ-la ta. 12Ba sɩ foma Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, ʋ naga ma dɩ Kirisito kala nɛ sʋba ba joŋo hugi, Wɩa chɩsɛ ma dɩ Yesu kala sʋʋ-la lɛ, a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ doluŋ. 13Faafaa-la ma fa naga ma sʋba nɛ Wɩa teeŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa a bɩ ma penee ma kere. Ama Wɩa sɩ chɩsɛ Yesu sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ leŋe ma ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala a chɛla nɛ. 14Ʋ dɩsɛ wʋbɔmɔ-la la fa sɩ ŋaa chei ba tutola chɩmɩŋ a ta nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ la tuto sɩɩ chɛ dɩ laa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ. Kirisito sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ kpʋ wɩalɩŋ ta. 15Ʋ laa kɩalɩŋ kala la sɩ bɩ na ka ba kɛŋ doluŋ a bibeŋ leriŋ doluŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yuo diiba nɛ a hɩɩsɛba nʋʋkala na.
16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bil kɩsɩnɩŋ pɩma a tɩgɛ ma kʋdiilee koo kʋnyʋalaa lɛ, Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ chɛ-balaa koo chɛŋ-falɩŋ gbiele koo chɛ-wiesiŋ tapʋlʋŋ lɛ. 17Kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba nagɛ kʋ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ daaliimiŋ nɛ. Kʋ-la tɩtɩa nɛ ŋaa Kirisito. 18Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala joŋ cheeriŋ pɩma, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩɩna arɩ ba ŋaa nɩbala nɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩɩ na wɩaa a nagɛ duosoo tʋɔŋ a pɛsɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa a muuri, a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa. Ba bɩ wɩɩkala kɛnɛ sɩ maga dɩ ba bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ. Ba yie ŋaa ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ba sɩ yie bɩɩnɛ ba yaraa wɩaa nɛ. 19Ba bɩ Kirisito lɛ mɛrɛ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la nyuŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nɩaa waa ʋ lɛ arɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba waa ʋ lɛ arɩ nuhuobiine yaraa haŋgbel-susugusuŋ arɩ poloo sɩ mɛrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a waa ŋɩɩ, aŋ ka nyuŋ nɛ ŋaa ba doluŋ tɩɩna.
20Ma dɩ Kirisito sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to bɩra bɩ doluŋ kɛnɛ ma lɛ. Bɛɛ nɛ saa tɩɩ ma haa ŋaa wɩaa a nagɛ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, aa to kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba: 21“Má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ koru, má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ dii, má sɩ́ kɩaa dɔnsʋŋ digu.” 22Má sɩ́ kʋdiilee kɩsɩnɩ-la to. Kʋdiile-la ma sɩɩ dii, ba jaŋ dɛrɛ ma yaraa lɛ. Nuhuobiinee nɛ dagɛ kɩsɩnɩŋ deemba. 23Ba wʋdagaa deemba yie nagɛ ba kɛŋ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Ba yie dagɛ dɩ nɩaa to ba-na Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ wombiiŋ, a bʋl dɩ ba muuri ba tɩtɩa, aa dɔgɩsɛ ba yaraa. Ama wʋdagaa deemba bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ nɩaa leŋ ba yaraa wʋchooloo a ta.

english_text:
1 You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side. 2Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth. 3You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God. 4Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
5Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols. 6God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things. 7And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way. 8But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others. 9 And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
10 Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better. 11It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
12 God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient. 13 Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you. 14Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
15Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful. 16 Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God. 17Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him.
Some Rules for Christian Living
18 A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
19 A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
20 Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
21 Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
22 Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart. 23Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master. 24In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you. 25 But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_text:
1Ma dɩ Kirisito kala sɩ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, máa chɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ, lee-la Kirisito sɩ hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ sɛmɛ. 2Má joŋ ma nyuŋ kala hɛ wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ ma nyuŋ joŋo hɛ dʋnɩa wɩaa lɛ, 3bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ naga ma sʋba nɛ, ka ma mɩɩsɩŋ faa Kirisito lɛ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ Wɩa teeŋ. 4Kirisito nɛ ŋaa la mɩɩsɩŋ. Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩaa jaŋ na ma dɩ ʋ kala dɩ maa kpaa ʋ yɩrɩ-bal-la.
Má kpʋ dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a ta
5Ʋ maga dɩ ma kpʋ dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ ma lɛ a ta nɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Wʋlɩɩlɩŋ ŋaanɩŋ, disiniŋ ŋaanɩŋ, yaraa wʋchooloo, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩɩnɩŋ, tʋɔ-luŋuŋ. Tʋɔ-luŋuŋ-na paala nagɛ vʋɩ-kpaarɩŋ nɛ. 6Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ [sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ sɛyɛ] aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa deemba. 7Ma ma fa hɛ wɩalɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ a vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wɩaa deemba. 8Ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ wɩaa deemba kala ta. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Baanɩŋ nanɩŋ, baanɩŋ joŋo fɩɩsɩŋ, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɩaa lɛ, harɩ-gaaŋ arɩ wʋlɩɩlɩŋ bʋlʋŋ. 9Má sɩ́ wɩaa nyɩɛ a pɩ dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma joŋ ma faafaa mɛlɛ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ ta nɛ 10aŋ lɛɛlɛ tuto mɛl-falɩɩ-la sɩ zɔmɔ. Wɩa leŋe ma waa mɛl-falɩŋ deeŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ ʋ wɩaa woruŋ a kʋ nagɛ ʋ tɩtɩa nagɩsɩŋ. 11Mɛl-falɩŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ ʋ bɩ wɩɩ kɛnɛ dɩ ma ŋaa Juu tɩŋŋaa koo ma bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa, dɩ ma keri ma penee koo ma bɩ ma penee kere, dɩ ma ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa, koo dɩ ma ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩaa sɩ bɩ suro, dɩ ma ŋaa yosuŋ koo dɩ ma tɩɩ ma tɩtɩa. Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ, Kirisito nɛ ŋaa ba wʋnyuŋ, ʋ hɛ ba kala lɛ nɛ.
12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛma a choma a leŋ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ma fɩfá nɩaa nenige a kɛŋ zile, a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa muuri, a leŋ dɩ ma sɩaa fɩɛlɛ, a kɛŋ kenyiri. 13Má nyalɩmɛ a joŋ wɩaa chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ma nɛ kɛŋ wɩɩ arɩ dɔŋɔ. La Tɩɩna sɩ joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛma ŋɩɩ, má ma joŋo chɩchɛ dɔŋɔ. 14Wɩaa deemba kala wʋnyuŋ nɛ chonuŋ. Chonuŋ nɛ jaŋ pɩma doluŋ dɩ ma wuo ŋaa wɩaa deemba kala woruŋ. 15Má leŋ dɩ fɩɛla-la Kirisito sɩ pɩma kɛmma tɩtɩŋ. Wɩa yɩrɛma dɩ ma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ a hɔŋ arɩ fɩɛlɩŋ, a lɔllɛ bʋa na-kala. 16Má leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Kirisito sɩ bʋla hɛ ma tʋɔŋ woruŋ. Má kpʋrɩsɛ dɔŋɔba dɩgɩlaa aa dagɛ dɔŋɔ arɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ. Má yɩɩ yɩɩla-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ Wɩa nɩaa yɩɩlaa dɔnsʋŋ, arɩ yɩɩlaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ dagɛma. Má yɩɩ ŋɩɩ a pɩ Wɩa a lɔllʋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ. 17Wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ ŋaa koo ma sɩɩ bʋl, má ŋaa ba kala La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ a lɔllɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa ʋ yɩrɩŋ lɛ.
Wɩa nɩaa sɩ maga baa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɔŋɔba lɛ
18Haalaa, má to ma balaba niiŋ a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ to Wɩa. 19Baalaa, má cho ma haalaa, má sɩ́ ba nyuŋ tɛrʋ. 20Hambiisiŋ, má to ma naamba arɩ ma nyɩmmaba wɩɩ na-kala lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ. 21Nyɩmmaba, má sɩ́ ma biiriŋ walɩmʋ kɩŋkɛŋ dɩ ba yaraa yʋɔrɛ. 22Yosuŋ, má to nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa ma tɩŋŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ wɩɩ na-kala lɛ. Má sɩ́ tɩŋ bʋa-la dʋndʋŋ lɛ ba sɩɩ bemma, aa chɛ dɩ ba tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ. Ama má tɩŋ arɩ tʋɔ-bala a tɩŋ ma sɩɩ fá Wɩa wɩaa. 23Tɩntɩmɩɩ na-kala ma sɩɩ tɩŋ, má tɩŋ arɩ tʋɔ-bala a nagɛ ma tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, nuhuobiinee dee. 24Má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ pɩma ma time, kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ ŋaa bil ʋ nɩaa lɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. La Tɩɩna Kirisito nɛ ma tɩma pɩpa. 25Wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa ma jaŋ laa ba time a magɛ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa. Wɩa bɩ nɩaa sɩaa lɛ nɛ bene aŋ ŋɩŋaa wɩaa.

english_text:
1 Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
2Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful. 3Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this. 4Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
5 When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time. 6 Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions.
Final Greetings
7 Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me. 8I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along. 9 Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
10 Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you. 11Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
12 Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely. 13I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
14 Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
15Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
16After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
17 Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
18I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
Don't forget that I am in jail.
I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_text:
1Yosuŋ tɩŋŋaa, má to wʋtɩtɩɩ a joŋ magɛ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga a pɩ ma yosuŋ, aŋ sɩ́ yʋ arɩ ma ma kɛŋ Tɩɩna nɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.
2Má chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa bʋa na-kala a sɩ́ leŋ, a pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ, aa lɔllɛ Wɩa. 3Má pɛ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩ la ma, dɩ Wɩa wuo suri wombiiŋ pɩla dɩ la wuo bʋl Kirisito wɩalɩŋ fa sɩ faa. Ba wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ tɔ dɩa. 4Má chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩla dɩ mɩ wuo bʋl wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga mɩ bʋl dɩ ba pʋllɛ.
5Dɩ ma nɛ hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Yesu wɩaa laa dii tʋɔŋ, má jɩma kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa. Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ma nɛ na wombiiŋ, má bʋl wɩaa pɩba. 6Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋbʋlaa kala sɩŋ a kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ, dɩ ma wuo jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ to a chaarɛ nʋʋkala wɩaa sɩaa pʋ.
Chʋɔlaa
7Takɩkʋs jaŋ bʋl mɩ wɩaa kala pɩma. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii-choolii nɛ, a ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ, a ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ. 8Mɩɩ tɩmʋ ma teeŋ, dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ wɩaa sɩ naga a pɩla, dɩ ʋ wuo ŋaa dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ. 9Ʋ dɩ Oniisimɔs nɛ mɩɩ tɩŋ. Ʋ ma ŋaa la naambii-choolii nɛ a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, a ŋaa ma dɔŋɔ. Ba jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ na-kala sɩɩ ŋaa daha a pɩma.
10Arɩsɩtakʋs ka chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ dɩ ʋ kala nɛ ba kaa tɔ dɩa. Maak-la sɩ ŋaa Banabas naambie maa chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ dagɛma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa ʋ lɛ nɛ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, má kɛnʋ woruŋ. 11Yesu ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Jasɩtɩs ma ka chʋɔlɛma. Nɩaa deemba batori dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ a lɩɩ Juu tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu dii tʋɔŋ, a pɛ mɩ lɛ aa bʋl Wɩa kuorii-la wɩaa. Ba ŋaa mɩ tʋɔŋ fɩɛlɛ nɛ. 12Ɛpafɩras ma sɩ lɩɩ ma jaŋ ka chʋɔlɛma. Ʋ ma ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnna-la dɔŋɔ nɛ aa tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ʋ yie chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, dɩ ma waa dɛrɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ a jɩŋ woruŋ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma ŋaa. 13Mɩ jaŋ wuo bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ faasa hɛ ʋ doluŋ kala a tɩma pɩma, arɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ Laadisiya arɩ Hiirapolis lɛ. 14Luuk, dɔgɩta-la la sɩ cho arɩ Dɩmas ka chʋɔlɛma. 15Má chʋɔlɛ la naambiiri-la sɩ hɛ Laadisiya lɛ, arɩ Nimifa arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ʋ dɩa lɛ. 16Dɩ ma nɛ karɩmɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩ ma nɩaa dɛrɛ, má karɩmɛ teŋ-la a pɩ Wɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Laadisiya ma lɛ. Ka má ma laa mɩ teŋ-la Laadisiya nɩaa teeŋ a ma karɩmɛ ma tʋɔŋ. 17Má bʋla pɩ Akɩpas dɩ ʋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ tɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩmɩɩ-la kala ʋ sɩ joŋo pʋ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ.
18Lɛɛlɛ mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɩtɩa nɛ ŋmʋnsa aa chʋɔlɛma. Má sɩ́ mɩ wɩaa yʋ arɩ ba sɩ tɔmɛ dɩa ma kala. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ.

english_text:
1 From Paul, Silas, and Timothy.
To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
2We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray, 3we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
4My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people. 5When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you. 6 So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
7You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia. 8And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it. 9Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God. 10They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl arɩ Sɩlas arɩ Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ a ŋaa la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nɩaa. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.
Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Tɛsalonaaka nɩaa lɛ
2La yie chʋɔlɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa pɩpɩ ma kala nɛ. Dɩ la nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, la yie lʋlɔllʋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. 3La yie liliisu ŋɩɩ ma sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa a tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii wɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ cho nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛŋ yɩɛlaa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ. 4Mɩ naambiiri, la jɩma nɛ arɩ Wɩa choma nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛma dɩ ma ŋaa ʋ nɩaa. 5Bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ wʋbʋlʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ la kʋ bʋla pɩma. La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la fa kɛŋ doluŋ, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma fa hɛ la teeŋ, ka wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa ma jʋʋ ma dɩgɩlaa woruŋ. La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, ma na la mɛlɛ fa sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ma wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ la kɛŋ la tɩtɩa woruŋ ŋɩɩ. 6Ma to la wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ nɛ a to La Tɩɩna Kirisito ma. Ma sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii ŋɩɩ, ba dɔgɩsɛma nɛ woruŋ, ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la leŋe ma jʋjʋɔsɛ wɩalɩŋ lɛ nɛ. 7A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Masidoonia arɩ Akaaya tinteeŋ lɛ chɛbɛ ma lɛ nɛ. 8La Tɩɩna Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa to ma lɛ nɛ a teeli Masidoonia arɩ Akaaya tinteeŋ kala. Ʋ ŋɩɩ dʋndʋŋa ma saa dee, lee-kala baa bʋl wɩaa a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ la bʋl ma wɩaa pɩ nʋʋkala. 9Nɩaa yie bʋbʋl ŋɩɩ ma sɩ kɛnla woruŋ bʋa-la lɛ la sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ. Ba yie bʋl ŋɩɩ ma sɩ vɩa ma vʋɩyaa ta aŋ bɩrɩma to Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ weye, ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la. 10Ba yie bʋl arɩ maa gbɛrɛ ʋ Bie Yesu dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa jaŋ kɔ. Ʋ nɛ Wɩa chɩsɛ sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ laala ta tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa baanɩŋ sɩ jaŋ sii nuhuobiinee nyuŋ.

english_text:
Paul's Work in Thessalonica
1My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted. 2 As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble. 3We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone. 4God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
5You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed. 6We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us. 7But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby. 8We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
9My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone. 10Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord. 11You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children. 12We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
13We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you. 14 My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
15 Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else. 16They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them.
Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
17My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person. 18We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us. 19After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us? 20You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_text:
Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Pɔɔl sɩ tɩma Tɛsalonaaka lɛ
1Mɩ naambiiri, la fa sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ ŋɩɩ, ma jɩma ʋ fa bɩ pɛɩ ŋaa. 2Aŋ ka dɩ la-na kɔ ma teeŋ Tɛsalonaaka lɛ, la fa laa sɩpaaŋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ. Ba dɔgɩsɛla woruŋ Fɩlɩpa taŋ-la lɛ. La sɩɩ chɛ la bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ ma ma, nɩaa yʋga a lɩɩ la harɩŋ. Ama Wɩa-la la sɩ tɩma pɩpa pɩla nyuduoŋ la wuo bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩma ma. 3La bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ dɩ la kʋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋaa a pɩma. La bɩra bɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ ma kaa kɔ. La bɩ maa nyɩsɛ ma. 4Wɩa na arɩ la ŋaa nɩtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ lɩɩsɛla dɩ la bʋl ʋ wʋzɔmɔ-la a pɩ nɩaa. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ bʋl, la fa bɩ chɛ dɩ la bʋl dɩ nɩaa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ la nyuŋ. Ama laa chɛ dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ bʋl lɛ nɛ. Ʋ jɩŋ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ. 5Ma saa jɩma arɩ la sɩ kɔ ma teeŋ, la bɩ nii-sɩma nɛ kaa kɔ. La bɩ kɔ dɩ la bʋl kanfugi wɩaa a laa ma kɩaa. Wɩa nɛ ŋaa la sɩada tɩɩna. 6La bɩ ma teeŋ kɔ dɩ ma nɩaa koo nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ zizilla. La sɩ ŋaa Kirisito nanzɔɔba ŋɩɩ, la fa jaŋ wuo joŋ wɩaa nyagɛma. 7Ama la bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. La leŋe la sɩaa fɩɛlɛ ma teeŋ nɛ, a nagɛ haala sɩ yie bibeŋ ʋ biiriŋ nyuŋ ŋɩɩ. 8La choma nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la bɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la dʋndʋŋa nɛ bʋla pɩma, ama la joŋ la tɩtɩa kala a pɩma nɛ. La ŋaa ŋɩɩ, bɛɛ wɩaa la chaasa choma nɛ.
9La naambiiriŋ, ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la fa sɩ faasa tɩŋ a na hɛɛŋ bʋa-la lɛ la fa sɩ bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la aa pɩma. La tɩŋ wɩɩhɛyɛ arɩ tɩtaŋɩŋ kala nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ ma nyuŋ hɔŋ a gbɛrɛma. 10Ma dɩ Wɩa kala ŋaa la sɩada tɩŋŋaa nɛ arɩ la fa sɩ hɛ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii teeŋ, la wʋŋaalaa kala fa to Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ a ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba. La bɩ wɩɩkala ŋaa chei. 11La sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, la kɛmma a nagɛ hambiisiŋ nyɩmma sɩ yie kɛŋ ʋ hambiisiŋ ŋɩɩ nɛ. 12La bʋl wɩaa ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ, a leŋ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala. La sʋlma nɛ dɩ ma leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛma dɩ ma kʋ jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ a pɛ na ʋ tʋla.
13A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, la yie lʋlɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ bʋa na-kala. La sɩ kɛŋ Wɩa wɩalɩŋ kʋ bʋla pɩma, ma laaba nɛ a sɛɩba. Ma bɩ ba joŋo arɩ ba ŋaa nuhuobiine wɩaa, ama ma sɛɩba arɩ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wɩaa nɛ, wɩalɩŋ ka tɩŋ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laaba dii lɛ nɛ.
14Mɩ naambiiri, ma ma kʋ nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi a hɛ Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ aa to Yesu Kirisito harɩŋ nɛ. Hɛɛ-la ba sɩ na, ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ ma ma na. Juu tɩŋŋaa sɩ dɔgɩsɛ ba tʋɔŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii Judiya tinteeŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ma ma na hɛɛŋ ma taŋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 15Juu tɩŋŋaa deemba nɛ kpʋ La Tɩɩna Yesu arɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa, aŋ to naasɩŋ dɔgɩsɛ la ma. Ba ŋaa wɩaa chei Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ aŋ hosi nʋʋkala nyuŋ. 16Ba paala pugila nɛ, dɩ la sɩ́ Wɩa wɩaa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Juu tɩŋŋaa ŋaa dɩ Wɩa laaba ta. Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa yi ba dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ Wɩa baanɩŋ sii ba nyuŋ nɛ.
Pɔɔl bʋla dɩ ʋ cho dɩ ʋ mɩɩra mʋ na Tɛsalonaaka tɩmma-la
17Mɩ naambiiri, la pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ ʋ bɩ diene, ama la tʋɔbɩɩnaa-na ha hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. La sɩ bɩ maa na ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ nɛ la faa chɛ la kʋ nama arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ. 18La faa chɛ la kʋ nama nɛ. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl tɩtɩa paala nɛrɩgɛ nɛrɩgɛ nɛ, ama Sɩtaanɩ tɔ la wombiiŋ nɛ. 19La yɩɛlaa hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. La tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ. Dɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, a tɩŋ ma wɩaa la jaŋ bigisi la tɩtɩa lɛ. 20Ma nɛ laa yɩrɩŋ pɩla. A tɩŋ ma wɩaa la yie jʋjʋɔsɛ nɛ.

english_text:
1 Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves 2and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you. 3We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer, 4because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know. 5At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
6 Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
7My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you. 8Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life. 9How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us? 10Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
11We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you. 12May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown. 13And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_text:
1La sɩ walɩma dɩ la kʋ nama a lɔl, ŋɩɩ nɛ la bɩɩnɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ pɛ la lɛ dɩ la nɛ hɔŋ Atɛŋ taŋ-la lɛ. 2La tɩŋ la naambie Timoti dɩ ʋ kʋ nama. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii nɛ, a ŋaa la tɩntɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma, a bʋl Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ a pɩpɩ nɩaa. La tɩmʋ dɩ ʋ kʋ bʋl wɩaa a nyaasɛ ma nyuŋ dɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ, 3ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala bɔyɛ sɩ́ joŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wʋwalɩmɩa-la sɩɩ puuma lɛ. Wɩa nɛ lɩɩsɛla dɩ wɩaa deemba puula. 4La fa sɩ hɛ ma teeŋ, la laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma arɩ ba jaŋ to naasɩŋ a dɔgɩsɛla. Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ bʋla pɩma kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ ma naba nɛ.
5Mɩ sɩ nyalɩma lɔl dɩ mɩ kʋ nama, ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ tɩŋ Timoti dɩ mɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ chɩna a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. Mɩ bɔyɛ faa joŋ nɛ arɩ Sɩtaanɩ jaŋ magɩsɛma a ŋaa dɩ ma joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii ta. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, tɩntɩmɩɩ-la la sɩ tɩma ma teeŋ jaŋ ŋaa pɛɩ. 6Ama lɛɛlɛ Timoti sɩ lɩɩ ma teeŋ kɔ, ʋ kɛŋ wʋzɔŋ nɛ kʋ bʋla pɩla. Ʋ bʋla pɩla arɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ a cho nɩaa ma. Ʋ bɩra bʋla pɩla arɩ ma yie liliisi la wɩaa nɛ woruŋ bʋa na-kala lɛ, a fa cho dɩ ma nala, arɩ la ma sɩ cho dɩ la nama ŋɩɩ. 7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la naambiiri, laa na hɛɛŋ nɛ ka wɩaa ma wʋwalɩmɛla, ama la sɩ nɩa arɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ ŋɩɩ, la tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ ma wɩaa. 8Lɛɛlɛ-na la wiese nɛ a tɩŋ ma sɩ chɩŋ La Tɩɩna wɩalɩŋ lɛ.
9La bɩ jaŋ wuo lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ dɛrɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. La yie jʋjʋɔsɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa. 10Laa sʋl Wɩa nɛ woruŋ tɩtaŋɩŋ arɩ wɩɩhɛyɛ kala dɩ la wuo kʋ nama, a wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma na kɩalɩŋ sɩ ka a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. 11Laa sʋl la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩ ba chɛ wombiiŋ pɩla dɩ la kɔ ma teeŋ. 12La bɩraa sʋl La Tɩɩna Yesu dɩ ʋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma wasa cho dɔŋɔ, dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ kɩŋkɛŋ a cho nʋʋkala, arɩ la sɩ choma ŋɩɩ, 13aŋ bɩra sʋlʋ dɩ ʋ leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ doluŋ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, a kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, a sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu arɩ ʋ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ.

english_text:
A Life That Pleases God
1Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder. 2Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus. 3God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex. 4Respect and honor your wife. 5Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God. 6You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things. 7God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure. 8So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
9We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this, 10and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more. 11Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do. 12 Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone.
The Lord's Coming
13My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope. 14We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died. 15 Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
16 With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life. 17Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever. 18Encourage each other with these words.
translation_text:
Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ
1La naambiiri, wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋl wʋkaanɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la: La dagɛma wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ma nyuŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ma sɛnɛ ŋɩŋaa. Ama la haa sʋlma La Tɩɩna Yesu yɩrɩŋ lɛ dɩ ma wasa ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ. 2Ma jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ joŋo dagɛma La Tɩɩna Yesu doluŋ lɛ nɛ. 3Wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ma sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ a lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ lɛ. 4Baal kala maga ʋ dɩ ʋ haala hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ a sɩ́ disiniŋ kɛŋ a zizil ba tɩtɩa. 5Má sɩ́ ma tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ to a gɔllɔ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. 6Bɩra, nʋʋkala sɩ́ wɩɩ ŋaa chei ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna a tɩgɛ ʋ haala lɛ. La chaasa bʋla pɩma nɛ faafaa kala a kpʋrɩsɛ ma dɩgɩlaa arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa disiŋ wɩaa. 7Wɩa bɩ la lɩɩsa dɩ la ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ, ama ʋ lɩɩsɛla dɩ la ŋaa nɩa sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. 8Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa wɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ bʋla, nuhuobiine dee tɩɩna vɩa, Wɩa nɛ ʋ vɩa ŋɩɩ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la pɩma.
9Mɩ naambiiri, ʋ bɩ maga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa tɩtɩa dagɛma ŋɩɩ ma sɩ jaŋ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ. 10Wʋtɩtɩɩ, ma paala cho nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Masidoonia lɛ nɛ. Mɩ naambiiri, la saa sʋlma dɩ ma wasa cho nɩaa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. 11La laa sɩpaaŋ bʋla pɩma dɩ ma hɛ ma doluŋ kala a fɩɛla hɔŋ, a bibeŋ ma tɩtɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa nyuŋ a wuo nɩna ma kʋchɛɛlɛɛ. 12Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii jaŋ zizilma. Ma bɩ jaŋ hɔnɔ gbɛrɛ nʋʋ dɩ ʋ pɩma ma kʋchɛɛlɛɛ.
Yesu jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii sʋʋŋ lɛ
13Mɩ naambiiri, laa chɛ dɩ ma jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba lɛ, dɩ ma tʋɔŋ sɩ́ faasa chei a nagɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ kʋŋkala ka yɩɛlɛ tʋɔŋ sɩ chei ŋɩɩ. 14La sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu sʋba nɛ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ la ma laa dii arɩ Wɩa jaŋ chɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ. 15Wɩaa deemba la sɩ bʋlaa pɩma lɛɛlɛ, La Tɩɩna Yesu tɩtɩa nɛ dagɛla: La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, la bɩ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ sʋba sɩpaaŋ a mʋ Yesu teeŋ. 16Bʋa kʋbala La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Bʋa-la lɛ nɩaa jaŋ nɩɩ dɩ ʋ faasa kpɩa goŋ. Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ma jaŋ kpɩa, ka dɩ ba ŋmʋʋ Wɩa nyile-la ma. Nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Kirisito wɩaa dii aŋ sʋʋ, ʋ jaŋ laa sɩpaaŋ chɩsɛba dɩ ba sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. 17Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ kɛsɛla kaa pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ chɩsa sʋʋŋ lɛ, dɩ la kala cheŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ wɩa-nyuŋ. La jaŋ hɛ La Tɩɩna teeŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. 18Má bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ dɔŋɔ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala.

english_text:
1I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen. 2 You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night. 3People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
4My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief. 5You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark. 6Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert. 7People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk. 8 But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
9God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. 10Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes. 11This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing.
Final Instructions and Greetings
12My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord. 13Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other. 14My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone. 15Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
16Always be joyful 17and never stop praying. 18Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
19Don't turn away God's Spirit 20or ignore prophecies. 21Put everything to the test. Accept what is good 22and don't have anything to do with evil.
23I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns. 24The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
25Friends, please pray for us.
26Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
27In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
28I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_text:
Má ŋaa siri a gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ
