Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ la ŋaa nɩa sɩ joŋ la nyuŋ hɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ lɛ. 15Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, joŋ wɩaa deemba a dagɛba, a kɛŋ dol-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩŋ, a bʋl wɩaa nyaasɛ ba nyuŋ, dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ ma chei dɩ ŋ bʋl ba teeŋ. Sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala bee gʋʋnʋŋ.

english_text:
Doing Helpful Things
1Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful 2and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone. 3We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
4God our Savior showed us
how good and kind he is.
5He saved us because
of his mercy,
and not because
of any good things
we have done.
God washed us by the power
of the Holy Spirit.
He gave us new birth
and a fresh beginning.
6God sent Jesus Christ
our Savior
to give us his Spirit.
7Jesus treated us much better
than we deserve.
He made us acceptable to God
and gave us the hope
of eternal life.
8This message is certainly true.
These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds. 9But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
10Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them. 11You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are.
Personal Instructions and Greetings
12 I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
13 When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
14Our people should learn to spend their time doing something useful and worthwhile.
15Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith.
I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_text:
Má ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa na-kala lɛ
1Bʋla pɩ Wɩa nɩaa dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bemba a tutoba, a ŋaa siri dɩ ba ŋaa wɩɩ na-kala sɩ zɔmɔ. 2Bʋla pɩba dɩ ba sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ kala bʋla tɩgɛ nʋʋkala lɛ. Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ ba cho yuosuŋ, ama ʋ maga dɩ ba leŋ ba dɩ nʋʋkala pɛgɛ zɔŋ, a leŋ dɩ ba sɩaa fɩɛlɛ nʋʋkala teeŋ. 3La ma tɩtɩa fa ŋaa nɩyaara nɛ, a fa bɩ Wɩa niiŋ to, wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ fa leŋ la yeŋŋi. La fa to la tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa harɩŋ nɛ a bɩrɩmɛ ba yosi. La fa cho dɩ nɩaa jʋʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a fa kɛŋ yarɩ-bieriŋ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Nɩaa fa bɛrɛla, la ma fa bɛrɛba. 4Ama la Laataara Wɩa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ kɛŋ zile arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ cho nɩaa nɛ, 5a laala ta. Ʋ bɩ naga arɩ la sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laala ta. Ama ʋ sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige nɛ tɩɩ ʋ laala ta. Ʋ laala ta nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ Wɩa bɩra wasa lʋlla nɛ, la kɛŋ mɩɩ-falɩŋ ʋ teeŋ. 6Wɩa to la Laataara Yesu Kirisito lɛ nɛ a joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a hɛ la lɛ woruŋ. 7Ʋ lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ la kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a wuo kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, wɩɩ-la la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ lɛ. 8Wɩɩŋ deeŋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ paala chaasa bʋl wɩaa deemba, dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, dɩ ba ŋaa siri a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa na-kala lɛ. Wɩaa deemba ŋaa wʋzɔmɔ nɛ. Ba jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩaa lɛ.
9Má leŋ nɩyaarɩ wʋkaalɛrɛ, a sɩ́ ma naabalɩmaba gentine sɩ duomo dɩɩsʋ. Má sɩ́ yuosuŋ hɛ a sɩ́ dɔŋɔ yuo a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ bɩ nʋʋ lɛ ka pɛ. 10Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ aa chɛ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ma nyusuŋ yagɛ dɔŋɔ, yɩrʋ a kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ vɩa aŋ ŋɩŋaa, bɩra yɩrʋ lɩa lɛ a kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa, aŋ lɩɩsɛ ŋ nɩsɩŋ ʋ lɛ. 11Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ vɩa wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ aŋ ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ʋ wʋŋaalaa gʋra diiu sarɩya nɛ.
Wʋkaanɩŋ
12Dɩ mɩ nɛ tɩŋ Atɩmas koo Takɩkʋs dɩ ʋ kɔ ŋ teeŋ, hɛ doluŋ aŋ kɔ mɩ teeŋ Nikopolis lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ bɩɩna dɩ mɩ hɔŋ nɩmɛ nɛ waarɩŋ chɛnsɩ-la tʋɔŋ. 13Dɩ Ziinas sarɩya diiru-la arɩ Apɔlɔs nɩɩ vɛŋ ba wombiiŋ, pɛ ba lɛ woruŋ. Pɩba kʋ-la kala ba sɩɩ chɛ. 14La nɩaa ma maga ba gʋnnɛ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ nɛ, a wuo pɩpɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba pɛ lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ mɛlɛ-la sɩ bɩ chie kɛnɛ kɛŋ.
15La dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɔnɔ, laa chʋɔlʋŋ. Chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a chola. Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ma kala lɛ woruŋ.

english_text:
1From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith.
Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you 2 and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
3I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
Philemon's Love and Faith
4Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God. 5I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people. 6As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us. 7My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people.
Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
8Christ gives me the courage to tell you what to do. 9But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ, 10 I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail. 11Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
12Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad. 13I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news. 14But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
15Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good, 16but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
17If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me. 18If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account. 19With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life. 20My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
21I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more. 22Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
23 Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings, 24 and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
25I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Pɔɔl, nɩɩ-la ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa a tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa arɩ la naambie Timoti nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na Fɩlɩmɔŋ. Ŋ ŋaa la nandɔŋ-choolii nɛ, a bɩra ŋaa la tɩtɩnnɩ dɔŋ ma.
2La bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi ŋ dɩa lɛ, a bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ la dɩhaala Apɩa arɩ la naambie Akɩpʋs. Akɩpas ŋaa la laalɩyuori dɔŋ nɛ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.
3La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.
Pɔɔl lɔllɛ Wɩa a mʋ tɩgɛ Fɩlɩmɔŋ lɛ
4Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ mɩ nɩɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa, mɩ yie lɔllɛ Wɩa nɛ a tɩŋ ŋ wɩaa, 5bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ nɩɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho Wɩa nɩaa, arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ laa La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii. 6Mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ Wɩa pɛ ŋ lɛ dɩ ŋ wasa bʋl Kirisito wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ laa dii a pɩ nɩaa, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ŋ chaasa jɩŋ wʋzɔŋ-na kala la sɩ kɛnɛ Kirisito teeŋ. 7Mɩ naambii-choolii, ŋ sɩ́ cho Wɩa nɩaa ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ ŋaa mɩ ma tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ nɛ kɩŋkɛŋ, mɩ nyuŋ nyaasɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ŋ leŋe Wɩa nɩaa tʋɔŋ pɩŋ dɩ-bala nɛ.
Pɔɔl sʋl Fɩlɩmɔŋ dɩ ʋ kɛŋ Oniisimɔs woruŋ
8Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Kirisito wɩaa lɛ, mɩ fa jaŋ wuo dagɩŋ wɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ ŋ ŋaa. 9Ama a tɩŋ mɩ sɩ choŋ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la. Mɩ-na Pɔɔl nɛ paala chɩŋ Yesu Kirisito naasɩŋ lɛ aŋ lɛɛlɛ hɛ sarɩka lɛ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa. 10Mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ a tɩŋ mɩ bie Oniisimɔs wɩaa. Ʋ naga mɩ bii nɛ Yesu wɩaa lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa, mɩ lɛ nɛ ʋ to a laa Yesu wɩaa dii bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ hɛ sarɩka lɛ. 11Bʋa-la lɛ ʋ fa sɩ hɛ ŋ teeŋ, ʋ fa bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ a pɩŋ, ama lɛɛlɛ, ʋ kɛŋ bʋbʋɔŋ a pɩ mɩ dɩŋ kala nɛ. 12Mɩ leŋe ʋ kʋkɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ, mɩ chou nɛ woruŋ. 13Mɩ fa cho dɩ ʋ hɛ mɩ teeŋ nɛ. Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ sarɩka lɛ ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ Yesu wʋzɔmɔ-la wɩaa, ʋ fa jaŋ wuo pɛ mɩ lɛ arɩ ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ ŋɩɩ. 14Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ fʋgʋŋ dɩ ŋ pɛ mɩ lɛ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ŋ to ŋ tɩtɩa tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a pɛ mɩ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ bɩ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩkala see dɩ ŋ sɛyɛ.
15Kapo Oniisimɔs lɩɩ ŋ teeŋ tapʋlɩa-la baŋmɛnɛ ŋɩɩ ka dɩ ʋ mɩɩra kɔ a hɛ ŋ teeŋ deeŋ deeŋ nɛ. 16Oniisimɔs fa ŋaa ŋ yomo nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ ʋ kɩɩ yomo. Ʋ ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii nɛ. Mɩ chou nɛ woruŋ, mɩ jɩma ŋ ma jaŋ chou, ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋ yomo arɩ ŋ naambie kala La Tɩɩna Yesu teeŋ. 17Dɩ ŋ nɛ bene dɩ mɩ ŋaa ŋ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔŋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ kɔ, kɛnʋ woruŋ arɩ ŋɩɩ ŋ fa sɩ jaŋ kɛmmɛ. 18Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa ŋaa wɩɩ cheyiŋ, koo dɩ ʋ dii ŋ chɩmɩŋ ma, joŋ arɩ mɩ nɛ ŋaa wɩɩ-la. 19Mɩ-na Pɔɔl, mɩ tɩtɩa nɩsɩŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩŋ. Mɩ jaŋ timiŋ. Sɩ́ yʋ arɩ ŋ ma kɛŋ mɩ chɩmɩŋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ lɛ nɛ ŋ to a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Yesu teeŋ. 20Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambii, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ, a tɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu wɩaa, ŋaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ. La sɩ ŋaa naambiiri Kirisito lɛ, leŋ dɩ mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ.
21Mɩ laa dii arɩ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩŋ, ŋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩɩ chɛ. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ŋ jaŋ paala ŋaa kɩɩ ŋɩɩ. 22Pɛ chɛ dɩa a bil mɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa mɩɩ yɩɛlɛ arɩ ma sɩ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa pɩpɩmɛ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ laa ma kala sʋla a leŋ dɩ mɩ mɩɩra kɔ ma teeŋ.
Pɔɔl arɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ chʋɔlɛ Fɩlɩmɔŋ
23Ɛpafɩras ma ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa a pɛ mɩ lɛ Yesu wɩaa, ʋ ma ka chʋɔlʋŋ. 24Maak arɩ Arɩsɩtakʋs arɩ Dɩmas arɩ Luuk, ba ma ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnɩ-dɔsʋŋ nɛ, ba ma ka chʋɔlʋŋ.
25La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_text:
1Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors. 2 But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son. 3 God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together.
After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven. 4He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs.
God's Son Is Greater than Angels
5 God has never said
to any of the angels,
“You are my Son, because today
I have become your Father!”
Neither has God said
to any of them,
“I will be his Father,
and he will be my Son!”
6 When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
7 And when God speaks about the angels, he says,
“I change my angels into wind
and my servants
into flaming fire.”
8 But God says about his Son,
“You are God,
and you will rule
as King forever!
Your royal power
brings about justice.
9You loved justice
and hated evil,
and so I, your God,
have chosen you.
I appointed you
and made you happier
than any of your friends.”
10 The Scriptures also say,
“In the beginning, Lord,
you were the one
who laid the foundation
of the earth
and created the heavens.
11They will all disappear
and wear out like clothes,
but you will last forever.
12You will roll them up
like a robe
and change them
like a garment.
But you are always the same,
and you will live forever.”
13 God never said to any
of the angels,
“Sit at my right side
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you!”
14 Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_text:
Wɩa Bie nɛ kɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa
1Faafaa-la Wɩa bʋl wɩaa pɩ la naabalɩmaba a yʋgɛ nɛ. Wombie-la ʋ sɩ to bʋl wɩaa pɩba ma yʋga nɛ. Ʋ to ʋ wʋlaabʋllaa lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa deemba pɩba. 2Ama lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋ to ʋ Bie lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa pɩla. Wɩa to ʋ Bie lɛ nɛ a ŋaa dʋnɩa, a joŋ kʋŋkala hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ. 3Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ tʋla-la, ʋ nɛ ʋ Bie ma kɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ Bie ma nagɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ bʋl kɛŋ doluŋ, dol-la nɛ ʋ kaa beŋ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Ʋ sɩ pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩla hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ. 4Ʋ nɛ kɩɩ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala. Yɩrɩ-la ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ ma nɛ kɩɩ yɩrɩ-la Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ laa.
5Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
“Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ,
mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ jɩnɩŋ.”
Ʋ saa bɩra bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ:
“Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ŋ Nyɩmma,
ŋ ma jaŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii.”
Wɩa tɩndaarɩ bɛɛ lɛ nɛ Wɩa ha bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ?
6Bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ʋ Bii-hɩaŋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, ʋ sɩ,
“Wɩa tɩndaaraa kala maga ba chʋɔlʋ nɛ.”
7Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a mʋ tɩgɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa lɛ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ,
“Mɩ leŋe mɩ tɩndaaraa sɩ ŋaa mɩ tɩntɩnnaa nagɛ peliŋ
arɩ nyiŋgeliŋ nɛ.”
8Ama ʋ sɩ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ bʋl: Ʋ sɩ,
“Ŋ ŋaa Wɩa nɛ, ŋ kuoruŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.
Tʋɔpʋla nɛ ŋ jaŋ kaa beŋ ŋ nɩaa.
9Ŋ cho tʋɔpʋl wɩaa nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ-na ŋ Wɩa lɩɩsɩŋ
a leŋ ŋ kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ a kɩɩ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa.”
10Wɩalɩŋ ba bɩra sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: Ba sɩ,
“La Tɩɩna, dɩ-suomuŋ kala ŋ nɛ bil tinteeŋ gentine,
ŋ nɛ ŋaa wɩa-nyuŋ ma.
11Wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala jaŋ lɛl, ama ŋ-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ.
Ba kala jaŋ kɔsɛ, a nagɛ gɛnnɩŋ sɩɩ kɔsɛ ŋɩɩ.
12Ba jaŋ nagɛ gɛrɩŋ dɩ ŋ kaa kpeŋ.
Ba jaŋ bɩrɩmɛ a nagɛ gɛrɩŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ lɩa.
Ama ŋ-na bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ŋ bɩrɩma. Ŋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.”
13Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa bɩra sɩ bʋla pʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ,
“Kʋ hɔŋ mɩ nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ,
see mɩ yuo dii ŋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ.”
Wɩa tɩndaarɩ bɛɛ lɛ nɛ Wɩa ha bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ? 14Wɩa tɩndaara-la kala ŋaa Wɩa tɩntɩnnaa nɛ. Wɩa yie tɩmba ba mʋ pɛ nɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩɩ chɛ ʋ laa ta lɛ nɛ.

english_text:
This Great Way of Being Saved
1We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away. 2The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved. 3So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true. 4God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to.
The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
5We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels. 6 Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God,
“What makes you care
about us humans?
Why are you concerned
for weaklings such as we?
7You made us lower
than the angels
for a while.
Yet you have crowned us
with glory and honor.
8And you have put everything
under our power!”
God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control. 9What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
10Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory. 11Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters. 12 He even said to God,
“I will tell them your name
and sing your praises
when they come together
to worship.”
13 He also said,
“I will trust God.”
Then he said,
“Here I am with the children
God has given me.”
14We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death. 15But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying. 16 Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants. 17He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins. 18And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_text:
Yesu nɛ ŋaa la Laataara
1A tɩŋ wɩɩŋ deeŋ wɩaa, ʋ maga dɩ la kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ nɩa woruŋ, dɩ wɩɩkala sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la mɩɩrɛ harɩŋ. 2Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa tɩndaaraa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa fa ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa bɩ baa to, koo dɩ nʋʋ nɛ fa chei ba kʋŋ, Wɩa yie dɔgɩsɛba nɛ. 3Ŋɩɩ wɩaa dɩ la nɛ vɩa wʋbalɩŋ deeŋ Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dɩ ʋ laala ta, ɛɛ nɛ la jaŋ ŋaa a fori? La Tɩɩna Yesu nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la, nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩɩ wɩɩ-la bʋla pɩla arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. 4Wɩa ma tɩtɩa daga arɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩ bʋla ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ dagɛ ʋ doluŋ a ŋaa wʋkpuŋkperisiŋ arɩ wʋmagɩlaa kala. Wɩa to ʋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ lɛ nɛ a joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ a dii zile nɩaa lɛ.
5Ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa joŋ tintee-falɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ a hɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ dɩ ba bibeŋ, tintee-falɩɩ-la wɩaa la sɩɩ bʋl. 6Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ba bʋla,
“Nuhuobiine tuo kʋŋkala ka ŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ ʋ wɩaa.
Nuhuobiine bie tuo kʋŋkala ka ŋ chɩl ʋ wɩaa
7Ŋ ŋaa nuhuobiine, a leŋ ŋ tɩndaaraa nɛ kɩɩʋ mʋa,
ka ŋ zilu a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ.
8Ŋ joŋ kʋŋkala ŋ sɩ ŋaa hɛ ʋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ bibeŋ.”
Ŋ sɩ joŋ kʋŋkala hɛ nuhuobiine nɩsɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ŋ leŋe ʋ kɛŋ ba kala doluŋ nɛ. Ama lɛɛlɛ la na dɩ nuhuobiine ha bɩ kʋŋkala ka beŋ. 9La na arɩ Wɩa fa leŋe Wɩa tɩndaaraa nɛ kɩɩ Yesu mʋa. Ama lɛɛlɛ Wɩa zilu nɛ a leŋ ʋ kɛŋ doluŋ arɩ yɩrɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ na hɛɛŋ nɛ a sʋʋ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ nɛ ʋ fa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, dɩ ʋ wuo laa nuhuobiinee kala nyuŋ a sʋʋ.
10Kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, Wɩa nɛ ŋaaba a tɩɩba ma. Ʋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ biiriŋ yʋgɛ kʋ jʋʋ ʋ kuorii-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ leŋe Yesu, nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ laaba ta na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ. 11Yesu, nɩɩ-la sɩ pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta, arɩ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ʋ sɩ pɩɩsa ta, ba kala nyɩmma ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ a wuo yɩrɛ ba kala ʋ naambiiriŋ, ka hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ. 12Wɩalɩŋ Yesu sɩ bʋla pɩ Wɩa nɛ ŋ-la:
“Mɩ jaŋ bʋl ŋ wɩaa pɩ mɩ naambiiriŋ,
aŋ dɛnnɩŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ hilime aa chʋɔlʋŋ tʋɔŋ.”
13Ʋ bɩra bʋla,
“Mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩ yɩɛlaa kala hɛ Wɩa lɛ,”
a bɩra bʋl,
“Na mɩ dɩ ŋ biiri-la kala ŋ sɩ joŋo pɩmɛ nɛ ŋ-la.”
14Biiri-la Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩ Kirisito kɛŋ chalɩŋ arɩ yaraa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Kirisito ma bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiiŋ a kɛŋ chalɩŋ arɩ yaraa dɩ ʋ sʋʋ a wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, nɩɩ-la sɩ kɛŋ sʋʋŋ doluŋ, 15a wuo laa nɩaa ta, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ fá sʋʋŋ a ŋaa sʋʋŋ yosi ba mɩɩsɩŋ kala lɛ. 16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ bɩ naga Wɩa tɩndaaraa lɛ nɛ ʋ kʋ pɛ, ama ʋ kʋ pɛ Abɩraham doho nɩaa lɛ nɛ. 17Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ bɩrɩmɛ nuhuobiine a ma nagɛ ʋ naambiiri-la, ba wɩɩ-wɩɩkala lɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ ʋ naambiiriŋ tʋɔŋ a ŋaa nʋʋ sɩɩ fa nɩaa nenige, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ Wɩa joŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba. 18Ʋ tɩtɩa na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ. Sɩtaanɩ ma fa magɩsʋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ wuo pɛ nɩalɩŋ Sɩtaanɩ sɩɩ magɩsʋ lɛ.

english_text:
Jesus Is Greater than Moses
1My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest! 2 Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people. 3But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house. 4Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
5Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future. 6But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope.
A Rest for God's People
7 It is just as the Holy Spirit says,
“If you hear God's voice today,
8don't be stubborn!
Don't rebel like those people
who were tested
in the desert.
* 9 For forty years your ancestors
tested God and saw
the things he did.
10“Then God got tired of them
and said,
‘You people never
show good sense,
and you don't understand
what I want you to do.’
11God became angry
and told the people,
‘You will never enter
my place of rest!’ ”
12My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God. 13You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn. 14We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end. 15 The Scriptures say,
“If you hear his voice today,
don't be stubborn
like those who rebelled.”
16 Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses? 17Who were the people that made God angry for 40 years? Weren't they the ones that sinned and died in the desert? 18And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him? 19We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_text:
Yesu nɛ kɩɩ Mosis
1Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, Wɩa nɛ yɩrɛla dɩ la kɔ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ saa maga dɩ ma joŋ Yesu wɩaa hɛ ma nyuŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ma, wombii-la la sɩɩ to lɛ. 2Ʋ fa to nɩɩ-la sɩ lɩɩsʋ nɛ arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ, arɩ Mosis fa sɩ to Wɩa arɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dɩa lɛ. 3La jɩma arɩ nɩɩ-la sɩ saa dɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ maga dɩ ʋ laa yɩrɩŋ a kɩɩ dɩa-la ʋ sɩ saa. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ yɩrɩ-la Yesu sɩ laa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ Mosis yɩrɩŋ. 4Dɩa na-kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, nʋʋ nɛ saa. Ama Wɩa nɛ ta kʋŋkala. 5Mosis fa ŋaa tɩntɩnnɩ-tɩtɩɩ nɛ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ fa bʋl wɩaa pɩba a tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa maachie sɩ jaŋ bʋl lɛ. 6Ama Kirisito-na fa ŋaa Wɩa Bii nɛ, a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a bibeŋ Wɩa nɩaa. Dɩ la ma nɛ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ a tɩŋ kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ wɩaa, la jaŋ wuo ŋaa ʋ nɩaa.
Ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a na wiese Wɩa teeŋ
7Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋla pɩla,
“Jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro,
8má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ, arɩ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ a lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ,
bʋa-la lɛ nɛ ba magɩsɛmɛ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ.
9Lee-la ma naabalɩmaba magɩsɛmɛ nɛ woruŋ,
arɩ ba sɩ na mɩ wʋŋaalaa jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa ma kala.
10Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ baanɩŋ sii nɩaa deemba kala nyuŋ, mɩ bʋl,
‘Ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa yie ŋaa ba yeŋŋi nɛ,
ba bɩ mɩ wombiiŋ jɩŋ.’
11Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ na baanɩŋ a ŋmɩɛsa hɛ ba lɛ a bʋl,
‘Ma bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩ jaŋ joŋo pɩma dɩ ma hɔnɔ wiesi.’ ”
12Mɩ naambiiri, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ ma tʋɔŋ nʋʋ sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bɩɩnʋ koo a kɛŋ tʋɔbɩɩna-la sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ Wɩa laa dii, dɩ ŋɩɩ leŋ dɩ ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa sɩ weye. 13Ama má pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala a lɩɩ jɩnɩŋ a kaa mʋmʋ, dɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛ ma kʋŋkala a leŋ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩɩ-duo wɩaa Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 14Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii bumbuŋ, dɩ la nɛ kɛmba ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ dɩdɛrɩŋ, la dɩ Kirisito kala jaŋ ŋaa kʋbala. 15Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ ŋ-la:
“Jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ kɔ dɩ ma nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro,
má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ a nagɛ ma naabalɩmaba fa sɩ kɛŋ sɩɩ-duoŋ
a lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ.”
16Kʋbɛɛba nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro aŋ lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ? Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ kaa lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. 17Kʋbɛɛba nyuŋ nɛ Wɩa fa na baanɩŋ jɩsɩŋ mahɩŋ balɩa ŋɩɩ? Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ Wɩa leŋ ba sʋʋ tintee-hɩlɩŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ. 18Kʋbɛɛba lɛ nɛ Wɩa fa ŋmɩɛsa hɛ arɩ ba bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la ʋ sɩ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba hɔnɔ wiesii ŋɩɩ? Ba nɛ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ka to. 19La na arɩ ba sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ wuo jʋʋ tintee-la Wɩa fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩba.

english_text:
1The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out. 2We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good. 3 Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say,
“God became angry
and told the people,
‘You will never enter
my place of rest!’ ”
God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation. 4 In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested. 5 We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!” 6This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter. 7 Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said,
“If you hear his voice today,
don't be stubborn!”
8 If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest. 9But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come. 10 On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
11We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did. 12God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts. 13 Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth.
Jesus Is the Great High Priest
14We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him. 15Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin! 16So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_text:
1Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla arɩ la jaŋ wuo kɔ ʋ teeŋ a na wiese, ŋɩɩ ha chɩna nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ dɩ wiese deeŋ sɩ́ ma kʋŋkala lɛ bal. 2Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la ba sɩ bʋla pɩla, ba fa bʋla pɩ la naabalɩmaba ma nɛ. Ama ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ laa dii. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ fa bɩ ba wiese-la pa. 3La nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa wɩalɩŋ dii jaŋ wuo mʋ Wɩa teeŋ a na wiese-la arɩ Wɩa sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ sɩ,
“Mɩ fa na baanɩŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmɩɛsɛ arɩ
ba bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ tintee-la mɩ fa sɩɩ chɛ mɩ joŋo pɩba dɩ ba hɔnɔ wiesi.”
Ama la jɩma arɩ bumbuŋ-la Wɩa sɩ ŋaa dʋnɩa, ʋ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa kala dɛrɛ nɛ. 4Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ chɛ-pɛmɩŋ chɛɛŋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ba sɩ,
“Wɩa sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ʋ wiese nɛ chɛ-pɛmɩŋ chɛɛŋ.”
5Lee-la tɩtɩa Wɩa bɩra bʋla,
“Ba bɩ jaŋ na wiese mɩ teeŋ.”
6Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ha jaŋ na wiese-la. Ama nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la bɩ wiese-la na, bɛɛ wɩaa ba bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ nɩa laa dii. 7Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa bɩra lɩɩsɛ tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa jɩnɩŋ. Ʋ to la naabalɩma Devit lɛ nɛ a bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ. Ʋ sɩ,
“Jɩnɩŋ, dɩ ma nɛ nɩɩ Wɩa yikoro, má sɩ́ sɩɩ-duoŋ kɛŋ.”
8Bʋa-la lɛ ba naabalɩma Josua fa sɩ ŋaa Iziral tɩŋŋaa sɩpaalaara, ʋ bɩ ba wiese pa. Dɩ ʋ nɛ fa pɩba wiese, Wɩa fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bʋl tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ wɩaa. 9Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, tapʋlɩɩ dɔŋ nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ, Wɩa nɩaa sɩ jaŋ wiesi. 10Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ na wiese Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ tɩɩna leŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ aŋ wiesi, arɩ Wɩa ma sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ aŋ wiesi ŋɩɩ.
11Má saa leŋ dɩ la hɛ doluŋ a na wiese-la Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ joŋo pɩla. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ to, ba bɩ wiese-la na. Dɩ la ma nɛ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ka to, la ma bɩ jaŋ na wiese-la. 12Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa weye a kɛŋ niiŋ a kɩɩ tokobiiŋ niiriŋ balɩa kala sɩɩ dii nyagaga. Ʋ yie wuo tɔɔ jʋʋ nuhuobiine, a kɛŋ ʋ dɩma arɩ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ kaa pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ. Ʋ yie wuo jɩŋ nuhuobiine tʋɔŋ arɩ ʋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa kala. 13Kʋŋkala tuo sɩ jaŋ wuo kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa faa Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa na kʋŋkala nɛ, ʋ teeŋ ba kala hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la dagɛ la wʋŋaalaa kala a pʋ.
Yesu nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ
14Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie a bɩra ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa nɩaa nyuŋ kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ sɩ tɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩl wɩa-nyuŋ a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii woruŋ. 15Yesu bɩ nagɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ sɩ bɩ nɩaa nenige ka fá ŋɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ wuo fá la nenige a jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ walɩmɛla, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa walɩmɛ ʋ ma nɛ. Sɩtaanɩ magɩsʋ nɛ arɩ ʋ sɩ magɩsɛla ŋɩɩ, ama ʋ bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa. 16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má leŋ dɩ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a wuo yi lee-la Wɩa sɩ hɔnɔ, dɩ ʋ wuo fá la nenige. Dɩ la nɛ jʋʋ wɩɩkala, ʋ jaŋ fá la nenige a pɛ la lɛ.

english_text:
1Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins. 2A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people. 3 This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others. 4 But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
5 This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him,
“You are my Son, because today
I have become your Father!”
6 In another place, God says,
“You are a priest forever
just like Melchizedek.”
7 God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers. 8Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God. 9Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him. 10This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek.
Warning against Turning Away
11Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand. 12 By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food. 13People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right. 14Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_text:
1Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-na kala, ba yie lɩɩsʋ nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ hɛ nuhuobiine arɩ Wɩa pɛgɛ a laa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa, aŋ pɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ tɩta. 2Ʋ sɩaa yie wuo fɩɛlɛ nɩaa nyuŋ nɛ woruŋ, nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ aŋ bɩ jɩŋ, arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ yeŋŋe Wɩa wombii-la lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ma tɩtɩa yie ŋaa wɩaa chichei nɛ. 3Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ʋ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩ Wɩa a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta, a bɩra kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pɩ Wɩa a tɩŋ nɩkaana-la ma kala wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa pɩɩsɛ ba ma disiniŋ ta. 4Nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ wuo lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩŋ deeŋ. Wɩa nɛ yie lɩɩsɛ tɩɩna, arɩ ʋ fa sɩ lɩɩsɛ Arɔŋ ŋɩɩ. 5Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Kirisito ma bɩ ʋ tɩtɩa kaa yʋgɛ dɩ ʋ tɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ sɩɩ tɩŋ. Ama wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla pʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ,
“Ŋ ŋaa mɩ Bii nɛ,
jɩnɩŋ mɩ nɛ lʋlʋŋ.”
6Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ ma ʋ bʋla,
“Ŋ nagɛ nɩɩ-la fa sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ
Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk nɛ.
Ŋ jaŋ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.”
7Yesu fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ, ʋ chʋɔlɛ Wɩa a faasa yel sɩlɩɩrɩŋ a sʋl Wɩa, ʋ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ wuo laa ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ ta dɩ ʋ sɩ́ sʋʋ. Yesu kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa muuri nɛ a ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa laa ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. 8Yesu fa ŋaa Wɩa Bii ma nɛ, ama ʋ gʋnnɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ to Wɩa niiŋ a tɩŋ hɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ na. 9Ʋ sɩ to Wɩa niiŋ kala dɛrɛ, ʋ kʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ sɩpaalaara, a laaba ta a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. 10Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ, a tɩma pɩ Wɩa arɩ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa sɩ tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa ŋɩɩ.
Má waa Wɩa wɩaa lɛ, aŋ sɩ́ harɩŋ joŋo yɩaba
11La kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ dɩ la bʋl a tɩgɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ lɛ. Ama la bɩ jɩŋ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩɩ-la dɩ ma jɩŋ ʋ bʋbʋɔŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma dɩgɩlaa yuŋŋie. 12Ma sɩ nɩɩ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ʋ diene nɛ. Ʋ fa maga dɩ ma nɛ dɩdagɛ nɩaa, ama ma haa chɛ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ dɩdagɛma Wɩa niiŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ. Ʋ naga maa chɛ yɩlɩŋ nɛ, ma ha bɩ kʋduoruŋ wuo didii. 13Nɩɩ-la sɩɩ wasɛ yɩlɩŋ ŋaa bii-mulo nɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋzɔmʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔmʋŋ bʋa jɩŋ. 14Nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ wuo kʋduoruŋ didii. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ waa dɛrɛ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ nagɛ nɩhɩasɩŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yie wuo jɩŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ arɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ pɛgɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba vɛnɛɛ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ.

english_text:
1We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God. 2And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment. 3Let's grow up, if God is willing.
4-6But what about people who turn away after they have already seen the light and have received the gift from heaven and have shared in the Holy Spirit? What about those who turn away after they have received the good message of God and the powers of the future world? There is no way to bring them back. What they are doing is the same as nailing the Son of God to a cross and insulting him in public!
7A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field. 8 But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
9My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved. 10God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people. 11We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is. 12Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them.
God's Promise Is Sure
13No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham, 14 “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!” 15Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised. 16When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves. 17So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow. 18God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed.
We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us. 19 This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place. 20 Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_text:
1Ŋɩɩ wɩaa la sɩ wuo jɩŋ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla pɩla a tɩgɛ Kirisito lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ la mʋ sɩpaaŋ nɛ a wuo waa dɛrɛ Kirisito wɩaa lɛ. Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la bɩra suomo bʋbʋl wɩalɩŋ la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a bɩrɩma lɩɩ la wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ la fa sɩɩ ŋaa. La bɩra bɩ chɛ dɩ la suomo bʋl ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ to a laa Wɩa wɩaa dii. 2La bɩra bɩ chɛ la bʋl ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ fola Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ nɩsaa daŋ la lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ nɩaa sɩ jaŋ sʋʋ aŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ, arɩ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ, a bɩra joŋ mɩɩsɩŋ pɩ dɔnsʋŋ ma a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. 3Dɩ Wɩa nɛ sɛyɛ, la jaŋ kieli bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ aŋ mʋ sɩpaaŋ. 4Dɩ Wɩa nɛ wuo suri nɩaa sɩaa dɩ ba wuo jɩŋ ʋ wɩaa, a wuo laa Wɩa zile kɩalɩŋ ma, a bɩra kɛŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma, 5a wuo na ŋɩɩ Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa sɩ zɔmɔ, a bɩra wuo na Wɩa kuorii-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ doluŋ sɩ magɛ ŋɩɩ, 6dɩ ba nɛ jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala aŋ bɩra joŋ harɩŋ yɩa Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la, ɛɛ nɛ ba jaŋ bɩra ŋaa a bɩrɩma lɩɩ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ, aŋ kɔ Wɩa teeŋ? Ʋ saa naga arɩ ba bɩra wasa kpaasɛ Wɩa Bie mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ nɛ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ba bɩra leŋe hɩɩsɩŋ diiu nɛ nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 7Dɩ duonuŋ nɛ nɩa, dɩ tinteeŋ nyʋa lɩɩŋ vɔgɛ, tintee-la kɩaa yie wasɛ nɛ a pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ pɛrɛ lee-la. Wɩa nɛ pɛ tintee-la lɛ. 8Ama dɩ yaŋ arɩ sɔsʋŋ dʋndʋŋa nɩɩ nyʋ lee-la, ŋɩɩ-na tintee-la bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ. Wɩa jaŋ wuo ŋmɩɛsa hɛ tintee-la lɛ. Ba jaŋ chaanɛ nyiniŋ hɛ dɩ ʋ dii buru.
9Laa bʋl wɩaa deemba kala, ama ma-na, la nandɔŋ-chooloo, la kɛŋ yɩɛlaa ma lɛ. La jɩma ma jaŋ na kʋzɔmɔ-la kala sɩ hɛ laatanɩŋ wombiiŋ lɛ. 10Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ bɩ jaŋ yʋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩma pʋ arɩ chono-la ma sɩ daga pʋ a pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ aŋ ha pɩpɛ ba lɛ. 11La saa cho dɩ ma kʋŋkala fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ aa yɩɛlɛ kɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jaŋ na, a jɩŋ woruŋ arɩ ma sɛnɛ jaŋ naba, a kɛŋ ŋɩɩ naaŋ lɛ a mʋ dɛrɛ. 12La bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kɛŋ yarɩwɩɩŋ. Laa chɛ dɩ ma to nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii faafaa naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ. Nɩaa deemba chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ nɛ a nyalɩma ŋɩɩ halɩɩ, a wuo na kɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩba arɩ ba jaŋ na.
Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla sɛnɛ ŋaa nɛ
13Faafaa-la Wɩa hɛ niiŋ a pɩ Abɩraham nɛ. Kʋŋkala fa tuo a yʋga kɩɩ ʋ-na Wɩa dɩ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ ŋmɩɛsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa. 14Ʋ ŋmɩɛsa a bʋl, “Wʋtɩtɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ pɛ ŋ lɛ a leŋ dɩ ŋ doho nɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ.” 15Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham kɛŋ kenyiri a gbɛrɛ, a sɛnɛ na wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pʋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ na. 16Dɩ nuhuobiinee nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba dagɛ arɩ wɩɩ-la ba sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, ba yie ŋmɩɛsɛ kʋŋ sɩ kɩɩba nɛ. Dɩ ba nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ kaalɛrɛ kala yie dɛrɛ nɛ. 17Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩ ʋ nɩaa arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kɩaa pɩba, ʋ fa sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba chaasa jɩŋ arɩ ʋ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ ʋ niiŋ bɩrɩmɛ, ʋ ŋmɩɛsa daŋ nɛ. 18Wɩa saa ŋaa wɩaa balɩa nɛ. Ʋ sɩ wuo bʋl wɩɩ-la aŋ pɛ ŋmɩɛsɛ ŋɩɩ, wɩaa deemba balɩamɩŋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ba bɩrɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bɩ wɩaa nyɩɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la nɩalɩŋ sɩ fá mʋ Wɩa teeŋ dɩ ʋ laala ta nyuŋ nyaasɛ nɛ dɩ la kɛŋ yɩɛlaa woruŋ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩla lɛ. 19La sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo nyɩrɛ la bɔyɛ a chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii lɛ woruŋ, a wuo jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la patɩɩsaŋ-balɩŋ fa sɩ kɛrɛ. 20Yesu nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ jʋʋ dɩ-zɔŋ-la a tɩŋ la wɩaa, dɩ la ma wuo to ʋ harɩŋ a jʋʋ. Yesu nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa kʋhɩaŋ a kaa mʋ wuu, arɩ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa sɩ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa kʋhɩaŋ ŋɩɩ.

english_text:
The Priestly Family of Melchizedek
1 Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings. 2Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had.
The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.” 3We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
4Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies. 5 The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests. 6Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise. 7Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
8Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive. 9Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth. 10This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
11Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron. 12And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
13The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar. 14Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
15All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest. 16That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end. 17 The Scriptures say about him,
“You are a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
18In this way a weak and useless command was put aside, 19because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
20-21 God himself made a promise when this priest was appointed. But he did not make a promise like this when the other priests were appointed. The promise he made is,
“I, the Lord, promise that you
will be a priest forever!
And I will never
change my mind!”
22This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God. 23There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died. 24But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever! 25He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
26Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven, 27 and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself. 28The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_text:
Ba bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara lɛ
1Baal-la ba sɩ yɩrʋ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk, ʋ fa ŋaa taŋ kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Salɛm kuoru nɛ aŋ fa pɛ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ. Bʋa kʋbala Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk cheŋ Abɩraham dɩ ʋ mʋ yuo laalɩŋ dii tinteeŋ dɔnsʋŋ kuoroo aŋ kʋkɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ Abɩraham. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Abɩraham kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii laal-la lɛ a kaa kpaa leree fii, a joŋ kʋbala pʋ. Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk yɩrɩ-la bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ‘kuoru-la sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla Wɩa sɩpaaŋ’. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Salɛm kuoro ma. Salɛm kuoro bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ, ‘kuoru-la sɩ kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa hɔŋ sɔm’. 3Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa bɩ nyɩmma kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ naaŋ ma kɛnɛ. Nʋʋkala fa bɩ ʋ doho jɩŋ, a bɩ bʋa-la ba sɩ lʋlʋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ sʋba ma jɩŋ. Ama ʋ fa nagɛ Wɩa Bie nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
4Ma jaŋ na dɩ ʋ fa ŋaa nɩbal nɛ. La naabalɩma Abɩraham fa sɩ lɩɩ laalɩŋ kɔ, ʋ paala kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ yuo dii laal-la lɛ a kaa kpaa leree fii, a joŋ kʋbala pʋ. 5Baal kʋbala nɛ fa hɛ nɩmɛ, ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ Levi, ʋ doho nɩaa nɛ fa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa. Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto tʋɔŋ, ba bʋla arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ ba kɩaa kpaa leree fii fii, a joŋ kʋbala pɩ ba naambiiriŋ Levi doho nɩaa. La jɩma arɩ Levi doho nɩaa arɩ Iziral tɩmma-la dɔnsʋŋ kala ŋaa Abɩraham doho nɩaa nɛ, ka Wɩa ha bʋl ŋɩɩ. 6Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk fa bɩ Levi doho nʋʋ ŋaa aŋ pɛ laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la Abɩraham teeŋ, aŋ sʋl Wɩa pʋ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiŋ pa. 7Wɩɩŋ deeŋ tuo wʋkaalɛrɛ, nɩbalɩŋ nɛ yie sʋl Wɩa pɩ nɩ-bie. 8Levi nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala deeŋ, ba-naa sʋʋ nɛ. Ama Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk-na sɩ laa kɩaa Abɩraham teeŋ, ʋ-na bɩ sʋʋ. Arɩ jɩnɩŋ ʋ ha weye nɛ. Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 9-10Bʋa-la lɛ Levi naabalɩma Abɩraham sɩ cheŋ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk a kɛŋ kɩaa kpaa leriŋ fii a joŋ kʋbala pʋ dɩ ba ha bɩ Levi lʋla. Lɛɛlɛ ʋ yie lɩlaa kpaalɩŋ fii tʋɔŋ kʋbala-la nɛ nɩaa teeŋ. Ama Abɩraham fa sɩ joŋ kɩaa pɩ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo bʋl arɩ Levi ma fa joŋ kɩaa pʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa Abɩraham doho nʋʋ nɛ.
11Wɩa sɩ joŋ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ a pɩ Mosis dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ nɛ Levi doho nɩaa to a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa sɩɩ tɩŋ. Dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la nɛ fa pɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa lɛ dɩ ba chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk kɔ aa tɩŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa tɩntɩŋŋaa. Ama Wɩa sɩ nʋʋ dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, ʋ-na bɩ jaŋ lɩɩ Arɔŋ doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ. 12Dɩ nʋʋ sɩ bɩ Levi doho nʋʋ ŋaa nɛ kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ bile dɩ nɩaa tuto ma kaa bɩrɩmɛ nɛ. 13La Tɩɩna Kirisito wɩaa nɛ baa bʋl ŋɩɩ. Ʋ ma lɩɩ doho dɔŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala ha bɩ doho deeŋ tʋɔŋ lɩa a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara. 14Nʋʋkala jɩma arɩ Yesu lɩɩ Juda doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ama bʋa-la lɛ Mosis fa sɩ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa lɛ, ʋ bɩ bʋla arɩ ba lɩɩsɛ nʋʋ sɩ lɩɩ Juda doho nɩaa tʋɔŋ.
Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara
15Nʋʋ dɔŋ sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara sɩ folo kɔ ŋ-la a nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk, wɩaa deemba kala chaasa pʋllɛ nɛ. 16Ʋ tɩɩna sɩ kʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara ŋɩɩ, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ʋ doho nɩaa wɩɩ nɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ naga arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ daga ba lɩɩsʋ. Ama ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ doluŋ lɛ nɛ ba lɩɩsʋ. Ʋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ. 17Wɩa bʋla pʋ, “Ŋ nagɛ Mɛlɩkɩzɛdɛk nɛ. Ŋ jaŋ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ.” 18Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ba joŋ wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto ta nɛ. Ba bɩra bɩ bʋbʋɔ kɛnɛ, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo pɛ nʋʋ lɛ. 19Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nʋʋkala wuo chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ. Wʋfalaa nɛ lɛɛlɛ Wɩa bil dɩ la tuto, wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ la mʋ kpagʋ.
20Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a daŋ wʋfalaa deemba lɛ nɛ. Ama dɩ ba nɛ fa lɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, Wɩa bɩ ŋmɩɛsaa daŋ. 21Ama La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛ Yesu, ʋ ŋmɩɛsa nɛ a bʋl, “Mɩ bɩ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ bɩrɩmɛ. Ʋ bɩra bʋla, ‘Ŋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara a kaa mʋ wuu.’ ” 22Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsɛ Yesu aŋ ŋmɩɛsa daŋ, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ ʋ nɛ kpɩa nii-la ʋ fa sɩ laa bil ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ.
23Bumbuŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa fa yʋga nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ba faa sʋʋ nɛ. Ba sɩɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ba bɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la wuo tɩŋ deeŋ deeŋ. 24Ama Kirisito-na jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara a kaa mʋ wuu, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ sʋʋ. 25Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, ʋ jaŋ wuo laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ to ʋ lɛ a kɔ Wɩa teeŋ ta. Ʋ jaŋ wuo laaba ta, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ bʋa na-kala a sʋl Wɩa pɩpɩba.
26Yesu sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaara kʋhɩaŋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ a pɩla. Yesu bɩ disiŋ kɛnɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋcheeli kɛnɛ, ʋ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɔrɛ nɛ wʋbɔŋ ŋaaraa lɛ. Wɩa kɛnʋ ŋaa nɩbal. Ʋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ ŋɩɩ, ʋ yʋga kɩɩ kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ. 27Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ fa yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala nɛ. Ʋ fa maga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a tɩŋ ba tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ, aŋ bɩra kpʋ dɔnsʋŋ ma a tɩŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Yesu-na bɩ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ bɩ pʋsʋŋ kpʋa a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ bala nɛ a pɩ Wɩa a tɩŋ nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa. Ʋ tɩtɩa mɩɩsɩŋ nɛ ʋ kaa ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la. 28Ba yie to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ nɛ a lɩɩsɛ nɩaa dɩ ba ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ lɩɩsa fa kɛŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ. Ama wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie Yesu lɛ to harɩŋ nɛ a kɔ. Wɩa ŋmɩɛsa nɛ aŋ-na lɩɩsɛ Yesu dɩ ʋ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.

english_text:
A Better Promise
1 What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven. 2He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
3Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer. 4If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices. 5 But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!” 6Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
7If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one. 8 But the Lord found fault with it and said,
“I tell you the time will come,
when I will make
a new agreement
with the people of Israel
and the people of Judah.
9It won't be like the agreement
that I made
with their ancestors,
when I took them by the hand
and led them out of Egypt.
They broke their agreement
with me,
and I stopped caring
about them!
10“But now I tell the people
of Israel
this is my new agreement:
‘The time will come
when I, the Lord,
will write my laws
on their minds and hearts.
I will be their God,
and they will be
my people.
11Not one of them
will have to teach another
to know me, their Lord.’
“All of them will know me,
no matter who they are.
12I will treat them with kindness,
even though they are wicked.
I will forget their sins.”
13When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_text:
Yesu nɛ tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa la nyuŋ
1Wɩɩ-la kala la sɩɩ bʋl wʋnyuŋ nɛ ŋ-la. La kɛŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa nɩaa nyuŋ a tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa kʋhɩaŋ nɛ. Ʋ nɛ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ a hɔŋ Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ kuoru kpasa nadiiŋ, nɩduoŋ dɩhɔnʋŋ. 2Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ lɛ nɛ ʋ hɛ a tɩtɩŋ. Wɩa dɩa tɩtɩa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Lee-la nuhuobiine dee bɩ saa. La Tɩɩna Wɩa nɛ saa. 3Dɩ ba nɛ lɩɩsɛ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ-na kala, ba yie lɩɩsʋ dɩ ʋ laa kɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ, aŋ pɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ ma pʋpʋ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ maga dɩ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ deeŋ ma joŋ kʋŋ nɛ a pɩ Wɩa. 4Dɩ ʋ nɛ saa fa hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, ʋ fa bɩ jaŋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, ba nɛ yie to wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto lɛ a tɩtɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa. 5Nɩaa deemba sɩ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ tɩŋ ba tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ Wɩa dɩa tʋɔŋ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, baa chesi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ wɩaa nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la tɩtɩa deeŋ. Mosis fa sɩ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ dɩ ʋ hɛ lɛbɩŋ, Wɩa fa bʋl wɩaa pʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Hɛ lɛbɩ-la dɩ ʋ nagɛ kʋ-la mɩ sɩ dagɩŋ peel-la nyuŋ.” 6Tɩntɩmɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩɩ tɩŋ nɛ yʋga kɩɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la bumbuŋ nɩaa sɩ tɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa to ʋ lɛ nɛ a bil nii-falɩŋ ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ. Nii-falɩɩ-la nɛ kpɩa bumbuŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ pɩ ʋ nɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ta da. 7Dɩ bumbuŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ nɛ fa pɛ ʋ nɩaa lɛ dɩ ba ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, Wɩa fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bil nii dɔŋ ʋ nɩaa teeŋ.
8Ʋ na dɩ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ bɩ ʋ nɩaa lɛ pɛ dɩ ba wuo ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl,
“Bʋa dɔŋ jaŋ kɔ, dɩ mɩ bil nii-falɩŋ mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa arɩ Juda doho nɩaa pɛgɛ.
9Ʋ bɩ jaŋ nagɛ nii-la mɩ fa sɩ bile mɩ dɩ ba naabalɩmaba pɛgɛ,
bʋa-la lɛ mɩ sɩ kɛmba kaa kʋʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ.
Ba fa bɩ mɩ nii-la lɛ to,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ joŋ harɩŋ yɩaba.”
10La Tɩɩna bɩra sɩ,
“Bʋa-la lɛ nii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bil mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ,
aŋ ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma lɛ.
Mɩ jaŋ ŋaa ba Wɩa,
dɩ ba ma ŋaa mɩ nɩaa.
11Nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ jaŋ dagɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna
koo ʋ naambii ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a jɩmmɛ,
bɛɛ wɩaa ba kala jaŋ jɩmmɛ,
a chɩŋ nɩbiisiŋ lɛ a kaa jɩl nɩbalaa.
12Mɩ jaŋ joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛba.
Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.”
13Wɩa sɩ bʋl nii-falɩɩ-la wɩaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ sɩ dɩ bumbuŋ kʋ-la ŋaa kʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ. Kʋ-la kala saa sɩ diene ŋaa kʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ, ʋ jaŋ lɛl.

english_text:
The Tent in Heaven
1The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth. 2 The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
3 Behind the curtain was the most holy place. 4 The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them. 5 On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy.
Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things. 6 But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties. 7 However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
8All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship. 9This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices. 10These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
11 Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world. 12Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
13 According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf. 14But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
15Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings! 16In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use. 17In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
18Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect. 19 Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water. 20He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.” 21 Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship. 22 The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered.
Christ's Great Sacrifice
23These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better. 24This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
25Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal. 26If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
27We die only once, and then we are judged. 28 So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_text:
Yesu nɛ laa la nyuŋ tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ
1Bumbuŋ-la nii-la Wɩa fa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ, fa kɛŋ wombiee nɛ ba to a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa, a kɛŋ lɛbɩŋ ma ba sɩɩ chʋɔlʋ nɩmɛ. 2Lɛbɩ-la fa kɛŋ leree balɩa nɛ, tɛgɛɛ arɩ sɩpaaŋ. Tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ nɛ chaaŋ daaŋ fa chɩŋ. Teebʋl ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ, boroboro-la ba sɩ yie kaa mʋ bil Wɩa sɩpaaŋ ma fa daŋ nyuŋ. Lee-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa lee-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, 3a kiele jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, ba fa kɛŋ patɩɩsaŋ nɛ a kaa kɛrɛ. Lee-la yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. 4Sɛlɩmɛ koruŋ nɛ fa hɛ lee-la. Nɩmɛ nɛ ba yie nyɩgɛ tɩɩ-keliŋ sʋɔra sɩ sɩma a pɩpɩ Wɩa. Daga kʋbala ma nɛ fa chɩŋ nɩmɛ, sɛlɩmɛ tɔ ʋ kala. Sɛlɩmɛ pupoiŋ nɛ fa hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ, ba joŋ kʋdiile-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ kʋ tuu baa yɩrɛ ‘mana’ hɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. Arɔŋ daa-la sɩ tɔsɔ ma fa hɛ daga-la tʋɔŋ nɛ. Tabɩɩ-taalɩa-la lɛ Wɩa fa sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ʋ niiŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ, ba ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. 5Daga-la nyuŋ, ba mɛ kɩaa sɩ nagɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa a kɛŋ kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ aa tʋl, a bil ba ma chɩŋ. Ba kɛŋ ba kɩŋkɛnsɩŋ kaa jɛrɛ tɔ daga-la nii-tɔlɔ, lee-la Wɩa sɩɩ fá nɩaa nenige, a joŋ ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɩchɛba. Lɛɛlɛ la bɩ jaŋ wuo bʋl wɩaa yʋgɛ a tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ.
6Ba sɩ bil kɩalɩŋ kala dɛrɛ, Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa, yie jʋʋ tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la a tɩtɩŋ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la sɩ maga dɩ baa tɩŋ. 7Ama Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ yie jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ. Ʋ ma saa yie jʋʋ lee-la bala nɛ jɩna kala. Ʋ yie kɛŋ pʋna chalɩŋ nɛ a kaa jʋʋ pɩ Wɩa, a tɩŋ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa arɩ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la a chei Wɩa aŋ bɩ jɩŋ. 8Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ to wɩaa deemba kala lɛ aa dagɛ arɩ wombii-la ba sɩ to jʋjʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ ha bɩ suro, bɛɛ wɩaa tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la ha hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. 9Tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la nagɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ la sɩ hɛ nɛ. Tɛgɛɛ lɛbɩ-la lɛ nɛ ba yie joŋ kɩaa pɩpɩ Wɩa aŋ pɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ pʋpʋ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ yie ŋaa lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ, bɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ kɔ lɛ wuo pɛ, dɩ ba tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi. 10Wɩaa deemba ka dagɛ kʋdiilee arɩ kʋnyʋalaa arɩ Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ sɔmʋŋ dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ, a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ kɛŋ wʋfalaa kɔ.
11Ama Kirisito kɔ nɛ lɛɛlɛ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩaŋ. Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ kaa kɔ nɛ zɔmɔ a kɩɩ bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ. Ʋ sɩ kɔ ŋɩɩ, ʋ jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ nɛ, ʋ nɛ zɔmɔ kɩɩ bumbuŋ kʋ-la. Nuhuobiine dee bɩ saa. Ʋ bɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kʋŋ ŋaa. 12Kirisito jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ bala dʋndʋŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ bʋʋna koo nɛ-pasɩŋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ nɩmɛ. Ama ʋ kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa chalɩŋ nɛ kaa jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ a joŋ chal-la a tiŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɩmɩŋ, a laala ta a kaa mʋ wuu. 13Bumbuŋ ba fa yie joŋ bʋʋnaa koo nɛ-belliŋ chalɩŋ nɛ a pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa disiniŋ, ba yie kpʋ nɛ-paha a nyɩgɛ a paa ʋ tʋɔrʋŋ mɩsɛ tɩɩna a pɩɩsɛ ʋ disiniŋ ta. 14Dɩ wɩaa deemba nɛ wuo pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta, ŋɩɩ-na Kirisito chalɩŋ ma jaŋ wuo paala pɩɩsɛ nɩaa disiniŋ ta a kɩɩ bʋʋnaa koo nɛsɩŋ chalɩŋ. Kirisito fa bɩ disiŋ kala kɛnɛ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ lɛ, ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ Wɩa, a sʋʋ a tɩŋ la wɩaa. Ʋ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ ma tʋɔbɩɩnaa chesi dɩ má sɩ́ wʋbɔŋ bɩɩnʋ, ka dɩ ma wuo tɩma pɩpɩ Wɩa sɩ weye.
15Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito ŋaa nɩɩ-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ to bil nii-falɩɩ-la ʋ dɩ nuhuobiinee pɛgɛ. Wɩa ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ yɩra wuo na kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba ʋ jaŋ lɛ nɛ. Lɛɛlɛ Kirisito sʋba nɛ dɩ ʋ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bʋa-la lɛ ba fa sɩɩ to bumbuŋ nii-la Wɩa sɩ bile ʋ dɩ ʋ nɩaa pɛgɛ. 16Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba, nʋʋ dɔŋ nɛ jaŋ tɩɩ ʋ kɩaa, dɩ tɩɩna nɛ ha bɩ sʋba, nɩɩ-la bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ, see dɩ kɩalɩŋ tɩɩna sʋba. 17Dɩ kɩaa tɩɩna nɛ weye, nɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ tɩɩ ʋ kɩaa bɩ jaŋ wuo tɩɩ kɩalɩŋ, see dɩ ʋ sʋba. 18Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Wɩa kɛŋ chalɩŋ bil bumbuŋ nii-la. 19Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, dɩ ʋ nɛ kʋ dagɛba wɩalɩŋ a kʋ dɛrɛ-na kala, ʋ yie kpʋ nɛ-pasɩŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa nɛ, a laa chalɩŋ a ŋaa lɩɩŋ guoli. Ʋ yie chɛ pie-pʋŋ-fɩɛsɩŋ arɩ kaku-dɩgɩlɩŋ a vɔɔ a hɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a kaa yuu chal-la, a mɩsɛ hɛ teŋ-la lɛ ʋ sɩ ŋmʋnsa, aŋ pɛ ŋaa mɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ ma. 20Dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa chal-la mɩmɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ, ŋ-la nɛ ʋ yie bʋl: “Chal-la Wɩa sɩ kaa bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ ma pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la.” 21Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ʋ yie ŋaa chal-la mɩsɛ lɛbɩ-la arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala ba sɩ kaa tɩtɩŋ Wɩa tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ. 22Wʋtɩtɩɩ, wɩalɩŋ Mosis sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto tʋɔŋ, chalɩŋ nɛ ba yie kaa pɩɩsɛ kɩaa jesiŋ kala disiniŋ ta. Dɩ ba nɛ bɩ kʋŋ chalɩŋ lɩɩsa, Wɩa bɩ jaŋ wuo joŋ nʋʋkala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛʋ.
Yesu laa nɩaa nyuŋ sʋʋ bala nɛ dɩ ʋ laa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta
23Kɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ lɛbɩ-la tʋɔŋ nagɛ kɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ. Ʋ maga dɩ ba kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ pɩɩsɛ kɩaa deemba disiniŋ ta. Ama kɩalɩŋ tɩtɩa sɩ hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba chɛ kʋ-la sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ pʋsʋ-la chalɩŋ nɛ a kaa pɩɩsɛ ba disiniŋ ta. 24Ʋ bɩ naga Kirisito jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la nuhuobiinee sɩ ŋaa nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ ŋaa lɛbɩ-la, ka chesi Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la nɛ. Ama Kirisito jʋʋ Wɩa-jaŋ tɩtɩa nɛ, dɩ ʋ chɩŋ la nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 25Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaaraa kʋhɩasɩŋ fa yie jʋʋ lɛbɩ-la sɩpaaŋ, lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ jɩna jɩna nɛ, a pɛ kɛŋ pʋsʋŋ chalɩŋ kaa jʋʋ a pɩ Wɩa. Ama Kirisito-na sɩ jʋʋ lee-la, ʋ bɩ naga arɩ ʋ jaŋ vɛnɛɛ jʋʋ nɩmɛ jɩna-na kala a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩpɩ Wɩa. 26Dɩ ʋ nɛ faa ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ fa jaŋ na hɛɛŋ jɩna na-kala a lɩɩ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Ama lɛɛlɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ kɔ bala dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa a sʋʋ, a laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. 27Bala nɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ sʋʋ. Ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ dii ʋ tɩɩna sarɩya. 28Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ ba kpʋ Kirisito balá dɩ ʋ laa nɩ-daŋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Dɩ ʋ nɛ mɩɩra kɔ, ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta, ama ʋ jaŋ laa nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ ba tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a gbɛrʋ ta.

english_text:
1The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year. 2If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices. 3-4But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.
5 When Christ came into the world, he said to God,
“Sacrifices and offerings
are not what you want,
but you have given me
my body.
6No, you are not pleased
with animal sacrifices
and offerings for sin.”
7Then Christ said,
“And so, my God,
I have come to do
what you want,
as the Scriptures say.”
8The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them? 9Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.” 10So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
11 The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins. 12 But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side, 13and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power. 14By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
15The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
16 “When the time comes,
I will make an agreement
with them.
I will write my laws
on their minds and hearts.
17 Then I will forget
about their sins
and no longer remember
their evil deeds.”
18When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices.
Encouragement and Warning
19My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place 20by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
21We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house. 22 So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water. 23We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us. 24We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things. 25Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
26No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth. 27 They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire. 28 If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death. 29 But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy. 30 We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people. 31It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
32Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light. 33Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others. 34You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
35Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards. 36Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised. 37 As the Scriptures say,
“God is coming soon!
It won't be very long.
38The people God accepts
will live because
of their faith.
But he isn't pleased
with anyone
who turns back.”
39We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_text:
1Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil nagɛ wʋzɔmɔ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ nɛ, ama wʋzɔmɔ-la tɩtɩa dee ŋɩɩ. Ba nagɛ wʋzɔmɔ-la daaliimiŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kaa kʋ kpʋ pɩpɩ Wɩa jɩna-na kala, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo leŋ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kɛŋ pʋsʋ-la kaa kɔ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 2Dɩ pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kaa mʋ kpʋ pɩpɩ Wɩa nɛ fa wuo leŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ kaa kɔ chaasa ŋaa nɩzɔmɔ sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, ŋɩɩ-na ba fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ kpʋkpʋ pʋsʋŋ deemba jɩna-na kala. Dɩ ba nɛ fa wuo pɩɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ tɩta, ŋɩɩ-na ba fa bɩra bɩ jaŋ bɩbɩɩnɛ dɩ ba kɛŋ wʋbɔŋ kala. 3Ama ba sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋ-la pɩpɩ Wɩa jɩna-na kala, ba yie liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, 4bɛɛ wɩaa nɛsɩŋ arɩ bʋʋnaa chalɩŋ bɩ jaŋ wuo laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta.
5Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ Kirisito bʋl wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa bʋa-la lɛ ʋ sɩ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Ʋ sɩ,
“Ŋ-na bɩ pʋsʋ-la ba sɩ yie kpʋ ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩalɩŋ nɛ cho,
ama ŋ lɩɩsɛmɛ nɛ dɩ mɩ joŋ mɩ tɩtɩa kala a pɩŋ.
6Ŋ bɩ kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa ma nɩɩ chɛ.
7Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ bʋl, ‘Mɩ Tɩɩna Wɩa, mɩ kɔ nɛ
dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ.
Mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil ŋ teniŋ tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ.’ ”
8Wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto nɛ daga dɩ ba kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a joŋ kɩaa ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ, a ŋɩŋaa kʋnyɩgaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ joŋo chɛnɩŋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ. Ama Kirisito bʋla dɩ Wɩa bɩ ŋɩɩ cho. Ʋ tʋɔŋ ma bɩ ba nyuŋ tɔrɔ. 9Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ bɩra bʋl, “Mɩ kɔ nɛ dɩ mɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ŋ tʋɔŋ.” Ʋ sɩ bʋl ŋɩɩ, ʋ vɩa bumbuŋ wɩalɩŋ ta nɛ, aŋ mɩɩra suomo bil wʋfalɩa. 10Kirisito sɩ ŋaa Wɩa tʋɔtɔrʋ wɩɩ-la a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa kala a pʋ a tɩŋ la wɩaa, ŋɩɩ nɛ leŋe la bɩra bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. Ʋ sɩ sʋʋ ŋɩɩ, ʋ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa pɩ Wɩa balá nɛ. Ʋ bɩra bɩ jaŋ kɔ dɩ ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ.
11Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarʋ kala yie chɩŋ ʋ leriŋ nɛ a tɩtɩŋ ʋ tɩntɩŋŋaa tapʋlɩɩ-na kala, a vɛnɛɛ kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a ŋɩŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ tapʋlɩɩ-na kala. Ʋ sɩ yie kpʋ pʋsʋŋ deemba a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pɩpɩ Wɩa, ba bɩ jaŋ wuo laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. 12Ama Kirisito sʋba a joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa bala nɛ dɩ ʋ laa nɩaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. Ʋ sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ a hɔŋ Wɩa nadiiŋ. 13Ʋ jaŋ hɔŋ nɩmɛ halɩɩ, see dɩ Wɩa yuo dii ʋ dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ. 14Ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ tɩtɩa a pɩ Wɩa balá ŋɩɩ, ʋ leŋe nɩalɩŋ disiniŋ ba sɩ pɩɩsɛ ta ŋaa nɩa sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. 15Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ ma ŋaa wɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ bʋl pɛ-naara. Bumbuŋ ʋ sɩ, 16“Dɩ bʋa-la nɛ yie, nii-la mɩ sɩ jaŋ bil mɩ dɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa pɛgɛ nɛ ŋ-la:
Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wombie-la mɩ sɩ bile dɩ ba tuto wɩaa hɛ ba nyuŋ lɛ,
aŋ ŋmʋnsɛba hɛ ba tʋɔŋ ma lɛ.”
17Ʋ bɩra bʋla,
“Mɩ bɩra bɩ jaŋ liliisi ba wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ
arɩ ba nɩbɔŋ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋaa.”
18Dɩ Wɩa nɛ joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala a chɛla, ʋ bɩra bɩ maga dɩ la kpʋ pʋsʋŋ a pʋ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa.
Má kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a kpagɛ Wɩa
19Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ naambiiriŋ, la jaŋ wuo kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, lee-la sɩ chaasa zɔŋ a bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Yesu joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ a jaasɛ la wɩaa nɛ. 20Wombii-falɩɩ nɛ Yesu suro pɩla. Wombii-la ʋ sɩ suro pɩla lɛ nɛ la jaŋ to a jʋʋ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la, a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ Wɩa teeŋ. Yesu sɩ sʋba ŋɩɩ, ʋ kɛŋ patɩɩsaŋ-la fa sɩ kɛrɛ Wɩa dɩ-zɔŋ-la lee-la zɔmʋŋ sɩ bɩ magɩa kɛnɛ suro pɩla nɛ. 21La folo kɛŋ Wɩɩsʋllɩ sɩpaalaarɩ-hɩa-bal nɛ, ʋ bibeŋ Wɩa nɩaa. 22Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má leŋ la kɛŋ nyuduoŋ a laa wɩaa deemba dii arɩ tʋɔ-bala, a mʋ Wɩa teeŋ. Wɩa chɛsɛ la tʋɔŋ nɛ, a chɛsɛ la tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔmɔ-la kala ta. Ba bɩra bɩ jaŋ wʋwalɩmɛla. Ʋ kɛŋ lɩɩzɔmʋŋ nɛ fola. 23Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii, má leŋ dɩ laa yɩɛlɛ wɩalɩŋ, a chɩŋ ba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a sɩ́ begilu mʋa ma, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, la laa dii arɩ la jaŋ naba. 24Má leŋ dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ, a kɛŋ dɔŋɔ arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, aa pɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ, a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ dɔŋɔ lɛ. 25La sɩ yie hihilimi ŋɩɩ, nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ yie vɩa nɛ. Má sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Ama má leŋ dɩ la haa hilimi a pɩpɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ dɩ la to Wɩa arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ kpaga nɛ.
26Dɩ la nɛ kʋ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la aŋ vɩaʋ ta a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, kʋŋ dɔŋ bɩra tuo ba sɩ jaŋ wuo kpʋ a pɩ Wɩa a laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta. 27Ama fawʋllʋŋ jaŋ kɛnla, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ dii la sarɩya. Ʋ jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩla, a jonla hɛ nyiniŋ sɩ faasa didii lɛ. Nyiŋ-la jaŋ dii Wɩa dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ kala dɛrɛ. 28Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chei wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto, ka dɩ nɩaa balɩa koo batori hɛ nɩmɛ a ŋaa wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ ŋaa chei pɛ-naaraa, ba yie kpʋ tɩɩna nɛ. Ba yie bɩ ʋ nenige ka fá. 29Dɩ ba nɛ fa yie ŋaa ŋ-la, ɛɛ nɛ saa ba jaŋ ŋaa nɩɩ-la sɩ bee gʋʋnɛ Wɩa Bie arɩ ʋ tuo kʋŋkala? Tɩɩna bɩra kɛŋ Yesu chal-la Wɩa sɩ kaa bil niiŋ ʋ dɩ nɩaa pɛgɛ kaa chei nɛ. Chal-la nɛ Wɩa fa kaa chɛsɛ tɩɩna disiniŋ kala ta ʋ kʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna. Dɩ tɩɩna bɩra tʋʋsɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la fa sɩɩ pɛ ʋ lɛ, ʋ maga dɩ ba dɔgɩsʋ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ chei wɩalɩŋ Mosis fa sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil dɩ nɩaa tuto. 30La jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Mɩ jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa dɔŋɔ lɛ a timba.” Nʋʋ dɔŋ bɩra sɩ, “La Tɩɩna jaŋ dii ʋ nɩaa sarɩya.” 31Dɩ ŋ nɛ jʋʋ Wɩa-la sɩ weye nɩsɩŋ, ʋ jaŋ lɔrɔ pɩŋ.
32Má liise mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ suri ma sɩaa, ma kʋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii. Bʋa-la lɛ ma na hɛɛŋ nɛ woruŋ aŋ nyalɩmɛ. 33Bʋa dɔŋɔ ba yie tʋʋsɛma a dɔgɩsɛma nɩaa tʋɔŋ. Bʋa dɔŋɔ ma ma yie chɩna gbɛrɛ nɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ dɔgɩsʋ. 34Ma fa nɩalɩŋ ba sɩ kaa tɔ dɩa Yesu wɩaa bunso nɛ. Ba sɩ fʋga laa ma kɩaa, ma sɛɩ wɩɩ-la arɩ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ma jɩma arɩ ma kɛŋ kɩalɩŋ sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ dʋnɩa deeŋ kɩaa nɛ. Kɩalɩŋ-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ. 35Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ma nandaasɩŋ yʋɔrɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ, ma time jaŋ yʋgɛ Wɩa teeŋ. 36Ʋ maga dɩ ma kɛŋ kenyiri a wuo ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩɩ chɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ma jaŋ na kɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩma. 37Wɩa teniŋ sɩ,
“Mʋapɩlɩɩ, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa jaŋ kɔ,
ʋ bɩ jaŋ dieni.
38Ama tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa-na jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a tɩŋ ba sɩ laamɛ dii wɩaa.
Ama dɩ ba nɛ vɩa Wɩa,
ʋ tʋɔŋ bɩ jaŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ.”
39Ama la-na tuo nɩalɩŋ sɩ vɩa Wɩa ʋ cheiba. La ŋaa nɩa sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ ʋ laala ta.

english_text:
The Great Faith of God's People
1Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see. 2 It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
3 Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
4 Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
5 Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found. 6But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
7 Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
8 Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen. 9 Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise. 10Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
11 Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son. 12 Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
13 Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth. 14When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own. 15If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time. 16But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
17-18 Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac, 19because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
20 Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau. 21 Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons. 22 And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
23 Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders. 24 Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson. 25 He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while. 26Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
27Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger. 28 His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
29 Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
30 God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
31 Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
32 What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets. 33 Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions 34 and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
35 Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life. 36 Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail. 37 Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured. 38The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
39All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised. 40This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_text:
Bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ
1Dɩ ŋ nɛ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii, ŋ yie jɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩ yɩɛlʋ Wɩa teeŋ, ŋ jaŋ naba. Ŋ jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩɩŋ sɩ bɩ na sɛnɛ hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ. 2Bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ba nyuŋ. 3La laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa suri ʋ niiŋ nɛ a bʋl wɩaa kʋŋkala hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. Kɩalɩŋ la sɩ bɩ na tʋɔŋ nɛ kɩalɩŋ la sɩɩ na lɩɩ.
4Ebil fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋ pʋna a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ sɩ zɔmɔ a pɩ Wɩa a kɩɩ ʋ naambie Keeŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa joŋu arɩ ʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna ʋ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ kɩaa wɩaa. Ebil sʋba ma nɛ, ama a tɩŋ ʋ fa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ʋ ha bʋl wɩaa pɩpɩla nɛ.
5Ɛnɔk ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ bɩ sʋba, aŋ ka Wɩa joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ, nʋʋkala bɩra bɩ ʋ na. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. Wɩa tʋɔŋ fa tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ nɛ, ka ʋ-na joŋu kaa jɩl Wɩa-jaŋ. 6Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ bɩ Wɩa laa dii, ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa wɩɩkala dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ʋ kɔ Wɩa teeŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ laa sɩpaaŋ laa dii arɩ Wɩa hɛ nɩmɛ nɛ, a bɩra laa dii arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bee chɩchɛ Wɩa, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ laa ʋ time Wɩa teeŋ.
7Nowa ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kpʋrɩsɛ ʋ dɩgɩlaa a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dʋnɩa lɛ a pʋ, ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la na aŋ sɛɩ Wɩa niiŋ a kpaasɛ lɩɩŋ daboro dɩ ʋ laa ʋ dɩ ʋ dɩa nɩaa ta. Nowa sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna aŋ joŋ cheeriŋ a pɩ nɩkaana-la kala.
8Abɩraham ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Wɩa bʋla pʋ dɩ ʋ lɩɩ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a mʋ tinteeŋ dɔŋɔ, dɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ lee-la a pɩ ʋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa. Ʋ to Wɩa niiŋ lɛ a lɩɩ ʋ jaŋ lɛ a mʋmʋ lee-la. Ʋ fa bɩ lee-la ʋ sɩɩ mʋ jɩŋ. 9Ʋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, ʋ mʋ hɔŋ tintee-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pʋ lɛ a nagɛ nʋhʋɔrʋ. Ʋ nanʋala Aɩzɩk arɩ ʋ nihiŋ Jekɔb ma fa hɔŋ lee-la tɩtɩa nɛ a ŋaa nʋhʋɔra. Ba fa hɛ lɛŋŋɛɛ nɛ a jʋjʋʋ. Wɩa fa bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ tintee-la pɩ ba kala nɛ. 10Abɩraham faa chɛ dɩ ʋ jʋʋ taŋ-la Wɩa tɩtɩa sɩ bil ʋ gentine a saa nɛ. Taŋ deeŋ nɛ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ a mʋmʋ. 11Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Abɩraham haala Saara ma laa Wɩa wɩaa dii. Saara fa ŋaa hapɩrɩ nɛ. Abɩraham arɩ ʋ haala kala fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ, ka Wɩa wuo pɛ ba lɛ ba lʋl bie. Sara jɩma arɩ Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa ʋ laa dii arɩ ʋ jaŋ na kʋ-la Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pʋ. 12Abɩraham fa hɩɛsa nɛ woruŋ a kieli biiriŋ lʋlʋŋ a kpagɛ sʋʋŋ aŋ lʋl bile. Ʋ doho nɩaa pʋŋa yʋgɛ woruŋ a nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa, koo hagɩla sɩ pɩŋ mʋgʋ-balɩŋ niiŋ nɛ.
13Nɩaa deemba kala laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ aŋ-na sʋʋ. Ba bɩ kɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩba laa. Ba naba arɩ ba hɛ dɩ-bolii, ama ba laa dii arɩ maachie ba jaŋ laa kɩalɩŋ. Ba bɩra jɩma arɩ ba ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa nɛ, a ŋaa jʋjʋʋlɛ dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. 14Nɩaa deemba faa chɛ ba tɩtɩa tinteeŋ nɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bʋl wɩaa deemba a mʋ tɩgɛ ba tɩtɩa lɛ ŋɩɩ. 15Dɩ ba nɛ faa bɩɩnɛ tintee-la lɛ ba sɩ lɩa wɩaa, ba fa jaŋ chɛ wombiiŋ a mɩɩra mʋ nɩmɛ. 16Ama ba faa chɛ dɩ ba hɔŋ tintee-la sɩ zɔmɔ kɩɩ tintee kala. Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ ŋɩɩ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ saa jaŋ-la a pɩba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yɩrɛ Wɩa yɩrɩŋ, ka hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ Wɩa kɛnɛ.
17Abɩraham fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ, Wɩa magɩsʋ a bʋl dɩ ʋ kɛŋ ʋ bie Aɩzɩk a kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ pʋ. Abɩraham, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ hɛ niiriŋ pa, sɛɩ a kɛŋ ʋ tɩtɩa hɛ dɔŋɔ a kɛŋ Aɩzɩk, ʋ bie kala dɩ ʋ kpʋ a ŋaa Wɩɩsʋlɩɩ-la. 18Wɩa fa bʋla pɩ Abɩraham arɩ Aɩzɩk lɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ tou a leŋ dɩ ʋ doho nɩaa pʋŋ. 19Abɩraham fa jɩma arɩ Wɩa jaŋ wuo chɩsɛ ʋ bie sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa ma sɛnɛ joŋ Aɩzɩk pɩ Abɩraham a nagɛ ʋ sʋba nɛ ka ʋ chɩsʋ sʋʋŋ lɛ. 20Aɩzɩk ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ biiriŋ Jekɔb arɩ Ɛsɔ, a mʋ tɩgɛ ba chiemiŋ lɛ. 21Jekɔb ma laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ sɩ kpaga, ʋ ma sʋl Wɩa pɩ ʋ nihee nɛ Josɛf biiriŋ. Ʋ tɩɛbɛ ʋ dantɩga nɛ aŋ sʋl Wɩa pɩba. 22Josɛf ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ʋ sʋʋŋ sɩ yie, ʋ bʋla arɩ Iziral tɩŋŋaa maachie jaŋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ. Ʋ bɩra dagɛba ŋɩɩ ba sɩ jaŋ joŋ ʋ kʋsʋʋŋ ŋaa.
23Mosis naaŋ arɩ ʋ nyɩmma ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba sɩ lʋl Mosis ba joŋu faa chɛnsɩŋ batori, bɛɛ wɩaa ba fa na dɩ ʋ ŋaa bii-zɔŋ nɛ. Ba fa bɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ kuoro fá aŋ vɩa nii-la ʋ sɩ bil a bʋl dɩ ba kpʋ Iziral tɩŋŋaa bii-mulluŋ kala sɩ ŋaa hambolibiisiŋ. 24Mosis sɩ kʋ waa dɛrɛ, ʋ ma fa laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ.
