Ʋ ŋɩɩ harɩŋ lɛ, Wɩa sɩ kɛŋ zile kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ a yɩrɛma dɩ ma ma na tʋla-la Kirisito sɩ kɛnɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Ʋ nɛ jaŋ kɛmma wasa kɩɩ, a leŋ dɩ ma chaasa chɩŋ arɩ doluŋ. 11Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.
Chʋɔlaa
12Mɩ nɛ leŋe Sɩlɩvaanʋs ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Mɩ jɩma arɩ ʋ ma ŋaa la naambii-tɩtɩɩ nɛ. Wʋkuu-bie nɛ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩma dɩ mɩ ŋaa dɩ ma nyuŋ nyaasɛ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, mɩ bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ pɛ la lɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa má chɩŋ wɩaa deemba lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ. 13Nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Babɩlɔŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa dɩ ba ŋaa ʋ nɩaa arɩ ʋ sɩ lɩɩsɛ ma ma ŋɩɩ, ba maa chʋɔlɛma. Mɩ nanʋala Maak maa chʋɔlɛma. 14Má guori dɔŋɔ a chʋɔlɛ dɔŋɔ, a dagɛ ma sɩ cho dɔŋɔ ŋɩɩ.
Ma nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, ma jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa.

english_text:
1From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ.
To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
2I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus.
Living as the Lord's Followers
3We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness. 4God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
5Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding, 6self-control, patience, devotion to God, 7concern for others, and love. 8If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful. 9But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
10My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall. 11Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
12You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things. 13In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body. 14And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind. 15This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone.
The Message about the Glory of Christ
16When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness. 17 God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.” 18We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
19All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts. 20But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures. 21The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Saamɔŋ Pɩɩta nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma. Mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a ŋaa ʋ nanzɔɔ ma. Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ma nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii arɩ la ma sɩ laa ʋ wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ. La dɩ ma kala ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩmma nɛ a tɩŋ Wɩa arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito wɩaa.
2Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ fɩɛlɩŋ jaŋ yʋgɛ ma teeŋ, a tɩŋ wʋjɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ kɛnɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ Wɩa arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu lɛ.
Má leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ dɩ Wɩa wuo timma
3Wɩa doluŋ lɛ, ʋ pɩla kʋŋkala la sɩɩ chɛ la mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, dɩ la wuo kaa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ to ʋ wombiiŋ, dɩ la wuo jɩŋ ʋ-na Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ yɩrɛla dɩ la wuo na ʋ tʋla arɩ ʋ zɔmʋŋ kala. 4Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ nɛ Wɩa to a ŋaa wʋbal-la ʋ fa sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩla. Wɩalɩŋ zɔmɔ kɩŋkɛŋ la teeŋ. Ʋ joŋ wɩaa deemba pɩla dɩ la wuo lɩɩsɛ la tɩtɩa wʋbɔmɔ-la dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ to ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a ŋɩŋaa, ka dɩ la kʋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ naga. 5A tɩŋ ma sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii ŋɩɩ, má hɛ doluŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ. Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋŋa pɩpɛ ma mɛl-zɔŋ-la lɛ. 6Má to ma wʋjɩmɩɩ-la lɛ a kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ. Ma sɩ kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa woruŋ ŋɩɩ, má kɛŋ nyalɩma. Ma sɩ kɛŋ nyalɩma ŋɩɩ, má ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ, 7ma sɩɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ ŋɩɩ, ma kɛŋ zile ma naambiiri-la kala teeŋ, aŋ pɛ choba maa. 8Dɩ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ deemba nɛ hɛ ma lɛ, ba jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ tɩmma a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ jɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ. 9Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa deemba ka ŋaa, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa nyʋlʋŋ nɛ, a nagɛ nɩɩ-la sɩɩ na ʋ naasɩŋ bʋbʋɔŋ dʋndʋŋa aŋ bɩ dɩ-bolii ka na, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ tɩɩna paala yʋ arɩ Yesu chɛsɛ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ.
10Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ naambiiriŋ, mɩɩ sʋlma arɩ Wɩa sɩ yɩrɛma a lɩɩsɛma ŋɩɩ, má hɛ doluŋ a chɩŋ wɩaa deemba lɛ woruŋ. Dɩ ma nɩɩ ŋaaba, ma bɩ jaŋ yeŋŋi Wɩa wombiiŋ lɛ. 11Dɩ ma chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ lɛ woruŋ, ma jaŋ na wombiiŋ a jʋʋ La Tɩɩna arɩ la Laataara Yesu Kirisito kuorii-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ deeŋ deeŋ tʋɔŋ.
12Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, mɩ jaŋ liliisima bʋa na-kala lɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ wɩaa deemba lɛ. Ma paala jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ a chɩŋ ʋ lɛ woruŋ. 13Mɩ ha sɩ hɛ mɩ mɩɩsɩŋ deeŋ lɛ, ʋ ŋaa wʋzɔŋ nɛ dɩ mɩ liliisima wɩaa deemba dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yʋ, 14bɛɛ wɩaa mɩ jɩma arɩ mɩ bɩ jaŋ dieni dʋnɩa deeŋ lɛ. La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito tɩtɩa bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩmɛ nɛ. 15Mɩ jaŋ hɛ doluŋ a dagɛma wɩaa deemba, dɩ mɩ nɛ sʋba ma, dɩ ma ha wuo liliisiba bʋa na-kala lɛ.
Pɩɩta sɩ dɩ ʋ tɩtɩa nɛ na Yesu ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ
16La bʋla pɩma ŋɩɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito sɩ kɔ dʋnɩa arɩ doluŋ. Wɩɩ-la la sɩ bʋla pɩma bɩ nagɛ sʋnsɔgʋlɔɔ wʋjɩnnaa sɩ sɔgʋlɔ. La tɩtɩa sɩɩŋ nɛ na Yesu Kirisito tʋla. 17Bʋa-la lɛ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ joŋ doluŋ arɩ tʋla pʋ, la nɩɩ yikoro dɩ ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ, Wɩɩjarɩbakɔ yikoro nɛ. Ʋ fa sɩ, “Mɩ Bii-chooluŋ nɛ ŋ-la, mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ ʋ nyuŋ.” 18La ma tɩtɩa fa nɩɩ yikoro-la sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa-jaŋ nɛ, bʋa-la lɛ dɩ la dɩ Yesu kala nɛ fa hɛ peel-la sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ nyuŋ. 19Wɩaa deemba leŋe la wasa laa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa ma fa sɩ bʋla dii nɛ. Má jegile nɩɩba, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla nagɛ chaanɩŋ nɛ a chaanɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ʋ jaŋ chaanɛ ŋɩɩ halɩɩ a mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Yesu Kirisito pʋlʋmʋŋ sɩ jaŋ chaanɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ, a nagɛ nanyʋɔlʋŋ sɩ yie chaanɛ ŋɩɩ. 20Wɩaa deemba kala lɛ, sɩɩfɩaŋ wɩɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la. Ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa bil Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ, Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la tɩtɩa doluŋ lɛ dee ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ. 21Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bʋla bɩ ba tɩtɩa tʋɔbɩɩnaa lɛ lɩa. Ama Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ nɛ kʋ hɛ ba tʋɔŋ a leŋ ba bʋl wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ joŋo pɩba.

english_text:
False Prophets and Teachers
1Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves. 2Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way. 3They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
4God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment. 5 And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
6 God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
7-8 Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him. 9This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
10The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven. 11Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
12These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them. 13They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil.
They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on. 14All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
15 They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook. 16But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
17These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them. 18They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life. 19They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
20When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first. 21They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given. 22 What happened to them is just like the true saying,
“A dog will come back
to lick up its own vomit.
A pig that has been washed
will roll in the mud.”
translation_text:
Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichiba sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ
1Bumbuŋ wʋnyɩɛraa fa hɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii tʋɔŋ, aa fugi arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichiba jaŋ kʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a lʋara dɩdagɛma wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ cheima a paala bʋl arɩ ba bɩ La Tɩɩna Kirisito jɩŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ laaba ta. Ŋɩɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa guu cheiba. 2Nɩaa jaŋ yʋgɛ a to ba harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa. Ba wʋŋaalaa jaŋ leŋ dɩ nɩaa bʋl wɩaa a chichei Wɩa wombii-tɩtɩɩ-la la sɩɩ to. 3Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba jaŋ kɛŋ tʋɔ-luŋuŋ. Ba jaŋ kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩnyɩsɛma a lɩlaa ma kɩaa ma. Faafaa kala nɛ Wɩa dagɛ arɩ ʋ jaŋ dii nɩaa deemba doho sarɩya. Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ cheiba bɩ doŋ pɩna.
4Bumbuŋ kala nɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa dɔnsʋŋ fa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ. Ba sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa bɩ ba leŋe pɛɩ. Ʋ kɛsɛba a jomba yuo hɛ Wɩa-nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba kɛŋ chɔrʋmɔɔ vɔɔba a leŋ ba pɩŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya. 5Bʋa-la lɛ Nowa fa sɩ hɛ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ, nɩalɩŋ kala fa sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, Wɩa fa bɩ ba leŋe pɛɩ. Ʋ leŋe lɩɩŋ pɛllɛ paa nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba kala nɛ, aŋ leŋ Nowa arɩ ʋ nɩaa balɩpɛ dʋndʋŋ. Nowa fa bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ dɩ baa ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ to Wɩa wombiiŋ. 6Bʋa-la lɛ tasɩŋ balɩa ma fa hɛ nɩmɛ. Ba yɩraa nɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora. Ba nɩaa fa sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, Wɩa fa dɔgɩsɛba nɛ. Ʋ fa joŋ nyiniŋ nɛ a nyɩgɛba, ba kala dii buru aŋ ka tʋɔrʋŋ dʋndʋŋa. Wɩa dagɛ ŋɩɩ arɩ ʋ jaŋ dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ bɩ ʋ wombiiŋ ka to. 7Baal kʋbala ba faa yɩrɛ Lɔt ma fa hɔŋ Sodom arɩ Gomora tinteeŋ nɛ a ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna. Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ Wɩa kaa lɩɩsɛ tasɩ-la tʋɔŋ. Nɩbɔmɔ-la wʋŋaalaa fa chei ʋ tʋɔŋ woruŋ. 8Lɔt fa sɩ hɔŋ nɩbɔmɔ-la tʋɔŋ, ʋ yie na aŋ pɛ nɩɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala ba fa sɩɩ ŋaa tasɩ-la tʋɔŋ tapʋlɩɩ na-kala. Wɩaa deemba nɛ leŋe ʋ tʋɔŋ viisi, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ-na fa ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ. 9Wɩaa deemba kala dagɛla arɩ Wɩa jɩŋ wombii-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ to a laa tʋɔpʋl tɩŋŋaa ta nɛ, dɩ Sɩtaanɩ sɩ́ wuo magɩsɛba dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba bɩra dagɛla ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ jaŋ ŋaa a dɔgɩsɛ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ ma a kaa mʋ yi tapʋlɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya. 10Ba tʋɔŋ, Wɩa jaŋ faasa dɔgɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ ba joŋ ba tɩtɩa a hɛ Wɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ.
Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba bɩ nʋʋkala ka fá, aŋ pɛ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ ma a ŋɩŋaa ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba yie tʋʋsɛ Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ. 11Wɩa tɩndaara-la nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba. Ama Wɩa tɩndaara-la bɩ ba ka tʋʋsɛ, a bɩ cheeriŋ ma joŋo pɩ nɩaa deemba Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 12Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba yie ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ pʋsʋŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ. Ba yie nagɛ pʋsʋŋ nɩaa sɩ yie dɩɛsɛ dɩ ba kɛsɛ kpʋ nɛ. Ba yie bʋbʋl wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ aa tɩgɛ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ lɛ. Ba sɩ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba dɩ ba sʋʋ. 13Wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩɩ ŋaa nɩaa lɛ, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la chɩmɩŋ a tiŋ ba lɛ. Ba tʋɔtɔrʋŋ kala nɛ dɩ ba gɔllɔɔ ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ deemba ba bɩ kaa fɩfaa. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, nɩaa yie chichei ma yɩrɩŋ a joŋ hɩɩsɩŋ aa hɛ ma lɛ. Ba yie guoli ma tʋɔŋ nɛ ma kala didii kɩaa, ama ba yie lɩɩ ma harɩŋ a ŋɩŋaa ba wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. 14Bʋa na-kala lɛ dɩ ba nɛ na haal, ba yie chɛʋ nɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ. Ba-na bɩ lɔl arɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaanɩŋ. Ba yie nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ chɩna kpaŋ kpaŋ dɩ ba ŋaa wʋbɔŋ. Ba ŋaa tʋɔ-luŋ tɩmma nɛ. Wɩa kalɩba hɛ ba lɛ nɛ. 15Nɩaa deemba vɩa Wɩa wombiiŋ nɛ a yeŋŋi. Baa to bumbuŋ baal kʋbala harɩŋ nɛ baa yɩrɛ Balam. Ʋ nyɩmma yɩrɩŋ nɛ fa Bioo. A tɩŋ moribiee wɩaa Balam fa vɩa Wɩa wɩaa aŋ tuto wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ. 16Ʋ sɩ vɩa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa dagʋ a leŋ Balam kakumo bʋl wɩaa a nagɛ nuhuobiine, a kɛrʋ dɩ ʋ sɩ́ wʋyaayasɩŋ ŋaa.
17Wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichi deemba nagɛ lɩɩ-bulo sɩ hɩla nɛ. Ba bɩra nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ tɩna, aŋ ka peliŋ ŋaa kiri ʋ bɩ nɩa nɛ. Nɩaa deemba, Wɩa jaŋ jomba hɛ biriŋ lim tʋɔŋ. 18Ba yie bʋbʋl babiibal wɩaa sɩ bɩ bʋbʋɔŋ kɛnɛ. Ba yie kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩnyɩsɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bumo lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ jɩŋ lɛ. 19Ba yie nyɩnyɩsɛba a bʋl dɩ ba nɛ to ba harɩŋ, ba jaŋ tɩɩ ba tɩtɩa. Ama wʋnyɩɛraa deemba paala bɩ ba tɩtɩa tɩɩ. Ba nɛ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ yosuŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ leŋe dɩ wɩɩ malʋ, dɩ ʋ nɛ bɩ wɩɩ-la wuo leŋ, ʋ yie kʋ ŋaa wɩɩ-la yoŋ nɛ. 20Dɩ nɩaa nɛ kʋ jɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito, a lɩɩsɛ ba tɩtɩa dʋnɩa wɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ zɔŋ lɛ, aŋ bɩra leŋ dɩ wɩaa deemba malba a kɛŋ doluŋ ba lɛ, nɩaa deemba dɩdɛrɩŋ nɛ jaŋ bɔmɔ kɩɩ bʋa-la lɛ ba ha sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la jɩŋ. 21Ʋ fa jaŋ kpɩa dɩ ba nɛ fa bɩ tʋɔpʋla wombiiŋ jɩŋ, ama ba jɩmʋ nɛ aŋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩba dɩ baa ŋaa. Wɩaa deemba bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ. 22Wɩɩŋ deeŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa deemba lɛ daga arɩ namaga-la nɩaa sɩɩ magʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ba sɩ, “Vaha yie gbu kɩaa nɛ aŋ gʋra paa dii. Ba yie fo tooŋ ma lɩɩŋ, ka ʋ bɩra mʋ ŋmoo vʋchɔɔŋ.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Return
1My dear friends, this is the second letter I have written to encourage you to do some honest thinking. I don't want you to forget 2what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
3 But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you 4and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
5 They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water. 6 Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood. 7But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
8 Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as 1,000 years, and 1,000 years is the same as one day. 9The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
10 The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
11Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live. 12You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat. 13 But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
14My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace. 15Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him. 16Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
17My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance. 18Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_text:
Tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ
1Mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, mɩ teŋ-lɩamɩŋ nɛ ŋ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma. Mɩ tenni-la balɩamɩŋ tʋɔŋ, mɩ bʋl wɩaa liliisima dɩ ma wuo to Wɩa arɩ tʋɔbɩɩŋ zɔŋŋɔɔ. 2Mɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba dɩ ma liliisi wɩalɩŋ Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla-la fa sɩ bʋla faafaa, dɩ ma sɩ́ ba yʋ. Má pɛ liliisi wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu fa sɩ to ma nanzɔɔba lɛ a bʋla pɩma. Ʋ nɛ la Laataara. 3Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ ma laa sɩpaaŋ jɩŋ arɩ bʋa-la lɛ dʋnɩa sɩ jaŋ kʋ kpagɛ dɩdɛrɩŋ, nɩsieree jaŋ to ba tʋɔtɔrɛ wʋŋaalaa lɛ a sisierima lɛ. 4Ba jaŋ pɩɛsɛma, “Yesu fa sɩ hɛ niiŋ arɩ ʋ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ, nɩɩ nɛ ʋ hɛ? Chɛ bɛɛ nɛ saa ʋ jaŋ bɩra kɔ?” Ba jaŋ bɩra bʋl dɩ bʋa-la lɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa sɩpaaŋ laa Yesu wɩaa dii sɩ sʋba a kaa kʋkɔ bʋa deeŋ lɛ, kʋŋkala bɩ bɩrɩma, ba kala ha nagɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ ŋaaba nɛ dʋnɩa dɩ-suomuŋ. 5Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba chaasa jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala Wɩa sɩ ŋaa nɛ, ama ba bɩ chɛ dɩ ba sɛɩ arɩ faafaa kala dʋnɩa fa tuo a kaa mʋ yi bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa sɩ bʋl wɩaa, ka wɩa-nyuŋ arɩ tinteeŋ kala-na kʋ hɛ nɩmɛ. Tinteeŋ fa hɛ lɩɩŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ, ka Wɩa kaa pɔrɛ ʋ pɩŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa, ka lɩɩŋ ma pɩŋ ʋ dʋndʋŋa. 6Lɩɩ-la tɩtɩa nɛ Wɩa joŋo tɔ bumbuŋ dʋnɩa-la, ʋ kala chei. 7Wɩa bɩra bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ nyiniŋ dii tinteeŋ arɩ wɩa-nyuŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ lɛɛlɛ ŋ-la. Ama ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ halɩɩ, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya kʋ yi. Nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa ka to, Wɩa jaŋ joŋ cheeriŋ pɩba a cheiba.
8Ama mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, má sɩ́ yʋ, arɩ Wɩa teeŋ tapʋl-bala nagɛ jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ nɛ, ka jɩsɩŋ bʋɩ ma nagɛ tapʋl-bala. 9Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ bɩɩna arɩ Wɩa fɩɛla nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ sɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa lɛ. Ʋ bɩ fɩɛlɛ, ama ʋ kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ a tɩŋ ma wɩaa, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ chɛ dɩ ma kʋŋkala lɛl. Ʋʋ chɛ dɩ nʋʋkala bɩrɩma lɩɩ ʋ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ nɛ. 10Ama tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu jaŋ sɩ kɔ, ʋ jaŋ nagɛ gaara sɩ kʋ dɩ nɩaa lɛ. Bʋa-la lɛ nʋʋkala jaŋ nɩɩ huuri-bal kʋbala wɩa-nyuŋ. Wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ lɛl, ka kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ma jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ a nyɩɩgɛ, ka dɩ tinteeŋ kʋŋkala ma dii nyiniŋ.
11Ma sɩ jɩma arɩ dʋnɩa kala jaŋ lɛl ŋɩɩ, ɛɛ nɛ ma bɩɩna arɩ ʋ maga dɩ ma mɛlɛ nagɛ? Ʋ maga dɩ ma joŋ ma tɩtɩa kala a pɩ Wɩa nɛ, a sɩ́ disiŋ kala kɛŋ, a tuto ʋ wombii-la. 12Ma sɩɩ gbɛrɛ tapʋlɩɩ-la La Tɩɩna Yesu sɩ jaŋ kɔ ŋɩɩ, má pɛ pipesi, dɩ ma ŋaa wɩɩ na-kala ma sɩ jaŋ wuo ŋaa dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la yima lɩma. Tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ wɩa-nyuŋ jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ tʋɔŋ a nyɩɩgɛ. Ka kʋŋkala sɩ hɛ wɩa-nyuŋ ma jaŋ ŋmɩɛrɛ nyiniŋ lɛ a lɛl. 13Faafaa-la Wɩa bʋla arɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa wɩa-nyu-falɩɩ arɩ tintee-falɩɩ. Lee-la ʋ nɩaa jaŋ ŋɩŋaa tʋɔpʋl wɩaa. Wɩaa deemba nɛ laa gbɛrɛ.
14Ŋɩɩ wɩaa mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, ma sɩɩ gbɛrɛ dɩ ma na wɩaa deemba ŋɩɩ, má fɩɛsɛ sɩɩŋ a leŋ dɩ ma mɛlɛ zɔŋ, dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la nɛ yie, dɩ Wɩa sɩ́ cheeriŋ joŋo pɩma, ka dɩ ma dɩ Wɩa sɩŋ. 15Mɩ naambiiriŋ, ʋ maga dɩ ma jɩŋ arɩ La Tɩɩna Yesu kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ. Ʋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ dɩ ʋ wuo laama ta nɛ. Wɩaa deemba tɩtɩa nɛ la naambii-chooluŋ Pɔɔl ma ŋmʋnsa pɩma. Wɩa nɛ pʋ wʋjɩmɩŋ deeŋ ʋ kaa bʋl wɩalɩŋ. 16Wɩaa deemba nɛ ʋ bʋl ʋ tenni-la kala lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ bʋla ʋ tenni-la lɛ, ba dɔnsʋŋ hɛyɛ. Nɩaa bɩ ba bʋbʋɔŋ jɩŋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wɩaa jɩŋ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ laa dii lɛ chɩna kpaŋ kpaŋ yie kɛŋ wɩalɩŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ wʋwogusu, arɩ ba sɩ yie kɛŋ Wɩa teniŋ wɩaa sɛmɛ dɔnsʋŋ kaa bɩrɩmɛ ŋɩɩ. Ba sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa jaŋ cheiba. 17Ma-na mɩ naambii-kpɩanaba, ma paala jɩŋ arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa deemba jaŋ kɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ dɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa niiŋ ka to sɩ́ wuo nyɩsɛma dɩ ma to ba wʋnyɩɛrɩɩ-la harɩŋ, aŋ joŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii a chɩŋ ba lɛ ta. 18Má leŋ dɩ ma wʋjɩmɩŋ pʋŋa pɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito wɩaa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la Laataara. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ pɛ ma lɛ. Ʋ yɩrɩŋ nɛ nɩaa jaŋ yɩrɛ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ.

english_text:
1 The Word that gives life
was from the beginning,
and this is the one
our message is about.
Our ears have heard,
our eyes have seen,
and our hands have touched
this Word.
2 The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us. 3We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ. 4We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy.
God Is Light
5Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
6If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth. 7 But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away. 8If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts. 9But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
10If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_text:
Wɩɩ-la sɩ kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiine
1Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma a tɩgɛ wɩɩ kʋbala lɛ. Wɩɩ-la fa hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩŋ. La nɩɩ ʋ yikoro a kɛŋ la sɩaa ma naʋ a chaasa benu, a kɛŋ la nɩsaa ma digu. 2Wɩɩ-la sɩ kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiine, la naʋ nɛ a laaʋ dii, a bʋl ʋ wɩaa pɩpɩma. Wɩɩ-la nɛ ŋ-la: Mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ, ʋ fa hɛ la Nyɩmma teeŋ nɛ a kʋ lɩɩ la teeŋ la naʋ. Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋɩɩ. 3Wɩalɩŋ la sɩ na aŋ nɩɩ ma, ba nɛ la bʋlaa pɩma, dɩ ma wuo jʋʋ la tʋɔŋ dɩ la kala kɛŋ nii-bala. La dɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito kɛŋ nii-bala nɛ. 4Laa chɛ dɩ la tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ nɛ woruŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma.
Wɩa nɛ kɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ
5Wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Bie sɩ dagɛla a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ, ba nɛ ŋ-la: Wɩa nɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ, birimiŋ mʋa ma tuo ʋ lɛ. 6Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la dɩ ʋ kɛŋ nii-bala aŋ ka laa ŋaa birimiŋ tʋɔŋ wɩaa, laa nyɩɛ nɛ. La wʋŋaalaa arɩ la wʋbʋlaa kala bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. 7Ama dɩ la nɛ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ, arɩ Wɩa sɩ hɛ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ ŋɩɩ, ŋɩɩ-na la dɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kala kɛŋ nii-bala nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, Wɩa Bie Yesu chalɩŋ ma jaŋ chɛsɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta. 8Dɩ la nɛ sɩ la bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, laa nyɩsɛ la tɩtɩa nɛ. La bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. 9Ama dɩ la nɛ sɛyɛ arɩ la ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ a dagɛ la wʋbɔmɔ-la a pʋ, Wɩa kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ, ʋ jaŋ wuo joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛla a chɛsɛ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ kala ta. 10Ama dɩ la nɛ sɩ la bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, la kɛŋ Wɩa yɩrɛ wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. La bɩ ʋ niiŋ wɩaa laa dii.

english_text:
Christ Helps Us
1My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us. 2Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
3When we obey God, we are sure we know him. 4But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts. 5We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him. 6If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ.
The New Commandment
7 My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard. 8But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
9If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark. 10But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them. 11If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
12Children, I am writing you,
because your sins
have been forgiven
in the name of Christ.
13Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you have defeated
the evil one.
14Children, I am writing you,
because you have known
the Father.
Parents, I am writing you,
because you have known
the one who was there
from the beginning.
Young people, I am writing you,
because you are strong.
God's message is firm
in your hearts,
and you have defeated
the evil one.
15Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father. 16Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father. 17The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever.
The Enemy of Christ
18Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here. 19These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
20Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand. 21I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth. 22And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son. 23If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father. 24Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father. 25The Son has promised us eternal life.
26I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you. 27But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do.
Children of God
28Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame. 29You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_text:
Kirisito chɩŋ la harɩŋ a pɩpɛ la lɛ
1Mɩ biiri, mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma dɩ ma bɩra sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, ama dɩ la kʋŋkala nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, la kɛŋ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ chɩŋ la nyuŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. Ʋ jaŋ sʋla laala ʋ Nyɩmma teeŋ. Tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nɛ ŋɩɩ. 2Ʋ nɛ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛla. La dʋndʋŋa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa dee, ama dʋnɩa nɩaa kala wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ. 3Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ la jɩŋ Wɩa nɛ. 4Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ jɩmʋ, aŋ bɩ wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga ka to, tɩɩna ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. 5Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to ʋ niiŋ wɩaa, ʋ nɛ nɩɩ-la sɩ sɛnɛ cho Wɩa kɩŋkɛŋ. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la jaŋ to jɩŋ arɩ la hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. 6Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɩ ʋ dɩ Wɩa ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ tɩɩna wʋŋaalaa nagɛ Yesu Kirisito wʋŋaalaa nɛ.
Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ
7Mɩ bii-chooloo, wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsaa pɩma lɛɛlɛ, ʋ bɩ wʋfalɩɩ kala ŋaa, ʋ ŋaa wʋbɩnɩɩ nɛ ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ kala. Wʋbɩnɩɩ-la nɛ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ nɩa faafaa kala. 8Ama ʋ saa naga arɩ wʋfalɩɩ nɛ mɩ sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa wɩɩŋ deeŋ kʋ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ Kirisito mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ arɩ ma ma mɩɩsɩŋ lɛ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ birimiŋ ka lɛl nɛ, aŋ ka pʋlʋmʋŋ suomo chɩchaanɛ. 9Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ sɩ ʋʋ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ aŋ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ha hɛ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. 10Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋʋ vɛŋ pʋlʋmʋŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Wɩɩkala bɩra tuo sɩ jaŋ ŋaa dɩ ʋ tel. 11Ka nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ tɩɩna ka vɛŋ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jɩŋ lee-la kala ʋ sɩɩ mʋ. Birimiŋ ŋaa ʋ sɩaa bɩ na.
12Mɩ biiriŋ, a tɩŋ Yesu wɩaa nɛ Wɩa joŋ ma wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a chɛma.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma.
13Mɩ nyɩmmaba ma, ma jɩŋ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ.
Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma.
Ma bapʋɔsaa ma, ma lɛɛlɛ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ nɛ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma.
Mɩ biiriŋ, ma ma jɩŋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa nɛ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩ ma ma.
14Mɩ kʋhɩasɩŋ ma, ma jɩŋ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala nɛ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma.
Ma bapʋɔsaa ma,
ma ma kɛŋ doluŋ,
Wɩa niiŋ wɩaa ma hɛ ma tʋɔŋ lɛ.
Ma lɛɛlɛ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ nɛ,
ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma.
15Má sɩ́ dʋnɩa kɩaa cho. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho dʋnɩa kɩaa, ʋ bɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa cho. 16Kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ, la yaraa wʋchɛɛlɛɛ arɩ la sɩɩŋ wʋchooloo arɩ kɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa nɩaa bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, ba kala bɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa teeŋ lɩa, ba ŋaa dʋnɩa kɩaa nɛ. 17Dʋnɩa arɩ kɩalɩŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ nuhuobiinee cho, ba kala jaŋ lɛl. Ama nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ cho, ʋ jaŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ.
Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ
18Mɩ biiriŋ, dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ. Ma nɩa arɩ Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ jaŋ kɔ. Bʋa deeŋ lɛ Kirisito dʋndɔŋŋɔɔ paala yʋgɛ nɛ a kɔ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, la jɩma arɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ kpaga nɛ. 19Ba lɩɩ la tʋɔŋ nɛ, ama la dɩ ba fa bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. Dɩ la dɩ ba nɛ fa ŋaa kʋbala, ba ma fa ha jaŋ hɛ la tʋɔŋ. Ama ba sɩ lɩɩ la tʋɔŋ nɛ daga arɩ la dɩ ba bɩ kʋbala ŋaa. 20Ama ma-na jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Kirisito joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. 21Ʋ bɩ naga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma a tɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la jɩŋ nɛ. Ama mɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩpɩma a tɩŋ ma sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ. Ma jɩma arɩ wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna bɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ kɛnɛ. 22Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna? Nɩɩ-la sɩ sɩ Yesu dee bɩ Kirisito ŋaa, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ tɩɩna. Nɩɩ-la nɛ ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ vɩa la Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu. 23Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ vɩa Wɩa Bie, ʋ bɩ ʋ Nyɩmma ma jɩŋ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ sɛɩ Wɩa Bie, ʋ sɛɩ ʋ Nyɩmma ma nɛ. 24Má leŋ dɩ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ wɩaa deemba nɛ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a kaa mʋ, ma jaŋ hɛ Wɩa Bie arɩ ʋ Nyɩmma lɛ. 25Wɩɩ-la Kirisito tɩtɩa sɩ bʋla dɩ ʋ jaŋ ŋaa pɩla nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ sɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ a pɩla.
26Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba pɩpɩma a mʋ tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba nyɩsɛma lɛ nɛ. 27Ama Kirisito joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la hɛ ma lɛ nɛ. Ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ ŋɩɩ, ma bɩra bɩ nʋʋ ka chɛ dɩ ʋ dagɛma. Ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la sɩ hɛ ma lɛ ka dagɛma wɩɩkala nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ dagɛma ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩba nɛ, wʋnyɩɛrɩ dee. Má to wɩalɩŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ dagɛma, a leŋ ma dɩ Kirisito ŋaa kʋbala.
28Mɩ biiri, dɩ ma nɩɩ to Kirisito ŋɩɩ a kaa mʋ, la jaŋ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ chɛɛ-la ʋ sɩ jaŋ mɩɩra kɔ. Hɩɩsɩŋ bɩ jaŋ kɛnla dɩ la faa. 29Ma jɩma arɩ Kirisito ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna nɛ, ma saa jaŋ jɩŋ arɩ nʋʋkala sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa Kirisito bii nɛ.

english_text:
1 Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are. 2My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is. 3This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
4Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law. 5 You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful, 6and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
7Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself. 8Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done. 9God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning. 10You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other.
Love Each Other
11 From the beginning you were told we must love each other. 12 Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil. 13My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you. 14 Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
15If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life. 16We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other. 17If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God. 18Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
19When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God. 20But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything. 21Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him. 22He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him. 23 God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do. 24If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_text:
La ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ
1Ma na ŋɩɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ chola. Ʋ chola kieli, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kɛnla yɩyɩrɛ ʋ biiriŋ. Wʋtɩtɩɩ, la sɛnɛ ŋaa ʋ biiriŋ nɛ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ba bɩ la ma jɩŋ ŋɩɩ. 2Mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, lɛɛlɛ la ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Ama Wɩa ha bɩ chaasa daga pʋllɛ ŋɩɩ la sɩ jaŋ nagɛ. Ama wɩɩ-la la sɩ jɩma nɛ ŋ-la: Bʋa-la lɛ Kirisito sɩ jaŋ kɔ, la ma jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ naga, bɛɛ wɩaa la jaŋ na ʋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ kala. 3Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ yɩɛlɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ, ʋ jaŋ lɩɩsɛ ʋ tɩtɩa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ aŋ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla, arɩ Kirisito sɩ kɛŋ tʋɔpʋla ŋɩɩ.
4Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmʋŋ, ʋ chei wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ leŋe ba ŋmʋnsa bil nɛ dɩ nɩaa tuto. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ, ʋ chei wɩalɩŋ nɛ. 5Ma kala jɩma arɩ Kirisito kɔ dɩ ʋ laa la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ta nɛ. Ʋ-na bɩ wʋbɔŋ kala ŋaa. 6Dɩ nʋʋ arɩ Kirisito nɛ ŋaa kʋbala, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa. Ama nɩɩ-la kala ha sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Kirisito jɩŋ. Ʋ sɩaa ma ha bɩ ʋ nyuŋ pollo. 7Mɩ biiriŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ nʋʋkala nyɩsɛma wɩaa deemba lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa wɩaa ba bʋa lɛ, ʋ tɩɩna ŋaa tʋɔpʋl tɩɩna nɛ, arɩ Kirisito sɩ ŋaa tʋɔpʋl Tɩɩna ŋɩɩ. 8Ama nɩɩ-la kala ha sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ nʋʋ nɛ. Sɩtaanɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ bumbuŋ kala nɛ a kaa kɔ arɩ jɩnɩŋ kala. Wɩɩ-la sɩ tɩɩ Wɩa Bie kɔ dʋnɩa nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ kɔ dɩ ʋ chei Sɩtaanɩ tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ. 9Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ ŋaa Wɩa bii, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa nagɩsɩŋ hɛ ʋ lɛ nɛ. Ʋ bɩ jaŋ wuo vɩa aŋ ha ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ. 10Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ Wɩa biiriŋ arɩ Sɩtaanɩ biiriŋ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩaa ŋaa ba bʋa lɛ, koo nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna cho, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa bii ŋaa.
Má cho dɔŋɔ
11Wɩɩ-la ma sɩ nɩa bumbuŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ maga dɩ ma cho dɔŋɔ. 12Ʋ bɩ maga dɩ la nagɛ Keeŋ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Sɩtaanɩ nʋʋ nɛ a kpʋ ʋ ŋaana. Bɛɛ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋʋ? Keeŋ faa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ nɛ, aŋ ka ʋ ŋaana fa ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ ʋ kpʋʋ. 13Mɩ naambiiri, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋkpuŋkpere ma lɛ dɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa nɛ bɛrɛma. 14La-na cho la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la jɩŋ arɩ la lɩɩ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ nɩaa cho ha hɛ sʋʋŋ bʋa lɛ nɛ. 15Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa nɩkpʋʋrʋ nɛ. Mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɩdɛrɩŋ kɛnɛ, ma jɩma arɩ nɩkpʋʋra bɩ ʋ kɛnɛ. 16Kirisito joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ yɔɔ sʋʋŋ la wɩaa nɛ, a dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ faasa chola. La ma saa maga dɩ la cho la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa ŋɩɩ nɛ a joŋ la mɩɩsɩŋ a yɔɔ sʋʋŋ ba wɩaa. 17Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ kɩaa woruŋ aŋ na ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ʋ jʋʋ wɩɩ a chɩchɛ pɛnɩŋ, ka ʋ kɛŋ tʋɔhɛɛŋ a bɩ ʋ nenige fá, ɛɛ nɛ ʋ jaŋ wuo bʋl dɩ ʋ cho Wɩa nɛ? 18Mɩ biiriŋ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ la kɛŋ niiŋ dʋndʋŋa cho dɔŋɔ. Má leŋ dɩ la to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ a ŋɩŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ, dɩ la wʋŋaalɩa-la dagɛ arɩ la sɛnɛ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ.
19Dɩ la nɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ wuo to ŋɩɩ lɛ a jɩŋ arɩ laa to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombiiŋ nɛ a wuo na wiese Wɩa teeŋ. 20Dɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ wuo dagɛ arɩ la cheye nɛ, la jɩma arɩ Wɩa nɛ yʋga kɩɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa a jɩŋ wɩɩkala. 21Mɩ nandɔŋ-kpɩanaba, dɩ la tʋɔbɩɩnaa nɛ bɩ daga arɩ la cheye nɛ, la jaŋ kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ. 22Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, dɩ la nɛ sʋl kʋŋ na-kala ʋ teeŋ, ʋ jaŋ joŋo pɩla, bɛɛ wɩaa laa to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ daga nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ. 23Wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ daga nɛ: dɩ la laa ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito wɩaa dii a cho dɔŋɔ, arɩ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ dagɛla. 24Nʋʋ na-kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagɛla, ʋ tɩɩna hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, Wɩa ma hɛ ʋ teeŋ. Ʋ sɩ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ hɛ la lɛ nɛ leŋe la jɩŋ arɩ Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ.

english_text:
God Is Love
1Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world, 2and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body. 3But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
4Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world. 5These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language. 6We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
7My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him. 8God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him. 9God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life. 10Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven. 11Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
12 No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
13God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us. 14God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him. 15God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God 16and are sure God loves us.
God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us. 17If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment. 18A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
19We love because God loved us first. 20But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see? 21The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_text:
Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ sɩ nagɛ ŋɩɩ
1Mɩ bii-chooloo, dɩ nɩaa nɛ sɩ dɩ ba kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo bʋl wɩaa, Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la doluŋ lɛ, má sɩ́ guu laa dii arɩ baa bʋl wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Má laa sɩpaaŋ magɩsɛba na arɩ ba sɛnɛ ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛɛ. Bɛɛ wɩaa wʋnyɩɛrɩ Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa yʋga nɛ a hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ. 2Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ ma jaŋ to a wuo jɩŋ dɩ nʋʋ nɛ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ: Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a sɛɩ dɩ ʋ nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, a bɩra sɛɩ dɩ ʋ kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, ʋ tɩɩna nɛ sɛnɛ kɛŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ. 3Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ ŋɩɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ, ʋ bɩ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ kɛnɛ. Dol-la ʋ tɩɩna sɩ kɛnɛ ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ doluŋ nɛ. Ma nɩa arɩ Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ deeŋ jaŋ kɔ dʋnɩa. Ʋ doluŋ nɛ saa paala hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ lɛɛlɛ. 4Mɩ biiri, ma nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ tɩɩ. Ma nɛ lɛɛlɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋlla nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ hɛ ma lɛ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a kɩɩ dol-la dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩ kɛnɛ. 5Nɩalɩŋ sɩ nyɩɛ wɩaa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa wʋlaabʋllaa nɛ, ba hɛ dʋnɩa nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ a bʋbʋl dʋnɩa wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa jegilee nɩɩ ba teeŋ. 6Ama la-na ŋaa nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ tɩɩ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ jɩŋ Wɩa, ʋ tɩɩna ma jegilee nɩɩ la teeŋ nɛ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, ba bɩ la teeŋ jegili. Ŋ-la lɛ nɛ la jaŋ wuo to jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩŋŋaa arɩ wʋnyɩɛraa.
Wɩa sɩ cho nɩaa ŋɩɩ
7Mɩ bii-chooloo, má leŋ dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ. Dɩ la nɛ cho dɔŋɔ, ʋ lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho nɩaa ŋaa Wɩa bii-lʋlɩɩ nɛ a jɩŋ Wɩa. 8Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩ bɩ nɩaa cho, ʋ bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa chonuŋ ŋaa Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ. 9Ŋ-la nɛ Wɩa dagɛla arɩ ʋ chola nɛ: Ʋ joŋ ʋ Bii-bala dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu dʋnɩa, dɩ la to ʋ lɛ a kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. 10Ŋ-la nɛ chonuŋ nagɛ: Ʋ bɩ naga la nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ cho Wɩa, ama Wɩa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ chola. Ʋ tɩŋ ʋ Bie ʋ kʋ tuu sʋʋ la wɩaa, dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ baanɩŋ ta ʋ fa sɩ kɛnɛ a tɩŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa, a joŋ la wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chɛla. 11Mɩ bii-chooloo, Wɩa sɩ chola ŋɩɩ, ʋ maga dɩ la ma cho dɔŋɔ. 12Nʋʋkala ha bɩ Wɩa na. Dɩ la nɛ cho dɔŋɔ, Wɩa hɛ la teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Dɩ ʋ nɛ hɛ la teeŋ ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ cho Wɩa arɩ la dɔnsʋŋ tɩŋŋaa kɩŋkɛŋ.
13Ʋ joŋ ʋ Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la hɛ la lɛ dɩ ʋ dɩdagɛla. Ŋɩɩ lɛ nɛ la to jɩŋ arɩ la hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ, Wɩa ma hɛ la teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. 14La tɩtɩa na nɛ a laa dii arɩ Wɩa ta ʋ Bie dɩ ʋ kʋ tuu ŋaa dʋnɩa nɩaa Laataara nɛ. 15Nʋʋkala sɩ wuo bʋl arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie, Wɩa hɛ tɩɩna teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Ʋ tɩɩna ma hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. 16Ŋɩɩ nɛ la tɩtɩa jɩŋ a laa dii arɩ Wɩa chola nɛ. Chonuŋ ŋaa Wɩa kʋŋ nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa a kaa mʋ, ʋ tɩɩna hɛ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ a kaa mʋ. Wɩa ma hɛ ʋ tɩɩna teeŋ a kaa mʋ. 17Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, la jaŋ nagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ fa sɩ naga dʋnɩa lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, la jaŋ kɛŋ nyuduoŋ tapʋlɩɩ-la Kirisito sɩ jaŋ dii dʋnɩa nɩaa sarɩya. 18Nɩɩ-la sɩ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ fawʋllʋŋ ka fá. Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa kɩŋkɛŋ, chono-la kiri fawʋllʋŋ ta nɛ. Dɩ la nɛ haa fá fawʋllʋŋ arɩ Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛla, la ha bɩ Wɩa arɩ nɩaa cho kɩŋkɛŋ. 19Wɩa nɛ laa sɩpaaŋ chola. Ŋɩɩ nɛ tɩɩ la ma wuo cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa. 20Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ sɩ ʋ cho Wɩa nɛ aŋ bɛrɛ ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna, ʋ ŋaa wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ wuo na ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna aŋ bɩ ʋ cho, ŋɩɩ-na ʋ bɩ Wɩa ʋ sɩ bɩ wuo na ma cho. 21Wɩa bʋla pɩla arɩ nɩɩ-la kala sɩ chou, ʋ maga dɩ ʋ cho ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna ma nɛ.

english_text:
Victory over the World
1If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children. 2If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children. 3 We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
4Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory. 5No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God.
Who Jesus Is
6Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful. 7In fact, there are three who tell about it. 8They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
9We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son. 10If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar. 11 God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son. 12And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life.
Knowing about Eternal Life
13All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life. 14We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him. 15And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
16Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly. 17Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
18We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
19We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
20We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
21Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_text:
Wɩa biiriŋ jaŋ kɛŋ doluŋ a wuo dʋnɩa
1Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Kirisito, Nɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ cho nʋʋ, ʋ cho nɩɩ-la bie ma nɛ. 2Dɩ la nɛ cho Wɩa a tuto wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛla, ŋɩɩ daga arɩ la cho Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. 3Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ ʋ sɩ dagɛla, ŋɩɩ dagɛ arɩ la cho Wɩa nɛ. Ʋ bɩ hɛɩ a pɩla dɩ la to wɩaa deemba, 4bɛɛ wɩaa Wɩa bii kala kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ dʋnɩa wɩaa lɛ. La sɩ laa Wɩa dii nɛ pɩla doluŋ deeŋ la yuo dii dʋnɩa wɩaa. 5Kʋbɛɛ nɛ saa kɛŋ doluŋ dɩ ʋ wuo yuo dii dʋnɩa? See nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa dii arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie.
Kɩalɩŋ batori sɩ daga arɩ Yesu nɛ ŋaa Wɩa Bie
6Ʋ-na Yesu Kirisito nɛ kɔ dʋnɩa ba fou Wɩɩchʋɔlɛ lɩɩŋ, a kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasɛ. Ŋ-la daga arɩ lɩɩŋ dʋndʋŋa dee ba fou, ba kpaasʋ mɛrɛ daagɛsɛ nyuŋ ma nɛ ʋ chalɩŋ jaasʋ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ŋɩɩ lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ nɛ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. 7Kɩaa batori nɛ hɛ nɩmɛ a dɩdagɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ. 8Ba nɛ ŋaa: Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ arɩ lɩɩ-la arɩ ʋ chal-la. Ba kala ka bʋl wʋbala nɛ. 9Dɩ wɩɩ nɛ ŋaa nʋʋ lɛ dɩ ʋ bʋl wɩɩ-la, la yie sɛɩ nɛ. Ama dɩ Wɩa nɛ bʋl wɩɩ, ʋ nɛ ŋaa sɩɩfɩaŋ a kɩɩ nuhuobiine wʋbʋlʋŋ. Wɩa tɩtɩa nɛ saa bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ. Wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. 10Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ laa Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii, ʋ tɩɩna jɩma ʋ tʋɔŋ lɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ lɛ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ Wɩa laa dii, ʋ kɛŋ Wɩa yɩyɩrɛ wʋnyɩɛrʋ nɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa ʋ bɩ wɩɩ-la ʋ sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ ʋ Bie lɛ laa dii. 11Wɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ bʋla nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ ʋ pɩla mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ. Mɩɩsɩ-la hɛ ʋ Bie teeŋ nɛ. 12Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ hɛ Wɩa Bie teeŋ kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la nɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala ma sɩ bɩ Wɩa bile teeŋ hɛ, ʋ ma bɩ mɩɩsɩ-la kɛnɛ.
La kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ
13Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa Bie wɩaa dii ma wuo jɩŋ arɩ ma kɛŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ nɛ. 14La kɛŋ bɔɩ-duoŋ nɛ Wɩa sɩpaaŋ, bɛɛ wɩaa la laa dii arɩ la nɛ sʋlʋ a chɩchɛ kʋŋkala sɩɩ tɔrɛ ʋ tʋɔŋ, ʋ jaŋ jegile nɩɩ la teeŋ. 15Dɩ la nɛ saa jɩma arɩ la nɛ sʋl kʋŋkala ʋ teeŋ, ʋ yie jegile nɩɩ la teeŋ nɛ, ŋɩɩ-na la jɩma arɩ ʋ jaŋ joŋ kʋ-la la sɩɩ chɛ pɩla.
16Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ na ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna dɩ ʋ ŋaa wʋbɔŋ sɩ bɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ sʋʋ, ʋ maga dɩ tɩɩna sʋl Wɩa pʋ nɛ dɩ Wɩa joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ chɛʋ. Mɩ bʋl ŋ-la a tɩgɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ ŋaa wʋbɔmɔ-la lɛ sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba sʋʋ lɛ nɛ a tɩŋ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la wɩaa. Wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ nʋʋ nɛ ŋaaba, ʋ tɩɩna jaŋ sʋʋ. Dɩ nʋʋ nɛ saa ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba, mɩ bɩ sɩ dɩ ma sʋl Wɩa dɩ ʋ joŋ ʋ mɩɩsɩŋ chɛʋ. 17Wɩɩ na-kala ŋ sɩ ŋaa chei ŋaa wʋbɔŋ nɛ, ama wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ, dɩ ŋ nɛ ŋaaba, ŋ bɩ jaŋ sʋʋ a tɩŋ ba wɩaa.
18La jɩma arɩ Wɩa bii kala bɩ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ka ŋaa deeŋ deeŋ. Wɩa Bie Yesu nɛ yie pʋpɔʋ. Sɩtaanɩ bɩ ʋ wɩɩkala wuo ŋaa.
19La jɩma la ŋaa Wɩa biiriŋ nɛ. Nɩkaana-la-na kala sɩ hɛ dʋnɩa lɛ hɛ Sɩtaanɩ nɩsɩŋ lɛ nɛ.
20La bɩra jɩma arɩ Wɩa Bie nɛ kɔ a suri la sɩaa la wuo jɩŋ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la. La dɩ Wɩɩ-tɩtɩɩ-la ŋaa kʋbala nɛ. La hɛ ʋ Bie lɛ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩtɩa. Ʋ nɛ joŋ mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ pɩla. 21Mɩ biiri, má lɩɩsɛ ma tɩtɩa vʋɩyaa lɛ.

english_text:
1From the church leader.
To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth. 2We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
3I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love.
Truth and Love
4I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do. 5 Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do. 6Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
7Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ. 8So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward. 9Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you. 10 If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them. 11Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds.
Final Greetings
12I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
13Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Wɩa dɩa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ aa pɩ ŋ-na haal-la Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, arɩ ŋ biiriŋ, nɩalɩŋ mɩ sɩ cho woruŋ. Mɩ dʋndʋŋa dee bɩ ma cho, mɩ dɩ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩ jɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la nɛ choma. 2La choma ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ la lɛ nɛ. Ʋ saa jaŋ hɛ la lɛ a kaa mʋ.
3La Nyɩmma Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie Yesu Kirisito lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ba jaŋ fá la nenige, a leŋ dɩ la hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa, a pɛ la lɛ dɩ la sɛnɛ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ a cho dɔŋɔ.
Ʋ maga dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ
4Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ kɩŋkɛŋ mɩ sɩ na arɩ ŋ biiriŋ dɔnsʋŋ to wʋtɩtɩɩ-la lɛ, arɩ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ dagɛla ŋɩɩ. 5Haal, mɩɩ sʋlʋŋ dɩ ŋ to wɩɩ-la dɔŋɔ Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩla bumbuŋ kala. Ʋ bɩ wʋfalɩɩ ŋaa. Ʋ nɛ ŋ-la: Ʋ maga dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ. 6Dɩ la nɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ daga, la sɛnɛ cho Wɩa arɩ nɩaa nɛ. Wɩɩ-la Wɩa fa sɩ bʋla pɩla bumbuŋ kala nɛ ŋ-la: dɩ la cho dɔŋɔ.
7Nɩaa yʋga a hɛ lee-kala dʋnɩa lɛ dɩ ba nyɩsɛ nɩaa. Nɩaa deemba bɩ sɛyɛ arɩ Yesu Kirisito kʋ ŋaa nuhuobiiŋ nɛ a kʋ tuu dʋnɩa. Nʋʋkala sɩ nagɛ nɩaa deemba ŋaa nɩnyɩsɛrʋ nɛ a ŋaa Kirisito dʋndɔŋ-balɩŋ ma. 8Má pɔ ma tɩtɩa lɛ a sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tɩntɩmɩɩ-la ma sɩ tɩma, sɩ́ pɛɩ ŋaa. Ama má tɩŋ ŋɩɩ sɩ maga dɩ Wɩa wuo joŋ ma time kala a pɩma. 9Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ bɩ wɩalɩŋ Kirisito sɩ daga dʋndʋŋa ka to, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa teeŋ hɛ. Ama nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ to wɩalɩŋ Kirisito sɩ daga dʋndʋŋa, ʋ tɩɩna kɛŋ Wɩa arɩ ʋ Bie kala nɛ. 10Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ kɔ ma teeŋ a bɩ wɩaa deemba ka dagɛ, má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ tɩɩna jʋʋ ma dɩa. Má paala sɩ́ ʋ chʋɔlʋ. 11Dɩ nʋʋkala nɛ chʋɔlʋ a kɛnʋ woruŋ, ʋ ma ŋaa ʋ dɔŋɔ tɩɩna nɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.
Wʋkaanaa
12Mɩ kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ mɩ sɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩma. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala teniŋ tʋɔŋ. Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ tɩtɩa kʋ yi ma nɛ a bʋla pɩma, dɩ la kala tʋɔŋ faasa tɔrɛ.
13Ŋ dɩhaala Wɩa sɩ lɩɩsa, ʋ biiriŋ ka chʋɔlʋŋ woruŋ.

english_text:
1 From the church leader.
To my dear friend Gaius.
I love you because we follow the truth, 2dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit. 3It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth. 4Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth.
Working Together
5Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before. 6They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve. 7When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower. 8We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
9I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us. 10So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
11Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
12Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true.
Final Greetings
13I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. 14I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
15I pray that God will bless you with peace!
Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Wɩa dɩa nɩhɩaŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ pɩpɩ ŋ-na Gayas, mɩ nandɔŋ-la mɩ sɩ cho woruŋ.
2Mɩ nandɔŋ-choolii, mɩ Wɩɩsʋlʋŋ nɛ dɩ wɩaa vɛŋ woruŋ a pɩŋ dɩ ŋ kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa a nagɛ wɩaa sɩ zɔmɔ pɩŋ ŋ dɩma lɛ ŋɩɩ. 3Mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɔ nɛ woruŋ la naambiiriŋ sɩ lɩɩ wombiiŋ kʋ bʋla pɩmɛ ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ a tuto wʋtɩtɩɩ-la. Mɩ jɩma ŋɩɩ nɛ ŋ vɛnɛɛ ŋaa. 4Wɩɩkala bɩ leŋe mɩ tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ kɩŋkɛŋ a magɛ mɩ sɩ nɩa arɩ mɩ biiriŋ ka to wʋtɩtɩɩ wombii-la.
Jɔɔŋ bɛsɛ Gayas lɛ
5Mɩ nandɔŋ-choolii, ŋ kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ ŋaa pɩpɩ ŋ dɔnsʋŋ tɩmma-la sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii, arɩ ba sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa ma kala ŋ teeŋ. 6Ba bʋl ŋɩɩ ŋ sɩ cho nɩaa a pɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Ʋ maga dɩ ŋ hɛ doluŋ aŋ pɛ ba lɛ arɩ kɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kaa vɛŋ wombiiŋ. Ŋaa ŋɩɩ sɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ Wɩa tʋɔŋ tɔrɛ, 7bɛɛ wɩaa ba lɩɩ ba dɩɩsɩŋ lɛ dɩ ba tɩŋ Kirisito tɩntɩŋŋaa nɛ. Ba vɩa dɩ ba laa kʋŋkala nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa laa dii teeŋ nɛ. 8Ʋ maga dɩ la nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Wɩa wɩaa dii nɛ pɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ. Dɩ la nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ naga la ma pɛ ba lɛ nɛ ŋɩɩ wʋtɩtɩɩ wombii-la tɩntɩŋŋaa lɛ.
Dayɔtɩfɩs bɩ woruŋ ŋaa
9Mɩ laa sɩpaaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ a pɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi. Ama baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dayɔtɩfɩs hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a fa cho dɩ ʋ ŋaa ma kʋhɩaŋ. Ʋ joŋ harɩŋ yɩa wɩɩ-la mɩ sɩ bʋla nɛ. 10Dɩ mɩ nɛ kɔ, mɩ jaŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩɩ ŋaa a tɩgɛ la lɛ a pɩma. Ʋ yie gɩgaa la harɩŋ a chichei la yɩrɩŋ. Ŋɩɩ ma dʋndʋŋa dee, la naambiiri-la sɩ ŋaa nʋhʋɔraa, dɩ ba nɛ kɔ, ʋ bɩ ba woruŋ ka kɛŋ, aŋ bɩra pɔ nɩalɩŋ ma sɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kɛmba woruŋ, dɩ ba sɩ́ ŋɩɩ ŋaa. Dɩ ba nɛ vɩa aŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, ʋ yie kiriba ta nɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tʋɔŋ.
11Mɩ nandɔŋ choolii, sɩ́ nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ chesu. Ama chichesi nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa Wɩa bii nɛ. Nɩɩ-la ma kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ, ʋ tɩɩna bɩ Wɩa jɩŋ. 12Baal-la ma ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Dɛmɩɩtɩas ŋaa nɩzɔŋ nɛ. Nʋʋkala bʋbʋl ʋ wɩaa woruŋ. Ʋ wʋŋaalaa ma tɩtɩa dagɛ ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩɩ to wʋtɩtɩɩ lɛ. La maa bʋl ʋ wʋzɔŋŋɔɔ wɩaa nɛ. Ma jɩma arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala mɩ sɩɩ bʋl ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ.
Chʋɔlaa
13Mɩ kɛŋ wɩaa yʋgɛ nɛ aa chɛ dɩ mɩ bʋla pɩŋ. Ama mɩ bɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ ba kala teniŋ tʋɔŋ. 14Mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ kɔ ŋ teeŋ nɛ ʋ bɩ dieni, dɩ la hɔnɔ bʋl wɩaa.
15Ŋ jaŋ hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ŋ nandɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ daha ka chʋɔlʋŋ. Ŋ ma chʋɔlɛ la nandɔnsʋŋ kala sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ pɩla.

english_text:
1 From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James.
To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
2I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love!
False Teachers
3My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people. 4Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
5 Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them. 6You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment. 7 We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
8The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels. 9 Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
10But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings. 11 Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
12These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit. 13Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
14 Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said:
Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels 15to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
16These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want.
More Warnings
17My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ. 18 They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God. 19And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
20Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray. 21And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life. 22Be helpful to all who may have doubts. 23Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds.
Final Prayer
24-25Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_text:
1Mɩ-na Juud nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ. Mɩ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito tɩntɩnnʋ nɛ a ŋaa Jeems naambii ma. Mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ yɩra, nɩalɩŋ la Nyɩmma Wɩa sɩ cho, nɩalɩŋ Yesu Kirisito sɩɩ pɔ.
2Wɩa jaŋ fá ma nenige a leŋ dɩ ma kɛŋ yarɩfɩɛlaa kɩŋkɛŋ, a na ŋɩɩ ʋ sɩ choma kɩŋkɛŋ kɩŋkɛŋ.
Juud bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ wʋnyɩɛrɩ kerichiba lɛ
3Mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, mɩ fa cho dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ pɩma nɛ, a bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ ŋɩɩ Wɩa sɩ laa la dɩ ma kala ta lɛ. Ama mɩ na dɩ ʋ maga dɩ mɩ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a sʋlma dɩ ma kala luloo woruŋ a tɩŋ wɩalɩŋ la sɩ laa dii wɩaa. Wɩa joŋ wɩalɩŋ hɛ ʋ nɩaa nɩsɩŋ lɛ bala nɛ. 4Mɩ bʋl wɩɩŋ deeŋ pɩpɩma, bɛɛ wɩaa nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ sɩ bɩ Wɩa ka fá lʋara jʋʋ ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba bɩ Wɩa wombiiŋ ka to, ŋɩɩ wɩaa Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsɛba a leŋ dɩ ba sʋʋ. Wɩa teniŋ tʋɔŋ ba bʋl faafaa kala nɛ dɩ Wɩa jaŋ ŋaa ŋɩɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. Wɩa sɩ fá la nenige a laala ta, ba to ŋɩɩ a kɛŋ Wɩa wʋzɔmɔ-la kaa bɩrɩmɛ a ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. Ba yie bʋl arɩ ba bɩ Yesu Kirisito jɩŋ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa la kala Tɩɩna.
5Ma jɩŋ wɩaa deemba kala mɩ sɩ bʋla pɩpɩma nɛ, ama mɩɩ chɛ dɩ mɩ liisima nɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna fa kɛŋ ʋ nɩaa kaa kʋ lɩɩ Ijipiti tinteeŋ lɛ nɛ, ama ŋɩɩ harɩŋ, ʋ chei nɩalɩŋ sɩ bɩ ʋ wɩaa laa dii nɛ. 6Má sɩ́ yʋ arɩ Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa ma nɛ. Ba fa kɛŋ doluŋ nɛ a bibeŋ leree, ama ba vɩa lere-la ba sɩ hɛ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kɛmba hɛ chɔrʋmɔɔ a bil birimiŋ tʋɔŋ lim. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu, see dɩ tapʋlɩɩ-la Wɩa sɩ jaŋ dii nɩaa sarɩya kʋ yi. 7Ŋɩɩ tɩtɩa nɛ, Wɩa dɔgɩsɛ tasɩ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Sodom arɩ Gomora arɩ tabala-la kala sɩ golli lee-la. Nɩalɩŋ fa sɩ hɛ tasɩ-la tʋɔŋ faa ŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ arɩ disinni-la nuhuobiinee paala sɩ bɩ maga dɩ ba ŋaa nɛ. Wɩa jomba hɛ nyiŋ-la sɩɩ dii deeŋ deeŋ, a bɩ dɩsɛ lɛ nɛ, aa chagɩlɛ nɩalɩŋ kala sɩɩ ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ.
8Nɩalɩŋ sɩ lʋara kʋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ, ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ bumbuŋ nɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dɔgɩsɔ nɛ. Ba yie bʋl arɩ ba na wɩaa duosoo tʋɔŋ, a to ŋɩɩ lɛ a ŋaa wɩaa chei ba tɩtɩa. Ba vɩa Wɩa doluŋ nɛ, aŋ tʋtʋʋsɛ ʋ tɩndaaraa ma sɩ kɛŋ tʋla. 9Ama bʋa-la lɛ Wɩa tɩndaaraa kʋhɩaŋ ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Maakɩl, arɩ Sɩtaanɩ fa sɩ kɛŋ Mosis kʋsʋʋŋ wɩaa yuyuo dɔŋɔ, Maakɩl bɩ wɩɩkala bʋla chei Sɩtaanɩ tʋɔŋ, ama ʋ ta bʋl nɛ arɩ La Tɩɩna Wɩa jaŋ dɔgɩsʋ. 10Ama wɩɩ na-kala nɩaa deemba sɩ bɩ jɩŋ, ba yie bʋl ʋ ŋaa wʋtɔɔ nɛ. Ba wʋŋaalaa nagɛ pʋsʋŋ sɩ bɩ wʋjɩmɩŋ kɛnɛ nɛ. Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩɩ ŋaa tɩtɩa nɛ jaŋ gʋra cheiba. 11Wɩɩŋ puuba. Ba to Keeŋ naabʋɔsʋŋ nɛ. Ba tɩŋ moribiee wɩaa nɛ a ŋaa wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ a nagɛ baal kʋbala ba fa sɩɩ yɩrɛ Balam fa sɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Ba lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ nɛ a nagɛ baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Kora ma fa sɩ lɩɩ Wɩa harɩŋ ŋɩɩ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ Wɩa kpʋ ba kala. 12Dɩ ma nɩalɩŋ sɩ cho dɔŋɔ nɛ hilime dɩ ma dii kɩaa, nɩaa deemba yie guoli ma tʋɔŋ nɛ. Ba nagɛ nanchʋɔsʋŋ nɛ aa chei ma kʋdiile-la. Ba dʋndʋŋa wɩaa nɛ ba yie chɩl. Ba nagɛ duonuŋ sɩ yie tɩŋ nɛ, ka peliŋ ŋaa kiri ʋ bɩ nɩa. Ba bɩra nagɛ tɩɩsɩŋ sɩ maga dɩ ba nɛŋ nɛ aŋ bɩ nɛŋ. Ba jaŋ huro churiba dɩ ba sʋʋ. 13Nɩaa deemba nagɛ lɩɩ-peliŋ sɩ dolie nɛ. Ba hɩɩsɩ wɩalɩŋ ma nagɛ disiniŋ lɩɩ-peliŋ sɩ kaa kʋ lɩɩ ta lɩɩŋ niiŋ. Ba nagɛ chɛnwʋlaa sɩ churo nɛ a mʋ jʋʋ sɛmɛ dɔŋɔ birimiŋ tʋɔŋ lim. Ba jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ a kaa mʋ wuu.
14Baal kʋbala ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Ɛnɔk fa bʋl wɩaa Wɩa doluŋ lɛ faafaa kala nɛ a tɩgɛ nɩaa deemba lɛ. Ʋ fa ŋaa Adam nihi-lɩɛrɩ-pɛmɩŋ nɛ. Ʋ sɩ, “Má bee na, La Tɩɩna Wɩa ka kɔ nɛ arɩ ʋ tɩndaaraa bʋɩ fii fiiba sɩ bɩ disiniŋ kɛnɛ, 15dɩ ʋ dii nʋʋkala sarɩya, a joŋ cheeriŋ pɩ nɩbɔmɔ-la kala a tɩŋ wʋbɔmɔ-la ba sɩ ŋaa, arɩ wʋbɔmɔ-la kala nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ deemba sɩ bʋla a tɩgɛ Wɩa lɛ.” 16Nɩaa deemba yie gʋgʋrɩmɛ wɩaa, a dʋdɔŋ nɩaa, baa to ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ nɛ, a bibigisi ba tɩtɩa lɛ, a kɛŋ nii-sɩma a nyɩsa lɩlaa nɩaa kɩaa.
Juud sɩ chagɩlɛ nɩaa ŋɩɩ
17Ama mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, má liliisi wɩalɩŋ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito nanzɔɔba sɩ bʋla pɩma arɩ ba jaŋ kʋ ŋaa. 18Ba bʋla pɩma arɩ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ, nɩaa jaŋ kɔ a sisieri Wɩa lɛ. Ba jaŋ tuto ba tʋɔbɩɩŋ bɔŋŋɔɔ harɩŋ. 19Nɩdosunuŋ deemba jaŋ kɛmma pɔrɛ dɔŋɔ lɛ a ŋɩŋaa wɩaa arɩ dʋnɩa nɩaa sɩɩ ŋaa ŋɩɩ. Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ tuo ba lɛ. 20Ama ma-na, mɩ nandɔŋ-chooloo, wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɩɩ Wɩa teeŋ nɛ. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má kɛmba woruŋ a waa ba lɛ, a to Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔŋ-la lɛ a chʋchʋɔlɛ Wɩa. 21Wɩa sɩ choma ŋɩɩ, má chɩŋ ŋɩɩ lɛ kpaŋ kpaŋ, a gbɛrɛ La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ kɔ, Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ fá ma nenige a pɩma mɩɩsɩ-la sɩ bɩ dɛrɛ. 22Nɩalɩŋ tʋɔbɩɩnaa sɩ bɩ Wɩa wɩaa lɛ woruŋ chɩna, má fá ba nenige aŋ bʋl Wɩa wɩaa pɩba. 23Nɩalɩŋ sɩɩ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ, má lorigo laaba ta. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ nɩmɛ sɩ maga dɩ ma fá Wɩa aŋ fá ba nenige, ama má kɛŋ ma tɩtɩa dɩ ba wʋbɔmɔ-la sɩ́ ma chol.
24Má leŋ la zizil Wɩa. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ, ʋ jaŋ wuo pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ ŋaa, a pɛ ma lɛ dɩ ma sɩ́ wʋcheeli kala kɛŋ ʋ sɩpaaŋ, a kɛŋ tʋɔtɔrʋŋ woruŋ. 25Ʋ dʋndʋŋa nɛ ŋaa Wɩa, ʋ nɛ to La Tɩɩna Yesu Kirisito lɛ a laala ta. Má dɛnnʋ a leŋ dɩ ʋ yɩrɩŋ yɩrɛ, ʋ nɛ kɛŋ doluŋ a tɩɩ kʋŋkala aa bemba ma, a lɩɩ dɩ-suomuŋ kʋkɔ lɛɛlɛ a kaa mʋ deeŋ deeŋ. Amɩɩ.

english_text:
1This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John. 2And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
3God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
4 From John to the seven churches in Asia.
I pray that you
will be blessed
with kindness and peace
from God, who is and was
and is coming.
May you receive
kindness and peace
from the seven spirits
before the throne of God.
5 May kindness and peace
be yours
from Jesus Christ,
the faithful witness.
Jesus was the first
to conquer death,
and he is the ruler
of all earthly kings.
Christ loves us,
and by his blood
he set us free
from our sins.
6 He lets us rule as kings
and serve God his Father
as priests.
To him be glory and power
forever and ever! Amen.
7 Look! He is coming
with the clouds.
Everyone will see him,
even the ones who stuck
a sword through him.
All people on earth
will weep because of him.
Yes, it will happen! Amen.
8 The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!”
A Vision of the Risen Lord
9I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus. 10On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet. 11The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
12When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands. 13 There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest. 14 His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire. 15 His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall. 16He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
17 When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said:
Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last, 18and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead. 19Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things. 20I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_text:
1Wɩaa deemba nɛ Wɩa joŋo pɩ Yesu Kirisito dɩ ʋ joŋo dagɛ ʋ tɩntɩnnaa, dɩ ba jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa lɛɛlɛ. Wɩa tɩŋ ʋ tɩndaara ʋ kɔ ʋ tɩntɩnna Jɔɔŋ teeŋ a bʋl wɩalɩŋ pʋ. 2Ŋɩɩ nɛ Jɔɔŋ bʋl wɩalɩŋ kala ʋ sɩ na, wɩalɩŋ Wɩa sɩ dagʋ arɩ wɩalɩŋ kala Yesu Kirisito sɩ bʋla pʋ. 3Nɩalɩŋ sɩ karɩmɛ wɩaa deemba nɩaa nɩɩ arɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ jegile nɩɩ wɩaa deemba a laa hɛ ba tʋɔŋ lɛ a tutoba, Wɩa jaŋ pɛ ba lɛ, bɛɛ wɩaa bʋa-la wɩaa deemba sɩ jaŋ ŋaa kpaga nɛ.
Jɔɔŋ chʋɔlɛ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hɛ Esia lɛ
4Mɩ-na Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Wɩa lahɔrɩmɔ lɛ, ʋ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ma hɔŋ arɩ yarɩfɩɛlaa. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ, Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ. Wɩaa deemba lɩɩ Wɩa Dɩnsɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ chɩŋ Wɩa kuoru kpasa-la sɩpaaŋ nɛ 5arɩ Yesu Kirisito teeŋ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa wɩalɩŋ sɩada tɩɩna a kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ. Ʋ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ sʋba aŋ laa sɩpaaŋ sii sʋʋŋ lɛ. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ dʋnɩa kuoroo kala doluŋ. Má leŋ dɩ la dɛnnʋ, a tɩŋ ʋ sɩ chola ŋɩɩ a joŋ ʋ chalɩŋ a jaasɛ, a lɩɩsɛla wʋbɔŋŋɔɔ lɛ. 6Ʋ nɛ leŋe la dɩ ʋ kala dii kuoruŋ a tɩmaa pɩ Wɩa, Nɩɩ-la sɩ ŋaa ʋ Nyɩmma. Ʋ nɛ kɛŋ yɩrɩŋ arɩ doluŋ a kaa mʋ wuu. Amɩɩ. 7Má bee na, ʋ nɛ to duoŋ-bɩlɩmbaanaa tʋɔŋ a kʋkɔ. Nʋʋkala jaŋ naʋ. Nɩalɩŋ ma sɩ joŋ kɩaa tɔbʋ jaŋ naʋ. Dʋnɩa nɩaa kala jaŋ yel ʋ wɩaa. Ŋɩɩ sɛnɛ jaŋ ŋaa. Amɩɩ.
8La Tɩɩna Wɩa sɩ, “Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Alɩfa arɩ Omega. Mɩ-na Wɩa doluŋ kala Tɩɩna, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ faafaa kala arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ kɔ.”
Wɩalɩŋ Jɔɔŋ sɩ na arɩ duosoo tʋɔŋ a tɩgɛ Yesu lɛ
9Mɩ-na ma naambie Jɔɔŋ nɛ ŋmʋnsɛ teniŋ deeŋ a pɩpɩma. A tɩŋ Yesu Kirisito wɩaa nɛ laa na hɛɛŋ. Ama la nɩalɩŋ sɩ na hɛɛ-la ŋɩɩ a tɩŋ ʋ wɩaa, la ma jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa kuorii-la tʋɔŋ. Hɛɛ-la kala lɛ la dii kenyiri nɛ a nyalɩmɛ. Mɩ fa bʋl Wɩa wɩaa nɛ aŋ pɛ ŋaa Yesu Kirisito sɩada tɩɩna. Ŋɩɩ wɩaa nɛ tɩɩ ba kɛmmɛ kaa mʋ tintee kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Patɩmɔs. Lɩɩŋ golli tintee-la kala chu nɛ. 10La Tɩɩna Wɩa tapʋlɩɩ kʋbala nɛ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ doluŋ kʋ hɛ mɩ lɛ woruŋ. Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ nɩɩ nʋʋ yikori-bal mɩ harɩŋ a nagɛ ba sɩɩ ŋmʋʋ banyilliŋ ŋɩɩ. 11Ŋɩɩ nɛ yikoro-la bʋla pɩmɛ, “Ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ kala ŋ sɩ na, a joŋo tɩŋ dɩ ba kaa mʋ pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Ba nɛ ŋ-la: Ɛfɛsɩs, Sɩmɩɩna, Pɛgamɔm, Taataya, Saadɩs, Fɩladɛlɩfɩa arɩ Laadisiya.”
12Ŋɩɩ nɛ mɩ mɩɩra daasɛ harɩŋ dɩ mɩ na nɩɩ-la sɩɩ bʋl wɩaa mɩ teeŋ. Mɩ sɩ daasa, mɩ na chaaŋ daasɩŋ balɩpɛ. Sɛlɩmɛ nɛ ba kaa ŋaa ba kala. 13Ka nʋʋ chɩŋ ba tʋtʋɔbaanɩŋ a nagɛ Nuhuobiine Bie, a laalɛ gɛrɩ-duduoŋ, a kɛŋ sɛlɩmɛ gɛrɩpɛlɩɛɛ-bie a vɔɔ ʋ bɔyɛ. 14Ʋ nyuŋ arɩ ʋ nyu-pʋnaa kala pʋllɛ a nagɛ kuŋkunuŋ, a pʋlla nagɛ bʋrʋŋ sɩ tɔ. Ʋ sɩaa kala nagɛ nyiŋgeliŋ. 15Ʋ naasɩŋ ma nagɛ kɔlɩɩŋ ba sɩ joŋo hɛ nyiniŋ lɛ ʋ fɩɛsɛ. Ʋ yikoro ma nagɛ lɩɩ-balɩŋ sɩɩ pɛllʋ gbul gbul. 16Ka ʋ kori chɛnwʋlaa balɩpɛ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ, tokobiiŋ lɩɩ ʋ niiŋ lɛ a kʋ lɩɩ. Ʋ niiriŋ balɩa kala didii nyagaga. Ka ʋ sɩaa kala tʋtʋl a nagɛ wɩɩpɔsʋŋ sɩ faasa pɔsɛ.
17Mɩ sɩ naʋ ŋɩɩ, mɩ tuu tel ʋ sɩpaaŋ a pɩŋ nɩmɛ chɩm a nagɛ dɩ mɩ sʋba. Ŋɩɩ nɛ ʋ joŋ ʋ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ daŋ mɩ lɛ aŋ bʋla pɩmɛ, “Sɩ́ fawʋllʋŋ fá, mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ arɩ Nɩɩ-la sɩ jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ. 18Mɩ nɛ ŋaa Nɩɩ-la sɩ weye. Mɩ fa sʋba nɛ, ama lɛɛlɛ mɩ weye nɛ a kaa mʋ wuu. Mɩ kɛŋ sʋʋŋ arɩ lɛlɛɛ-jaŋ kala doluŋ nɛ. 19Lɛɛlɛ ŋmʋnsɛ wɩalɩŋ ŋ sɩ na, wɩalɩŋ sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ arɩ wɩalɩŋ sɩ jaŋ ŋaa harɩŋ. 20Wʋkpuŋkpere-la ŋ sɩ na a mʋ tɩgɛ chɛnwʋla-la balɩpɛ ŋ sɩ na mɩ na-diiŋ lɛ arɩ chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ bʋbʋɔŋ nɛ: Chɛnwʋlaa balɩpɛ-la nɛ ŋaa Wɩa tɩndaara-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi a hɛ tasɩ-la balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ nɛ ŋaa nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi tasɩŋ balɩpɛ-la sɩ hɛ Esia tinteeŋ lɛ.

english_text:
The Letter to Ephesus
1This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus:
I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
2I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars. 3You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
4But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to. 5Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand. 6But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
7 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden.
The Letter to Smyrna
8 This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna:
I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
9I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
10Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
11 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.
The Letter to Pergamum
12This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum:
I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
13I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
14 I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral. 15Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans. 16Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
17 If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone.
The Letter to Thyatira
18This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira:
I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
19I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before. 20 But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols. 21I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
22I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop. 23 I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
24Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands. 25But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
26 I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end. 27-28I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.
29If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_text:
Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Ɛfɛsɩs nɩaa
1Ŋmʋŋsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩpɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Ɛfɛsʋs lɛ.
Mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ kori chɛnwʋla-la balɩpɛ mɩ nadiiŋ nɩsɩŋ lɛ a vɩvɛŋ chaaŋ daasɩ-la balɩpɛ tʋɔŋ, mɩ nɛ tɩŋ tɩndaarɩŋ deeŋ.
2Mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ kala ma sɩ ŋaa nɛ. Mɩ na ŋɩɩ ma sɩ tɩma arɩ sɩɩfɩɛsɩŋ nɛ, a dii kenyiri wɩɩkala lɛ. Mɩ jɩma ma dɩ nɩbɔŋŋɔɔ bɩ dɔŋɔ lɛ wuo. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba ŋaa Wɩa nanzɔɔba nɛ, ama ma magɩsɛ nɩaa deemba nɛ a na dɩ baa nyɩɛ nɛ. 3Ma kɛŋ kenyiri nɛ, a na hɛɛŋ mɩ wɩaa aŋ nyalɩmɛ, a ha bɩ lɔlɔ.
4Ama wɩɩ nɛ mɩ kɛŋ a tɩgɛ ma lɛ. Ma fa sɩ chomi ŋɩɩ bumbuŋ-la, ma bɩra bɩ mɩ ŋɩɩ cho. 5Má bɩɩna yi wɩalɩŋ lɛ a sɩ́ tele. Má bɩrɩma lɩɩ a ŋɩŋaa wɩalɩŋ ma fa sɩɩ ŋaa bumbuŋ-la. Dɩ ŋɩɩ dee, mɩ jaŋ kʋ joŋ ma chaaŋ daaŋ. 6Ama wɩɩ-la ma sɩ ŋaa mɩ cho nɛ ŋ-la: Ma bɛrɛ Nɩkɔlaata nɩaa wʋŋaalaa nɛ arɩ mɩ ma sɩ bɛrɛ ba wʋŋaalaa ŋɩɩ.
7Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋlaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii a hihilimi lee-kala Esia lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ leŋ dɩ ʋ dii tɩa-la nɛnɛɛ sɩɩ pɩ nɩaa mɩɩsɩŋ a hɛ Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.
Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Sɩmɩɩna nɩaa
8Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Sɩmɩɩna lɛ.
Wɩaa deemba lɩɩ mɩ-na Nɩɩ-la fa sɩ hɛ nɩmɛ bumbuŋ kala teeŋ nɛ, aŋ ha jaŋ hɛ nɩmɛ dʋnɩa dɩdɛrɩŋ. Mɩ sʋba nɛ, aŋ bɩra sii sʋʋŋ lɛ.
9Mɩ jɩŋ wɩalɩŋ sɩɩ walɩmɛma nɛ, a jɩŋ ŋɩɩ ma sɩ summo, ama Wɩa teeŋ, ma ŋaa kuoroo nɛ. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ nɩmɛ aa chei ma yɩrɩŋ. Nɩaa deemba joŋ ba tɩtɩa arɩ ba ŋaa Juu tɩmma nɛ aŋ bɩ Juu tɩmma ŋaa. Baa to Sɩtaanɩ harɩŋ nɛ. 10Má sɩ́ leŋe dɩ fawʋllʋŋ kɛmma a mʋ tɩgɛ hɛɛ kala ma sɩ jaŋ na lɛ. Mɩ bʋlaa pɩma, Sɩtaanɩ jaŋ magɩsɛ ma dɔnsʋŋ a leŋ dɩ ba kɛmma tɔ bɩnɩŋ dɩa. Ma jaŋ na hɛɛŋ a yi tapʋlaa fii. Dɩ ba nɩɩ chɛ dɩ ba kpʋma ma, ma-na ha chɩŋ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii lɛ. Dɩ ma nɛ ŋaa ŋɩɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ mɩɩ-zɔmʋŋ pɩma Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ.
11Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋlaa pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi lee-na kala Esia lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ wuo yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, dɩ ʋ nɛ sʋba, ʋ bɩ jaŋ jʋʋ Wɩa nyiniŋ.
Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Pɛgamɔm nɩaa
12Bɩra ŋmʋnsɛ wɩaa deemba a pɩ Wɩa tɩndaarʋ-la sɩɩ beŋ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi taŋ-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Pɛgamɔm lɛ.
Mɩ-na nɩɩ-la sɩ kori tokobiiŋ niiriŋ balɩa kala sɩɩ dii nyagaga nɩɩ bʋl wɩaa deemba.
13Mɩ jɩŋ lee-la ma sɩ hɛ nɛ, nɩmɛ nɛ Sɩtaanɩ dii kuoruŋ. Ama ma ha kɛŋ wʋtɩtɩɩ nɛ a mʋ tɩgɛ mɩ yɩrɩŋ lɛ. Ma bɩ wɩalɩŋ ma sɩ laa dii joŋo ta bʋa-la lɛ ba sɩ kpʋ Antɩpas sɩ ŋaa wʋtɩtɩɩ tɩɩna a bʋl wɩaa a tɩgɛ mɩ lɛ. Ba kpʋʋ ma tabalɩŋ lɛ nɛ, lee-la Sɩtaanɩ sɩ hɛ.
14Ma ŋaa kukeri nɛ, ama wɩaa baŋmɛnɛ nɛ ma ŋaa chei. Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a tuto wɩalɩŋ baal-la ba sɩɩ yɩrɛ Balam fa sɩɩ dagʋ. Ʋ nɛ dagɛ kuoru kʋbala baa yɩrɛ Balak dɩ ʋ nyɩsɛ Iziral tɩŋŋaa dɩ ba didii vʋɩyaa kɩaa aŋ pɛ ŋɩŋaa wʋlɩɩlɩŋ. 15Nɩaa dɔnsʋŋ ma hɛ ma tʋɔŋ a tuto wʋbɔmɔ-la Nɩkɔlaata tɩmma-la sɩɩ dagʋ. 16Ŋɩɩ wɩaa, má bɩrɩma lɩɩ wɩalɩŋ lɛ, dɩ ŋɩɩ dee mɩ jaŋ kɔ lɛɛlɛ a kɛŋ mɩ niiŋ wʋbʋlaa sɩ nagɛ tokobiiŋ, a yuoma.
17Dɩgɩlaa tɩŋŋaa, má wuoli ma dɩgɩlaa a nɩɩ wɩalɩŋ Wɩa Dɩŋ-zɔmʋŋ sɩ bʋla pɩ nɩalɩŋ sɩ laa Yesu wɩaa dii aa hilimi Esia tinteeŋ lɛ. Nɩɩ-la kala sɩ yuo dii Sɩtaanɩ, mɩ jaŋ joŋ kʋdiile-la sɩ faa Wɩa-jaŋ lɛ a pʋ, a joŋ tabɩɩ-pʋla ma a pʋ. Mɩ jaŋ ŋmʋnsɛ yɩrɩ-falɩŋ a hɛ tabɩɩ-la lɛ. Yɩrɩ-la nʋʋkala bɩ jaŋ jɩmʋ, see nɩɩ-la sɩ laa tabɩɩ-la dʋndʋŋa.”
Wɩalɩŋ ba sɩ ŋmʋnsa pɩ Taataya nɩaa
